articles.title: Autel Expands Nissan Diagnostic and ADAS Access
articles.author: Brake and Front End Staff

paras.en: Autel U.S. has released diagnostic and ADAS software updates for Nissan vehicles using the Consult 4 platform. The updates expand bidirectional control and ADAS calibration access across supported North American vehicles.
paras.zh: Autel U.S. 已使用 Consult 4 平台为日产汽车发布了诊断和 ADAS 软件更新。这些更新扩展了受支持的北美车辆的双向控制和 ADAS 校准访问。

paras.en: The Nissan diagnostic software is available on supported MaxiSYS Ultra and Ultra S2 tablets. ADAS calibration capability is available on these tablets with ADAS calibration software installed.
paras.zh: Nissan 诊断软件可在受支持的 MaxiSYS Ultra 和 Ultra S2 平板电脑上使用。这些安装了 ADAS 校准软件的平板电脑上提供 ADAS 校准功能。

paras.en: Available functions depend on the vehicle and system. They include ECU information, code reading and clearing, live data, Active Tests and ADAS calibration procedures.
paras.zh: 可用功能取决于车辆和系统。其中包括 ECU 信息、代码读取和清除、实时数据、主动测试和 ADAS 校准程序。

paras.en: Supported Autel tablets access protected vehicle functions through AutoAuth. The independent service works with manufacturers and aftermarket tool providers to verify shops, technicians and tools for secure vehicle access.
paras.zh: 支持的 Autel 平板电脑通过 AutoAuth 访问受保护的车辆功能。该独立服务与制造商和售后工具提供商合作，验证商店、技术人员和工具以确保车辆安全访问。

paras.en: Authenticated Access for Newer Nissan Platforms
paras.zh: 对较新 Nissan 平台进行身份验证的访问

paras.en: Nissan began incorporating security-gateway protections into select North American vehicles with the 2020 model year. These protections restrict designated bidirectional functions unless the technician, shop and diagnostic tool receive proper authentication.
paras.zh: 日产开始将安全网关保护纳入 2020 年款的精选北美车辆中。这些保护措施限制指定的双向功能，除非技术人员、车间和诊断工具得到适当的认证。

paras.en: Autel has offered AutoAuth-based Nissan security-gateway access for several years. The access applies to vehicles supported by Nissan’s Consult-III plus diagnostic platform.
paras.zh: Autel 多年来一直提供基于 AutoAuth 的 Nissan 安全网关访问。该访问权限适用于日产 Consult-III plus 诊断平台支持的车辆。

paras.en: Nissan introduced its newer web-based Consult 4 diagnostic software for the 2023 Nissan Ariya. The automaker now uses the software on a growing number of newer vehicle platforms.
paras.zh: Nissan 为 2023 款 Nissan Ariya 推出了更新的基于网络的 Consult 4 诊断软件。该汽车制造商现在在越来越多的新型车辆平台上使用该软件。

paras.en: Supporting protected functions required Autel to develop and validate a compatible authorization process. The process works with the vehicles’ newer electronic architectures.
paras.zh: 支持受保护的功能需要 Autel 开发并验证兼容的授权流程。该过程适用于车辆更新的电子架构。

paras.en: Autel’s new capability expands diagnostic and ADAS calibration access across supported Nissan vehicles using Consult 4.
paras.zh: Autel 的新功能使用 Consult 4 扩展了支持的 Nissan 车辆的诊断和 ADAS 校准访问。

paras.en: Available functions depend on the vehicle and system. They include ECU information, code reading and clearing, live data, Active Tests and ADAS calibration procedures.
paras.zh: 可用功能取决于车辆和系统。其中包括 ECU 信息、代码读取和清除、实时数据、主动测试和 ADAS 校准程序。

paras.en: North American Nissan vehicles using Consult 4 include:
paras.zh: 使用 Consult 4 的北美 Nissan 车辆包括：

paras.en: - 2025 and newer Nissan Kicks, Murano, Pathfinder and Armada
paras.zh: - 2025 年及更新款 Nissan Kicks、Murano、Pathfinder 和 Armada

paras.en: Autel issued the expanded capabilities through the Nissan_V7.40 diagnostic software and Nissan_ADAS V5.20 software released on Sept. 9.
paras.zh: Autel通过9月9日发布的Nissan_V7.40诊断软件和Nissan_ADAS V5.20软件发布了扩展功能。

paras.en: Access requires an active Autel software subscription and an active AutoAuth account for Nissan access. ADAS calibration also requires applicable Autel software, equipment, targets and accessories.
paras.zh: 访问需要有效的 Autel 软件订阅和有效的 AutoAuth 帐户才能进行 Nissan 访问。 ADAS 校准还需要适用的 Autel 软件、设备、目标和配件。

paras.en: Supported Consult 4 vehicle coverage does not require a separate AutoAuth service tier. Eligible users can obtain the software releases through the standard update process on their Autel tablet.
paras.zh: 支持的 Consult 4 车辆覆盖范围不需要单独的 AutoAuth 服务层。符合条件的用户可以通过 Autel 平板电脑上的标准更新流程获取软件版本。

articles.title: Brake Job: 2020–2026 Buick Encore GX
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: I was recently working on an ASE A5 test-prep article, and we reached the section on parking brakes. Most parking brakes act on the rear wheels, so the test is structured around that arrangement. But some vehicles have parking brakes on the front wheels. I knew that some older Saabs and Datsuns used front-wheel parking brakes. One modern example is the Buick Encore GX.
paras.zh: 我最近正在撰写 ASE A5 测试准备文章，我们到达了有关驻车制动器的部分。大多数驻车制动器作用于后轮，因此测试是围绕这种安排进行的。但有些车辆的前轮装有驻车制动器。我知道一些老式萨博和达特桑使用前轮驻车制动器。别克 Encore GX 就是现代的一个例子。

paras.en: On these models, pulling the park-brake switch sends a signal to the Electronic Brake Control Module. The module supplies 12 volts to the apply-control circuits and ground to the release-control circuits, activating the left and right park-brake actuators and applying the brakes.
paras.zh: 在这些型号上，拉动驻车制动开关会向电子制动控制模块发送信号。该模块向应用控制电路提供 12 伏电压，并向释放控制电路提供接地电压，从而激活左右驻车制动执行器并应用制动器。

paras.en: Pressing the switch sends a signal to the module to release the brakes. The module supplies 12 volts to the release-control circuits and ground to the apply-control circuits, activating the actuators and releasing the brakes. Depending on the vehicle, the switch may be a push-button style. Pressing it commands the parking brakes to apply or release based on their current position.
paras.zh: 按下开关会向模块发送信号以释放制动器。该模块向释放控制电路提供 12 伏电压，并向应用控制电路提供接地电压，从而激活执行器并释放制动器。根据车辆的不同，开关可能是按钮式的。按下它可以命令驻车制动器根据当前位置应用或释放。

paras.en: The parking brake will release automatically if the engine is running, the vehicle is shifted into gear, and the driver attempts to move off. Avoid rapid acceleration while the parking brake is applied to help preserve the parking-brake lining.
paras.zh: 如果发动机正在运转、车辆挂档且驾驶员试图起步，驻车制动器将自动释放。使用驻车制动器时避免快速加速，以帮助保护驻车制动器衬片。

paras.en: The Electronic Brake Control Module, also called the Brake System Control Module, controls the park-brake motor circuits and runs diagnostics to verify that they are operating properly.
paras.zh: 电子制动控制模块，也称为制动系统控制模块，控制驻车制动电机电路并运行诊断以验证它们是否正常运行。

paras.en: To replace the brake pads, the park-brake caliper pistons must be fully retracted. There are two ways to put the parking brake into service mode. The preferred method is to use a scan tool with a service-mode function. If you do not have a compatible scan tool, use this procedure:
paras.zh: 要更换刹车片，驻车制动卡钳活塞必须完全缩回。有两种方法可以将驻车制动器置于维修模式。首选方法是使用具有服务模式功能的扫描工具。如果您没有兼容的扫描工具，请使用以下过程：

paras.en: - Turn the ignition on with the engine off.
paras.zh: - 在发动机关闭的情况下打开点火装置。

paras.en: - Press the accelerator pedal halfway down.
paras.zh: - 将油门踏板踩到一半。

paras.en: - Move the park-brake switch to the release position and hold it for 10 seconds. Release the switch.
paras.zh: - 将驻车制动开关移至释放位置并保持 10 秒钟。松开开关。

paras.en: - Within five seconds, move the switch to the release position again.
paras.zh: - 在五秒钟内，再次将开关移至释放位置。

paras.en: The actuator bolts to the back of the caliper and is not included with a replacement caliper. If you remove the actuator, GM recommends replacing the caliper’s O-ring. Front-wheel parking brakes may be a novelty, but they make an interesting piece of trivia to test your technician friends on.
paras.zh: 执行器用螺栓固定在卡钳的背面，并且不包含在替换卡钳中。如果拆下执行器，GM 建议更换卡钳的 O 形圈。前轮驻车制动器可能是一个新奇事物，但它们是一个有趣的琐事，可以测试您的技术人员朋友。

articles.title: ACT Flags Supply Constraints as Truck Orders Slow
articles.author: Kevin Linger

paras.en: ACT Research’s truck market outlook for October 2026 pointed to higher costs and supply chain constraints as challenges for equipment buyers and manufacturers. Preliminary North American Class 8 orders totaled 18,700 units in September, down 9.5% year-over-year (Y/Y).
paras.zh: ACT Research 对 2026 年 10 月卡车市场的展望指出，成本上升和供应链限制是设备买家和制造商面临的挑战。 9月份北美8级汽车初步订单总数为18,700辆，同比下降9.5%。

paras.en: The trailer market showed stronger order activity. U.S. trailer net orders rose more than 55% month-over-month (M/M), while orders through August were up 40% year-to-date (YTD). ACT said the gains signaled renewed momentum as manufacturers opened their 2027 order books early.
paras.zh: 拖车市场订单活跃度较高。美国拖车净订单环比 (M/M) 增长超过 55%，而截至 8 月份的订单今年迄今 (YTD) 增长 40%。 ACT 表示，随着制造商提前开放 2027 年订单，这一涨幅预示着新的势头。

paras.en: Equipment Demand Meets Planning Uncertainty
paras.zh: 设备需求满足规划的不确定性

paras.en: Underlying U.S. private domestic demand posted its strongest growth in more than three years in Q2 2026, according to ACT. Investment in artificial intelligence and resilient manufacturing activity helped offset continued weakness in housing.
paras.zh: ACT 的数据显示，2026 年第二季度，美国私人国内需求出现三年多来最强劲的增长。对人工智能和弹性制造业活动的投资帮助抵消了房地产市场的持续疲软。

paras.en: Tariffs, elevated energy prices, and rising interest rates nevertheless constrained purchasing power and increased business costs. Higher borrowing costs and supply chain disruptions also weighed on capital equipment demand.
paras.zh: 然而，关税、能源价格上涨和利率上升限制了购买力并增加了商业成本。借贷成本上升和供应链中断也影响了资本设备需求。

paras.en: For truck buyers, uncertainty surrounding the Environmental Protection Agency’s (EPA) 2027 rule continued to complicate planning. ACT also pointed to Class 8 backlogs that were materially higher than a year earlier.
paras.zh: 对于卡车买家来说，环境保护局 (EPA) 2027 年规则的不确定性继续使规划变得复杂化。 ACT 还指出，8 类积压订单大幅高于一年前。

paras.en: “Fleets are eager to replace aging equipment and prepare for anticipated cost increases, but the ability to plan remains hampered by economic and regulatory uncertainty as well as, at least into the medium-term, the evolving supply chain landscape,” said Ken Vieth, ACT’s president and senior analyst. “The recent decline in Class 8 orders in part reflects not only these headwinds, but materially higher backlogs now than at this time last year, and the impact of uncertainty around the final EPA’27 rule. Rather than a sudden drop in underlying demand, in the case of Class 8, fleets weigh their options in a shifting market.”
paras.zh: ACT 总裁兼高级分析师 Ken Vieth 表示：“船队渴望更换老化设备，并为预期的成本增加做好准备，但规划能力仍然受到经济和监管不确定性以及至少在中期不断变化的供应链格局的阻碍。” “近期 8 级订单的下降在一定程度上不仅反映了这些不利因素，还反映了现在的积压订单比去年同期大幅增加，以及 EPA'27 最终规则的不确定性的影响。就 8 级而言，车队并不是潜在需求的突然下降，而是在不断变化的市场中权衡自己的选择。”

paras.en: Trailer Production Faces Supplier and Material Constraints
paras.zh: 拖车生产面临供应商和材料限制

paras.en: The October 2026 truck market outlook also raised questions about how quickly trailer manufacturers could increase production to meet demand. ACT identified emerging steel and aluminum shortages and suppliers whose ability to deliver at higher volumes remained untested.
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月的卡车市场前景还引发了关于拖车制造商能够以多快的速度增加产量以满足需求的问题。 ACT 发现了新出现的钢铁和铝短缺问题，而供应商的大批量供货能力仍未得到检验。

paras.en: “In the trailer segment, strong order activity is encouraging, but the next test will be the industry’s ability to ramp production quickly into a rising demand environment,” Vieth said. “Many new suppliers, brought in to navigate around recent tariffs, remain untested at scale, and shortages of key materials like steel and aluminum are emerging. The challenge ahead will be matching production capacity with rising demand amid ongoing cost pressures.”
paras.zh: 维特表示：“在拖车领域，强劲的订单活动令人鼓舞，但下一个考验将是该行业在需求不断增长的环境中快速提高产量的能力。” “许多为应对近期关税而引入的新供应商仍未经过大规模测试，钢铁和铝等关键材料的短缺正在出现。未来的挑战将是在持续的成本压力下使产能与不断增长的需求相匹配。”

articles.title: Caliber Auto Glass Acquires Arrow Auto Glass
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Caliber Auto Glass, part of the Caliber family of automotive repair and service brands, announced its acquisition of Arrow Auto Glass. Arrow Auto Glass is an established auto glass service provider headquartered in Kingston, Pennsylvania. The acquisition expands Caliber Auto Glass’s reach into four additional states, bringing its presence to 44 of the lower 48 states.
paras.zh: Calibre Auto Glass 是 Calibre 汽车维修和服务品牌系列的一部分，宣布收购 Arrow Auto Glass。 Arrow Auto Glass 是一家成熟的汽车玻璃服务提供商，总部位于宾夕法尼亚州金斯顿。此次收购将 Calibre Auto Glass 的业务扩展到另外 4 个州，使其业务覆盖美国本土 48 个州中的 44 个州。

paras.en: Caliber Expands Auto Glass Service Network
paras.zh: Calibre 扩大汽车玻璃服务网络

paras.en: The acquisition builds on Caliber Auto Glass’s existing network of auto glass repair, replacement and calibration services. Through its trained technicians and mobile service capabilities, Caliber Auto Glass provides windshield chip repairs and vehicle glass replacements. The company also offers advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) calibration services. The company supports commercial fleet customers and works with major insurance providers to help simplify the repair process.
paras.zh: 此次收购建立在 Calibre Auto Glass 现有的汽车玻璃维修、更换和校准服务网络的基础上。通过训练有素的技术人员和移动服务能力，Calibre Auto Glass 提供挡风玻璃碎片维修和车辆玻璃更换。该公司还提供高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）校准服务。该公司为商业车队客户提供支持，并与主要保险公司合作，帮助简化维修流程。

paras.en: Modern vehicles increasingly rely on cameras and sensors integrated into windshields. Proper glass replacement and calibration play an important role in vehicle safety. Caliber Auto Glass offers services to address these evolving repair requirements. The company also provides a limited lifetime nationwide warranty on eligible glass repairs and replacements.
paras.zh: 现代车辆越来越依赖集成到挡风玻璃上的摄像头和传感器。正确的玻璃更换和校准对于车辆安全起着重要作用。 Calibre Auto Glass 提供的服务可满足这些不断变化的维修需求。该公司还为符合条件的玻璃维修和更换提供有限终身全国保修。

paras.en: “Arrow has built a strong regional business with a dedicated team and a longstanding commitment to its customers,” said Troy Mason, senior vice president and general manager of Caliber Auto Glass. “We are excited to welcome Arrow’s teammates to the Caliber family. This acquisition allows us to extend our reach into new markets while continuing to focus on the quality, safety and service our customers depend on.”
paras.zh: Calibre 汽车玻璃高级副总裁兼总经理 Troy Mason 表示：“Arrow 凭借专业团队和对客户的长期承诺，建立了强大的区域业务。” “我们很高兴欢迎 Arrow 的团队成员加入 Calibre 大家庭。此次收购使我们能够将业务范围扩展到新市场，同时继续专注于客户所依赖的质量、安全和服务。”

paras.en: Arrow Auto Glass has served customers throughout the eastern United States for many years. The company provides auto glass repair, replacement and recalibration services. The companies will continue operating separately in the near term, with plans to integrate Arrow into Caliber Auto Glass in the future.
paras.zh: Arrow Auto Glass 多年来一直为美国东部地区的客户提供服务。该公司提供汽车玻璃维修、更换和重新校准服务。两家公司将在短期内继续独立运营，并计划在未来将 Arrow 整合到 Calibre Auto Glass 中。

paras.en: “We are incredibly proud of our Arrow team,” said Bill Cogswell, president of Arrow Auto Glass. “Their commitment to supporting one another and, most importantly, our customers is what drives us each and every day. Joining with Caliber will provide additional resources, opportunities for our teammates and a continued commitment to servicing our customers.”
paras.zh: “我们为 Arrow 团队感到无比自豪，”Arrow 汽车玻璃总裁 Bill Cogswell 说道。 “他们对彼此支持的承诺，最重要的是对我们客户的支持，是我们每天的动力。加入 Calibre 将为我们的团队成员提供额外的资源和机会，并持续致力于为客户提供服务。”

paras.en: The company said the acquisition reflects Caliber Auto Glass’s continued focus on expanding its service network. The company also continues investing in expertise, technology and resources to support drivers as vehicle repair requirements evolve.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，此次收购反映了 Calibre Auto Glass 继续致力于扩大其服务网络。该公司还继续投资于专业知识、技术和资源，以随着车辆维修需求的发展为驾驶员提供支持。

articles.title: Tekmetric Appoints Former Toast CEO to Board
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: Tekmetric announced the appointment of Chris Comparato to its board of directors. Comparato, former chairman and CEO of Toast, joins the board as an independent member. Comparato spent nine years leading Toast, a company that develops software for restaurant owners. He now brings that experience to Tekmetric, which develops software for auto repair shops.
paras.zh: Tekmetric 宣布任命 Chris Comparato 为其董事会成员。 Toast 前董事长兼首席执行官 Comparato 作为独立成员加入董事会。 Comparato 领导了一家为餐厅老板开发软件的公司 Toast 九年。现在，他将这些经验带到了 Tekmetric，该公司为汽车维修店开发软件。

paras.en: Tekmetric Adds Software Industry Veteran
paras.zh: Tekmetric 聘请软件行业资深人士

paras.en: In a news release announcing Comparato’s appointment, Tekmetric noted that restaurants and auto repair shops face many of the same pressures. Both are owner-led businesses that operate on long hours and tight margins, where every tool must justify its cost. Comparato brings experience building and scaling software for businesses like these. Comparato served as chairman and CEO of Toast from 2015 to 2023. Under his leadership, Toast grew from $1 million to more than $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. The company also expanded into new products and markets.
paras.zh: 在宣布 Comparato 任命的新闻稿中，Tekmetric 指出，餐馆和汽车维修店面临着许多相同的压力。两者都是所有者主导的企业，运营时间长，利润微薄，每种工具都必须证明其成本合理。 Comparato 为此类企业带来了构建和扩展软件的经验。 Comparato 于 2015 年至 2023 年间担任 Toast 董事长兼首席执行官。在他的领导下，Toast 的年度经常性收入从 100 万美元增长到超过 10 亿美元。该公司还扩展到新产品和市场。

paras.en: Earlier in his career, Comparato led customer success at Acquia and Endeca, which Oracle acquired in 2011. He holds a bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering from Union College.
paras.zh: 在其职业生涯早期，Comparato 领导了 Acquia 和 Endeca 的客户成功（Oracle 于 2011 年收购了这两家公司）。他拥有联合学院机械工程学士学位。

paras.en: “Our customers trust Tekmetric with their livelihoods, and they expect it to work as hard as they do,” said Lauren Langston, president of Tekmetric. “We wanted a board member who knows what it takes to build software for owner-operators at scale, and Chris brings that experience from Toast.”
paras.zh: Tekmetric 总裁 Lauren Langston 表示：“我们的客户信任 Tekmetric 的生计，他们希望 Tekmetric 能够像他们一样努力工作。” “我们想要一位知道如何为业主运营商大规模构建软件的董事会成员，Chris 带来了 Toast 的经验。”

paras.en: Comparato Brings Experience in Business Growth
paras.zh: Comparato 带来业务增长经验

paras.en: Comparato led Toast through years of rapid growth. His experience will help Tekmetric’s leadership make decisions that support the long-term health of its customers’ businesses.
paras.zh: Comparato 带领 Toast 经历了多年的快速增长。他的经验将帮助 Tekmetric 的领导层做出支持客户业务长期健康发展的决策。

paras.en: “The restaurant owners I worked alongside at Toast were some of the hardest-working people I’ve known, and everyone who keeps a shop running, from the owner to the technician, shares that same grit,” said Comparato. “What drew me to Tekmetric was the team Sunil and Lauren have built, and how closely they listen to the people they serve. That’s the kind of company I want to help build.”
paras.zh: “与我一起在 Toast 工作的餐厅老板是我所认识的最勤奋的人，每个维持商店运营的人，从老板到技术人员，都拥有同样的勇气，”Comparato 说。 “吸引我加入 Tekmetric 的是 Sunil 和 Lauren 建立的团队，以及他们对所服务的人的倾听程度。这就是我想帮助建立的公司。”

paras.en: “Every decision at Tekmetric starts with what’s right for the shop owner,” said Sunil Patel, founder and CEO of Tekmetric. “Everyone who joins us, including our board, has to care about shop owners as deeply as we do. Chris understood that commitment from our first conversation. I’m grateful to have his perspective in the room.”
paras.zh: Tekmetric 创始人兼首席执行官 Sunil Patel 表示：“Tekmetric 的每项决策都从适合店主的角度出发。” “加入我们的每个人，包括我们的董事会，都必须像我们一样深切地关心店主。克里斯从我们第一次谈话中就明白了这一承诺。我很高兴能在房间里听到他的观点。”

articles.title: AutoZone President and CEO Phil Daniele on ‘Putting Customers First’
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Phil Daniele, president and CEO, customer satisfaction, AutoZone.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 AutoZone 客户满意度部门总裁兼首席执行官 Phil Daniele。

paras.en: Daniele said the company’s commercial business has evolved significantly as it continues investing in the professional repair market. With commercial sales approaching $6 billion and programs in approximately 95% of its stores, AutoZone is strengthening its product quality, availability and delivery capabilities to better serve repair shops. Daniele emphasized the importance of OE-quality or better products, including its Duralast portfolio, alongside expanded assortments through its hub and mega hub strategy. Investments in technology, inventory optimization and a dedicated professional sales force are helping AutoZone get the right parts to shops faster while building stronger customer relationships.
paras.zh: Daniele 表示，随着公司继续投资专业维修市场，其商业业务已取得显着发展。 AutoZone 的商业销售额接近 60 亿美元，并在其约 95% 的商店中实施了该计划，因此正在加强其产品质量、可用性和交付能力，以更好地为维修店提供服务。 Daniele 强调了原厂品质或更好产品的重要性，包括其 Duralast 产品组合，以及通过其中心和大型中心战略扩大的品种。对技术、库存优化和专业销售队伍的投资正在帮助 AutoZone 更快地将合适的零件送到商店，同时建立更牢固的客户关系。

paras.en: AutoZone’s recent milestone of 8,000 stores globally reflects decades of expansion and continued growth opportunities, Daniele explained. The company also celebrated its 1,000th store in Mexico, expanded distribution capabilities there and broke ground on another facility. Looking ahead, AutoZone plans to continue opening stores across the United States, Mexico and Brazil. Daniele said that expansion creates opportunities not only to serve more customers but also to develop future leaders within the organization. AutoZone’s promote-from-within culture has helped employees build long-term careers, with many executives beginning their careers in stores.
paras.zh: Daniele 解释说，AutoZone 最近在全球拥有 8,000 家门店的里程碑反映了数十年的扩张和持续增长机会。该公司还庆祝其在墨西哥开设第 1,000 家商店，扩大了当地的分销能力，并在另一家工厂破土动工。展望未来，AutoZone 计划继续在美国、墨西哥和巴西开设门店。 Daniele 表示，扩张不仅创造了服务更多客户的机会，而且还为组织内培养未来的领导者创造了机会。 AutoZone 的内部晋升文化帮助员工建立了长期的职业生涯，许多高管都是在商店开始他们的职业生涯的。

paras.en: Delivering “WOW! customer service” remains central to AutoZone’s culture and operating philosophy. Daniele said empowering approximately 130,000 AutoZoners to consistently exceed customer expectations requires strong systems, processes and accountability. For professional repair shops, that means delivering quality parts quickly, ensuring accurate transactions and understanding each customer’s specific needs. Daniele emphasized that every interaction, from sales representatives to delivery drivers, contributes to the customer experience. By combining operational execution with a customer-first mindset, AutoZone aims to strengthen relationships and deliver the level of service that keeps customers coming back.
paras.zh: 提供“哇！客户服务”仍然是 AutoZone 文化和运营理念的核心。 Daniele 表示，要让大约 130,000 名 AutoZoners 持续超越客户期望，需要强大的系统、流程和问责制。对于专业维修店来说，这意味着快速交付优质零件、确保准确的交易并了解每个客户的具体需求。 Daniele 强调，从销售代表到送货司机的每一次互动都有助于提升客户体验。通过将运营执行与客户至上的理念相结合，AutoZone 旨在加强关系并提供高水平的服务，让客户成为回头客。

paras.en: To hear more of Daniele’s insights, be sure to watch the above video.
paras.zh: 要了解 Daniele 的更多见解，请务必观看上面的视频。

paras.zh: • AutoZone 如何投资于产品质量、库存可用性和交付能力，以更好地为专业维修店提供服务。 （8:34）

paras.zh: • AutoZone 的 8,000 家门店里程碑对未来的扩张和员工职业机会意味着什么。 （15:21）

articles.title: Advance Auto Parts Foundation Awards 24 Scholarships
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Advance Auto Parts Foundation today announced the recipients of its 2026 scholarship program, awarding 24 scholarships to students pursuing higher education. The annual program helps family members of Advance Auto Parts team members continue their education and work toward earning degrees.
paras.zh: Advance Auto Parts Foundation 今天宣布了 2026 年奖学金计划的获得者，向接受高等教育的学生颁发了 24 份奖学金。该年度计划帮助 Advance Auto Parts 团队成员的家庭成员继续接受教育并努力获得学位。

paras.en: This year’s recipients stood out for their academic achievement, leadership, community involvement, personal accomplishments and future goals. Each student will receive a one-time scholarship of $3,500 to support their education.
paras.zh: 今年的获奖者在学术成就、领导力、社区参与、个人成就和未来目标方面脱颖而出。每位学生将获得 3,500 美元的一次性奖学金，以支持他们的学业。

paras.en: “Supporting our team members also means supporting their families, and we’re proud to recognize these students and their achievements,” said Anthony Sarlanis, president of the Advance Auto Parts Foundation and senior vice president, professional at Advance Auto Parts. “Their hard work and dedication have earned this recognition, and we’re proud to help them take the next step in their education. We congratulate each recipient and look forward to seeing all they accomplish in the years ahead.”
paras.zh: “支持我们的团队成员也意味着支持他们的家庭，我们很自豪能够认可这些学生和他们的成就，”Advance Auto Parts 基金会主席兼 Advance Auto Parts 专业高级副总裁 Anthony Sarlanis 说道。 “他们的辛勤工作和奉献精神赢得了这一认可，我们很自豪能够帮助他们在教育上迈出下一步。我们祝贺每位获奖者，并期待看到他们在未来几年取得的成就。”

articles.title: 2,000-year-old tomb of an elite nomad in Mongolia contained a Roman glass cup and Han-dynasty-inspired jade decorations
articles.author: Kristina Killgrove

paras.en: Archaeologists have unearthed a massive 2,000-year-old tomb of an elite nomad from the Xiongnu Empire in Central Asia. The nine-level tomb contained more than 400 grave goods and is the largest Xiongnu tomb ever found in Mongolia.
paras.zh: 考古学家在中亚发掘了一座拥有 2000 年历史的巨型陵墓，墓主人是来自中亚匈奴帝国的精英游牧民族。墓葬共九层，随葬品400余件，是蒙古迄今发现的规模最大的匈奴墓葬。

paras.en: Archaeologists identified the enormous tomb full of riches during a four-year excavation at the site of Duurlig Nars in northern Mongolia, according to a translated statement from the National Museum of Korea, whose researchers have been excavating the site in cooperation with the Institute of Archaeology of the Mongolian Academy of Sciences and the National Museum of Mongolia.
paras.zh: 根据韩国国家博物馆的一份翻译声明，考古学家在蒙古北部杜尔利格纳尔斯遗址进行了四年的挖掘过程中，发现了这座充满财富的巨大坟墓。韩国国家博物馆的研究人员一直在与蒙古科学院考古研究所和蒙古国家博物馆合作挖掘该遗址。

paras.en: Duurlig Nars is the largest noble burial complex of the Xiongnu Empire, with nearly 300 ancient burial mounds called kurgans. The Xiongnu, also known as the Hunnu, were a collection of nomadic tribes who coalesced into a mobile empire on the Mongolian steppe in 209 B.C. The Xiongnu were connected to a broad trading network that stretched from the Roman Empire in the West to China and the Korean Peninsula in the East.
paras.zh: 杜里格纳尔斯是匈奴帝国最大的贵族墓葬群，拥有近 300 个被称为库尔干的古墓葬群。匈奴，也称为匈奴，是一群游牧部落的集合，他们于公元前 209 年在蒙古草原上联合成一个移动帝国。匈奴与一个广泛的贸易网络​​相连，该网络从西部的罗马帝国延伸到东部的中国和朝鲜半岛。

paras.en: When the Xiongnu Empire fractured in the late first century B.C., one band moved west, picking up new tribes and eventually becoming the horde known as the Huns. Both the Xiongnu and the Huns were well known for their fighting and horseback riding skills.
paras.zh: 当匈奴帝国在公元前一世纪末分裂时，一支部落向西迁移，建立了新的部落，最终成为被称为匈奴的部落。匈奴和匈奴都以战斗和骑马技巧而闻名。

paras.en: The newly announced tomb is roughly square, with a long passageway extending from it, according to the statement. Including the passageway, the tomb is about 240 feet (73 meters) long, roughly the size of the Great Sphinx of Giza. Archaeologists discovered nine concentric layers of stone, each smaller than the last, going down around 48 feet (14.5 m) deep, making the tomb a kind of inverted pyramid.
paras.zh: 声明称，新公布的坟墓大致呈正方形，有一条长长的通道从墓穴延伸出来。包括通道在内，坟墓长约 240 英尺（73 米），大致相当于吉萨大狮身人面像的大小。考古学家发现了九层同心石层，每一层都比上一层小，深入约 48 英尺（14.5 m），使坟墓成为一种倒金字塔。

paras.en: Jade "bi" discs unearthed on the floor of the coffin.
paras.zh: 棺材地板上出土了玉“碧”盘。

paras.en: A glass cup with a handle, possibly made in the Roman Empire.
paras.zh: 带把手的玻璃杯，可能是罗马帝国制造的。

paras.en: Archaeologists unearthed a wooden carriage from one of the tomb layers.
paras.zh: 考古学家从其中一层墓葬中出土了一辆木制马车。

paras.en: In the tomb's central chamber, archaeologists found a wooden burial chamber with a coffin. The burial chamber is smaller than other elite Xiongnu burials, according to the statement, which may suggest that the society was changing and Xiongnu power was declining when the tomb was created in the late first to second century A.D.
paras.zh: 在坟墓的中央墓室中，考古学家发现了一个木制墓室，里面有一具棺材。声明称，该墓室比其他匈奴精英墓葬要小，这可能表明该墓葬于公元一二世纪末期，当时社会正在发生变化，匈奴势力正在衰落。

paras.en: Artifacts found in the tomb show the extent of the Xiongnu's connections across Eurasia 2,000 years ago, according to the statement. Among the grave goods recovered from the tomb were silver-and-quartz accessories crafted to decorate horses, as well as a wheel from a lacquered horse-drawn carriage, suggesting the tomb's occupant was a person of high social status.
paras.zh: 声明称，墓中发现的文物显示了 2000 年前匈奴在欧亚大陆的联系范围。墓中出土的随葬品包括装饰马匹的银质和石英饰品，以及漆制马车的车轮，表明墓主人社会地位很高。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Additionally, archaeologists found evidence of connections with the Han dynasty, which arose around 200 B.C. and was the second imperial dynasty of ancient China. On the bottom of the wooden coffin, archaeologists recovered 15 flat, overlapping pieces of jade.
paras.zh: 此外，考古学家还发现了与公元前 200 年左右兴起的汉朝有联系的证据。是中国古代第二个皇朝。在木棺的底部，考古人员发现了15块扁平、重叠的玉石。

paras.en: - Archaeologists have found dozens more sacrificed horses in 2,800-year-old burial in Siberia that's eerily similar to Scythian graves
paras.zh: - 考古学家在西伯利亚一处 2800 年前的墓葬中发现了数十匹被牺牲的马，该墓葬与斯基泰人的坟墓极其相似

paras.en: - 5,300-year-old kidney stone the size of a grape found in Bronze Age man's burial near Black Sea
paras.zh: - 在黑海附近青铜时代男子的墓葬中发现了一颗葡萄大小的肾结石，已有 5,300 年历史

paras.en: - 'The most shameful form of execution': Han warriors found dismembered in 2,100-year-old mass grave in Mongolia
paras.zh: - “最可耻的处决形式”：蒙古2100年历史乱葬坑中发现汉武士被肢解

paras.en: Han dynasty burials of important people often included at least one "bi," the term for a jade disk. But unlike the typically circular "bi," the jade pieces in the Xiongnu tomb are irregular and have elaborate designs engraved on them, according to the statement. This may suggest that the Xiongnu adopted a Han burial practice but put their own spin on it.
paras.zh: 汉代重要人物的墓葬中通常至少有一个“璧”，意为玉盘。但声明称，与典型的圆形“璧”不同，匈奴墓中的玉器是不规则的，上面刻有精美的图案。这可能表明匈奴采用了汉族的丧葬习俗，但又融入了自己的风格。

paras.en: Archaeologists also found a broken cup in the tomb. The transparent glass cup with a handle may have been manufactured in the Roman Empire, the archaeologists believe. Additional tests will be carried out to try to determine where the glass cup was made.
paras.zh: 考古学家还在墓中发现了一个破碎的杯子。考古学家认为，带把手的透明玻璃杯可能是在罗马帝国制造的。还将进行额外的测试，以确定玻璃杯的制造地点。

paras.en: So far, archaeologists are unsure who was buried in the tomb. But they plan to use DNA analysis techniques on the teeth and hair they recovered from the coffin to figure out the person's chromosomal sex and whether the individual was related to other people interred in the Duurlig Nars burial complex. According to the statement, future analyses of this important tomb will help archaeologists paint a more detailed picture of ancient Xiongnu society two millennia ago.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，考古学家还不确定墓中埋葬的是谁。但他们计划对从棺材中找到的牙齿和头发使用 DNA 分析技术，以确定此人的染色体性别，以及此人是否与埋葬在 Duurlig Nars 墓葬群中的其他人有亲属关系。声明称，未来对这座重要墓葬的分析将有助于考古学家更详细地描绘两千年前的古代匈奴社会。

paras.en: Kristina Killgrove is a staff writer at Live Science with a focus on archaeology and paleoanthropology news. Her articles have also appeared in venues such as Forbes, Smithsonian, and Mental Floss. Kristina holds a Ph.D. in biological anthropology and an M.A. in classical archaeology from the University of North Carolina, as well as a B.A. in Latin from the University of Virginia, and she was formerly a university professor and researcher. She has received awards from the Society for American Archaeology and the American Anthropological Association for her science writing.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫 (Kristina Killgrove) 是《Live Science》的特约撰稿人，专注于考古学和古人类学新闻。她的文章还发表在《福布斯》、《史密森尼》和《Mental Floss》等杂志上。克里斯蒂娜拥有博士学位。北卡罗来纳大学生物人类学学士学位和古典考古学硕士学位，以及北卡罗来纳大学古典考古学学士学位。她拥有弗吉尼亚大学拉丁语学位，曾任大学教授和研究员。她因其科学写作而获得美国考古学会和美国人类学协会颁发的奖项。

articles.title: Striking photo shows tardigrade laying egg in its discarded skin — 'incredibly beautiful and unexpected'
articles.author: Pandora Dewan

paras.en: It's not often we get to peer into the tiny world of tardigrades (also known as water bears). But through his photography, biologist Gonzalo Quiroga-Artigas is unmasking the secret lives of these creatures in stunning detail.
paras.zh: 我们很少能看到缓步动物（也称为水熊虫）的微小世界。但生物学家贡萨洛·基罗加-阿蒂加斯通过他的摄影，以惊人的细节揭开了这些生物的秘密生活。

paras.en: In one photo, which won Quiroga-Artigas 12th place in Nikon's 2026 Photomicrography Competition, a tardigrade (Hypsibius exemplaris) is seen shedding its tough outer layer, known as a cuticle or an exuvium, while laying an egg in the discarded skin.
paras.zh: Quiroga-Artigas 在尼康 2026 年显微摄影大赛中获得第 12 名的照片中，可以看到一只缓步动物（Hypsibius exemplaris）正在脱落其坚硬的外层（称为角质层或蜕皮），同时在废弃的皮肤上产卵。

paras.en: "A large part of my research involves imaging, and during the many hours I spend at the confocal microscope, I have come across some incredibly beautiful and unexpected scenes," Quiroga-Artigas, a postdoctoral researcher at the Montpellier Cell Biology Research Center in France, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 法国蒙彼利埃细胞生物学研究中心的博士后研究员 Quiroga-Artigas 在一封电子邮件中告诉《Live Science》：“我的研究很大一部分涉及成像，在我在共聚焦显微镜前度过的许多时间里，我遇到了一些令人难以置信的美丽和意想不到的场景。”

paras.en: "An interesting feature of tardigrade reproduction is that some species lay their eggs inside the shed cuticle, or exuvium. The exuvium can therefore provide an additional layer of physical protection for the developing embryos."
paras.zh: “缓步动物繁殖的一个有趣特征是，一些物种将卵产在脱落的角质层或蜕皮内。因此，蜕皮可以为发育中的胚胎提供额外的物理保护层。”

paras.en: In some species, males may place sperm inside the cuticle of a molting female before egg laying, according to National Geographic. In others, the males fertilize the eggs after they have been left inside the cuticle. And some don't even need males to reproduce at all.
paras.zh: 据《国家地理》报道，在某些物种中，雄性可能会在产卵前将精子放入正在蜕皮的雌性的角质层内。在其他情况下，雄性将卵留在角质层内后使其受精。有些甚至根本不需要雄性来繁殖。

paras.en: "Many species reproduce through parthenogenesis," Quiroga-Artigas said, which is when an embryo develops from an unfertilized egg, also known as a virgin birth. "This means that males are not required for reproduction, and the resulting offspring are genetically very similar to their mothers," he added. The species in the photograph falls into this category.
paras.zh: 基罗加-阿蒂加斯说：“许多物种通过孤雌生殖进行繁殖，”这是指胚胎从未受精卵发育而来，也称为处女分娩。 “这意味着繁殖不需要雄性，而且产生的后代在基因上与母亲非常相似，”他补充道。照片中的物种属于这一类。

paras.en: Molting and egg laying often take place over several hours, but the shedding itself is a relatively fast process. Capturing it on camera is, therefore, no mean feat.
paras.zh: 蜕皮和产卵通常需要几个小时，但脱落本身是一个相对较快的过程。因此，用相机捕捉它绝非易事。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "Once I had collected animals that were laying eggs, I had to fix, stain, and mount the specimens before imaging them," Quiroga-Artigas said. "I then spent a long microscopy session searching for the right specimen and the right orientation to obtain a high-quality image. Finding a specimen at exactly the right stage of molting, and in an orientation that allows the process to be clearly visualized, is largely a matter of patience and luck."
paras.zh: “一旦我收集了正在产卵的动物，我就必须在对它们进行成像之前修复、染色和安装标本，”基罗加-阿蒂加斯说。 “然后，我花了很长时间寻找正确的标本和正确的方向，以获得高质量的图像。找到处于完全正确的蜕皮阶段的标本，并且方向能够使整个过程清晰可见，很大程度上需要耐心和运气。”

paras.en: Photographing these animals is also challenging due to their tiny size. "Working with tardigrades in the lab requires a lot of experience with micromanipulation, as they are extremely small," Quiroga-Artigas said. "Hypsibius exemplaris, for example, is only about 250 µm [micrometers] long." That's about twice the width of a human hair.
paras.zh: 由于它们体型很小，拍摄这些动物也具有挑战性。 Quiroga-Artigas 说：“在实验室中研究缓步动物需要大量的显微操作经验，因为它们非常小。” “例如，Hypsibius exemplaris 的长度只有约 250 µm [微米]。”这大约是人类头发宽度的两倍。

paras.en: This particular photo was taken using confocal microscopy, which uses a focused laser beam to light up one section at a time to create a detailed, high-resolution image. Quiroga-Artigas used this technique for a second tardigrade photo that was listed as an Image of Distinction in the same competition.
paras.zh: 这张特殊的照片是使用共焦显微镜拍摄的，它使用聚焦激光束一次照亮一个部分，以创建详细的高分辨率图像。 Quiroga-Artigas 使用这种技术拍摄了第二张缓步动物照片，该照片在同一比赛中被列为杰出图像。

paras.en: He also received an Honorable Mention in the Nikon Small World in Motion Competition for a video of a pregnant tardigrade making contact with another tardigrade, which can then be seen pooping. However, it's not clear whether the contact between the two individuals caused this movement, Quiroga-Artigas said.
paras.zh: 他还在尼康运动小世界大赛中获得了荣誉奖，因为他拍摄了一段视频，视频中一只怀孕的缓步动物与另一只缓步动物接触，然后可以看到缓步动物排便。然而，基罗加-阿蒂加斯说，目前尚不清楚这两个人之间的接触是否导致了这一运动。

paras.en: Quiroga-Artigas hopes his photography and videos give viewers an idea of just how beautiful and complex the microscopic world really is. "There are tiny animals all around us that we cannot see with the naked eye, yet they live, reproduce, grow, and undergo complex life cycles just like the animals we are more familiar with," he said.
paras.zh: Quiroga-Artigas 希望他的摄影和视频能让观众了解微观世界到底是多么美丽和复杂。 “我们周围有很多肉眼看不见的微小动物，但它们就像我们更熟悉的动物一样生活、繁殖、生长，经历复杂的生命周期，”他说。

paras.en: "I will continue capturing images of tardigrades in different contexts related to my future research, without necessarily having a specific photographic goal in mind," he added. "In my experience, some of the best images I have captured were not necessarily the ones I was actively looking for."
paras.zh: “我将继续在与我未来的研究相关的不同背景下捕捉缓步动物的图像，而不必考虑特定的摄影目标，”他补充道。 “根据我的经验，我拍摄到的一些最好的图像不一定是我正在积极寻找的图像。”

paras.en: Pandora is the trending news editor at Live Science. She is also a science presenter and previously worked as Senior Science and Health Reporter at Newsweek. Pandora holds a Biological Sciences degree from the University of Oxford, where she specialised in biochemistry and molecular biology.
paras.zh: 潘多拉 (Pandora) 是 Live Science 的热门新闻编辑。她还是一名科学主持人，此前曾担任《新闻周刊》的高级科学与健康记者。潘多拉拥有牛津大学生物科学学位，专攻生物化学和分子生物学。

articles.title: ​​Homo erectus and Denisovans may have lived alongside each other in China, study suggests
articles.author: Chris Simms

paras.en: Homo erectus was adaptable enough to live in rainforests in what is now southern China and may have lived alongside Denisovans there, two new studies hint.
paras.zh: 两项新研究暗示，直立人的适应能力足以生活在现在中国南部的雨林中，并且可能与那里的丹尼索瓦人一起生活。

paras.en: The research is based on the incredibly rare findings of nine fossil teeth from ancient humans — eight from H. erectus and one from a mystery human in the genus Homo. The teeth reveal that H. erectus lived in China much more recently than previously thought and that this population likely devoured tropical food found there.
paras.zh: 这项研究基于对古代人类九颗牙齿化石的极其罕见的发现——其中八颗来自直立人，一颗来自人属的神秘人类。这些牙齿表明，直立人生活在中国的时间比之前想象的要晚得多，而且这个种群很可能吞食那里发现的热带食物。

paras.en: "I think it's exciting because it means that there are two hominin populations occupying these rainforest conditions there at the same time," study first author Frido Welker, a molecular palaeoanthropologist at the University of Copenhagen in Denmark, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 研究第一作者、丹麦哥本哈根大学分子古人类学家弗里多·韦尔克 (Frido Welker) 告诉《生活科学》杂志：“我认为这很令人兴奋，因为这意味着有两个古人类种群同时占据了这些雨林条件。”

paras.en: H. erectus is generally seen as the first human species to venture out of Africa, after evolving about 2 million years ago. It spread through eastern Eurasia, reaching China and Indonesia between about 1.6 million and 1.8 million years ago. It is one of the longest-surviving hominin species, and the last known record of it is from 108,000 years ago in river flood plains in Java, Indonesia. However, there was no physical evidence of H. erectus being on the Asian mainland more recently than 400,000 years ago.
paras.zh: 直立人通常被视为第一个走出非洲的人类物种，经过大约 200 万年前的进化。它穿过欧亚大陆东部，在大约 160 万至 180 万年前到达中国和印度尼西亚。它是现存最长寿的人类物种之一，其最后的已知记录是 108,000 年前在印度尼西亚爪哇河漫滩上发现的。然而，没有任何物理证据表明直立人在 40 万年前就曾出现在亚洲大陆。

paras.en: But in two caves in Guangxi province in southern China, researchers have found thousands of mammalian fossils, accumulated there by porcupines that scavenged for and collected bones. The Baxian and Naxian caves are about 9 miles (15 kilometers) apart, sitting in a karst landscape of limestone formations that are prone to dissolving to create caves that would have offered crucial shelter for H. erectus.
paras.zh: 但在中国南部广西省的两个洞穴中，研究人员发现了数千个哺乳动物化石，这些化石是由豪猪在其中寻找和收集骨头而积累的。巴仙洞穴和纳仙洞穴相距约 9 英里（15 公里），坐落在石灰岩地貌的喀斯特地貌中，这些石灰岩地层很容易溶解形成洞穴，为直立人提供了重要的庇护所。

paras.en: Researchers found the nine human teeth among more than 18,000 fossils, including from apes, elephants, rhinoceroses and other ancient hoofed animals, Welker and his colleagues reported in a study published Wednesday (Nov. 18) in the journal Nature.
paras.zh: 韦尔克和他的同事在周三（11 月 18 日）《自然》杂志上发表的一项研究中报告说，研究人员在 18,000 多块化石中发现了 9 颗人类牙齿，这些化石包括猿、大象、犀牛和其他古代有蹄动物。

paras.en: Radiometric dating of the fossils and surrounding sediments by methods including assessing the decay of uranium, pins them to about 324,000 to 184,000 years ago. Eight of the teeth have physical features reminiscent of H. erectus, but the ninth is more elusive. It looks distinct from H. erectus, Neanderthals and modern humans, Welker said.
paras.zh: 通过评估铀衰变等方法对化石和周围沉积物进行放射性测年，将其确定为大约 324,000 至 184,000 年前。其中八颗牙齿的物理特征让人想起直立人，但第九颗牙齿则更加难以捉摸。韦尔克说，它看起来与直立人、尼安德特人和现代人类不同。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Welker's team took samples from five teeth — four from the group that seemed to be H. erectus and one from the mysterious tooth — to see which ancient proteins were present, since DNA tends to degrade more easily than the proteins in an organism. (The study of these proteins is known as proteomics.)
paras.zh: 韦尔克的团队从五颗牙齿中采集了样本——其中四颗来自似乎是直立人的牙齿，一颗来自神秘的牙齿——来看看存在哪些古老的蛋白质，因为DNA往往比生物体中的蛋白质更容易降解。 （对这些蛋白质的研究称为蛋白质组学。）

paras.en: The four similar ones had protein signatures that matched what had been seen before in H. erectus.
paras.zh: 这四个相似的蛋白质特征与之前在直立人中看到的特征相匹配。

paras.en: "The morphology is nicely confirmed by the proteomics," Welker told Live Science. Three of these teeth were from males, and the other was from a female, which the team was able to determine based on the presence or absence of amelogenin-Y, a protein coded for only by the Y chromosome.
paras.zh: “蛋白质组学很好地证实了这种形态，”韦尔克告诉《生活科学》。其中三颗牙齿来自男性，另一颗来自女性，研究小组能够根据牙釉蛋白-Y（一种仅由 Y 染色体编码的蛋白质）是否存在来确定。

paras.en: However, some parts of the protein signatures differed from what had been seen in other H. erectus remains in China, so the new specimens may be from a previously unknown H. erectus population that perhaps had a slightly different genetic makeup, Welker said.
paras.zh: 然而，蛋白质特征的某些部分与中国其他直立人遗骸中发现的不同，因此新标本可能来自以前未知的直立人种群，该种群的基因组成可能略有不同，韦尔克说。

paras.en: The finding that H. erectus was present in mainland Asia until at least 184,000 years ago — rather than 400,000 years ago — fills a geographical and chronological gap, helping to explain how H. erectus was on Java 108,000 years ago.
paras.zh: 直立人至少在 184,000 年前（而不是 400,000 年前）就存在于亚洲大陆，这一发现填补了地理和时间上的空白，有助于解释 108,000 年前直立人是如何在爪哇岛存在的。

paras.en: "This brings the history of H. erectus in East Asia closer in age to the late Javanese examples, raising the possibility that these populations were connected through land bridges at times of lowered sea level," Chris Stringer, a paleoanthropologist at the Natural History Museum in London who was not involved in the research, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 伦敦自然历史博物馆的古人类学家克里斯·斯金格（Chris Stringer）没有参与这项研究，他在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》杂志：“这使得东亚直立人的历史与爪哇晚期的例子更加接近，这增加了这些种群在海平面下降时期通过陆桥相连的可能性。”

paras.en: John Hawks, an anthropologist at the University of Wisconsin-Madison who wasn't involved in the study, previously believed that specimens from the past 400,000 years or so flagged as H. erectus were actually Denisovans — ancient humans who lived in Asia, disappeared around 30,000 years ago and belonged to the Homo longi lineage. But he told Live Science that the new morphological and protein findings provide convincing evidence that H. erectus did survive until relatively recently in some places.
paras.zh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的人类学家约翰·霍克斯（John Hawks）并未参与这项研究，他此前认为，过去 40 万年前被标记为直立人的标本实际上是丹尼索瓦人——生活在亚洲的古代人类，大约在 3 万年前消失，属于长人谱系。但他告诉《生活科学》杂志，新的形态和蛋白质发现提供了令人信服的证据，证明直立人直到最近才在某些地方生存。

paras.en: The fifth analyzed tooth, known as PA1796, remains mysterious. The protein analysis revealed it was from a male, but it didn't show a recognizable signature in the protein sequence data. Therefore, Welker's team suggested it could be from another hominin species that was present in the region at the same time.
paras.zh: 第五颗被分析的牙齿被称为 PA1796，仍然是个谜。蛋白质分析显示它来自男性，但蛋白质序列数据中没有显示出可识别的特征。因此，韦尔克的团队认为它可能来自同时存在于该地区的另一种古人类物种。

paras.en: Welker didn’t want to speculate about which species it might be, but said: "Sequence-wise it doesn't have this Homo erectus substitution and morphologically, it doesn't look like an erectus tooth."
paras.zh: 韦尔克不想猜测它可能是什么物种，但他说：“从序列上看，它没有这种直立人的替代，从形态上看，它看起来不像直立人的牙齿。”

paras.en: The tooth could be from a previously unknown human species, but many experts suspect it is from a Denisovan.
paras.zh: 这颗牙齿可能来自以前未知的人类物种，但许多专家怀疑它来自丹尼索瓦人。

paras.en: "With some of the new material probably dating to less than 200,000 years old, this already brings it close in age to known or putative Homo longi/Denisovan samples in southern China and Laos, implying potentially long overlaps between these species," Stringer said. "Tooth PA1796 could represent a longi/Denisovan, though it is relatively small in size, and relevant comparative data for longi/Denisovans is sparse."
paras.zh: 斯金格说：“由于一些新材料的历史可能不到20万年，这已经使其年龄与中国南部和老挝已知或推定的长人/丹尼索瓦人样本的年龄接近，这意味着这些物种之间可能存在长期重叠。” “牙齿 PA1796 可能代表长吉/丹尼索瓦人，尽管它的尺寸相对较小，而且长吉/丹尼索瓦人的相关比较数据很少。”

paras.en: Recent research suggests there was interbreeding between the H. erectus and Denisovan lineages, and the new evidence increases the likelihood that this happened, at least occasionally, Stringer said.
paras.zh: 斯特林格说，最近的研究表明直立人与丹尼索瓦人血统之间存在杂交，新的证据增加了这种情况发生的可能性，至少偶尔发生。

paras.en: Any firm conclusions of who the tooth is from will have to wait for further finds of similar teeth elsewhere, Welker said.
paras.zh: 韦尔克说，关于这颗牙齿来自谁的任何确切结论都必须等待在其他地方进一步发现类似的牙齿。

paras.en: Hawks agreed that the tooth is most likely from a Denisovan, perhaps from a divergent branch for which we don't have protein data. But it could also be from a novel H. erectus population or someone from the same population as the other teeth who, for developmental or genetic reasons, wasn't typical. "I would have liked to see additional comparisons in the paper to more Denisovan teeth," Hawks said.
paras.zh: 霍克斯一致认为，这颗牙齿很可能来自丹尼索瓦人，也许来自我们没有蛋白质数据的不同分支。但它也可能来自一个新的直立人种群，或者来自与其他牙齿相同种群的人，但由于发育或遗传原因，这些牙齿并不典型。 “我希望在论文中看到与更多丹尼索瓦人牙齿的更多比较，”霍克斯说。

paras.en: In another paper, also published Nov. 18 in the journal Nature, Kira Westaway, a geochronologist at Macquarie University in Sydney, and her colleagues examined trace elements in the same teeth, as well as in animal teeth from the caves, to see what they revealed about the hominins' diet and local habitat.
paras.zh: 在另一篇同样发表在 11 月 18 日《自然》杂志上的论文中，悉尼麦格理大学的地质年代学家 Kira Westaway 和她的同事检查了相同牙齿以及洞穴中动物牙齿中的微量元素，以了解它们对古人类饮食和当地栖息地的揭示。

paras.en: Their analysis indicated that this H. erectus population found plants and animals to eat in tropical, rainforest-like ecosystems. Previously, it was thought that only our own species, Homo sapiens, was able to adapt to this type of environment.
paras.zh: 他们的分析表明，直立人种群在热带雨林式生态系统中找到了可食用的植物和动物。此前，人们认为只有我们自己的物种——智人——能够适应这种环境。

paras.en: "Rather than being confined to open woodland and grassland environments, H. erectus was considerably more ecologically adaptable than many of us have assumed," Stringer said.
paras.zh: “直立人并不局限于开阔的林地和草原环境，它的生态适应性比我们许多人想象的要强得多，”斯特林格说。

paras.en: "Being adaptable and being flexible are not traits that we associate with ancient human species — these are traits that we associate with H. sapiens," Westaway told Live Science. "Suddenly we're seeing H. erectus being able to survive in environments that we didn't think they could possibly survive in."
paras.zh: “适应能力和灵活性并不是我们与古代人类物种相关的特征，而是我们与智人相关的特征，”韦斯特韦告诉《生活科学》。 “突然间，我们看到直立人能够在我们认为它们不可能生存的环境中生存。”

paras.en: And given the mysterious tooth, it is possible that two different early human populations were this adaptable, said Welker, who was a co-author of the study.
paras.zh: 该研究的合著者韦尔克说，考虑到这颗神秘的牙齿，两个不同的早期人类群体可能具有如此强的适应性。

paras.en: Westaway and her colleagues also looked at levels of the element strontium in the teeth, which can shed light on where someone grew up based on the unique strontium levels in water and foods they consumed as children. The team matched these strontium levels to another karst landscape about 200 miles (320 km) away, in the Red River valley of northern Vietnam.
paras.zh: 韦斯特韦和她的同事还研究了牙齿中锶元素的含量，这可以根据一个人小时候所喝的水和食物中独特的锶含量来了解一个人在哪里长大。研究小组将这些锶含量与约 200 英里（320 公里）外、越南北部红河谷的另一个喀斯特地貌相匹配。

paras.en: "It looks like H. erectus moved across large areas, traversing this karst landscape in the rainforests" — a finding that adds to our understanding of these ancient humans, Westaway said.
paras.zh: 韦斯特韦说：“看起来直立人跨越了大片区域，穿越了雨林中的喀斯特地貌”——这一发现增加了我们对这些古代人类的了解。

paras.en: - 'Absolute surprise': Homo erectus skulls found in China are almost 1.8 million years old — the oldest evidence of the ancient human relatives in East Asia
paras.zh: -“绝对令人惊讶”：在中国发现的直立人头骨已有近 180 万年的历史——东亚古代人类亲戚的最古老证据

paras.en: - Our extinct cousins the Denisovans had a 'distinctive' appearance, new analysis reveals
paras.zh: - 新的分析显示，我们已灭绝的表亲丹尼索瓦人具有“独特”的外观

paras.en: - Neanderthal DNA still survives in our human family tree. What were our ancient relatives' relationships like?
paras.zh: - 尼安德特人的 DNA 仍然存在于我们人类的家谱中。我们古代的亲戚关系是怎样的？

paras.en: It's absurd that people often think of H. erectus as an unsuccessful species, she added. "We think they were the first to leave Africa, the first to use fire. It blows my mind because they survived six times longer than H. sapiens has survived so far, so I don't see them as unsuccessful."
paras.zh: 她补充说，人们常常认为直立人是一个不成功的物种，这是荒谬的。 “我们认为他们是第一个离开非洲的人，第一个使用火的人。这让我大吃一惊，因为他们的生存时间是智人迄今为止生存时间的六倍，所以我不认为他们是不成功的。”

paras.en: Hawks' big question, however, is linked to modern humans, who were in the Chinese region from at least 45,000 years ago.
paras.zh: 然而，霍克斯的大问题与现代人类有关，现代人类至少在 45,000 年前就生活在中国地区。

paras.en: "Denisovan DNA is present in the peoples of Island Southeast Asia, so, modern humans must have run into Denisovans at some point," he said. "If H. erectus was enduring in the same area at the same time, might H. sapiens also have encountered late H. erectus?"
paras.zh: “丹尼索瓦人的 DNA 存在于东南亚岛屿的人民中，因此，现代人类一定在某个时候遇到了丹尼索瓦人，”他说。 “如果直立人同时在同一地区生存，那么智人是否也遇到了晚期直立人？”

paras.en: Liao, W., Zanolli, C., Ásmundsdóttir, R. D., Wu, Z., Yi, Z., Villa-Islas, V., Fagernäs, Z., Troché, G., Zhou, K., Feng, X., Liu, F., Olsen, J. paras.en: What do you know about early humans? Test your knowledge with our human origins quiz!
paras.zh: 关于早期人类，你了解多少？通过我们的人类起源测验测试您的知识！

paras.en: Chris Simms is a freelance journalist who previously worked at New Scientist for more than 10 years, in roles including chief subeditor and assistant news editor. He was also a senior subeditor at Nature and has a degree in zoology from Queen Mary University of London. In recent years, he has written numerous articles for New Scientist and in 2018 was shortlisted for Best Newcomer at the Association of British Science Writers awards.
paras.zh: 克里斯·西姆斯 (Chris Simms) 是一名自由撰稿人，曾在《新科学家》杂志工作了 10 多年，担任过首席副主编和助理新闻编辑等职务。他还是《自然》杂志的高级副编辑，并拥有伦敦玛丽女王大学动物学学位。近年来，他为《新科学家》撰写了大量文章，并于2018年入围英国科学作家协会奖最佳新人奖。

articles.title: Medieval Readers Saw Floods, Plagues and Comets as Omens of Doom—So They Created a Mysterious Manuscript of Apocalyptic Artworks to Peruse at Will

paras.en: In the Bible, God’s will often emerges through natural phenomena. The great flood cleanses the earth of human corruption, while the rainbow symbolizes the divine covenant “between God and every living creature.” For millennia, worshippers familiar with these stories have wondered: What meaning can be found in the movements of storms, seas and stars?
paras.zh: 在圣经中，神的旨意常常通过自然现象显现出来。大洪水净化了地球上的人类腐败，而彩虹则象征着“上帝与所有生物之间”的神圣契约。几千年来，熟悉这些故事的崇拜者一直在想：风暴、海洋和星星的运动有何意义？

paras.en: That’s the central question of The Book of Miracles, an illustrated manuscript dating to the mid-16th century. Featuring 167 imaginative paintings, the text begins with episodes from the Old Testament and ends with apocalyptic visions from the Book of Revelation. Between them is a catalog of earthquakes, comet sightings, locust plagues, volcanic eruptions and other events spanning antiquity through the manuscript’s creation.
paras.zh: 这是《奇迹之书》的核心问题，这是一本可追溯至 16 世纪中叶的插图手稿。该文本以 167 幅富有想象力的画作为特色，以《旧约》中的情节开始，以《启示录》中的世界末日景象结束。在它们之间是一系列地震、彗星目击、蝗灾、火山爆发和手稿创作过程中跨越古代的其他事件的目录。

paras.en: Now, The Book of Miracles is heading to the auction block, where it’s expected to fetch between roughly $920,000 and $1.3 million. Bidders can vie for the volume during Christie’s Valuable Books and Manuscripts sale on December 10.
paras.zh: 现在，《奇迹之书》正在拍卖，预计售价约为 92 万至 130 万美元。竞标者可以在 12 月 10 日的佳士得珍贵书籍和手稿拍卖会上争夺该书。

paras.en: “The artists of The Book of Miracles have reinterpreted historical and contemporary sources with apocalyptic panache,” per the lot listing. Illustrations of earthquakes, floods and other natural disasters that occurred in Europe are “among the most energetic, imaginative and colorful illustrations in the manuscript.”
paras.zh: 拍品清单上写道：“《奇迹之书》的艺术家们以世界末日般的气派重新诠释了历史和当代的资料。”欧洲发生的地震、洪水和其他自然灾害的插图是“手稿中最有活力、最富有想象力和色彩缤纷的插图之一”。

paras.en: The text was rediscovered in the library of a Bavarian castle about two decades ago. It’s since changed hands several times. After acquiring the manuscript, London art dealer James Faber helped date it to the 16th century. The publisher Taschen released a facsimile edition in 2013.
paras.zh: 大约二十年前，该文本在巴伐利亚城堡的图书馆中被重新发现。此后它又易手数次。伦敦艺术品经销商詹姆斯·费伯 (James Faber) 获得这份手稿后，帮助确定其年代为 16 世纪。出版商 Taschen 于 2013 年发行了传真版。

paras.en: Because The Book of Miracles depicts about a dozen events near Augsburg, a city in modern-day Germany, scholars think it may have been created there. Christie’s attributes the manuscript to two painters, Hans Burgkmair the Younger and Heinrich Vogtherr the Younger, and their workshops. Nobody knows who commissioned the manuscript—or what exactly that individual had in mind. “Its existence was hitherto unknown, and silence wraps its discovery,” the New York Review of Books’ Marina Warner wrote in 2014. “This Book of Miracles is a gorgeous unheralded surprise: a foundling of unknown parents, a virgin birth.”
paras.zh: 由于《奇迹之书》描述了现代德国城市奥格斯堡附近的十几起事件，学者们认为它可能是在那里创作的。佳士得认为这份手稿的作者是两位画家：小汉斯·布格克迈尔 (Hans Burgkmair the Younger) 和小海因里希·沃格瑟尔 (Heinrich Vogtherr the Younger) 及其工作室。没有人知道是谁委托撰写了这份手稿，也不知道那个人到底有什么想法。 《纽约书评》的玛丽娜·华纳 (Marina Warner) 在 2014 年写道：“它的存在迄今无人知晓，沉默包裹着它的发现。”“这本奇迹之书是一个华丽的、意想不到的惊喜：一个未知父母的弃儿，一个处女的诞生。”

paras.en: The manuscript is divided into three parts. The Old Testament section features famous biblical scenes, including Moses parting the Red Sea and Jonah and the whale, while the Book of Revelation section depicts St. John’s apocalyptic visions. The middle section records historical events across the centuries, such as the eruption of Mount Vesuvius.
paras.zh: 手稿分为三个部分。旧约部分展示了著名的圣经场景，包括摩西分开红海和约拿与鲸鱼，而启示录部分则描绘了圣约翰的世界末日景象。中间部分记录了几个世纪以来的历史事件，例如维苏威火山的喷发。

paras.en: - The volcano famously demolished several Roman towns, including Pompeii and Herculaneum, in 79 C.E.
paras.zh: - 公元 79 年，这座火山摧毁了包括庞贝和赫库兰尼姆在内的数个罗马城镇，这一点众所周知。

paras.en: - The Book of Miracles incorrectly dates the eruption to 1482. Although Vesuvius has erupted repeatedly over many years, the manuscript mentions Pliny the Elder, who died in the 79 eruption. According to the caption, the Roman author had “wanted to see the fire but the fire consumed him too.”
paras.zh: - 《奇迹之书》错误地将喷发日期定为 1482 年。尽管维苏威火山多年来反复喷发，但手稿中提到了老普林尼，他在第 79 次喷发中丧生。根据标题，这位罗马作者“想看到火焰，但火焰也把他吞噬了”。

paras.en: Each image is accompanied by a caption in German. For example, the text below the Vesuvius illustration describes how the volcano “burst open at its summit or peak and threw up such a fire that cities and villages and all the trees burned up.” The latest event depicted in the manuscript is a 1552 hailstorm over the Dutch city of Dordrecht, so terrifying that “the people thought the Day of Judgment was coming.”
paras.zh: 每张图片都附有德语说明文字。例如，维苏威火山插图下面的文字描述了火山如何“在其顶峰或山峰爆发并喷出大火，烧毁了城市、村庄和所有树木”。手稿中描述的最新事件是 1552 年荷兰城市多德雷赫特的一场冰雹，这场冰雹非常可怕，以至于“人们认为审判日即将到来”。

paras.en: Some of the images from the middle section are fantastical—at least at first glance. One illustration depicts “wondrous dragons” crossing Bavaria’s skies in 1533; scholars think they may represent the northern lights. The five suns that “many trustworthy persons” saw over Leipzig in 1551 were likely an illusion known as a parhelion.
paras.zh: 中间部分的一些图像非常梦幻——至少乍一看是这样。一幅插图描绘了 1533 年穿越巴伐利亚天空的“神奇巨龙”；学者认为它们可能代表北极光。 1551 年，“许多值得信赖的人”在莱比锡上空看到的五个太阳很可能是一种被称为幻日点的幻觉。

paras.en: “Beyond their extraordinary beauty, these images offer us a glimpse into how people in the 16th century made sense of a world that could often seem mysterious and unpredictable,” Eugenio Donadoni, Christie’s specialist in medieval and Renaissance manuscripts, tells the Art Newspaper’s Maev Kennedy. “Today, we might understand a comet, an eclipse or an earthquake through science, but in the Renaissance, these phenomena could be interpreted as signs of something greater, even as warnings of what was to come.”
paras.zh: 佳士得中世纪和文艺复兴手稿专家尤金尼奥·多纳多尼 (Eugenio Donadoni) 告诉《艺术报》的梅夫·肯尼迪 (Maev Kennedy)，“除了非凡的美感之外，这些图像还让我们一睹 16 世纪的人们如何理解这个看似神秘且不可预测的世界。” “今天，我们可能通过科学来理解彗星、日食或地震，但在文艺复兴时期，这些现象可以被解释为更伟大事物的迹象，甚至是对即将发生的事情的警告。”

paras.en: According to the lot listing, the manuscript was influenced by illustrated broadsheets, or news bulletins that frequently covered strange celestial happenings. For readers who saw extreme weather as harbingers of horrors to come, “all of these events are portentous,” Donadoni tells the Guardian’s Donna Ferguson. Perusing The Book of Miracles may have been “a little like the 16th-century version of doomscrolling.”
paras.zh: 根据拍品清单，手稿受到插图大报或经常报道奇怪天体事件的新闻公告的影响。对于那些将极端天气视为即将到来的恐怖预兆的读者来说，“所有这些事件都是不祥的，”多纳多尼告诉卫报的唐娜·弗格森。细读《奇迹之书》可能“有点像 16 世纪版本的末日卷轴”。

paras.en: Nearly 500 years have passed since the manuscript’s creation, but humanity’s fascination with doom has endured. “One can easily imagine more recent catastrophes getting the Book of Miracles treatment, from people clinging to their rooftops in the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina in 2005 to scenes of almost biblical devastation following the tsunami generated by the Tohoku earthquake in 2011,” Collectors Weekly’s Ben Marks wrote in 2014. “That may be the real message of Book of Miracles, that the veneer of civilization we place our faith in daily is actually rather fragile and thin.”
paras.zh: 自手稿创作以来已经过去了近 500 年，但人类对末日的迷恋却一直存在。 《收藏家周刊》的本·马克斯 (Ben Marks) 在 2014 年写道：“人们可以很容易想象最近发生的灾难会受到《奇迹之书》的处理，从 2005 年卡特里娜飓风过后，人们紧贴屋顶，到 2011 年东北地震引发的海啸后几乎圣经中的毁灭场景。”“这可能是《奇迹之书》的真正信息，文明的外表我们日常所寄托的信仰其实是相当脆弱和单薄的。”

articles.title: A Gene Variant Inherited From Neanderthals Might Affect Modern Humans' Brain Size and Provide Protection Against Schizophrenia

paras.en: Tens of thousands of years ago, Homo sapiens interbred with Neanderthals, resulting in billions of humans alive today carrying traces of these extinct cousins in their DNA. The bits of Neanderthal ancestry can affect mood, metabolism, disease risk and other traits.
paras.zh: 数万年前，智人与尼安德特人杂交，导致今天活着的数十亿人的 DNA 中带有这些已灭绝近亲的痕迹。尼安德特人的血统会影响情绪、新陈代谢、疾病风险和其他特征。

paras.en: Now, new research suggests one of those inherited genetic variants is associated with a slightly shrunken brain region and lower risk of schizophrenia, according to a study published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences on November 16. The findings further highlight the enduring impacts of modern humans’ trysts with Neanderthals.
paras.zh: 现在，根据 11 月 16 日发表在《美国国家科学院院刊》上的一项研究，新的研究表明，其中一种遗传性基因变异与大脑区域轻微萎缩和患精神分裂症的风险较低有关。这些发现进一步凸显了现代人类与尼安德特人幽会的持久影响。

paras.en: “This is a very important variant,” says Davide Marnetto, a computational biologist at the University of Turin in Italy who wasn’t involved in the research, to Michael Marshall at Nature. “Its effect is really one of the most beautiful and strong that I’ve ever seen.”
paras.zh: “这是一个非常重要的变体，”意大利都灵大学的计算生物学家达维德·马内托（Davide Marnetto）对《自然》杂志的迈克尔·马歇尔说，他没有参与这项研究。 “它的效果确实是我见过的最美丽、最强烈的效果之一。”

paras.en: Neanderthals had larger skulls than modern humans, and they were more elongated front-to-back, hinting at a different brain tissue layout. Evolutionary geneticists Hugo Zeberg and Svante Pääbo, of the Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology in Germany, suspected the occipital lobe—which sits at the back of the brain and processes visual information—had something to do with that distinct shape.
paras.zh: 尼安德特人的头骨比现代人类更大，而且从前到后也更长，这暗示着不同的脑组织布局。德国马克斯·普朗克进化人类学研究所的进化遗传学家 Hugo Zeberg 和 Svante Pääbo 怀疑枕叶（位于大脑后部并处理视觉信息）与这种独特的形状有关。

paras.en: So, the research duo investigated gene variants known to affect occipital lobe size in people of European descent, whose DNA typically contains around 1 to 2 percent Neanderthal ancestry. Then, they looked at which variants were not present in people of sub-Saharan African descent, who have little to no Neanderthal DNA because their ancestors didn’t mingle with the extinct hominins, which evolved in Europe and Asia.
paras.zh: 因此，研究人员研究了已知影响欧洲后裔枕叶大小的基因变异，这些人的 DNA 通常含有约 1% 至 2% 的尼安德特人血统。然后，他们研究了撒哈拉以南非洲人后裔中不存在哪些变异，这些人几乎没有尼安德特人 DNA，因为他们的祖先没有与在欧洲和亚洲进化的已灭绝的古人类混在一起。

paras.en: The work revealed a genetic variant that affects the DAAM1 gene, which is linked to brain development. This variant upstream of DAAM1 was seen in all five available genomes—complete sets of genetic instructions—from Neanderthals, the team found. Importantly, it wasn’t present in the two tested genomes from Denisovans, another extinct cousin that interbred with humans. The scientists estimate that about 20 percent of people of European descent carry at least one copy of the variant, reports Science’s Michael Price.
paras.zh: 这项工作揭示了一种影响 DAAM1 基因的遗传变异，该基因与大脑发育有关。研究小组发现，DAAM1 上游的这种变异存在于尼安德特人的所有五个可用基因组（完整的遗传指令集）中。重要的是，它并不存在于丹尼索瓦人的两个测试基因组中，丹尼索瓦人是另一种与人类杂交的灭绝表亲。据《科学》杂志的迈克尔·普莱斯报道，科学家们估计，大约 20% 的欧洲人后裔至少携带一份该变体副本。

paras.en: Using data from the U.K. Biobank, which contains genetic information from about half a million participants, the team examined how the Neanderthal gene variant affects people today. Analyses revealed that having one copy—inherited from one parent—is associated with a 0.85-cubic-centimeter reduction in occipital lobe volume, whereas inheriting it from both parents doubles the shrinkage. That seems a bit surprising since Neanderthals are thought to have had bigger brains than Homo sapiens.
paras.zh: 英国生物银行包含约 50 万参与者的遗传信息，研究小组利用该数据研究了尼安德特人基因变异对当今人类的影响。分析显示，从父母一方继承的枕叶体积会减少 0.85 立方厘米，而从父母双方继承的枕叶体积会缩小一倍。这似乎有点令人惊讶，因为人们认为尼安德特人的大脑比智人更大。

paras.en: “It sounds paradoxical, but it probably is not unexpected,” since traits like brain size are influenced by hundreds, or even thousands, of genes, says Joshua Akey, a geneticist at Princeton University who wasn’t involved in the work, to Nature. “Neanderthals could have an overall larger occipital lobe, but they still contain some variants that contribute smaller sizes and some that contribute larger sizes,” he explains, and Homo sapiens may have inherited a variant that contributes to a smaller size.
paras.zh: 普林斯顿大学遗传学家约书亚·阿基（Joshua Akey）对《自然》杂志表示：“这听起来很矛盾，但可能并不意外，”因为大脑大小等特征受到数百甚至数千个基因的影响。他解释说：“尼安德特人的枕叶整体可能更大，但它们仍然包含一些导致尺寸较小的变体和一些导致尺寸较大的变体，”而智人可能继承了一种导致尺寸较小的变体。

paras.en: Having two copies of the Neanderthal variant was also associated with a nearly 10 percent reduction in schizophrenia risk, though the exact mechanism behind that effect is unclear. Future research in animals or brain organoids could provide more information, Zeberg tells Science, “but the honest answer is we don’t understand the exact mechanics at this point.”
paras.zh: 拥有两个尼安德特人变体拷贝也与精神分裂症风险降低近 10% 相关，尽管这种效应背后的确切机制尚不清楚。泽伯格告诉《科学》杂志，未来对动物或大脑类器官的研究可以提供更多信息，“但诚实的答案是，我们目前还不了解确切的机制。”

paras.en: Still, the findings align with research by Karen Berman, a neuroscientist at the National Institute of Mental Health, and colleagues, who reported in 2021 that people with more Neanderthal ancestry have lower rates of schizophrenia. The new study helps scientists further “understand the repercussions of the echoes of this genetic material in our present genetic underpinnings,” she tells the outlet.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这些发现与美国国家心理健康研究所神经科学家 Karen Berman 及其同事的研究结果一致，他们在 2021 年报告称，尼安德特人血统较多的人患精神分裂症的几率较低。她告诉媒体，这项新研究帮助科学家进一步“了解这种遗传物质的回声对我们目前遗传基础的影响”。

paras.en: Additionally, Zeberg and Pääbo examined the variant’s potential associations with intelligence, bipolar disorder, depression, ADHD and autism spectrum disorder. They found no link between these traits and the fragment of Neanderthal DNA, and they note that their findings suggest that the size of a brain region shouldn’t be equated with cognitive abilities.
paras.zh: 此外，Zeberg 和 Pääbo 研究了该变异与智力、双相情感障碍、抑郁症、多动症和自闭症谱系障碍的潜在关联。他们发现这些特征与尼安德特人 DNA 片段之间没有联系，他们指出，他们的发现表明大脑区域的大小不应等同于认知能力。

paras.en: The researchers are now continuing to sift through data to better understand Neanderthals’ fingerprints on modern humans’ genetic makeup, and they hope to turn up additional exciting discoveries.
paras.zh: 研究人员现在正在继续筛选数据，以更好地了解尼安德特人对现代人类基因构成的指纹，他们希望能有更多令人兴奋的发现。

paras.en: “You might hear from us again,” Zeberg tells Jackie Flynn Mogensen at Scientific American.
paras.zh: “你可能会再次收到我们的消息，”泽伯格告诉《科学美国人》的杰基·弗林·摩根森。

articles.title: A Modern Forensic Investigation Reveals the Cause of Death of a 2,000-Year-Old Body Found in a Bog in Northern Ireland

paras.en: After more than 2,000 years, authorities Northern Ireland are making major discoveries in gruesome cold case. A public inquest-style inquiry has determined the cause of death of an young woman from the Iron Age, whose body was recovered in a peat bog in 2023. A coroner’s investigation concluded that she was deliberately beheaded from behind with a bladed weapon.
paras.zh: 两千多年过去了，北爱尔兰当局在这起可怕的悬案中取得了重大发现。一场公开调查式的调查确定了一名铁器时代年轻女性的死因，她的尸体于 2023 年在泥炭沼泽中被发现。验尸官的调查得出的结论是，她是被一把带刃武器故意从后面斩首的。

paras.en: Hosted at the Ulster Museum in Belfast, the proceeding synthesized findings from an international research consortium led by National Museums NI (NMNI). Although not a formal legal inquest, the hearing applied contemporary investigative standards to examine the evidence behind a death more than 20 centuries ago.
paras.zh: 该会议在贝尔法斯特的阿尔斯特博物馆举行，会议综合了由北爱尔兰国家博物馆 (NMNI) 领导的国际研究联盟的研究结果。虽然不是正式的法律调查，但听证会采用了当代调查标准来审查 20 多世纪前死亡背后的证据。

paras.en: “Finds like this that are women are incredibly rare,” Hannah Crowdy, head of curatorial at NMNI, tells the BBC’s Eve Rosato. “She’s the first of her kind in Northern Ireland at all. This helps us piece together a part of history that is quite mysterious. To honor her, it’s important to tell her story and bring that to the fore.”
paras.zh: “像这样的女性发现极其罕见，”NMNI 策展人汉娜·克劳迪 (Hannah Crowdy) 告诉 BBC 的伊芙·罗萨托 (Eve Rosato)。 “她是北爱尔兰的第一个同类。这有助于我们拼凑出一段相当神秘的历史。为了纪念她，重要的是讲述她的故事并将其带到人们的面前。”

paras.en: The remains were unearthed in October 2023, when peat workers from Bulrush Horticulture uncovered human bones in Ballymacombs More outside Bellaghy in County Londonderry.
paras.zh: 这些遗骸于 2023 年 10 月出土，当时 Bulrush Horticulture 的泥炭工人在伦敦德里郡贝拉吉郊外的 Ballymacombs More 发现了人类骨头。

paras.en: Subsequent excavations recovered further skeletal remains and a woven artifact, though no skull was found. Researchers initially thought the body was male and dubbed the individual “Bellaghy Boy,” before forensic testing revealed the remains belonged to a young woman between 15 and 22 years old. She was subsequently renamed the Ballymacombs More Woman.
paras.zh: 随后的挖掘发现了更多的骨骼遗骸和编织物，但没有发现头骨。研究人员最初认为这具尸体是男性，并称其为“贝拉吉男孩”，后来法医检测显示，尸体属于一名 15 至 22 岁的年轻女性。她随后被更名为“巴利马库姆斯更多女人”。

paras.en: Using micro-CT scanning, digital mapping, 3D imaging and targeted analyses of preserved bone, hair, skin, nails and the woven textile, researchers from nine institutions gathered clues about her diet, health and physical appearance.
paras.zh: 来自九家机构的研究人员利用微型 CT 扫描、数字测绘、3D 成像以及对保存的骨骼、头发、皮肤、指甲和机织纺织品进行有针对性的分析，收集了有关她的饮食、健康和外貌的线索。

paras.en: Cut marks on the woman’s neck appear to indicate that she was “intentionally decapitated in the bog,” Niamh Baker, NMNI’s curator of archaeology, tells the BBC.
paras.zh: NMNI 考古学馆长尼亚姆·贝克 (Niamh Baker) 告诉 BBC，这名女子脖子上的割痕似乎表明她“在沼泽中被故意斩首”。

paras.en: The reason for this decapitation is unknown. “It may be that she falls into a pattern of ritual and sacrifice that took place across northwest Europe in the Iron Age period,” Baker explains, adding that comparable Iron Age male remains found in the Republic of Ireland have been linked to leadership positions.
paras.zh: 这次斩首的原因尚不清楚。贝克解释说：“她可能陷入了铁器时代欧洲西北部发生的一种仪式和牺牲模式。”他补充说，在爱尔兰共和国发现的类似铁器时代男性遗骸与领导职位有关。

paras.en: “Was she a female sovereign?” Baker asks. “Or it may be that it was related to an agricultural or weather issue at the time.”
paras.zh: “她是女皇吗？”贝克问道。 “或者可能与当时的农业或天气问题有关。”

paras.en: “The purpose of the exercise is not to impose modern legal conclusions upon the distant past, but to provide a framework through which the available evidence could be assessed and the story of a previously unknown young woman could be told,” Joe McCrisken, the coroner who chaired the investigation, said at the inquest, the Guardian’s Rory Carroll reports.
paras.zh: 据《卫报》的罗里·卡罗尔报道，主持此次调查的验尸官乔·麦克克里斯肯 (Joe McCrisken) 在审讯中表示：“这次演习的目的不是将现代法律结论强加于遥远的过去，而是提供一个框架，通过该框架可以评估现有证据，并讲述一名以前不为人知的年轻女性的故事。”

paras.en: The Ballymacombs More Woman joins internationally famous bog bodies—including Denmark’s Tollund Man and Grauballe Man, as well as Ireland’s Clonycavan Man and Old Croghan Man—in offering rare insights into ancient societies.
paras.zh: Ballymacombs More Woman 与国际著名的沼泽组织（包括丹麦的托伦德人和格劳巴勒人，以及爱尔兰的克隆卡文人和老克罗根人）一起，为古代社会提供了罕见的见解。

paras.en: Bog discoveries inspired poems by the late Irish Nobel laureate Seamus Heaney, including “The Grauballe Man,” “The Tollund Man” and “The Tollund Man in Springtime.”
paras.zh: 沼泽的发现启发了已故爱尔兰诺贝尔奖得主谢默斯·希尼 (Seamus Heaney) 的诗歌，包括《格劳巴勒人》、《托伦德人》和《春天的托伦德人》。

paras.en: Residents of Bellaghy have embraced the young woman as one of their own, naming her Áine after an Irish goddess.
paras.zh: 贝拉吉的居民将这位年轻女子视为自己的一员，并以爱尔兰女神的名字为她命名为 Áine。

paras.en: “We feel that Áine is one of our own,” Séamus Mac an Fhirléighinn of the Bellaghy Historical Society tells the BBC. “This is her inquest, she needed her people, her family there with her to act on her behalf as advocates.”
paras.zh: “我们觉得 Áine 是我们中的一员，”贝拉吉历史学会的 Séamus Mac 和 Fhirléighinn 告诉 BBC。 “这是她的调查，她需要她的人民、她的家人和她一起代表她作为倡导者。”

paras.en: As the Ulster Museum prepares updates to its Early Peoples gallery, curators have decided not to display Ballymacombs More Woman’s physical remains, opting instead to evoke her life through mediums such as illustration and poetry, for example.
paras.zh: 当阿尔斯特博物馆准备更新其早期人民画廊时，策展人决定不展示 Ballymacombs More Woman 的遗骸，而是选择通过插图和诗歌等媒介来唤起她的生活。

paras.en: “Ballymacombs More Woman was once a person, just like us,” Crowdy says in a statement. “While the circumstances of her life and death belong to the past, her discovery raises questions that remain relevant to the future, not least the presence and care of human remains in museum collections today.”
paras.zh: “女人曾经也是一个人，就像我们一样，”克劳迪在一份声明中说。 “虽然她的生与死的情况属于过去，但她的发现提出了与未来仍然相关的问题，尤其是今天博物馆收藏中人类遗骸的存在和护理。”
