articles.title: All Points Logistics Announces Partnership with Expeditors for Space Prep Logistics Center at Kennedy Space Center
articles.author: All Points Logistics

paras.en: MERRITT ISLAND, FL, November 18, 2026 — All Points Logistics has announced a partnership with Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. (NYSE: EXPD) to serve as the exclusive logistics provider for its planned Space Prep Spaceport Logistics Center at Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州梅里特岛，2026 年 11 月 18 日 — All Points Logistics 宣布与华盛顿 Expeditors International, Inc.（纽约证券交易所股票代码：EXPD）建立合作伙伴关系，为其计划中的位于佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心的太空准备航天港物流中心提供独家物流服务。

paras.en: Through this partnership, Expeditors will establish an on-site presence at the Space Prep facility, providing end-to-end mission logistics for government agencies and commercial space operators. Services for spacecraft, ground support equipment, and related mission materials will include aerospace warehousing, inventory control, transportation management, project cargo services, customs brokerage, supply chain visibility, and launch campaign support. The operation will serve space system operators and manufacturers working at Kennedy Space Center, Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, and other launch locations.
paras.zh: 通过此次合作，Expeditors 将在太空准备设施建立现场服务，为政府机构和商业太空运营商提供端到端的任务后勤服务。航天器、地面支持设备和相关任务材料的服务将包括航空航天仓储、库存控制、运输管理、项目货运服务、报关、供应链可视性和发射活动支持。该行动将为在肯尼迪航天中心、卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站和其他发射地点工作的航天系统运营商和制造商提供服务。

paras.en: “Companies in the space industry manage highly specialized equipment and materials across global supply chains,” said Ed Rone, Expeditors’ Regional Vice President of the U.S. Southeast. “This partnership puts our people and services closer to their launch operations, transforming logistics from a transportation function into a mission-readiness capability that helps ensure critical flight hardware, launch equipment, and operational assets are available at the right time. We look forward to working with All Points and applying our experience to the unique demands of this industry.”
paras.zh: Expeditors 美国东南部区域副总裁 Ed Rone 表示：“航天工业公司管理着全球供应链中高度专业化的设备和材料。” “这种伙伴关系使我们的人员和服务更接近他们的发射操作，将物流从运输功能转变为任务准备能力，有助于确保关键的飞行硬件、发射设备和运营资产在正确的时间可用。我们期待与 All Points 合作，并将我们的经验应用于该行业的独特需求。”

paras.en: As part of its Space Prep initiative, All Points plans to build a 266,000-square-foot Spaceport Logistics Center on its 65-acre site at Kennedy Space Center. Located within five miles of the launch pads, the facility is scheduled to open by the end of 2027. The site will also include an adjacent 260,000-square-foot Spacecraft Processing Center, bringing together launch-site logistics and specialized spacecraft processing capabilities.
paras.zh: 作为其太空准备计划的一部分，All Points 计划在肯尼迪航天中心 65 英亩的场地上建造一个 266,000 平方英尺的太空港物流中心。该设施距离发射台不到 5 英里，计划于 2027 年底开放。该设施还将包括一个毗邻的 260,000 平方英尺的航天器处理中心，汇集发射场物流和专业航天器处理能力。

paras.en: “Expeditors is an ideal partner for our Space Prep business,” said Phil Monkress, CEO of All Points Logistics. “Their global logistics expertise and specialized transportation capabilities align directly with the needs of our space industry customers, helping them move, stage, and manage mission-critical flight hardware more efficiently at major launch sites.”
paras.zh: “Expeditors 是我们 Space Prep 业务的理想合作伙伴，”All Points Logistics 首席执行官 Phil Monkress 表示。 “他们的全球物流专业知识和专业运输能力直接满足我们航天工业客户的需求，帮助他们在主要发射场更有效地移动、部署和管理关键任务飞行硬件。”

paras.en: Through this collaboration, Space Prep customers will also benefit from access to Expeditors’ broader global logistics network, connecting suppliers and manufacturing locations with launch operations. The Kennedy Space Center location will also position Expeditors to support existing customers, including hyperscalers, as they explore opportunities in space-based data centers and advanced computing infrastructure.
paras.zh: 通过此次合作，Space Prep 客户还将受益于 Expeditors 更广泛的全球物流网络，将供应商和制造地点与发射业务连接起来。肯尼迪航天中心的位置还将帮助 Expeditors 为现有客户（包括超大规模企业）提供支持，帮助他们探索天基数据中心和先进计算基础设施的机会。

paras.en: All Points developed Space Prep to help address the growing demand for spacecraft processing and launch-site logistics infrastructure. By combining specialized facilities, mission support services, and strategic partnerships, All Points is expanding its capabilities to support commercial and government space customers at America’s major launch sites.
paras.zh: All Points 开发了 Space Prep，以帮助满足对航天器处理和发射场物流基础设施不断增长的需求。通过结合专业设施、任务支持服务和战略合作伙伴关系，All Points 正在扩大其能力，为美国主要发射场的商业和政府太空客户提供支持。

paras.en: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc. (NYSE: EXPD) is a leading S&P 500 global logistics company headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. Through a worldwide network of knowledgeable professionals across six continents and a globally connected technology platform, Expeditors tailors solutions to manage increasingly complex supply chains and international trade requirements. The asset-light company offers air, customs, ocean, order management, road, warehousing and distribution, and cargo insurance services to key industries worldwide. Guided by a culture of exceptional customer service, Expeditors aspires to be the most trusted and valued logistics company in the world. For more information, visit expeditors.com.
paras.zh: Expeditors International of Washington, Inc.（纽约证券交易所代码：EXPD）是一家领先的标准普尔 500 强全球物流公司，总部位于华盛顿州贝尔维尤。通过遍布六大洲的知识丰富的专业人士的全球网络和全球互联的技术平台，Expeditors 定制解决方案来管理日益复杂的供应链和国际贸易要求。这家轻资产公司为全球主要行业提供空运、海关、海运、订单管理、公路、仓储和配送以及货物保险服务。在卓越客户服务文化的指导下，Expeditors 立志成为全球最值得信赖和最有价值的物流公司。欲了解更多信息，请访问 expeditors.com。

paras.en: Space Prep, a business line of All Points Logistics, LLC, is developing multi-user spacecraft processing and logistics facilities at the nation’s busiest launch bases in Florida and California, giving commercial and government customers flexible access to cleanroom processing, fueling, storage, and mission support services. Learn more at SpacePrep.com.
paras.zh: Space Prep 是 All Points Logistics, LLC 的一个业务部门，正在美国佛罗里达州和加利福尼亚州最繁忙的发射基地开发多用户航天器处理和物流设施，为商业和政府客户提供灵活的洁净室处理、加油、存储和任务支持服务。请访问 SpacePrep.com 了解更多信息。

paras.en: Established in 1997 as a service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB), All Points Logistics has operations in multiple states and has grown into a leading solution provider to a diverse array of government and commercial customers, with award-winning expertise in software development, IT services, modeling and simulation, launch support services, and integrated logistics. Learn more at allpointsllc.com.
paras.zh: All Points Logistics 成立于 1997 年，是一家退伍军人拥有的小型企业 (SDVOSB)，在多个州开展业务，现已发展成为面向各类政府和商业客户的领先解决方案提供商，在软件开发、IT 服务、建模和模拟、启动支持服务和综合物流方面拥有屡​​获殊荣的专业知识。如需了解更多信息，请访问 allpointsllc.com。

articles.title: What Is the Moon Base?
articles.author: Kaitlyn Adams

paras.en: NASA is returning astronauts to the Moon – and this time they will spend more time on the lunar surface. The Moon Base is humanity’s first lunar outpost. It will be a place where astronauts live, work, and explore.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局正在将宇航员送回月球——这一次他们将在月球表面度过更多的时间。月球基地是人类第一个月球前哨基地。它将成为宇航员生活、工作和探索的地方。

paras.en: outpost: a station or base located in a remote, distant place
paras.zh: 前哨站：位于偏远地区的站或基地

paras.en: infrastructure: the basic framework and systems that make up a larger building or organization
paras.zh: 基础设施：构成较大建筑物或组织的基本框架和系统

paras.en: terrain: the physical features, shape, and layout of the surface of a piece of land, including its slope and elevation
paras.zh: 地形：一块土地表面的物理特征、形状和布局，包括坡度和高程

paras.en: regolith: the layer of loose, fragmented rock and mineral dust covering most of the lunar surface
paras.zh: 风化层：覆盖月球表面大部分的松散、破碎的岩石和矿物尘埃层

paras.en: The Moon Base will be built in the lunar South Pole region. This area was selected for its unique lighting conditions and potential for scientific discovery.
paras.zh: 月球基地将建在月球南极地区。该区域因其独特的照明条件和科学发现的潜力而被选中。

paras.en: Near the lunar South Pole, the Sun stays low on the horizon. Some areas can receive extended periods of sunlight. Other areas stay in shadows for long periods of time. In some craters, sunlight may never reach the surface at all.
paras.zh: 在月球南极附近，太阳位于地平线上较低的位置。有些地区可以接受较长时间的阳光照射。其他区域则长时间处于阴影中。在一些陨石坑中，阳光可能永远不会到达表面。

paras.en: Areas that receive extended sunlight could be good for generating solar power. Longer sunlight hours are also good for navigating and exploring. Areas that remain in shadows are some of the coldest areas on the Moon. In these locations, scientists hope to find deposits of frozen water ice.
paras.zh: 阳光充足的地区有利于太阳能发电。较长的日照时间也有利于导航和探索。留在阴影中的区域是月球上最冷的区域。在这些地方，科学家希望找到冰冻水冰的沉积物。

paras.en: The Moon Base will be constructed in three phases. Each phase will build on what is learned along the way.
paras.zh: 月球基地将分三期建设。每个阶段都将建立在沿途学到的知识的基础上。

paras.en: Phase One is taking place right now. Over the next few years, NASA and its partners will send robotic missions to explore the lunar South Pole region. They will test new technologies and practice landing on the Moon. This phase will include multiple different landers and lunar terrain vehicles. These missions will conduct science experiments and look for the best locations for building the Moon Base.
paras.zh: 第一阶段正在进行中。在接下来的几年里，美国宇航局及其合作伙伴将派遣机器人任务探索月球南极地区。他们将测试新技术并练习登陆月球。这一阶段将包括多个不同的着陆器和月球地形车。这些任务将进行科学实验并寻找建造月球基地的最佳地点。

paras.en: Phase Two is planned for 2029-2032. During this period, NASA will begin setting up long-term infrastructure. This includes things like power systems, cargo transportation, and communications hardware. These components will be set up across multiple locations. This will allow for future expansion of the Moon Base.
paras.zh: 第二阶段计划于 2029 年至 2032 年进行。在此期间，NASA 将开始建立长期基础设施。这包括电力系统、货物运输和通信硬件等。这些组件将分布在多个地点。这将为未来月球基地的扩建做好准备。

paras.en: During Phase Three, NASA will begin assembling a permanent lunar outpost. This is where astronauts will be able to live and work for extended periods. Habitats, power and communication systems, and transportation will all come together to grow Moon Base.
paras.zh: 在第三阶段，美国宇航局将开始建造一个永久性的月球前哨站。宇航员将能够在这里长期生活和工作。栖息地、电力和通信系统以及交通都将汇集在一起​​以发展月球基地。

paras.en: What Are the Different Components of the Moon Base?
paras.zh: 月球基地有哪些不同的组成部分？

paras.en: Crewed and robotic lunar rovers will play an important role in the development of the Moon Base. These rovers will test out technologies, transport astronauts, map terrain, and more. Let’s learn about a few of the rovers being built as part of the Moon Base.
paras.zh: 载人月球车和机器人月球车将在月球基地的发展中发挥重要作用。这些漫游车将测试技术、运送宇航员、绘制地形图等。让我们了解一些作为月球基地一部分建造的漫游车。

paras.en: NASA’s VIPER (Volatiles Investigating Polar Exploration Rover) is fully built. It is being tested at NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston. In 2027, it will launch to the Moon from NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. Its mission will be to explore permanently shadowed craters to look for water and other resources. It will travel more than 15 miles, collecting data and analyzing the lunar soil.
paras.zh: NASA 的 VIPER（挥发物调查极地探索车）已完全建成。它正在休斯顿的美国宇航局约翰逊航天中心进行测试。 2027 年，它将从美国宇航局佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心发射到月球。它的任务是探索永久阴影的陨石坑以寻找水和其他资源。它将行驶超过 15 英里，收集数据并分析月球土壤。

paras.en: NASA’s PROMISE (Polar Rover for Observation, Mapping, and In-Situ Exploration) is a nuclear-powered rover. It is being built from existing hardware that was created for NASA’s Mars rover missions. PROMISE will look for resources – like potential water ice – on and below the lunar surface. It will carry multiple science instruments, including several that are also on VIPER. The mission is targeted to launch by late 2028.
paras.zh: NASA 的 PROMISE（用于观测、测绘和原位探索的极地漫游车）是一款核动力漫游车。它是利用为美国宇航局火星探测器任务创建的现有硬件构建的。 PROMISE将在月球表面及其下方寻找资源，例如潜在的水冰。它将携带多种科学仪器，其中一些也在 VIPER 上。该任务计划于 2028 年底发射。

paras.en: Lunar terrain vehicles (LTVs) will launch to the lunar South Pole region by 2028. These crewed vehicles will be driven by astronauts during missions to the Moon. This will allow the crew to explore larger areas and gather geology samples. When astronauts are not on the Moon, the LTVs will be remotely operated from Earth. They will map the lunar surface and collect data about the extreme environment in the region.
paras.zh: 月球地形飞行器 (LTV) 将于 2028 年发射到月球南极地区。这些载人飞行器将在执行月球任务期间由宇航员驾驶。这将使船员能够探索更大的区域并收集地质样本。当宇航员不在月球上时，LTV 将在地球上进行远程操作。他们将绘制月球表面地图并收集有关该地区极端环境的数据。

paras.en: In addition to rovers, NASA’s MoonFall mission will send a group of propulsive drones to the Moon. They will land near the lunar South Pole by 2028. The drones will descend to the lunar surface independently. They will operate separately over the course of a single lunar day (about 14 Earth days). They will use high-definition cameras to map hard-to-reach terrain. This data will help NASA select potential Artemis landing sites.
paras.zh: 除了漫游车之外，美国宇航局的 MoonFall 任务还将向月球发送一组推进式无人机。到2028年，它们将降落在月球南极附近。无人机将独立降落到月球表面。它们将在一个农历日（大约 14 个地球日）内单独运行。他们将使用高清摄像机来绘制难以到达的地形地图。这些数据将帮助美国宇航局选择潜在的阿尔忒弥斯着陆点。

paras.en: What Are the Challenges of Building on the Moon?
paras.zh: 在月球上建造建筑面临哪些挑战？

paras.en: The lunar South Pole region is an extreme environment. The Moon doesn’t have any noticeable atmosphere. This means temperatures can reach more than 130°F (54°C) in sunlit areas. And it can be as cold as -334°F (-203°C) inside permanently shadowed craters. This can be very dangerous for astronauts. But it is also a challenge for designing infrastructure and hardware.
paras.zh: 月球南极地区是一个极端的环境。月球没有任何明显的大气层。这意味着阳光照射区域的温度可能达到 130°F (54°C) 以上。永久阴影陨石坑内的温度可能低至 -334°F (-203°C)。这对于宇航员来说非常危险。但这对于设计基础设施和硬件也是一个挑战。

paras.en: Navigating the uneven lunar surface can be difficult. The South Pole region of the Moon has steep slopes, ridges, rocks, and deep craters. Shackleton Crater is more than twice as deep as the Grand Canyon. Detailed mapping and robotic exploration will help NASA identify safe landing areas and plan routes for astronauts and rovers.
paras.zh: 在不平坦的月球表面航行可能很困难。月球南极地区有陡峭的斜坡、山脊、岩石和深坑。沙克尔顿陨石坑的深度是大峡谷的两倍多。详细的测绘和机器人探索将帮助美国宇航局确定安全着陆区域并为宇航员和漫游车规划路线。

paras.en: The lunar surface is covered with regolith. This layer of rocky material is the result of meteoroid impacts. Since there is no wind or rain to cause erosion on the lunar surface, regolith particles have sharp edges. This means regolith can quickly wear down spacesuits and equipment. It can be particularly irritating to skin and dangerous if inhaled. Precautions must be taken to keep regolith and lunar dust out of areas where astronauts live.
paras.zh: 月球表面覆盖着风化层。这层岩石物质是流星体撞击的结果。由于月球表面没有风雨造成侵蚀，风化层颗粒具有锋利的边缘。这意味着风化层会很快磨损宇航服和设备。它对皮肤特别刺激，吸入后会很危险。必须采取预防措施，防止风化层和月球尘埃进入宇航员居住的区域。

paras.en: How Will the Moon Base Prepare Us for Future Missions?
paras.zh: 月球基地将如何为我们未来的任务做好准备？

paras.en: The Moon Base is an important step in learning how to live and work on another world. What we learn on the lunar surface by testing new landing techniques, construction methods, and exploration technologies will help prepare for human missions to Mars.
paras.zh: 月球基地是学习如何在另一个世界生活和工作的重要一步。我们通过测试新的着陆技术、施工方法和探索技术在月球表面学到的知识将有助于为人类火星任务做好准备。

paras.en: Here are a few examples of the careers that are making NASA’s Moon Base plans possible:
paras.zh: 以下是使美国宇航局月球基地计划成为可能的职业的一些例子：

paras.en: Space tire engineer: The rovers being designed as part of the Moon Base need to have special tires. Engineers must consider the lack of atmosphere, extreme temperature, and rocky terrain when designing tires to drive long distances on the Moon. A career in engineering demands a strong understanding of math and complex problem-solving. An advanced college degree is usually required. Click here to see a space tire engineer in action.
paras.zh: 太空轮胎工程师：作为月球基地一部分设计的漫游车需要有特殊的轮胎。工程师在设计在月球上长距离行驶的轮胎时，必须考虑缺乏大气层、极端温度和岩石地形。工程职业需要对数学和解决复杂问题有深刻的理解。通常需要高级大学学位。单击此处查看太空轮胎工程师的实际操作。

paras.en: Exploration geologist: These scientists study rocks and minerals on Earth and throughout the solar system. They look at geological processes to see how erosion and harsh environments can change terrain. For Moon Base, they’re helping to select locations to explore on the lunar surface. And they’re helping train the astronauts who will land and gather samples. This career requires strong observational skills and usually requires an advanced college degree. Click here to see what it’s like being an exploration geologist at NASA.
paras.zh: 勘探地质学家：这些科学家研究地球和整个太阳系的岩石和矿物。他们研究地质过程，看看侵蚀和恶劣的环境如何改变地形。对于月球基地，他们正在帮助选择月球表面的探索地点。他们正在帮助训练将着陆和收集样本的宇航员。这个职业需要很强的观察能力，通常需要高级大学学位。单击此处了解在 NASA 担任勘探地质学家的感受。

paras.en: Manufacturing technician: Turning designs into reality takes skilled technicians. Fabrication and assembly of robotic equipment and spacecraft parts requires precise calculations. Being able to follow intricate instructions is key. Trade school training and skills such as operating forklifts and heavy machinery may be required.
paras.zh: 制造技术人员：将设计变为现实需要熟练的技术人员。机器人设备和航天器部件的制造和组装需要精确的计算。能够遵循复杂的指示是关键。可能需要贸易学校培训和操作叉车和重型机械等技能。

paras.en: Instrument technician: These experts install, calibrate, and maintain sensors and control systems. They troubleshoot issues that might come up with delicate systems and equipment. This career path often starts with an apprenticeship or hands-on training alongside experienced technicians. An associate’s degree is often required. Click here to see some of the testing completed on one of the Moon Base landers.
paras.zh: 仪器技术人员：这些专家安装、校准和维护传感器和控制系统。他们解决精密系统和设备可能出现的问题。这条职业道路通常始于与经验丰富的技术人员一起进行学徒或实践培训。通常需要副学士学位。单击此处查看在月球基地着陆器之一上完成的一些测试。

articles.title: NASA Announces Mid-Power Electric Rocket Challenge for US Companies
articles.author: Bailey Light

paras.en: NASA launched a new competition inviting U.S. companies to produce prototypes of mid-power Hall effect thrusters – a type of electric propulsion system considered crucial for future space operations and exploration.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局发起了一项新的竞赛，邀请美国公司生产中功率霍尔效应推进器的原型——一种被认为对未来太空操作和探索至关重要的电力推进系统。

paras.en: Hall effect thrusters use an electric field to accelerate a propellant gas, producing efficient thrust for long-duration missions. Used for propelling satellites and deep space robotic vehicles, Hall effect thruster systems are critical technology.
paras.zh: 霍尔效应推进器利用电场来加速推进剂气体，为长期任务产生有效的推力。霍尔效应推进器系统用于推进卫星和深空机器人飞行器，是关键技术。

paras.en: NASA’s Advanced Mid-Power Electric Rocket (AMPERE) Challenge is offering $500,000, split between two winning U.S. companies, to accelerate the maturation of mid-power systems that could be foundational to supporting future NASA and commercial missions. Interested parties can learn more at an AMPERE Virtual Industry Day hosted by NASA on Thursday, Nov. 19.
paras.zh: NASA 的先进中功率电动火箭 (AMPERE) 挑战赛将提供 50 万美元，由两家获胜的美国公司平分，以加速中功率系统的成熟，这可能是支持未来 NASA 和商业任务的基础。有兴趣的人士可以在 NASA 于 11 月 19 日星期四主办的 AMPERE 虚拟工业日上了解更多信息。

paras.en: “This challenge approach seeks to remove key barriers and facilitate commercialization by providing access to NASA subject matter expertise, state-of-the-art technologies, and world-class facilities at no cost to challenge winners,” said Dr. Jason Frieman, AMPERE project co-owner at NASA’s Glenn Research Center in Cleveland. “We hope participants will see this as an opportunity to demonstrate their capabilities to NASA and other government and commercial stakeholders.”
paras.zh: NASA 克利夫兰格伦研究中心 AMPERE 项目共同所有人 Jason Frieman 博士表示：“这种挑战方法旨在通过免费提供 NASA 主题专业知识、最先进的技术和世界一流的设施来挑战获胜者，从而消除关键障碍并促进商业化。” “我们希望参与者能够将此视为向 NASA 以及其他政府和商业利益相关者展示其能力的机会。”

paras.en: The competition is the first of NASA’s Tech Maturation Prize series, which seeks to accelerate development of breakthrough technologies in support of NASA missions while strengthening the U.S. space economy.
paras.zh: 该竞赛是 NASA 技术成熟奖系列的第一个，旨在加速突破性技术的开发，以支持 NASA 的任务，同时加强美国太空经济。

paras.en: The competition includes three phases. In Phase 1, each participating team will submit a concept design, manufacturing plan, and cost and performance projections. NASA may select two winners to advance to Phase 2, where teams will develop prototypes and collaborate with NASA personnel. Through no-cost licensing, these teams can gain early access to NASA-developed Hall effect thruster technologies that use krypton as a propellant. In Phase 3, prototypes will be tested at NASA Glenn at no cost to the participating teams.
paras.zh: 比赛共分三个阶段。在第一阶段，每个参赛团队将提交概念设计、制造计划以及成本和性能预测。 NASA 可能会选出两名获胜者进入第二阶段，团队将开发原型并与 NASA 人员合作。通过免费许可，这些团队可以尽早获得 NASA 开发的使用氪作为推进剂的霍尔效应推进器技术。在第三阶段，原型将在 NASA 格伦进行测试，参与团队无需支付任何费用。

paras.en: In total, two winning teams may be selected to receive up to $250,000 each.
paras.zh: 总共，两支获胜球队可能会被选中，每支球队将获得高达 250,000 美元的奖金。

paras.en: The AMPERE Challenge is open for registration until Jan. 27, 2027, at 5 p.m. EST. The challenge supports the Advanced Mid-Power Electric Rocket project, managed by NASA Glenn and NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California. The project is funded by the agency’s Research and Technology Mission Directorate. Yet2 administers the challenge through a contract with the NASA Center of Excellence for Collaborative Innovation within the Research and Technology Mission Directorate.
paras.zh: AMPERE 挑战赛开放报名，截止时间为 2027 年 1 月 27 日下午 5 点。美国东部时间。该挑战赛支持由美国宇航局格伦和美国宇航局南加州喷气推进实验室管理的先进中功率电动火箭项目。该项目由该机构的研究和技术任务理事会资助。 Yet2 通过与 NASA 研究与技术任务理事会卓越协作创新中心签订的合同来管理这项挑战。

paras.en: For complete competition details, eligibility requirements, and official rules, visit:
paras.zh: 有关完整的竞赛详细信息、资格要求和官方规则，请访问：

articles.title: MAF EAP – Holidays – How to manage the BAH HUMBUG that tries to sneak in
articles.author: Justin M. Robert

paras.en: Holidays are often a fun break during a busy year – a long weekend here and there is an event many of us can get behind. However, when a short holiday break turns into a full holiday season, we know that this is a different “ball game”.
paras.zh: 假期通常是忙碌的一年中的一个有趣的休息时间——这里有一个长周末，而且我们很多人都可以参加一些活动。然而，当短暂的假期变成了完整的假期时，我们知道，这是一场不同的“球赛”。

paras.en: Everyone has stress about something – some people love the holidays, and some people are holiday-avoidant… and some live in the middle. What specific stressors or challenges you experience might not bother your sibling, your spouse or your coworker. We want to be aware of and have a clear understanding of what holidays mean to you as a person.
paras.zh: 每个人都会因某些事情而感到压力——有些人喜欢假期，有些人回避假期……还有一些人生活在中间。您所经历的具体压力或挑战可能不会困扰您的兄弟姐妹、配偶或同事。我们希望了解并清楚地了解假期对您个人的意义。

paras.en: The first step is to acknowledge what your feelings and emotions are – you may enjoy seeing the neighborhood holiday lights but not want to decorate yourself (totally okay!!), you may love shopping for the perfect gift for everyone on your list, you may avoid all of the activities — everyone one of these is an okay choice… you can be yourself always in all ways. Give yourself that permission. As you prepare, keep a list or a calendar of events – expected/obligated, okay to go or not go,
paras.zh: 第一步是承认你的感受和情绪是什么——你可能喜欢看到附近的节日灯光，但不想装饰自己（完全可以！！），你可能喜欢为清单上的每个人购买完美的礼物，你可能会避免所有的活动——其中每个人都是一个不错的选择……你可以在所有方面永远做你自己。给自己这样的许可。当你准备时，保留一份活动清单或日历——预期的/必须的，可以去也可以不去，

paras.en: Combine this with your standard calendar and make a schedule. If you want, add to the list what your part is (bring a dish, gift, coordinate a visit, etc.). Having the majority of activities written down will help you not overbook, help you plan ahead, make it easier to say no, spend within your budget. Before you commit to something, say “I have to check my calendar first…. I will get back to you”.
paras.zh: 将其与您的标准日历结合起来并制定时间表。如果您愿意，可以在列表中添加您的职责（带菜、礼物、协调访问等）。写下大部分活动将帮助您避免超额预订，帮助您提前计划，更容易拒绝，并在预算范围内进行支出。在你做出某件事之前，请说“我必须先查看我的日历......我会回复你”。

paras.en: Prepare your budget – We often budget for gifts but forget that we will be buying more groceries for those special meals and favorite dishes…. We also need to budget for travel, having guests in your home, clothing, even allow for a higher electric bill. Write it down – keep receipts – let your immediate family know that this is what we have to spend, then track it as you go.
paras.zh: 准备你的预算——我们经常为礼物做预算，但忘记了我们会为那些特殊的膳食和最喜欢的菜肴购买更多的杂货……。我们还需要为旅行、家里的客人、衣服、甚至更高的电费做好预算。把它写下来——保留收据——让你的直系亲属知道这是我们必须花的钱，然后在你走的时候跟踪它。

paras.en: Now that you have a current calendar and a working budget, set realistic expectations for your holiday experience. We know that not everything is optional and traditions will continue but none of it has to be perfect…minor stress and family friction can be normal.
paras.zh: 现在您已经有了当前的日历和工作预算，请为您的假期体验设定切合实际的期望。我们知道，并非一切都是可选的，传统将继续下去，但没有一个必须是完美的……轻微的压力和家庭摩擦可能是正常的。

paras.en: When telling someone no, use “I” statements and stick to the single issue at hand. In addition to your list/calendar, remember to prioritize time for yourself. Keep your regular sleep schedule as much as possible, eat well (if you have a heavy meal one day, lighten up the next), schedule time to get fresh air and a quick break. ALWAYS focus on what matters. Focus on meaningful connections rather than activities that cause you anxiety.
paras.zh: 当告诉某人“不”时，使用“我”陈述并坚持手头的单一问题。除了您的清单/日历之外，请记住优先考虑自己的时间。尽可能保持有规律的睡眠时间，吃得好（如果你一天吃得很饱，第二天就吃得清淡一些），安排时间呼吸新鲜空气和快速休息。始终专注于重要的事情。专注于有意义的联系，而不是那些导致你焦虑的活动。

paras.en: If you feel emotional, take a few moments alone and identify the feeling, honor yourself for being able to face it and breathe through it (avoid pushing it down). Remember how many times you have gotten through a “pressure moment” and give yourself credit. Call a trusted friend or your therapist if you feel overwhelmed for longer than a day….and, please call 988 if you feel overwhelmed to an extreme. 988 is always available and waiting to help.
paras.zh: 如果您感到情绪激动，请花一些时间独处并识别这种感觉，为自己能够面对它并通过它呼吸而感到自豪（避免将其压低）。记住你经历了多少次“压力时刻”并给自己信心。如果您感到不知所措超过一天，请致电值得信赖的朋友或治疗师……如果您感到不知所措到了极点，请致电 988。 988 随时为您提供帮助。

paras.en: Look for the glimmers – find a happy moment (no matter how brief), find the memories that make you smile. Thinking of something joyful changes your emotional state… train yourself to do this any time you need a lift. Ultimately, we want to move away from focusing on the future (It causes anxiety) or overthinking about the past (it causes depression) ….and find yourself in the here and now where you have power to manage things happening around you. Your power is with you in the present. (Eckert Tolle book – The Power of Now).
paras.zh: 寻找闪光点——寻找快乐的时刻（无论多么短暂），寻找让你微笑的回忆。想到一些快乐的事情会改变你的情绪状态……训练自己在任何需要提神的时候都这样做。最终，我们希望摆脱对未来的关注（它会导致焦虑）或过度思考过去（它会导致抑郁）......并发现自己处于此时此地，你有能力管理周围发生的事情。你的力量就在当下。 （埃克特·托尔的书《当下的力量》）。

paras.en: The holiday season lasts for weeks – gift yourself with
paras.zh: 假期持续数周——给自己一个礼物

paras.en: - Honoring yourself – take a break if you need to
paras.zh: - 尊重自己——如果需要的话休息一下

paras.en: - Acknowledge your emotions (holidays can be sad as well as joyful)
paras.zh: - 承认你的情绪（假期可以悲伤也可以快乐）

paras.en: - Respect differences – focus on the reason you are together and celebrating
paras.zh: - 尊重差异——专注于你们在一起和庆祝的原因

paras.en: With the extra pressure of the holiday season, our feelings can often be stronger than other times during the year…. if you start having feelings:
paras.zh: 由于假期的额外压力，我们的感受往往会比一年中的其他时间更强烈……。如果你开始有感觉：

paras.en: Anxious – take deep breaths, focus ONLY on the present – your surroundings, what you see, count objects, put ice on the inside of your wrists (this works really well!)
paras.zh: 焦虑 – 深呼吸，只关注当下 – 你的周围环境，你所看到的，数物体，在你的手腕内侧放冰块（这非常有效！）

paras.en: Angry – walk away for a moment, take a break, give yourself as long as you need to regulate these feelings, know that whoever gets angry first loses…be the winner in the moment.
paras.zh: 生气——走开一会儿，休息一下，只要你需要调节这些情绪，就给自己足够的时间，知道谁先生气，谁就输了……成为当下的赢家。

paras.en: Helpless, hopeless, trapped (discouraged) – remember that you have a voice, it is sometimes difficult to use it in family situations, but you can talk to yourself. Remember how strong you are, how many accomplishments you have completed…. reframe the situation so you recall all of your wonderful qualities.
paras.zh: 无助、绝望、受困（灰心）——记住你有发言权，有时在家庭情况下很难使用它，但你可以对自己说话。记住你有多强大，你完成了多少成就……。重新构建情境，让你回忆起你所有的美好品质。

paras.en: Overwhelmed – Check your list/holiday calendar again…what can you change or take off the list. What can you postpone for 24-48 hours? What can you give someone else to do? What can you order from the store rather than do the cooking or shopping yourself? Find a quick solution for one or two things (at least) and take some pressure off.
paras.zh: 不知所措 – 再次检查您的清单/假期日历……您可以更改或从清单中删除哪些内容。什么事情可以推迟 24-48 小时？你能给别人做什么？您可以从商店订购什么而不是自己做饭或购物？ （至少）找到一两件事的快速解决方案并减轻一些压力。

paras.en: Grief – acknowledge how you feel, we do not have to be cheerful just because it is a holiday. Say no to any event or activity that feels too “heavy” and give yourself permission to leave if it becomes too much. Find a way to keep their memory with you – carry a favorite picture or memento. Find a grief support group.
paras.zh: 悲伤——承认你的感受，我们不必仅仅因为这是一个假期就感到高兴。对任何感觉太“沉重”的事件或活动说“不”，如果变得太“沉重”，就允许自己离开。想办法让他们留在你身边——携带一张最喜欢的照片或纪念品。寻找悲伤支持小组。

paras.en: Basically, we want to notice the small things and find gratitude in what we have. Our outward situation does not define us. If you find that holiday time is difficult or stressful, always give yourself permission to contact your EAP services for assistance and support.
paras.zh: 基本上，我们想要注意到小事情，并在我们所拥有的事物中找到感激之情。我们的外在处境并不能定义我们。如果您发现假期很困难或压力很大，请务必允许自己联系您的 EAP 服务寻求帮助和支持。

articles.title: Ukraine: Civilian casualties in 2026 already far exceed previous years’ tolls

paras.en: Ukraine: Civilian casualties in 2026 already far exceed previous years’ tolls
paras.zh: 乌克兰：2026年平民伤亡人数已远超往年

paras.en: This year has seen dramatically higher civilian casualties in Ukraine than any other year since the full-scale invasion of the eastern European country by Russia in February 2022, the UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in Ukraine (HRMMU) said on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 联合国驻乌克兰人权监察团（HRMMU）周二表示，自俄罗斯于 2022 年 2 月全面入侵东欧国家以来，今年乌克兰的平民伤亡人数比任何其他年份都要高。

paras.en: In October 2026, the number of civilians killed (372) and injured (1,981) was 95 per cent higher than in October the previous year.
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月，平民死亡人数（372 人）和受伤人数（1,981 人）比上一年 10 月增加了 95%。

paras.en: The first ten months of 2026 have seen more civilian deaths than all of 2025, which in turn was worse than the year before, the head of the HRMMU noted, urging the world not to “become numb to the deadly toll the war exacts on Ukraine’s civilians.”
paras.zh: HRMMU 负责人指出，2026 年前 10 个月的平民死亡人数比 2025 年全年还要多，这反过来又比前一年更糟糕，他敦促世界不要“对战争给乌克兰平民造成的致命伤亡麻木不仁”。

paras.en: In all, almost 18,000 civilians have been killed and almost 58,000 have been injured in Ukraine since February 2022.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年 2 月以来，乌克兰总共有近 18,000 名平民被杀，近 58,000 人受伤。

paras.en: The alarming trend continued in November, which saw one of the deadliest single attacks on civilians since the start of the war.
paras.zh: 11 月份这一令人震惊的趋势仍在继续，这是自战争开始以来针对平民最致命的一次袭击事件之一。

paras.en: On 2 November, multiple bombs struck the premises of a school in Komyshuvakha in south-eastern Ukraine, including an underground shelter where civilians had gathered to receive humanitarian aid.
paras.zh: 11 月 2 日，多枚炸弹袭击了乌克兰东南部 Komyshuvakha 的一所学校校舍，其中包括平民聚集接受人道主义援助的地下避难所。

paras.en: 72 people had been killed and four remained missing, Ukrainian authorities reported on 16 November.
paras.zh: 乌克兰当局 11 月 16 日报告称，已造成 72 人死亡，四人失踪。

paras.en: The UN human rights mission is still verifying the victims' identities and status, but has confirmed that dozens were civilians, including local residents, administrative staff and emergency workers.
paras.zh: 联合国人权特派团仍在核实受害者的身份和状况，但已确认数十人是平民，包括当地居民、行政人员和急救人员。

paras.en: Moreover, on Monday, a drone struck a humanitarian vehicle evacuating civilians with limited mobility from the city of Kramatorsk in eastern Ukraine. The driver was seriously injured, one evacuee sustained minor injuries, and other passengers suffered hearing damage, the UN Secretary-General’s spokesperson told journalists on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 此外，周一，一架无人机袭击了一辆人道主义车辆，该车辆正在从乌克兰东部的克拉马托尔斯克市疏散行动不便的平民。联合国秘书长发言人周二告诉记者，司机受重伤，一名撤离人员受轻伤，其他乘客听力受损。

paras.en: The UN's humanitarian coordination office (OCHA) renewed its call for the protection of civilians, including aid workers.
paras.zh: 联合国人道主义协调办公室（OCHA）再次呼吁保护平民，包括援助人员。

paras.en: Long-range weapons – missiles and drones – remain the leading cause of civilian casualties, accounting for more than half of those killed and injured.
paras.zh: 远程武器——导弹和无人机——仍然是造成平民伤亡的主要原因，占伤亡人数的一半以上。

paras.en: Casualties from aerial glide bombs – bombs fitted with wings that allow them to travel long distances after being dropped from aircraft – also rose sharply in October. The number of civilian deaths they caused doubled compared with September, reaching 92 killed and 331 injured.
paras.zh: 空中滑翔炸弹——装有机翼的炸弹，从飞机上投下后可以远距离飞行——造成的伤亡也在 10 月份急剧上升。与9月份相比，他们造成的平民死亡人数增加了一倍，达到92人死亡、331人受伤。

paras.en: Aerial glide bombs accounted for 18 per cent of civilian casualties that month, while short-range drones were responsible for 19 per cent.
paras.zh: 当月平民伤亡中，空中滑翔炸弹造成的伤亡占 18%，短程无人机造成的伤亡占 19%。

paras.en: Russian forces intensified attacks on Ukraine's energy infrastructure in October as the country prepared for its fifth winter at war.
paras.zh: 十月，俄罗斯军队加强了对乌克兰能源基础设施的攻击，当时乌克兰正在为第五个冬天的战争做准备。

paras.en: Strikes damaged electricity and heating facilities, disrupting power supplies and, in some cities, water services.
paras.zh: 罢工损坏了电力和供暖设施，中断了电力供应，在一些城市还中断了供水服务。

paras.en: Ukrainian authorities were forced to introduce rolling power outages nationwide.
paras.zh: 乌克兰当局被迫在全国范围内实行轮流停电。

paras.en: Ukrainian armed forces also attacked electricity infrastructure in Russian-occupied territory of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 乌克兰武装部队还袭击了俄罗斯占领的乌克兰领土上的电力基础设施。

paras.en: According to Russian authorities, Ukrainian attacks in October killed at least 90 people and injured 306 in Russian-occupied Ukrainian territory, while 59 were killed and 402 injured in the Russian Federation – though HRMMU could not independently verify these figures due to restricted access and a lack of independent sources.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯当局称，乌克兰 10 月份的袭击事件在俄罗斯占领的乌克兰领土上造成至少 90 人死亡、306 人受伤，而在俄罗斯联邦则有 59 人死亡、402 人受伤，但由于访问受限和缺乏独立消息来源，HRMMU 无法独立核实这些数字。

paras.en: In Russian-occupied areas of Ukraine, Ukrainian forces also targeted electricity infrastructure and the UN mission independently verified that at least 12 civilians were killed and 18 injured.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯占领的乌克兰地区，乌克兰军队还袭击了电力基础设施，联合国特派团独立核实，至少有12名平民死亡、18人受伤。

articles.title: Dozens more children killed in Yemen amid escalating hostilities

paras.en: Dozens more children killed in Yemen amid escalating hostilities
paras.zh: 也门敌对行动升级，数十名儿童丧生

paras.en: The UN child rights agency, UNICEF, on Wednesday called for warring parties in Yemen to protect children as renewed conflict between Houthi rebels and Government forces approaches the three-month mark.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童权利机构联合国儿童基金会周三呼吁也门交战各方保护儿童，因为胡塞叛军和政府军之间的新冲突已接近三个月。

paras.en: At least 64 children have been killed and the same number injured since hostilities intensified on 3 September, UNICEF said, warning that numbers are likely to increase as fighting continues around densely populated areas, particularly in Taiz and Lahj governorates.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会表示，自 9 月 3 日敌对行动加剧以来，至少有 64 名儿童被杀，受伤人数相同，并警告说，随着人口稠密地区（特别是塔伊兹省和拉赫季省）的战斗继续进行，数字可能会增加。

paras.en: “The rising number of children killed and injured in Yemen is devastating. It must stop,” said UNICEF Executive Director Catherine Russell. “Behind every number is a child whose life has been cut short or changed forever.”
paras.zh: “也门儿童死伤人数不断增加，这是毁灭性的。这种现象必须停止，”联合国儿童基金会执行主任凯瑟琳·拉塞尔说。 “每个数字的背后都有一个孩子的生命被缩短或永远改变。”

paras.en: The escalation ended a four-year UN-brokered truce between the Iran-backed Houthis, officially known as Ansar Allah, and Yemeni troops, who are supported by a Saudi-led coalition.
paras.zh: 此次升级结束了伊朗支持的胡塞武装（正式名称为安萨尔安拉）与也门军队（得到沙特领导的联军支持）之间为期四年的停火协议。

paras.en: The fighting has directly impacted basic services and infrastructure that children depend on, UNICEF said, noting that at least seven schools – including five that it supports – and 28 health facilities have been damaged.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会表示，战斗直接影响了儿童赖以生存的基本服务和基础设施，并指出至少 7 所学校（其中包括其支持的 5 所学校）和 28 个医疗设施遭到破坏。

paras.en: Furthermore, an attack on the UNICEF-supported Al-Suqyah Health Centre in Lahj on 2 November reportedly killed five people, including three health workers.
paras.zh: 此外，据报道，11 月 2 日，联合国儿童基金会支持的拉赫季 Al-Suqyah 卫生中心遭到袭击，造成 5 人死亡，其中包括 3 名卫生工作者。

paras.en: Meanwhile, more than 330,000 people, including some 174,000 children, have been displaced. Many families are now sheltering in unfinished or damaged buildings and struggling to access food, safe water and healthcare.
paras.zh: 与此同时，超过 330,000 人流离失所，其中包括约 174,000 名儿童。许多家庭现在躲在未完工或受损的建筑物中，难以获得食物、安全用水和医疗保健。

paras.en: UNICEF expressed particular alarm over the situation in Taiz City, where more than 800,000 people are reportedly cut off from humanitarian assistance because the main road from Aden – seat of the internationally-recognized government – is closed.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会对塔伊兹市的局势表示特别警惕，据报道，由于国际公认政府所在地亚丁的主要道路被关闭，该市有超过 80 万人无法获得人道主义援助。

paras.en: Alternative routes are insecure with Houthi forces reportedly only 60 kilometres from Aden.
paras.zh: 据报道，胡塞武装距离亚丁仅 60 公里，其他路线并不安全。

paras.en: Inside Taiz City, water production has fallen by nearly half while food and fuel prices have more than doubled, the agency said, while shortages of medicines, fuel, medical oxygen and electricity threaten emergency, maternal and newborn care.
paras.zh: 该机构表示，塔伊兹市内的水产量下降了近一半，而食品和燃料价格上涨了一倍多，而药品、燃料、医用氧气和电力的短缺威胁着紧急情况、孕产妇和新生儿护理。

paras.en: Across areas affected by the escalation, over 1,160 schools have closed or suspended classes, disrupting education for more than half a million students. At the same time, around one in three children screened by UNICEF mobile teams was found to be acutely malnourished.
paras.zh: 在受事态升级影响的地区，超过 1,160 所学校已停课或停课，超过 50 万学生的教育受到影响。与此同时，联合国儿童基金会流动小组筛查的大约三分之一的儿童被发现患有严重营养不良。

paras.en: “Yemen’s children have suffered so much. We urgently need safe and unimpeded humanitarian access,” Ms. Russell said, urging all sides to comply with their obligations under international law.
paras.zh: 拉塞尔女士表示：“也门的儿童遭受了如此多的苦难。我们迫切需要安全、畅通无阻的人道主义准入。”她敦促各方遵守国际法规定的义务。

paras.en: “Children must be protected, including their access to essential services such as healthcare, education, safe water and food.”
paras.zh: “儿童必须受到保护，包括他们获得医疗保健、教育、安全饮水和食品等基本服务的机会。”

paras.en: As the crisis continues, UNICEF is expanding its emergency response to reach up to 350,000 people. This includes redeploying health and nutrition mobile teams to displacement sites and affected communities in Aden, Lahj, Abyan, Marib and Taiz.
paras.zh: 随着危机的持续，联合国儿童基金会正在扩大应急响应范围，覆盖范围已扩大至 35 万人。这包括将卫生和营养流动小组重新部署到亚丁、拉赫季、阿比扬、马里卜和塔伊兹的流离失所地点和受影响社区。

paras.en: The agency is also scaling up emergency water and sanitation support, and providing psychosocial care and case management for children, including those who are unaccompanied or separated from their families.
paras.zh: 该机构还扩大了紧急供水和卫生设施支持，并为儿童（包括那些无人陪伴或与家人失散的儿童）提供社会心理护理和案件管理。

articles.title: Patients running out of options as antibiotics stop working against common infections

paras.en: Patients running out of options as antibiotics stop working against common infections
paras.zh: 由于抗生素不再对常见感染起作用，患者别无选择

paras.en: Common bacteria are becoming highly resistant to front-line and even “last-resort” antibiotics, the UN World Health Organization (WHO) said on Wednesday, warning that the situation today is worse than it was in 2019.
paras.zh: 联合国世界卫生组织 (WHO) 周三表示，常见细菌对一线甚至“最后手段”抗生素产生了高度耐药性，并警告说，今天的情况比 2019 年更糟糕。

paras.en: The agency issued the alert with the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) after analysing progress on targets to reduce infections caused by resistant bacteria – often described as “superbugs” – that thrive in healthcare settings.
paras.zh: 该机构在分析了减少耐药细菌（通常被称为“超级细菌”）引起的感染的目标进展情况后，与欧洲疾病预防和控制中心（ECDC）发布了这一警报。

paras.en: Instead of achieving the target of a five per cent fall in infections from the common hospital bacterium Klebsiella pneumoniae, they rose by an estimated 72 per cent between 2019 and 2025.
paras.zh: 2019 年至 2025 年间，医院常见细菌肺炎克雷伯菌感染率并未实现下降 5% 的目标，反而增加了 72%。

paras.en: And infections with E. coli bacterium - which are also resistant to regular antibiotics known as cephalosporins - were set a target of a 10 per cent decrease. Instead, they rose by more than 16 per cent.
paras.zh: 大肠杆菌感染（也对头孢菌素等常规抗生素具有耐药性）的目标是减少 10%。相反，它们的涨幅超过 16%。

paras.en: WHO said that it found resistance to key antibiotics in at least half of the samples of Klebsiella pneumoniae and another common bug, Acinetobacter, in about one in two countries in Europe.
paras.zh: 世卫组织表示，在欧洲约二分之一的国家中，至少一半的肺炎克雷伯菌和另一种常见细菌不动杆菌样本中发现了对关键抗生素的耐药性。

paras.en: Dr Marc-Alain Widdowson, head of health security at WHO/Europe said that in many countries in the region, “the antibiotics doctors usually reach for first are failing against serious hospital infections”. When these treatments fail to work, doctors turn to stronger drugs normally kept for the most serious cases that are called carbapenems.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织/欧洲卫生安全负责人Marc-Alain Widdowson博士表示，在该地区的许多国家，“医生通常首先使用的抗生素对严重的医院感染无效”。当这些治疗无效时，医生会转而使用通常用于治疗最严重病例的更强效药物，即碳青霉烯类药物。

paras.en: “When those stop working too, what’s left is mostly a small group of last-resort drugs that are often expensive and not available in every country,” he explained. “Each time one of these lines of defence falls, patients move closer to having no good options at all. That matters, because people whose first antibiotic doesn’t work against their infection are more likely to die in hospital.”
paras.zh: “当这些药物也停止作用时，剩下的大多是一小部分最后手段的药物，这些药物通常很昂贵，而且并非在每个国家都可用，”他解释道。 “每当这些防线被攻破时，患者就更接近根本没有好的选择。这很重要，因为第一种抗生素对感染不起作用的人更有可能在医院死亡。”

paras.en: WHO noted that of 51 countries analysed, 16 still lack a standardized national approach and national coordination, hampering the effort to overcome antimicrobial resistance globally.
paras.zh: 世卫组织指出，在分析的 51 个国家中，有 16 个国家仍然缺乏标准化的国家方法和国家协调，阻碍了全球克服抗菌药物耐药性的努力。

paras.en: And in hospitals where few blood samples are taken to identify the bacteria behind an infection, doctors often “have to choose an antibiotic without knowing which will work”, the agency said.
paras.zh: 该机构表示，在医院中，很少采集血液样本来识别感染背后的细菌，医生常常“不得不选择一种抗生素，而不知道哪种有效”。

paras.en: For patients, this raises the risk of starting treatment on a drug that will not work. And for health systems, “it means planning half-blind”, WHO stressed, since without reliable data, countries cannot tell where resistance is spreading or whether their efforts to stop it are working. “Better testing would help on both fronts, giving patients the right drug sooner and countries a clearer view of the threat.”
paras.zh: 对于患者来说，这增加了开始使用无效药物治疗的风险。世卫组织强调，对于卫生系统来说，“这意味着半盲目的规划”，因为如果没有可靠的数据，各国就无法判断耐药性正在何处蔓延，也无法判断其阻止耐药性的努力是否有效。 “更好的测试将在这两方面都有帮助，让患者更快地获得正确的药物，让各国更清楚地认识到威胁。”

paras.en: In more positive news, the estimated rate of bloodstream infections caused by resistant Acinetobacter has almost halved since the high levels seen in 2021 during the COVID-19 pandemic.
paras.zh: 更积极的消息是，自 2021 年 COVID-19 大流行期间出现的高水平以来，由耐药不动杆菌引起的血液感染率估计几乎减半。

articles.title: Koepka 'disappointed' with PGA Tour season but 'beyond happy' to be back

paras.en: Brooks Koepka: American labels his 2026 PGA Tour season a 'disappointment' and targets 2027 Ryder Cup spot
paras.zh: 布鲁克斯·科普卡：美国人称他的 2026 年 PGA 巡回赛赛季为“失望”，并瞄准 2027 年莱德杯参赛资格

paras.en: Brooks Koepka will tee up in the RSM Classic this weekend; the American left LIV Golf in 2025 and returned to the PGA Tour earlier this year but has endured a tough season; watch the RSM Classic live on Sky Sports Golf
paras.zh: 布鲁克斯·科普卡 (Brooks Koepka) 将于本周末参加 RSM 精英赛 (RSM Classic)；这位美国人于 2025 年离开 LIV Golf，并于今年早些时候重返 PGA 巡回赛，但经历了一个艰难的赛季；在天空体育高尔夫频道观看 RSM Classic 直播

paras.en: Brooks Koepka has dubbed his 2026 season a "a disappointment" but insists he is hungry to secure a spot on Team USA's 2027 Ryder Cup squad.
paras.zh: 布鲁克斯·科普卡 (Brooks Koepka) 称他的 2026 年赛季“令人失望”，但坚称他渴望在美国队 2027 年莱德杯阵容中获得一席之地。

paras.en: The American returned to the PGA Tour via the one-time-only Returning Member Program in January following his LIV Golf exit at the end of 2025, a decision he said he was "beyond happy with".
paras.zh: 这位美国人在 2025 年底退出 LIV Golf 后，于 1 月份通过一次性回归会员计划重返 PGA 巡回赛，他表示对这一决定“非常满意”。

paras.en: After being welcomed back to the tour with open arms, Koepka made his return at the Farmers Insurance Open in February. He'd go on to make 16 starts on the PGA Tour this year but would miss the cut at five events and record only one top-10 finish.
paras.zh: 在受到热烈欢迎重返巡回赛后，科普卡在二月份的农民保险公开赛上回归。今年他在 PGA 巡回赛上首发 16 场，但在 5 场赛事中遭遇淘汰，仅取得一次前十名的成绩。

paras.en: Koepka, who was not selected as one of Keegan Bradley's captain's picks for the 2025 Ryder Cup and was also omitted from Brandt Snedeker's President's Cup team in 2026, hopes to raise his game and earn a spot in the roster for next year's Ryder Cup.
paras.zh: 科普卡没有被选为基冈·布拉德利 (Keegan Bradley) 参加 2025 年莱德杯的队长人选之一，并且也被布兰特·斯内德克尔 (Brandt Snedeker) 的 2026 年总统杯队剔除，他希望提高自己的水平，并在明年莱德杯的名单中赢得一席之地。

paras.en: "Adare Manor is a big goal of mine," Koepka said. "But this year has just been a little bit of a disappointment, so I know I need to pick it up a little bit.
paras.zh: “阿黛尔庄园是我的一个大目标，”科普卡说。 “但今年有点令人失望，所以我知道我需要重新振作起来。

paras.en: "It's something I don't enjoy, sitting back watching the Presidents Cup.
paras.zh: “我不喜欢坐在后面观看总统杯。

paras.en: "I know I've only played in one [2017], a lot of those [omissions are due to] injuries. But those team events are a lot of fun, I really enjoy them.
paras.zh: “我知道我只参加过一场[2017]，其中很多[缺席是由于]受伤。但那些团队活动很有趣，我真的很喜欢它们。

paras.en: "Getting to be around the guys and representing your country is pretty cool.
paras.zh: “与这些人在一起并代表你的国家是非常酷的。

paras.en: "So, anytime you can do that, or you have the opportunity to, and you're not able to go play, it kind of infuriates me sitting on the sidelines."
paras.zh: “所以，任何时候你可以这样做，或者你有机会，但你不能去比赛，这会让坐在场边的我感到愤怒。”

paras.en: The 36-year-old has featured in four Ryder Cup's in the past, notably helping Team USA to victory in at Hazletine in 2016 and Whistling Straits in 2020.
paras.zh: 这位 36 岁的球员过去曾四次参加莱德杯比赛，特别是帮助美国队在 2016 年的黑兹勒廷赛和 2020 年的呼啸海峡赛中获胜。

paras.en: He boasts an overall individual record of 7-6-2.
paras.zh: 他的个人总战绩为 7-6-2。

paras.en: 'The reception was fantastic from the players'
paras.zh: “球员们的接待非常棒”

paras.en: However, following the dissolution of the formerly Saudi-backed breakaway league, Rahm, DeChambeau and Smith have all elected to rejoin the DP World Tour for the 2027 season, along with multiple other former LIV Golf players.
paras.zh: 然而，随着前沙特支持的分离联盟解散，拉姆、德尚博和史密斯都选择在 2027 赛季重新加入 DP 世界巡回赛，以及其他多名前 LIV Golf 球员。

paras.en: Koepka, meanwhile, was asked ahead of this week's RSM Classic whether he felt back at home after returning to the PGA Tour, replying: "Yeah, I felt very at peace with coming back.
paras.zh: 与此同时，科普卡在本周的RSM精英赛之前被问及回到美巡赛后是否有宾至如归的感觉，他回答说：“是的，我对回来感到非常平静。

paras.en: "The reception was fantastic from all the players, caddies, just everybody on tour.
paras.zh: “所有球员、球童以及巡回赛上的每个人的接待都非常棒。

paras.en: "I think I kept a good relationship with everybody even when I left.
paras.zh: “我认为即使在我离开后，我也与每个人都保持着良好的关系。

paras.en: "I think that played probably a huge part in that.
paras.zh: “我认为这可能在其中发挥了重要作用。

paras.en: "Everybody was really receptive. I loved the conversations that I've had just throughout the year, just guys asking what was going on, thought process and how things went and the decisions made to get back here.
paras.zh: “每个人都非常乐于接受。我非常喜欢这一年来与大家的交流，大家会问我发生了什么、我的思考过程、事情的进展以及为了重返这里所作的决定。

paras.en: "Everything was great. I'm beyond happy with my decision."
paras.zh: “一切都很棒。我对自己的决定非常满意。”

articles.title: Hemp stars as Man City beat Hacken in Champions League

paras.en: BK Häcken Women vs Manchester City Women; Women's Champions League
paras.zh: BK Häcken 女子 vs 曼城 女子；女子冠军联赛

paras.en: BK Häcken Women vs Manchester City Women. Women's Champions League.
paras.zh: BK Häcken 女子 vs 曼城 女子。女子冠军联赛。

paras.en: BK Hacken 0-2 Man City: Lauren Hemp and Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw on target in Women's Champions League win
paras.zh: BK Hacken 0-2 曼城：Lauren Hemp 和 Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw 在女子冠军联赛获胜中进球

paras.en: Match report as Lauren Hemp and Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw won the game for Man City at BK Hacken; the pair came on at half-time after a goalless first half; Mary Fowler saw a late penalty saved by Jennifer Falk; Man City remain unbeaten in the Women's Champions League this season
paras.zh: 比赛报道 Lauren Hemp 和 Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw 为曼城队在 BK Hacken 赢得了比赛；上半场双方互交白卷，两人在中场休息时上场。玛丽·福勒 (Mary Fowler) 看到最后时刻的点球被詹妮弗·法尔克 (Jennifer Falk) 扑出。曼城本赛季女足欧冠保持不败

paras.en: Lauren Hemp scored one and assisted another as Manchester City beat BK Hacken 2-0 in their penultimate Women's Champions League league phase game on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 周三，曼城队在女足欧冠联赛倒数第二场比赛中，劳伦·汉普 (Lauren Hemp) 攻入一球并助攻另一球，帮助曼城 2-0 击败 BK Hacken。

paras.en: After a goalless first half in which the WSL champions struggled to break down a stubborn Hacken, Andree Jeglertz played his aces at half-time, bringing on Hemp and Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw.
paras.zh: 上半场双方互交白卷，WSL 冠军队艰难地击败了顽固的哈肯，安德烈·耶格勒茨 (Andree Jeglertz) 在半场打出了他的王牌，派上了 Hemp 和 Khadija “Bunny” Shaw。

paras.en: The England international immediately brought a spark and directness Man City had been lacking in the first 45 minutes. Aoba Fujino was their best attacking threat to that point, but was one of the players - along with Beth Mead, who was largely ineffective - who made way at the break.
paras.zh: 这位英格兰国脚立即为曼城带来了前45分钟所缺乏的火花和直接性。青叶藤野是他们当时最好的进攻威胁，但也是在中场休息时让路的球员之一——还有贝丝·米德，后者基本上效率低下。

paras.en: It was a fortuitous opener for Hemp, although made by her own tenacity. She wriggled through two defenders into the box, with Emma Ostlund's clearance hitting her on the shin before beating Jennifer Falk.
paras.zh: 对于 Hemp 来说，这是一个偶然的开局，尽管是她自己的坚韧造成的。她蠕动着穿过两名防守队员进入禁区，艾玛·奥斯特伦德的解围击中了她的小腿，然后击败了詹妮弗·福尔克。

paras.en: She hit the post too not long after as Man City looked for the comfort of a second, and soon found it as Hemp and Shaw linked up perfectly.
paras.zh: 不久之后，当曼城寻求一秒钟的舒适感时，她也击中了立柱，很快就发现了这一点，汉普和肖完美地配合在一起。

paras.en: It was almost telepathic as the winger picked up the ball deep on the left, lifting up her head for Shaw, who immediately began her run. The Jamaica international muscled through three defenders and once she had the ball at her feet, it was inevitable that she would beat the goalkeeper into the far corner.
paras.zh: 当边锋在左侧深处接球时，她几乎有心灵感应，抬起头向肖求助，肖立即开始跑动。这位牙买加国脚强行突破了三名后卫，一旦她把球拿在脚下，她就不可避免地会击败守门员射入远角。

paras.en: There was late drama too as Man City were awarded a contentious penalty. Shaw went down after taking an elbow to the face from Aivi Luik as the two jumped for a high ball. The striker looked dazed as she went off the pitch, with the referee sent to the monitor by the VAR officials.
paras.zh: 最后的戏剧性事件也发生了，曼城被判了一个有争议的点球。当两人跳起高球时，肖被艾维·路易斯的肘部击倒在地。这名前锋离开球场时看上去很茫然，VAR官员将裁判送到了监视器前。

paras.en: She eventually pointed to the spot with Mary Fowler stepping up. However, Falk guessed the right way as the Man City forward went for the bottom left corner.
paras.zh: 她最终指着那个地方，玛丽·福勒站了出来。然而，法尔克猜对了，曼城前锋射向左下角。

paras.en: But it did little to alter the overall result as Man City won their second Women's Champions League game, and it sends them into third on nine points. However, there are seven games yet to play on matchday five, with Jeglertz's side facing Austria Wien at home in their final league phase game on December 16.
paras.zh: 但这并没有改变整体结果，曼城赢得了第二场女足欧冠比赛，并以 9 分排名第三。然而，第五轮比赛还有七场比赛尚未进行，耶格勒茨的球队将于 12 月 16 日在联赛阶段最后一场比赛中主场迎战奥地利维也纳。

paras.en: 38: BIG CHANCE! Fujino's shot is well-saved by Falk after a great run, before Yui Hasegawa skies the rebound.
paras.zh: 38：大机会！藤野的射门在一次出色的跑动后被法尔克扑出，随后长谷川由衣抢下篮板。

paras.en: 45: CHANCE! Rebecca Knaack hits a wicked volley goalwards, but Falk is there to collect again.
paras.zh: 45：机会！丽贝卡·纳克 (Rebecca Knaack) 射出一记邪恶的凌空抽射，但法尔克 (Falk) 再次接球。

paras.en: 52: SHOT!! Anna Anvegard's shot is blocked and cleared by Knaack.
paras.zh: 52：开枪！！安娜·安维加德的射门被纳克挡出并解围。

paras.en: 55: GOAL! Hemp opens the scoring for Man City after a deflection off her shin.
paras.zh: 55：目标！汉普在小腿受伤后为曼城首开纪录。

paras.en: 57: NO GOAL! Fowler has the ball in the net, but the offside flag is up with Hasegawa standing in Falk's line of sight.
paras.zh: 57：没有目标！福勒将球射入网内，但越位旗已举起，长谷川站在福尔克的视线范围内。

paras.en: 67: OFF THE POST! Hemp hits the woodwork after a great driving run, before Grace Clinton also sees her follow-up blocked.
paras.zh: 67：离岗！汉普在一次出色的开球后击中了门框，随后格蕾丝·克林顿也看到她的后续动作被阻挡。

paras.en: 77: GOAL! Shaw slots home after a fine pass from Hemp for Man City's second.
paras.zh: 77：目标！汉普送出精彩传球后，肖破门得分，为曼城打入第二球。

paras.en: 90+5: PENALTY! Man City are awarded a penalty after the referee was sent to the monitor by VAR. Luik is penalised for catching Shaw in the face with an elbow.
paras.zh: 90+5：罚球！ VAR将主裁送至监视器后，曼城判罚点球。路易斯因用肘部击中肖的脸部而受到处罚。

paras.en: 90+6: SAVED! Fowler's spot kick is saved by Falk.
paras.zh: 90+6：已保存！福勒主罚的点球被法尔克扑出。

paras.en: Analysis from Sky Sports' Charlotte Marsh:
paras.zh: 天空体育的夏洛特·马什分析：

paras.en: As if we needed a reminder, but it was clearer than ever just how influential Hemp and Shaw are for Man City after their half-time introduction.
paras.zh: 好像我们需要提醒一样，但在半场介绍后，我们比以往任何时候都更清楚汉普和肖对曼城的影响力有多大。

paras.en: Hemp was electric from the whistle. In the opening five minutes, she had already put in at least two crosses. Shaw made a key clearance at the other end too, proving that she can contribute across the pitch.
paras.zh: 口哨声响起，大麻就带电了。开场五分钟内，她就已经至少送出了两次传中。肖也在另一端做出了关键的解围，证明了她可以在球场上做出贡献。

paras.en: While Hemp's goal was created by talent and executed by luck, it was the second, as she pinged a ball forward for Shaw to finish, that truly showed why they are one of the most dangerous pairings in women's football. It was textbook from them both, but one that Hacken clearly had not studied.
paras.zh: 虽然亨普的进球是靠天赋创造的，而且执行得也靠运气，但第二个进球是她把球传给肖，才真正证明了为什么她们是女足中最危险的组合之一。这是他们俩的教科书，但哈肯显然没有学过。

paras.en: Jeglertz would have been hoping to give his stars a rest, but they delivered when he needed them - ultimately what they are paid to do.
paras.zh: 杰格勒茨本来希望让他的明星们休息一下，但他们在他需要的时候提供了帮助——最终他们得到报酬的目的。

paras.en: It was a shame Fujino had to be sacrificed. She was one of Man City's best players in the first half, but Beth Mead missed an opportunity to stake her claim for a regular starting spot. She offered little on her first Man City start since early October and will surely be disappointed.
paras.zh: 不得不牺牲藤野，真是可惜。她是曼城上半场表现最好的球员之一，但贝丝·米德错过了获得常规首发位置的机会。自十月初以来，她在曼城的首次首发中几乎没有做出什么贡献，她肯定会感到失望。

paras.en: But Hemp and Shaw reign supreme. It is a joy to watch them both play.
paras.zh: 但汉普和肖占据了主导地位。看他们俩踢球真是一种享受。

paras.en: Jeglertz: We got more space in the second half
paras.zh: 耶格勒茨：下半场我们获得了更多空间

paras.en: Man City boss Andree Jeglertz to the club's media: "A good game. We knew it would be a tough game to score against a very organised defending team. They have a great goalkeeper and we struggled in the first half. In the second half, they got a little bit tired, we got a little more space and we managed to get the goals.
paras.zh: 曼城主帅安德烈·耶格勒茨对俱乐部媒体表示：“一场精彩的比赛。我们知道对阵一支组织严密的防守球队将是一场艰难的比赛。他们有一位出色的门将，我们在上半场表现不佳。下半场，他们有点累了，我们有更多的空间，我们成功进球了。”

paras.en: "We try to get the best out of each player and put them in positions where they can really show what qualities they have.
paras.zh: “我们努力让每个球员发挥出最好的水平，并将他们安排在能够真正展示自己素质的位置上。

paras.en: "We have a great team together, we rotate players, and they all have a great impact on what we're doing. I think that will be very important in the future."
paras.zh: “我们拥有一支优秀的团队，我们轮换球员，他们都对我们正在做的事情产生很大的影响。我认为这在未来将非常重要。”

articles.title: Cadillac confirm Bottas to stay with team for 2027

paras.en: Valtteri Bottas: Cadillac confirm Finnish driver to stay with team for 2027 Formula 1 season ahead of Las Vegas Grand Prix
paras.zh: 瓦尔特利·博塔斯：凯迪拉克确认芬兰车手将在拉斯维加斯大奖赛之前留在车队参加 2027 年一级方程式赛季

paras.en: Valtteri Bottas will remain with Cadillac next year after speculation his future at the team was in doubt; watch the Las Vegas GP weekend on Sky Sports F1, with Friday's practice sessions at 12.30am and 4pm
paras.zh: 瓦尔特利·博塔斯明年将继续留在凯迪拉克，因为外界猜测他在车队的未来存在疑问。在天空体育 F1 观看拉斯维加斯大奖赛周末，周五中午 12.30 和下午 4 点进行练习赛

paras.en: Cadillac have confirmed Valtteri Bottas will stay on at the team for the 2027 Formula 1 season, ending speculation about the Finnish driver's future.
paras.zh: 凯迪拉克已确认瓦尔特利·博塔斯将留在车队参加 2027 年一级方程式赛季，结束了对这位芬兰车手未来的猜测。

paras.en: Bottas returned after a year's absence from the grid for this season, Cadillac's first in the sport, as one of two hugely experienced drivers for the all-new American team's first line-up alongside Sergio Perez, who signed a contract extension last month until at least 2029.
paras.zh: 博塔斯在缺席赛场一年后重返本赛季，这是凯迪拉克在这项运动中的第一次，作为全新美国车队第一阵容的两位经验丰富的车手之一，与塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯并肩作战，佩雷斯上个月签署了一份续约合同，至少到 2029 年。

paras.en: But, Bottas' future has been up in the air recently as Cadillac pushed for American Formula 2 driver Colton Herta to earn a Formula 1 super licence, which he secured two weeks ago, by running him in practice sessions.
paras.zh: 但是，博塔斯的未来最近一直悬而未决，因为凯迪拉克推动美国二级方程式赛车手科尔顿·赫塔获得一级方程式超级驾照，两周前他通过在练习赛中与他比赛而获得了该驾照。

paras.en: The team have committed to Bottas for another year though, citing the 37-year-old's "extensive Formula 1 experience, technical insight and race-winning pedigree to the team".
paras.zh: 不过，车队已承诺让博塔斯再续约一年，理由是这位 37 岁的博塔斯拥有“丰富的一级方程式经验、技术洞察力和为车队赢得比赛的血统”。

paras.en: "To whom it may concern, I'm staying!" said Bottas, in reference to his team radio after winning the 2019 Australian Grand Prix with Mercedes.
paras.zh: “不管是谁，我都会留下来！”博塔斯在与梅赛德斯一起赢得 2019 年澳大利亚大奖赛后，在谈到他的车队广播时说道。

paras.en: "I'm excited to continue this journey with Cadillac into 2027. We knew building a new Formula 1 team from the ground up wasn't going to be easy, but that's exactly what makes this challenge so special.
paras.zh: “我很高兴能与凯迪拉克一起继续这一旅程直至 2027 年。我们知道从头开始组建一支新的一级方程式车队并不容易，但这正是这一挑战如此特别的原因。

paras.en: "We've laid the foundations, we're learning and improving, and there's still plenty more to come, I'm hungry for more, and I believe in what we're building together. The story is only just getting started."
paras.zh: “我们已经奠定了基础，我们正在学习和改进，还有更多的事情要做，我渴望更多，我相信我们正在共同建设的东西。故事才刚刚开始。”

paras.en: Newcomers Cadillac are yet to score a point in their maiden campaign but Bottas is ahead of Perez in the Drivers' Championship due to countback, as his 13th place result at the Chinese Grand Prix is the team's highest result.
paras.zh: 新人凯迪拉克在首场比赛中尚未获得一分，但博塔斯在车手积分榜上由于倒数而领先于佩雷斯，他在中国大奖赛上的第13名成绩是车队的最高成绩。

paras.en: But, Perez has generally outpaced his team-mate which, with the links of Cadillac potentially keen for an American driver in Herta, led to speculation about Bottas' future.
paras.zh: 但是，佩雷斯总体上超过了他的队友，凯迪拉克可能热衷于赫塔的美国车手，这引发了人们对博塔斯未来的猜测。

paras.en: Cadillac F1 CEO Dan Towriss said: "Valtteri's experience, perspective and commitment are important strengths for our team.
paras.zh: 凯迪拉克 F1 首席执行官 Dan Towriss 表示：“Valtteri 的经验、视角和承诺是我们团队的重要优势。

paras.en: "Continuity gives us a strong platform as we continue developing the team and working toward our ambitions in Formula 1. On the eve of the Las Vegas GP, everyone in the team is pleased to have Valtteri locked in for 2027 alongside Checo and look forward to the next stage of our journey together."
paras.zh: “连续性为我们提供了一个强大的平台，帮助我们继续发展团队并努力实现我们在一级方程式中的雄心。在拉斯维加斯大奖赛前夕，团队中的每个人都很高兴 Valtteri 与 Checo 一起锁定 2027 年，并期待着我们共同旅程的下一阶段。”

paras.en: Cadillac say they will announce their 2027 F1 reserve and test drivers in "due course".
paras.zh: 凯迪拉克表示，他们将在“适当的时候”宣布 2027 年 F1 储备车手和测试车手。

paras.en: Just one seat left to be filled on 2027 F1 grid
paras.zh: 2027 年 F1 发车位仅剩一个席位

paras.en: With Bottas' future secured and Racing Bulls confirming last week that Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad will be their line-up once again in 2027, only Haas are yet to complete their driver pairing for next year.
paras.zh: 随着博塔斯的未来得到保障，公牛队上周也确认利亚姆·劳森和阿维德·林德布拉德将在 2027 年再次成为他们的阵容，只有哈斯尚未完成明年的车手配对。

paras.en: Last month, Haas announced Rafael Camara will drive for the team in 2027, having already made an early F1 debut in Brazil and will compete again this weekend in Las Vegas, after Esteban Ocon was dropped following a dispute at the Mexico City Grand Prix.
paras.zh: 上个月，哈斯宣布拉斐尔·卡马拉将在 2027 年为车队效力，他已经在巴西首次亮相 F1，并将于本周末在拉斯维加斯再次参加比赛，此前埃斯特班·奥康因墨西哥城大奖赛发生争议而被退赛。

paras.en: But, Oliver Bearman has not been confirmed, although is expected to keep his seat once a "few bigger-picture things that we're working on" have been resolved according to the British driver.
paras.zh: 但是，奥利弗·贝尔曼（Oliver Bearman）尚未得到确认，尽管据英国司机称，一旦“我们正在处理的一些大局问题”得到解决，预计他将保留自己的席位。

paras.en: Haas team principal Ayao Komatsu furiously dismissed reports claiming that contract extension talks with Bearman are being held up by the British driver demanding a £5m annual salary.
paras.zh: 哈斯车队负责人小松绫雄愤怒地驳斥了有关英国车手要求 500 万英镑年薪而阻碍与贝尔曼续约谈判的报道。

paras.en: "I have no idea where that comes from," he said in Mexico.
paras.zh: “我不知道那是从哪里来的，”他在墨西哥说。

paras.en: "I've experienced this sometimes this season as well. People say there's no smoke without fire but really some people will invent a story."
paras.zh: “这个赛季我有时也经历过这种情况。人们说无风不起浪，但实际上有些人会编造一个故事。”

articles.title: World waits as Trump, Xi and Putin prepare for high-stakes meeting
articles.author: Alexander Smith

paras.en: SHENZHEN, China — What these three men might decide has the potential to reverberate across the globe.
paras.zh: 中国深圳——这三个人可能做出的决定有可能在全球范围内产生反响。

paras.en: But the spectacle of President Donald Trump’s meeting with rivals Russia’s Vladimir Putin and China’s Xi Jinping may be what delivers the defining image.
paras.zh: 但唐纳德·特朗普总统与竞争对手俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和中国国家主席习近平会面的场面可能会传递出决定性的形象。

paras.en: Before a word uttered in English, Russian or Mandarin, comparisons have already been drawn with the Yalta Conference of 1945, in which President Franklin D. Roosevelt, British Prime Minister Winston Churchill and Soviet leader Joseph Stalin sat down to carve up the postwar world.
paras.zh: 在用英语、俄语或普通话说出这个词之前，人们已经将其与 1945 年雅尔塔会议进行了比较，当时总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福、英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔和苏联领导人约瑟夫·斯大林坐下来瓜分战后世界。

paras.en: On Thursday, Trump, Putin and Xi will gather on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in the Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen. They will project power, with Trump governing the world’s largest economy, Putin the biggest nuclear arsenal, and Xi the largest standing army and manufacturing sector. Allies, whose futures may hinge on the whims of these three personalities, would be forgiven for worrying because, as the saying goes, “If you are not at the table, you are on the menu.”
paras.zh: 周四，特朗普、普京和习近平将在中国科技中心深圳举行的亚太经济合作峰会期间举行会议。他们将投射力量，特朗普掌管世界最大经济体，普京掌管最大核武库，习近平掌管最大常备军和制造业。盟友的未来可能取决于这三个人的一时兴起，他们的担忧是可以理解的，因为俗话说，“如果你不在谈判桌上，你就在菜单上。”

paras.en: The meeting itself represents a major shift from Washington’s post-Cold War policy of driving a wedge between Moscow and Beijing, said Ali Wyne, a senior adviser for U.S.-China relations at the International Crisis Group, a think tank based in Belgium.
paras.zh: 总部位于比利时的智库国际危机组织美中关系高级顾问阿里·韦恩表示，这次会议本身代表了华盛顿冷战后挑拨莫斯科和北京关系的政策的重大转变。

paras.en: Now, Trump and Putin “are currying favor with President Xi,” he added. “The symbolism is going to be very powerful.”
paras.zh: 他补充说，现在特朗普和普京“正在讨好习主席”。 “象征意义将非常强大。”

paras.en: Trump says he wants to discuss nuclear disarmament, the Iran war, economics and trade. On Monday, he added his “favorite subject, Ukraine,” contradicting White House officials who had said just days earlier that Russia’s war would not feature in the discussions.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他想讨论核裁军、伊朗战争、经济和贸易。周一，他补充了他“最喜欢的话题，乌克兰”，这与白宫官员几天前表示的俄罗斯战争不会出现在讨论中的说法相矛盾。

paras.en: Trump has previously called for a new nuclear arms control deal — that includes China as well as Russia — after the final deal between Washington and Moscow, named New START, lapsed in February.
paras.zh: 在华盛顿和莫斯科之间名为《新削减战略武器条约》的最终协议于二月份失效后，特朗普此前曾呼吁达成一项新的核军控协议——其中包括中国和俄罗斯。

paras.en: “When the leaders of the three largest nuclear powers sit down to discuss how to reduce the proliferation of these weapons, that is always important,” said John B. Emerson, a former U.S. diplomat who served as ambassador to Germany under President Barack Obama.
paras.zh: “当三个最大核大国的领导人坐下来讨论如何减少这些武器的扩散时，这总是很重要的，”曾在巴拉克·奥巴马(Barack Obama)总统领导下担任驻德国大使的美国前外交官约翰·B·爱默生(John B. Emerson)说。

paras.en: Trump, who has also sought to resume talks with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un over his sanctioned nuclear program, “sees denuclearization as a legacy deal,” said Craig Singleton, a China expert at the Washington-based Foundation for Defense of Democracies.
paras.zh: 总部位于华盛顿的保卫民主基金会的中国问题专家克雷格·辛格尔顿表示，特朗普还寻求与朝鲜领导人金正恩就其受制裁的核计划恢复谈判，“将无核化视为一项遗留协议”。

paras.en: “He’s betting that his relationships can get leaders into a room that other presidents couldn’t assemble,” he said in written comments.
paras.zh: “他打赌，他的关系可以让领导人进入一个其他总统无法聚集的房间，”他在书面评论中说。

paras.en: A bigger accomplishment, Singleton said, would be getting Beijing to join real talks on nuclear arms reduction, although he called that possibility a “long shot.”
paras.zh: 辛格尔顿表示，更大的成就将是让北京加入有关削减核武器的真正谈判，尽管他称这种可能性“可能性不大”。

paras.en: China is reluctant to engage on the subject when its estimated nuclear arsenal of 600 warheads, though growing rapidly, is still eclipsed by the more than 5,000 each held by the U.S. and Russia.
paras.zh: 中国不愿参与这个话题，因为中国的核武库估计有 600 枚弹头，虽然增长迅速，但与美国和俄罗斯各拥有 5,000 多枚弹头相比，仍然黯然失色。

paras.en: Moscow, meanwhile, has made clear that it wants Ukraine on the agenda although not at the table. This comes as the U.S. and Russian officials have called for negotiations over Europe’s wider security arrangements to be part of any lasting peace settlement — something that deeply alarms long-standing American allies.
paras.zh: 与此同时，莫斯科明确表示希望将乌克兰问题列入议程，尽管不在谈判桌上。在此之际，美国和俄罗斯官员呼吁就欧洲更广泛的安全安排进行谈判，将其作为任何持久和平解决方案的一部分——这让美国的长期盟友深感震惊。

paras.en: This arrangement has also worried Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, who said last month that “we really don’t want this to turn into ‘Yalta 2, 3, 4’ with a redistribution of influence.”
paras.zh: 这种安排也让乌克兰总统泽伦斯基感到担忧，他上个月表示，“我们真的不希望这变成‘雅尔塔2、3、4’，影响力重新分配。”

paras.en: Yalta saw the great powers of the day carve up Berlin into occupied zones, sowing the seeds for communist control of Eastern Europe and the beginning of the Cold War.
paras.zh: 雅尔塔见证了当时的大国将柏林瓜分为占领区，为共产主义控制东欧和冷战的开始播下了种子。

paras.en: Senior U.S. officials told reporters ahead of Trump’s trip that the Ukraine war was a separate “track” that China is not part of and that it would not be “appropriate” for the three leaders to discuss it. Beijing has also signaled its reluctance to discuss Ukraine without European leaders at the table.
paras.zh: 美国高级官员在特朗普出访前告诉记者，乌克兰战争是一个单独的“轨道”，中国不属于其中，三位领导人讨论这个问题“不合适”。北京还表示不愿在欧洲领导人不在场的情况下讨论乌克兰问题。

paras.en: Even if Trump, Putin and Xi don’t decide anything on Ukraine at their meeting, the fact that it’s happening at all only reinforces Ukraine’s suspicion “that Washington is increasingly negotiating with Moscow to the detriment of Kyiv, or perhaps even siding with Moscow,” Wyne said.
paras.zh: 韦恩表示，即使特朗普、普京和习近平在会晤中没有就乌克兰问题做出任何决定，这种情况的发生也只会加剧乌克兰的怀疑，“华盛顿越来越多地与莫斯科进行不利于基辅的谈判，甚至可能站在莫斯科一边”。

paras.en: China, which says this week’s trilateral meeting has “groundbreaking significance,” has nonetheless tried to manage expectations.
paras.zh: 中国称本周的三边会议具有“开创性意义”，但仍试图控制预期。

paras.en: Da Wei, director of the Center for International Security and Strategy at Tsinghua University in Beijing, said he didn’t expect anything concrete to come from the meeting but that it was a “starting point” that could promote international stability.
paras.zh: 北京清华大学国际安全与战略研究中心主任戴维表示，他预计这次会议不会产生任何具体成果，但这是一个可以促进国际稳定的“起点”。

paras.en: “No matter we like them or not, these three leaders and these three countries are major shapers of the international order,” he said in an interview Wednesday. “So for that reason, I think the meeting among the three is a good thing.”
paras.zh: “无论我们喜欢与否，这三位领导人和这三个国家都是国际秩序的主要塑造者，”他在周三接受采访时表示。 “因此，我认为三人的会面是一件好事。”

paras.en: Jennifer Jett and Janis Mackey Frayer reported from Shenzhen, and Alexander Smith from Londn.
paras.zh: Jennifer Jett 和 Janis Mackey Frayer 从深圳报道，Alexander Smith 从伦敦报道。
