articles.title: Bird backpacks and fresh poo used to track deadly H5 spread
articles.author: Leah MacLennan

paras.en: A CSIRO program has been using GPS tracking and poo collections to help provide vital information about the Murray Darling Basin bird populations.
paras.zh: CSIRO 的一个项目一直在使用 GPS 跟踪和粪便收集来帮助提供有关墨累达令盆地鸟类种群的重要信息。

paras.en: The scientists are travelling well off the beaten track via four wheel drive, kayak and foot for the study.
paras.zh: 科学家们正在人迹罕至的地方通过四轮驱动、皮划艇和步行进行研究。

paras.en: One researcher says while the spread of H5 bird flu has been slower than some predictions, its arrival in the basin is inevitable.
paras.zh: 一位研究人员表示，虽然 H5 禽流感的传播速度比一些预测要慢，但它到达流域是不可避免的。

paras.en: Researchers are using backpacks and bird poo to track the spread of the deadly H5 bird flu In Australia's Murray Darling Basin.
paras.zh: 研究人员正在使用背包和鸟粪来追踪致命的 H5 禽流感在澳大利亚墨累达令盆地的传播情况。

paras.en: The response was part of a CSIRO program that would help understand how the virus might spread once it starts infecting birds in the system.
paras.zh: 该响应是 CSIRO 计划的一部分，该计划将有助于了解病毒一旦开始感染系统中的鸟类，将如何传播。

paras.en: Heather McGinness is one of the scientists who travels well off the beaten track for the study.
paras.zh: 希瑟·麦金尼斯 (Heather McGinness) 是不走寻常路进行这项研究的科学家之一。

paras.en: "To get to some of these places often involves not just driving the four wheel drive hours and hours to get there," she said.
paras.zh: “要到达其中一些地方，通常不仅仅需要花费数小时的四轮驱动车才能到达那里，”她说。

paras.en: "But then getting in kayaks and then putting our waders on, which are very lovely, and walking and kayaking out to where the birds actually are and that can take a long time. It can takes hours."
paras.zh: “但是，然后坐上皮划艇，穿上我们的涉水鞋，这非常可爱，然后步行和划皮划艇到鸟儿真正所在的地方，这可能需要很长时间。可能需要几个小时。”

paras.en: Once they find the birds, they have two things to do.
paras.zh: 一旦他们找到了鸟儿，他们就有两件事要做。

paras.en: The first is to fit them with backpacks containing GPS trackers.
paras.zh: 第一个是给他们装上装有 GPS 追踪器的背包。

paras.en: Dr McGinness does not make the trackers, but she makes the bags they fit into.
paras.zh: 麦金尼斯博士并不制造追踪器，但她制造了适合追踪器的袋子。

paras.en: "I design it so it fits the same way as a backpack would fit on a person or on a child," she said.
paras.zh: “我设计它的方式就像背包适合人或孩子一样，”她说。

paras.en: "There's a little strap on the bird's chest that holds it in place and then it is basically adjusted at the back to make sure it's a perfect fit for that bird.
paras.zh: “鸟的胸前有一条小带子将其固定到位，然后基本上在后面进行调整，以确保它完美贴合那只鸟。

paras.en: "Where it crosses the bird's chest, there's a weak link so we deliberately design it so that there's a particular place where the harness will eventually break and when it breaks it just falls off the bird cleanly."
paras.zh: “它穿过鸟的胸部的地方是一个薄弱环节，所以我们特意设计了它，以便有一个特定的地方，安全带最终会断裂，当它断裂时，它就会从鸟身上干净地掉下来。”

paras.en: The second part of these missions is searching for bird poo.
paras.zh: 这些任务的第二部分是寻找鸟粪。

paras.en: It cannot be any bird poo — it must be fresh — adding an extra challenge to the scientists' field work.
paras.zh: 它不能是任何鸟粪——它必须是新鲜的——给科学家的实地工作增加了额外的挑战。

paras.en: "That means having to go out very early in the morning because you don't want those samples to dry out or get damaged by the sun or anything," Dr McGinness said.
paras.zh: 麦金尼斯博士说：“这意味着必须一大早就出去，因为你不希望这些样本变干或被阳光或其他任何东西损坏。”

paras.en: The GPS tracking and bird poo collections helped provide vital information about the Murray Darling Basin bird populations.
paras.zh: GPS 跟踪和鸟粪收集有助于提供有关墨累达令盆地鸟类种群的重要信息。

paras.en: Dr McGinness said the GPS trackers can provide detailed information about bird movements, down to whether they were roosting in trees or on the ground.
paras.zh: 麦金尼斯博士说，GPS追踪器可以提供有关鸟类活动的详细信息，包括它们是栖息在树上还是地面上。

paras.en: She said it was information that has long been lacking.
paras.zh: 她说这是长期以来缺乏的信息。

paras.en: "Most of Australia's other waterbird species really don't have movement data. It's very new doing all of this tracking and we really need more movement data for other species," she said.
paras.zh: “澳大利亚大多数其他水鸟物种确实没有运动数据。所有这些跟踪都是非常新的，我们确实需要更多其他物种的运动数据，”她说。

paras.en: The poo samples can reveal what diseases the birds have, including strains of bird flu already in Australia, and whether the deadly strain H5 is present in the Murray Darling Basin.
paras.zh: 粪便样本可以揭示鸟类患有哪些疾病，包括澳大利亚已有的禽流感病毒株，以及墨累达令盆地是否存在致命的 H5 病毒株。

paras.en: "The Murray Darling Basin is pretty vast, it's about 14 per cent of our continent and there's a lot of really important wetlands out there," Dr McGinness said.
paras.zh: “墨累达令盆地相当广阔，约占我们大陆的 14%，那里有很多非常重要的湿地，”麦金尼斯博士说。

paras.en: Australia was the last continent to be hit by bird flu when it was first detected in Western Australia in June, but it had already spread widely across the globe.
paras.zh: 六月份在西澳大利亚首次发现禽流感时，澳大利亚是最后一个遭受禽流感袭击的大陆，但禽流感已经在全球广泛传播。

paras.en: In the United States alone, it was believed to have killed tens of millions of birds since it arrived there in 2022.
paras.zh: 据信，自 2022 年抵达美国以来，仅在美国就已经杀死了数千万只鸟类。

paras.en: Project leader Rebecca Doble said the good news was, while the virus has killed birds along Australia's coastline, so far there was little evidence of H5 bird flu in the Murray Darling Basin.
paras.zh: 项目负责人丽贝卡·多布尔（Rebecca Doble）表示，好消息是，虽然该病毒已经导致澳大利亚海岸线的鸟类死亡，但到目前为止，墨累达令盆地几乎没有H5禽流感的证据。

paras.en: "That's actually been really surprising to see the movement of bird flu in Australia so far," she said.
paras.zh: “到目前为止，禽流感在澳大利亚的传播确实令人惊讶，”她说。

paras.en: "It's inherently hard to predict how it will move but we suspect the reason that it hasn't really become established inland yet is that there's weaker connections between inland systems and the coastal systems where bird flu has been detected already."
paras.zh: “本质上很难预测它会如何移动，但我们怀疑它尚未真正在内陆建立的原因是内陆系统与已经检测到禽流感的沿海系统之间的联系较弱。”

paras.en: Dr Doble said while H5 bird flu has been slower to spread than some predictions, its arrival in the basin was inevitable.
paras.zh: 多布尔博士说，虽然H5禽流感的传播速度比一些预测要慢，但它到达流域是不可避免的。

paras.en: She said that was why surveillance projects like the one her team has been undertaking was important.
paras.zh: 她说，这就是为什么像她的团队一直在进行的监控项目如此重要。

paras.en: "I suspect there's not much we can do to stop it moving inland into Australia and into the Murray Darling Basin," she said.
paras.zh: “我怀疑我们无能为力阻止它向澳大利亚内陆移动并进入墨累达令盆地，”她说。

paras.en: "This makes this research and surveillance and monitoring even more critical to get an understanding and build our knowledge of potential impacts of bird flu before it arrives."
paras.zh: “这使得这项研究、监视和监测对于在禽流感到来之前了解和建立我们对禽流感潜在影响的了解变得更加重要。”

articles.title: Factory-built housing could lift construction productivity, report says
articles.author: Declan Bowring

paras.en: Factory-built housing using "modern methods of construction" (MMC) should be embraced more broadly to boost housing construction productivity, a new think tank report says.
paras.zh: 一份新的智库报告称，应更广泛地采用采用“现代建筑方法”（MMC）的工厂建造的住房，以提高住房建设生产率。

paras.en: The Committee for Sydney argues the NSW government must order more new housing projects to give builders reason to invest in MMC factories.
paras.zh: 悉尼委员会认为，新南威尔士州政府必须订购更多新住房项目，让建筑商有理由投资 MMC 工厂。

paras.en: Australian Building Codes Board is currently consulting on a national voluntary certification scheme for MMC.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚建筑规范委员会目前正在就 MMC 国家自愿认证计划进行咨询。

paras.en: Factory-built housing using modern methods of construction should be embraced more broadly to boost housing construction productivity, according to a new report by a Sydney urban think tank.
paras.zh: 悉尼城市智囊团的一份新报告称，应更广泛地采用现代建筑方法建造的工厂化住房，以提高住房建设生产率。

paras.en: The Committee for Sydney proposes the NSW government address lagging housing construction productivity by committing to a steady pipeline of projects to support factories that can prefabricate whole rooms for mid- and high-rise apartment buildings.
paras.zh: 悉尼委员会建议新南威尔士州政府通过致力于稳定的项目管道来支持能够为中高层公寓楼预制整个房间的工厂来解决住房建设生产力滞后的问题。

paras.en: The think tank's housing policy director, Estelle Grech, said moving to factory-built housing, also known as modern methods of construction (MMC), would "re-industrialise" house building.
paras.zh: 该智囊团的住房政策主管埃斯特尔·格雷奇(Estelle Grech)表示，转向工厂建造的住房，也称为现代建筑方法(MMC)，将使房屋建筑“重新工业化”。

paras.en: "We know that for every 100 workers on site, the industry is only producing 14 homes, against 32 [homes] 50 years ago," Ms Grech said.
paras.zh: “我们知道，每 100 名现场工人，该行业只能生产 14 套房屋，而 50 年前是 32 套房屋，”Grech 女士说。

paras.en: "I think it's a no-brainer for both the state and federal governments to do more to improve the productivity of this sector because its about 7 per cent of the whole economy."
paras.zh: “我认为州政府和联邦政府都应该采取更多措施来提高该行业的生产力，因为该行业约占整个经济的 7%。”

paras.en: Australian Bureau of Statistics figures suggest productivity in housing construction has fallen by 21 per cent between 2013 and 2025.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚统计局的数据显示，2013 年至 2025 年间，住房建设生产率下降了 21%。

paras.en: Ms Grech says this is because 99 per cent of Australian construction firms employ fewer than 20 people, and so are too small to invest in research and development.
paras.zh: Grech 女士表示，这是因为 99% 的澳大利亚建筑公司雇用的员工不到 20 人，因此规模太小，无法投资于研发。

paras.en: Her report also found this is because there is more complexity in the regulations of home building and homes are larger than they used to be, particularly apartments.
paras.zh: 她的报告还发现，这是因为房屋建筑法规更加复杂，房屋比以前更大，尤其是公寓。

paras.en: Ms Grech's research showed MMC is a niche part of Australian housing construction, making up just 5 per cent of new home builds.
paras.zh: Grech 女士的研究表明，MMC 是澳大利亚住房建设的一个小众部分，仅占新住房建设的 5%。

paras.en: It pales in comparison to Scandinavian countries where around 45 per cent of new homes are built off-site.
paras.zh: 与斯堪的纳维亚国家相比，这一数字相形见绌，斯堪的纳维亚国家约 45% 的新房都是在场外建造的。

paras.en: A quarter faster than traditional methods
paras.zh: 比传统方法快四分之一

paras.en: According to some builders who use MMC, which can be done by building entire modular rooms or by creating parts for assembling on site, using the methods can save as much as 25 per cent on construction time compared to traditional methods.
paras.zh: 据一些使用 MMC 的建筑商称，与传统方法相比，使用这些方法可以节省多达 25% 的施工时间。MMC 可以通过建造整个模块化房间或创建现场组装的零件来完成。

paras.en: One project in Sydney's Macquarie Park that recently topped out using 19 storeys of factory-built modular student accommodation took 19 weeks to put together.
paras.zh: 悉尼麦格理公园 (Macquarie Park) 的一个项目最近使用 19 层工厂建造的模块化学生宿舍竣工，花了 19 周的时间才完成。

paras.en: "The project overall will be around 25 per cent quicker than traditional construction," said Steven Mann, chief strategy officer at the developer Freecity.
paras.zh: 开发商 Freecity 的首席战略官史蒂文·曼 (Steven Mann) 表示：“该项目总体速度将比传统施工快 25% 左右。”

paras.en: Mr Mann, who used to be the chief executive of the Urban Development Institute of Australia, said further savings in cost and time were likely to occur in future projects.
paras.zh: 曾任澳大利亚城市发展研究所首席执行官的曼表示，未来的项目可能会进一步节省成本和时间。

paras.en: "Achieving at the lower, 20-25 per cent, is probably where we are, but we're aiming for more like a third and up to 40 per cent quicker," Mr Mann said.
paras.zh: 曼先生表示：“我们的目标可能是实现较低的 20% 至 25%，但我们的目标是加快三分之一，甚至高达 40%。”

paras.en: "Once you go and do another project, you're using all of that learning and all that planning to do the next project."
paras.zh: “一旦你去做另一个项目，你就会利用所有的学习和计划来完成下一个项目。”

paras.en: John Stone from the developer BuiltLiving, which is building a factory to make parts for assembling in Western Australia, said their facility would be able to finish building projects up to 50 per cent faster and up to 20 per cent cheaper.
paras.zh: 开发商BuiltLiving的约翰·斯通(John Stone)正在西澳大利亚州建造一家生产组装零部件的工厂，他表示，他们的工厂将能够将建筑项目的完成速度提高50%，成本降低20%。

paras.en: Mr Stone said the factory will be able to produce parts to make 3000 apartments a year but could also build parts for other structures like low-rise housing and industrial structures.
paras.zh: 斯通先生表示，该工厂每年将能够生产用于建造 3000 套公寓的零部件，但也可以为低层住宅和工业结构等其他结构制造零部件。

paras.en: "We're in a global crisis when it comes to affordability of housing," Mr Stone said.
paras.zh: “在住房负担能力方面，我们正处于一场全球危机，”斯通先生说。

paras.en: "When you're in that sort of realm, you're, quite frankly, forced to start looking at innovation."
paras.zh: “坦率地说，当你处于这种境界时，你就被迫开始关注创新。”

paras.en: Construction costs have been a significant issue for the building industry, with materials rising by over 60 per cent since 2013 according to the Australian Bureau of Statistics.
paras.zh: 建筑成本一直是建筑行业的一个重大问题，根据澳大利亚统计局的数据，自 2013 年以来，材料成本上涨了 60% 以上。

paras.en: The Committee for Sydney report also found there are only six builders in Sydney who will build non-luxury apartments for another developer, presenting a potential headache for the NSW Labor government that has been spruiking its credentials in approving more mid-high rise housing in inner Sydney.
paras.zh: 悉尼委员会的报告还发现，悉尼只有六家建筑商将为另一家开发商建造非豪华公寓，这对新南威尔士州工党政府来说是一个潜在的头痛问题，该政府一直在大肆宣扬其在悉尼内城区批准更多中高层住房的资格。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the NSW Labor government said MMC was recognised in law by legislation passed in August that also streamlined approval processes.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州工党政府发言人表示，MMC 已在 8 月份通过的立法中获得法律认可，该立法还简化了审批流程。

paras.en: "The NSW government developed its broader reform package in lock-step with industry and has been advocating for the same approach to be adopted in other jurisdictions," the spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 该发言人表示：“新南威尔士州政府与行业同步制定了更广泛的改革方案，并一直主张在其他司法管辖区采用同样的方法。”

paras.en: "These changes will save the building industry valuable time and reduce costs."
paras.zh: “这些变化将为建筑行业节省宝贵的时间并降低成本。”

paras.en: The Australian Building Codes Board is currently consulting on a national voluntary certification scheme for MMC.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚建筑规范委员会目前正在就 MMC 国家自愿认证计划进行咨询。

paras.en: Master Builders NSW CEO Matthew Pollock says the government deserves credit for bringing modular and prefab building into the mainstream.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州建筑大师协会首席执行官马修·波洛克表示，政府将模块化和预制建筑引入主流值得赞扬。

paras.en: Mr Pollock said the major barrier to high-density projects was feasibility, which could be addressed by speeding up approvals.
paras.zh: 波洛克表示，高密度项目的主要障碍是可行性，这可以通过加快审批来解决。

paras.en: "It takes more than three years to construct an apartment building form approval to completion in NSW and the longer a project takes the more it costs,"
paras.zh: “在新南威尔士州，建造一栋公寓楼从审批到竣工需要三年多的时间，而且项目时间越长，成本就越高。”

paras.en: "Much of the opportunity to accelerate housing supply rests with local government."
paras.zh: “加速住房供应的大部分机会取决于地方政府。”

paras.en: Shadow NSW housing minister Chris Rath said backing MMC would be necessary for the NSW Labor government, which he says is 40 per cent behind on its housing target.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州影子住房部长 Chris Rath 表示，新南威尔士州工党政府有必要支持 MMC，他表示新南威尔士州工党政府比其住房目标落后了 40%。

paras.en: "We need a smarter, faster and more efficient way to deliver housing and modern methods of construction have enormous potential to help achieve that," Mr Rath said.
paras.zh: 拉斯先生说：“我们需要一种更智能、更快速、更高效的方式来提供住房，而现代建筑方法具有帮助实现这一目标的巨大潜力。”

articles.title: Live: ASX to open lower as Wall Street braces for Anthropic IPO
articles.author: Adelaide Miller

paras.en: ASX to open lower as widely anticipated Anthropic IPO imminent, live updates
paras.zh: 由于广泛预期 Anthropic IPO 即将到来，澳大利亚证券交易所开盘走低，实时更新

paras.en: The Australian share market is set to open lower as Wall Street prepares for AI giant Anthropic's launch on the Nasdaq stock exchange.
paras.zh: 随着华尔街为人工智能巨头 Anthropic 在纳斯达克证券交易所上市做准备，澳大利亚股市开盘将走低。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the price of oil continues to trade lower, under $US92 a barrel.
paras.zh: 与此同时，石油价格继续走低，跌破每桶 92 美元。

paras.en: Follow the day's financial news and insights from our specialist business reporters on our live blog.
paras.zh: 在我们的实时博客上关注我们的专业商业记者当天的财经新闻和见解。

paras.en: Disclaimer: this blog is not intended as investment advice.
paras.zh: 免责声明：本博客无意作为投资建议。

articles.title: Bianca Andreescu enjoying tennis again during late-season surge: 'I can't stop smiling'
articles.author: Gemma Karstens-Smith

paras.en: Bianca Andreescu enjoying tennis again during late-season surge: 'I can't stop smiling'
paras.zh: 比安卡·安德烈斯库在赛季后期再次享受网球带来的乐趣：“我无法停止微笑”

paras.en: Shoulder, knee, ankle, back injuries have repeatedly interrupted 2019 U.S. champ's career
paras.zh: 肩部、膝盖、脚踝、背部伤病多次中断2019年美国冠军的职业生涯

paras.en: Bianca Andreescu wasn't sure she would get back to this place.
paras.zh: 比安卡·安德烈斯库不确定她是否会回到这个地方。

paras.en: Yet a winning streak has brought delight back into the Canadian tennis star's game.
paras.zh: 然而，连胜给这位加拿大网球明星的比赛带来了欢乐。

paras.en: "I'm enjoying playing tennis again," Andreescu said. "At times, with the injuries, I genuinely wondered if I wanted to keep doing this. So, to play four finals in a row and then get here and be excited to play another match, I think that says a lot."
paras.zh: “我又开始享受打网球的乐趣了，”安德烈斯库说。 “有时，由于伤病，我真的想知道我是否想继续这样做。所以，连续打四场决赛，然后来到这里并兴奋地打另一场比赛，我认为这说明了很多。”

paras.en: The 26-year-old from Mississauga, Ont., reached four consecutive WTA 125 finals, winning three titles in less than a month and capping the stretch with a victory at the Cundinamarca Open in Sopo, Colombia on Saturday.
paras.zh: 这位来自安大略省米西索加的 26 岁选手连续四次闯入 WTA 125 决赛，在不到一个月的时间内赢得了三个冠军，并于周六在哥伦比亚索波举行的昆迪纳马卡公开赛上取得胜利，为这一历程画上了圆满的句号。

paras.en: "Things are definitely starting to sink in for me. I've had two days to really reflect on the last few weeks. I just can't stop smiling," Andreescu said on Tuesday from Vitoria, Brazil, where she's preparing to play a Billie Jean King Cup tie with Canada.
paras.zh: “事情肯定开始让我明白。我有两天时间来真正反思过去几周的情况。我就是无法停止微笑，”安德烈斯库周二在巴西维多利亚说道，她正准备在那里与加拿大队进行比利·简·金杯比赛。

paras.en: "I'm just on cloud nine, and to be able to finish the year off playing for my country, it's unreal. Unreal."
paras.zh: “我只是在云九，能够为我的国家队打完这一年，这是不真实的。不真实的。”

paras.en: Andreescu started the year sitting at No. 225 in the WTA standings, a far cry from the career-high No. 4 she reached after winning the U.S. Open in 2019.
paras.zh: 安德烈斯库今年年初在 WTA 积分榜上排名第 225 位，与她在 2019 年赢得美国公开赛后达到的职业生涯最高排名第 4 位相去甚远。

paras.en: Shoulder, knee, ankle and back injuries have repeatedly interrupted her career, sidelining her for months at a time.
paras.zh: 肩膀、膝盖、脚踝和背部的伤病一再打断她的职业生涯，让她一度缺席几个月。

paras.en: Heading into 2026, Andreescu kept her goals simple — she wanted to play as many matches as possible and stay healthy.
paras.zh: 进入 2026 年，安德烈斯库的目标很简单——她希望参加尽可能多的比赛并保持健康。

paras.en: "And that's what I've been doing all year," she said.
paras.zh: “这就是我一整年都在做的事情，”她说。

paras.en: There was "a bit of a hiccup" in the middle of the calendar when she struggled to make it out of early rounds, but Andreescu rebounded in late June by winning her qualifiers and getting into the main draw at Wimbledon.
paras.zh: 赛程中期，她在前几轮比赛中挣扎着出线，但遇到了“一点小问题”，但安德烈斯库在六月末反弹，赢得了资格赛冠军，并进入了温布尔登正赛。

paras.en: "To see myself back in a main draw of a Grand Slam was so awesome," she said. "And then I just continued playing as many matches as possible, and basically I can say that I've surpassed my goals."
paras.zh: “看到自己重返大满贯正赛真是太棒了，”她说。 “然后我就继续参加尽可能多的比赛，基本上我可以说我已经超越了我的目标。”

paras.en: In mid-October, Andreescu won her first WTA title of the year at the Rovereto Open in Italy, a 125 tournament one level below the main tour.
paras.zh: 十月中旬，安德烈斯库在意大利罗韦雷托公开赛上赢得了她今年的第一个 WTA 冠军头衔，这是一项比主巡回赛低一级的 125 场比赛。

paras.en: To play match after match, still feel hungry and have that same grit and motivation I had in 2018, 2019? I'm beyond grateful.2019 U.S. Open women's champion Bianca Andreescu
paras.zh: 一场又一场地比赛，仍然感到饥饿并拥有与 2018 年、2019 年相同的勇气和动力吗？我感激不尽。2019年美国公开赛女子冠军比安卡·安德烈斯库

paras.en: She then stormed through three more 125 events, winning the Queretaro Open in Mexico before reaching the final at the Cali Open in Colombia. She lost to Spain's Leyre Romero Gormaz in Cali but returned to the winner's circle last week at the Cundinamarca Open.
paras.zh: 随后，她又闯入了三项125赛事，赢得了墨西哥克雷塔罗公开赛的冠军，并在哥伦比亚卡利公开赛上闯入决赛。她在卡利输给了西班牙选手莱尔·罗梅罗·戈尔马斯，但上周在昆迪纳马卡公开赛上重返冠军圈。

paras.en: The streak landed her at No. 77 in the WTA rankings.
paras.zh: 这一连胜让她在 WTA 排名中排名第 77 位。

paras.en: "I wanted to crack the top 100, let alone the top 80," Andreescu said. "And then I'm healthy, and to play match after match after match, and still feel hungry, and have that same grit and motivation, let's say, that I had back in 2018, 2019? I'm just beyond grateful."
paras.zh: “我想闯入前 100 名，更不用说前 80 名了，”安德烈斯库说。 “然后我就恢复了健康，一场又一场地比赛，仍然感到饥饿，并拥有与 2018 年、2019 年相同的勇气和动力？我非常感激。”

paras.en: The decision to play 125 events instead of bigger tournaments in Asia at this point of the season was a calculated one.
paras.zh: 赛季此时决定在亚洲参加 125 场赛事而不是更大型的赛事是经过深思熟虑的决定。

paras.en: "I wasn't sure if I was going to secure my spot in the [qualifiers] or in the main draw of any of the tournaments in Asia," Andreescu said.
paras.zh: “我不确定我是否能确保在[预选赛]或亚洲任何锦标赛的正赛中占据一席之地，”安德烈斯库说。

paras.en: After reviewing the schedule with her team, Andreescu decided to head to Mexico and then Colombia, having already committed to playing the Billie Jean King Cup tie in Brazil.
paras.zh: 在与她的团队审查了赛程后，安德烈斯库决定先前往墨西哥，然后前往哥伦比亚，因为她已经承诺参加在巴西举行的比利·简·金杯比赛。

paras.en: "The schedule just looked the best if I came to South America and then to Brazil because it's not easy to get here," she said. "So, I'm playing on clay, BJK is on clay, so it made sense. And, yeah, it worked out well."
paras.zh: “如果我先去南美，然后再去巴西，日程安排看起来是最好的，因为到达这里并不容易，”她说。 “所以，我在红土上比赛，BJK也在红土上，所以这是有道理的。而且，是的，效果很好。”

paras.en: Even with a multitude of matches in recent months, Andreescu said the body is feeling good, and her energy levels are steady.
paras.zh: 安德烈斯库表示，尽管最近几个月参加了很多比赛，但她的身体感觉很好，她的能量水平也很稳定。

paras.en: She was quick to credit those around her for the recent success, from the physiotherapists who have kept her body strong to her coaches and the people who have stuck by her.
paras.zh: 她很快将最近的成功归功于周围的人，从让她身体保持强壮的理疗师到她的教练和一直支持她的人。

paras.en: "I wouldn't be able to do this without an army behind me," she said.
paras.zh: “如果没有军队在我身后，我就无法做到这一点，”她说。

paras.en: Heading into the Billie Jean King Cup tie on Friday and Saturday, Andreescu's simply looking forward to playing for Canada again.
paras.zh: 周五和周六将举行比利·简·金杯比赛，安德烈斯库非常期待再次为加拿大队效力。

paras.en: The event, taking place on outdoor clay courts, will see her team with doubles ace Gabriela Dabrowski, Kayla Cross, Ariana Arseneault and Clemence Mercier.
paras.zh: 这项赛事在室外红土场上举行，她的队伍将与双打王牌加布里埃拉·达布罗斯基、凯拉·克罗斯、阿丽亚娜·阿塞诺和克莱门斯·梅西埃一起参赛。

paras.en: Together, the eighth-ranked Canadians will face the 19th-ranked Brazilians in a best-of-five series, with the winner advancing to the 2027 qualifiers. Canada won the competition in 2023 but is coming off a 3-1 loss to Kazakhstan in the qualifiers earlier this year.
paras.zh: 排名第八的加拿大队将在五场四胜制的系列赛中迎战排名第 19 位的巴西队，获胜者将晋级 2027 年预选赛。加拿大赢得了 2023 年的比赛，但在今年早些时候的预选赛中以 3-1 输给了哈萨克斯坦。

paras.en: In Vitoria, the Canadians will face familiar faces, including Dabrowski's doubles partner, Luisa Stefani. Andreescu also faced Laura Pigossi -- another member of Brazil's contingent – in Sopo, Colombia last week.
paras.zh: 在维多利亚，加拿大人将面对熟悉的面孔，包括达布罗斯基的双打搭档路易莎·史蒂芬尼。安德烈斯库上周还在哥伦比亚索波对阵巴西队的另一名成员劳拉·皮戈西。

paras.en: "I know [Pigossi's] a very tough competitor," Andreescu said. "She doesn't let up, and she has a very good forehand, and she's just tough mentally. And at the end of the day, I feel like we all have the skills to do well, but mentally, if we're not there on that specific day, things can go awry for sure."
paras.zh: “我知道[皮戈西]是一个非常强大的竞争对手，”安德烈斯库说。 “她不会放松，她有很好的正手，而且她的心理素质很强。归根结底，我觉得我们都有能力做得很好，但从心理上来说，如果我们在那一天不在那儿，事情肯定会出问题。”

paras.en: Billie Jean King Cup events are a unique opportunity for women's tennis players who go from facing one another week to week to competing for their countries together.
paras.zh: 比利·简·金杯赛事对于女子网球运动员来说是一个独特的机会，她们从一周又一周的对抗到一起为自己的国家竞争。

paras.en: "Having the girls on the sidelines cheering just makes this week so much more special," Andreescu said. "That's the one thing that I look forward to during these ties. And for me to be able to do the same, I feel like I'm a very big cheerleader. And this is the week where I can show it."
paras.zh: 安德烈斯库说：“女孩们在场边欢呼，让这一周变得更加特别。” “这是我在这些比赛中期待的一件事。对于我来说，能够做同样的事情，我觉得我是一个非常大的啦啦队长。本周我可以展示这一点。”

articles.title: Hakeem Jeffries poised to become 1st Black U.S. House Speaker, after internal vote by Democrats

paras.en: Hakeem Jeffries poised to become 1st Black U.S. House Speaker, after internal vote by Democrats
paras.zh: 经过民主党内部投票，哈基姆·杰弗里斯有望成为美国第一位黑人众议院议长

paras.en: Full vote in House, including Republican members, will take place in early January
paras.zh: 包括共和党议员在内的众议院全体投票将于一月初进行

paras.en: Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries on Wednesday to be Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives, as he brushed past skeptics and was on track to make history as the country's first Black American with the gavel.
paras.zh: 周三，民主党人提名哈基姆·杰弗里斯担任美国众议院议长，他克服了怀疑者的质疑，有望创造历史，成为美国第一位握有木槌的美国黑人。

paras.en: Jeffries, of New York, secured the nod during closed-door voting, ahead of a full House vote when the new Congress, including Republican members, convenes in January. CNN reported that there were 11 No votes out of 262 cast.
paras.zh: 纽约州的杰弗里斯在闭门投票中获得了批准，随后，包括共和党议员在内的新一届国会将于一月份召开，届时将进行众议院全体投票。 CNN 报道称，262 票中有 11 票反对。

paras.en: The speaker of the House is second in the presidential line of succession, behind the vice-president.
paras.zh: 众议院议长在总统继任顺序中排名第二，仅次于副总统。

paras.en: Jeffries ran unopposed but faces a restive party eager for a change after voters ousted Republicans in the recent midterm elections in a rebuke of U.S. President Donald Trump and the party in power.
paras.zh: 杰弗里斯在竞选中没有遇到对手，但在最近的中期选举中，选民在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和执政党的谴责下驱逐了共和党人，该党面临着一个渴望变革的不安的政党。

paras.en: Phone calls and social media posts have been flooding the offices of returning Democrats and newly elected members demanding a fresh start. Protesters heckled Jeffries last week during a Democratic conference in Denver.
paras.zh: 回归的民主党人和新当选议员的办公室里充斥着电话和社交媒体帖子，要求重新开始。上周在丹佛举行的民主党会议上，抗议者质问杰弗里斯。

paras.en: Ahead of Wednesday's vote, Jeffries said he was taking nothing for granted. He met with the caucuses that make up the House Democrats and talked to almost all members in what will be their large majority.
paras.zh: 在周三投票之前，杰弗里斯表示他不会认为任何事情都是理所当然的。他会见了众议院民主党的核心小组，并与几乎所有成员进行了交谈，这将是他们的绝大多数成员。

paras.en: "I embrace those conversations," he said.
paras.zh: “我接受这些对话，”他说。

paras.en: After the vote, Jeffries thanked his party for the support in a message on X.
paras.zh: 投票结束后，杰弗里斯在 X 上的一条消息中感谢他的政党的支持。

paras.en: "Together, we will deliver bold change. And make a big difference in the lives of the American people!"
paras.zh: “我们将共同实现大胆的变革。并为美国人民的生活带来巨大的改变！”

paras.en: Jeffries will be part of a leadership trio with Rep. Katherine Clark of Massachusetts and Rep. Pete Aguilar of California, which would also represent historic firsts — Clark as the first female majority leader and Aguilar as the first Latino to serve as the majority whip. They also ran unopposed.
paras.zh: 杰弗里斯将与马萨诸塞州众议员凯瑟琳·克拉克 (Katherine Clark) 和加利福尼亚州众议员皮特·阿吉拉尔 (Pete Aguilar) 组成领导三人组，这也将创造历史性的第一——克拉克成为第一位女性多数党领袖，阿吉拉尔成为第一位担任多数党党鞭的拉丁裔。他们也没有遇到反对。

paras.en: - Analysis Investigate Trump or work with him? Democrats debate best path forward
paras.zh: - 分析 调查特朗普还是与他合作？民主党人辩论最佳前进道路

paras.en: - Mary Peltola wins U.S. Senate seat in Alaska for Democrats
paras.zh: - 玛丽·佩尔托拉 (Mary Peltola) 为民主党赢得阿拉斯加美国参议院席位

paras.en: Jeffries, 56, was born in Brooklyn to a mother who was a social worker and a father who was a substance abuse counsellor. He attended Binghamton University for undergraduate studies, earning a master's in public policy from Georgetown University in Washington, D.C., and a law degree from New York University.
paras.zh: 杰弗里斯现年 56 岁，出生于布鲁克林，母亲是一名社会工作者，父亲是一名药物滥用咨询师。他在宾厄姆顿大学攻读本科学位，并获得华盛顿特区乔治城大学公共政策硕士学位和纽约大学法学学位。

paras.en: After two unsuccessful bids for a state assembly seat in New York, he succeeded in 2006. He was elected to U.S. Congress eight years later, joining the Congressional Caucus.
paras.zh: 在两次竞选纽约州议会席位失败后，他于 2006 年获得成功。八年后，他当选为美国国会议员，加入国会核心小组。

paras.en: There are seven races yet to be projected in the 435-seat House of Representatives. Democrats have sewn up 257 seats, and with one of the biggest incoming majorities in decades, Jeffries will have room to spare, unlike current Speaker Mike Johnson from the Republicans.
paras.zh: 众议院 435 个席位中还有 7 场比赛尚未确定。民主党已经锁定了 257 个席位，杰弗里斯将拥有几十年来最大的多数席位之一，这与共和党现任议长迈克·约翰逊不同。

paras.en: When Rep. Nancy Pelosi of California decided to step aside from leadership in 2022 after the party's electoral defeat that handed Republicans the majority, it set the stage for this era. Pelosi, No. 2 Democratic Rep. Steny Hoyer of Maryland and Rep. James Clyburn of South Carolina had often moved together, rising, and then stepping back, from their long-held positions.
paras.zh: 当加利福尼亚州众议员南希·佩洛西 (Nancy Pelosi) 在该党选举失败并让共和党获得多数席位后决定于 2022 年辞去领导职务时，为这个时代奠定了基础。佩洛西、马里兰州第二号民主党众议员斯坦尼·霍耶和南卡罗来纳州众议员詹姆斯·克莱伯恩经常一起行动，从他们长期担任的职位上站起来，然后后退。

paras.en: Jeffries, Clark and Aguilar have risen together, as a team, as the first new generation of leaders of the post-Pelosi era and will soon serve as leaders in the majority for the first time.
paras.zh: 杰弗里斯、克拉克和阿吉拉尔作为一个团队一起崛起，成为后佩洛西时代的第一批新一代领导人，并将很快首次成为多数派的领导人。

paras.en: "There is one candidate in this race: Hakeem Jeffries," Democratic Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez said at the Capitol. "I think that everyone is far more concerned what that leadership means, what is it promising."
paras.zh: “这场竞选中有一位候选人：哈基姆·杰弗里斯，”民主党众议员亚历山大·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯在国会大厦说。 “我认为每个人都更关心这种领导力意味着什么，它有什么前景。”

paras.en: - Maryland's Van Hollen to challenge Schumer for U.S. Senate leadership post
paras.zh: - 马里兰州的范霍伦将挑战舒默，争夺美国参议院领导职位

paras.en: - Analysis How the Democrats' midterm wave shows a path back to the presidency
paras.zh: - 分析民主党的中期浪潮如何显示重返总统宝座的道路

paras.en: Seven incoming House progressives said in a joint statement that they voted against Jeffries.
paras.zh: 七名即将上任的众议院进步人士在一份联合声明中表示，他们投票反对杰弗里斯。

paras.en: "While we have seen meaningful progress, there is still work to be done to ensure that the direction our party takes this coming Congress reflects what our constituents are demanding of leadership," they said. "Those conversations are ongoing."
paras.zh: 他们说：“虽然我们已经看到了有意义的进展，但仍有工作要做，以确保我们党在本届国会所采取的方向反映了我们的选民对领导力的要求。” “这些对话正在进行中。”

paras.en: The Senate Democrats will decide on their leader early next month. Chuck Schumer of New York, who has been majority leader before, faces a challenge from Sen. Chris Van Hollen of Maryland.
paras.zh: 参议院民主党将于下月初决定其领导人。纽约州的查克·舒默(Chuck Schumer)此前曾担任多数党领袖，现在面临着马里兰州参议员克里斯·范·霍伦(Chris Van Hollen)的挑战。

paras.en: Returning Rep. Yassamin Ansari of Arizona said the situations in the Senate and the House "are quite different."
paras.zh: 亚利桑那州回归众议员亚萨明·安萨里表示，参议院和众议院的情况“截然不同”。

paras.en: She said Jeffries has been a collaborative leader who is listening to ideas from progressive caucus members like her and others.
paras.zh: 她说，杰弗里斯一直是一位协作型领导者，正在倾听像她和其他人这样的进步党团成员的想法。

paras.en: "His job is to reflect all of us, not just a faction," Ansari said.
paras.zh: 安萨里说：“他的工作是反映我们所有人，而不仅仅是一个派别。”

paras.en: "It is more productive to focus on preparing on what we're going to do in the majority and what we need and want to get done in those first 100 days."
paras.zh: “专注于准备我们大多数人要做什么以及我们需要并希望在前 100 天内完成的事情会更有成效。”

articles.title: Flights, banks, emails: What we know about a U.S. wave of tech outages
articles.author: Sara Jabakhanji

paras.en: Flights, banks, emails: What we know about a U.S. wave of tech outages
paras.zh: 航班、银行、电子邮件：我们对美国科技中断浪潮的了解

paras.en: Back-to-back disruptions cause concern for many over high-profile technology meltdown
paras.zh: 连续的中断引起了许多人对备受瞩目的技术崩溃的担忧

paras.en: A string of recent technical outages across the U.S. has affected everything from air travel and banking to security systems, raising questions about whether the seemingly unrelated incidents are caused by cyberattacks, artificial intelligence (AI) or simply overdue updates.
paras.zh: 美国各地最近发生的一系列技术故障影响了从航空旅行、银行到安全系统的方方面面，引发了人们的疑问：这些看似无关的事件是由网络攻击、人工智能（AI）还是仅仅是逾期更新引起的。

paras.en: This distressing series of glitches has affected multiple organizations — Microsoft, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), JPMorgan Chase, the National Security Agency's communications network and Apple — and left the U.S. administration scrambling to calm an American public worried about accessing their emails, checking their bank accounts or safely flying on airplanes.
paras.zh: 这一系列令人痛心的故障影响了多个组织——微软、美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）、摩根大通、国家安全局通信网络和苹果——并让美国政府忙于安抚担心访问电子邮件、检查银行账户或安全乘坐飞机的美国公众。

paras.en: Those organizations say the disruptions were not a result of cyberattacks; in most cases, the outages have been blamed on technical glitches.
paras.zh: 这些组织表示，中断并不是网络攻击造成的；而是造成的。在大多数情况下，停电被归咎于技术故障。

paras.en: If you've been confused about what's been glitching where, here's a breakdown of what happened.
paras.zh: 如果您对哪里出了问题感到困惑，这里有对所发生事件的详细分析。

paras.en: The FAA issued a countrywide ground stop on Friday that caused upheaval after halting thousands of flights over an air traffic control communications outage, lasting for almost five hours.
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空局周五在全国范围内发布了地面停飞令，由于空中交通管制通信中断导致数千架航班停飞，持续了近五个小时，引发了剧变。

paras.en: It was the longest countrywide halt to U.S. air travel since the Sept. 11, 2001, al-Qaeda attacks on the U.S.
paras.zh: 这是自 2001 年 9 月 11 日基地组织袭击美国以来，美国航空旅行最长的一次全国性停飞。

paras.en: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said there was no evidence of a cyberattack.
paras.zh: 交通部长肖恩·达菲表示，没有证据表明存在网络攻击。

paras.en: Duffy said Wednesday an issue with a Juniper router installed by L3Harris Technologies in a remote Arkansas facility "was not identified quickly enough" and that lessons have been learned to prevent future incidents.
paras.zh: 达菲周三表示，L3Harris Technologies 在阿肯色州偏远设施中安装的瞻博网络路由器存在问题，“没有足够快地发现”，并且已经吸取了教训，以防止未来再次发生此类事件。

paras.en: Jay Clayton, the Trump administration's director of national intelligence, said Wednesday at a House committee hearing that there was "no indication of any external threat actors or state-sponsored actors."
paras.zh: 特朗普政府国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿周三在众议院委员会听证会上表示，“没有迹象表明存在任何外部威胁行为者或国家支持的行为者”。

paras.en: A screen at Miami International Airport displays information about the ground stop order issued by U.S. aviation regulators on Nov. 13. (Georgio Viera/AFP/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 迈阿密国际机场的一个屏幕显示美国航空监管机构 11 月 13 日发布的地面停止命令的信息。（Georgio Viera/法新社/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: Equity research and brokerage firm Bernstein estimated the ground stop and the weekend work needed to recover from it cost the four biggest U.S. airlines $345 million US combined.
paras.zh: 股票研究和经纪公司 Bernstein 估计，停飞和恢复所需的周末工作使美国四大航空公司总共损失了 3.45 亿美元。

paras.en: Days after the ground stop, United Airlines said an outage that triggered departure delays for more than 100 flights on Monday was related to a system that helps them determine a plane's final weight. The airline said there was no indication it was a cybersecurity-related issue.
paras.zh: 地面停止几天后，美国联合航空公司表示，周一导致 100 多个航班起飞延误的故障与帮助他们确定飞机最终重量的系统有关。该航空公司表示，没有迹象表明这是与网络安全相关的问题。

paras.en: While these outages may not have been caused by cyberthreats themselves, some experts say the race to address software vulnerabilities exposed by AI has put companies at risk of the updates themselves getting botched.
paras.zh: 虽然这些中断可能不是由网络威胁本身造成的，但一些专家表示，解决人工智能暴露的软件漏洞的竞赛使公司面临更新本身被破坏的风险。

paras.en: "We have systems like the FAA systems, which are known to be ancient and really need an upgrade," Anne Neuberger, a general partner with the venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz and former White House deputy national security adviser, told the Wall Street Journal. "In addition to that, we have this whole set of AI attackers that are able to find vulnerabilities in code."
paras.zh: 风险投资公司安德森·霍洛维茨 (Andreessen Horowitz) 的普通合伙人、前白宫副国家安全顾问安妮·纽伯格 (Anne Neuberger) 告诉《华尔街日报》：“我们拥有像美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 系统这样的系统，众所周知，这些系统很古老，确实需要升级。” “除此之外，我们还有一整套人工智能攻击者能够发现代码中的漏洞。”

paras.en: JPMorgan Chase, the largest U.S. bank, said a software bug was affecting its internal hardware systems and causing transaction delays that began on Monday.
paras.zh: 美国最大的银行摩根大通表示，一个软件错误正在影响其内部硬件系统，并导致周一开始的交易延迟。

paras.en: Some customers of the company's retail bank, Chase, received a message Monday that said, "Some services aren't available. We're working on them. Please try back later."
paras.zh: 该公司零售银行大通银行的一些客户周一收到一条消息，称“某些服务不可用。我们正在处理这些服务。请稍后再试。”

paras.en: A Chase spokesperson said in an email Tuesday that the problem was resolved later Monday and that "transactions are processing normally."
paras.zh: 大通发言人周二在一封电子邮件中表示，问题已于周一晚些时候得到解决，“交易正在正常处理”。

paras.en: While the disruptions took place just days apart, government officials and company leaders have said the banking glitches were unrelated to the Microsoft and air traffic disruptions last week.
paras.zh: 虽然中断发生的时间间隔只有几天，但政府官员和公司领导人表示，银行业务故障与微软和上周的空中交通中断无关。

paras.en: The parent company said the technical problem was not the result of a cyberattack, stressing it was an isolated incident and not related to anything other than a bug.
paras.zh: 母公司表示，技术问题不是网络攻击的结果，并强调这是一个孤立的事件，除了错误之外与其他任何事情都没有关系。

paras.en: Customers at Bank of America, Citigroup and other banks trying to transact with Chase may have seen their transactions slow, even though those banks were not having issues with their services, a Chase spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 大通发言人表示，美国银行、花旗集团和其他试图与大通进行交易的银行的客户可能会发现交易速度很慢，尽管这些银行的服务没有出现问题。

paras.en: While this incident was isolated to technical problems at Chase, the way the modern financial system works is that a failure at one bank can make it appear as if other banks are affected, even if they are operating normally.
paras.zh: 虽然这一事件与大通银行的技术问题无关，但现代金融体系的运作方式是，一家银行的倒闭可能会让其他银行看起来受到影响，即使它们正常运营。

paras.en: "Even when the cause is a technical failure rather than a cyberattack, an issue at one point in the system can disrupt transactions elsewhere," said Christina Powers, who specializes in cybersecurity and banking issues at West Monroe, a Chicago-based digital services firm.
paras.zh: 芝加哥数字服务公司 West Monroe 专门研究网络安全和银行问题的克里斯蒂娜·鲍尔斯 (Christina Powers) 表示：“即使原因是技术故障而不是网络攻击，系统中某一点的问题也可能会扰乱其他地方的交易。”

paras.en: Many customers took to social media with concerns over whether their money is safe in the bank amid the rise in wider cyber issues. Even when online banking services are down, the money in the actual account remains safe and untouched, The Associated Press reported. Bank deposits are insured up to $250,000 US by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation.
paras.zh: 随着更广泛的网络问题的增加，许多客户在社交媒体上担心他们存在银行的钱是否安全。据美联社报道，即使网上银行服务出现故障，实际账户中的资金仍然安全且未受影响。联邦存款保险公司为银行存款提供高达 250,000 美元的保险。

paras.en: Email, video-conferencing and Apple services
paras.zh: 电子邮件、视频会议和 Apple 服务

paras.en: Tech giant Microsoft said the outage that hit its email and video-conferencing services last week was not the result of a cyberattack or rogue AI agents, but instead an unspecified issue with what the company described as a "network capacity upgrade."
paras.zh: 科技巨头微软表示，上周其电子邮件和视频会议服务中断并非网络攻击或流氓人工智能代理造成的，而是该公司所谓的“网络容量升级”的一个未具体说明的问题。

paras.en: The Thursday outage lasted for more than 24 hours, severely impacting services including Outlook, Teams and AI assistant Copilot.
paras.zh: 周四的中断持续了超过 24 小时，严重影响了 Outlook、Teams 和 AI 助手 Copilot 等服务。

paras.en: The U.S.-based company said on Saturday that services had fully recovered across Teams, Outlook and its other products.
paras.zh: 这家总部位于美国的公司周六表示，Teams、Outlook 及其其他产品的服务已完全恢复。

paras.en: Outlook and Teams are two of the most widely used workplace applications, with hundreds of millions of users. The outage prevented people from performing essential functions such as sending emails, managing calendars and hosting virtual meetings.
paras.zh: Outlook 和 Teams 是使用最广泛的两种工作场所应用程序，拥有数亿用户。停电导致人们无法执行发送电子邮件、管理日历和主持虚拟会议等基本功能。

paras.en: It affected government agencies from Australia and Japan to the United States, caused delays at trading firms, hindered some companies from publishing earnings and prompted airlines to warn customers of communication lags.
paras.zh: 它影响了从澳大利亚、日本到美国的政府机构，导致贸易公司延误，阻碍一些公司发布收益，并促使航空公司警告客户通信滞后。

paras.en: Organizations that host Microsoft services on their own servers, rather than in the cloud, were somewhat spared.
paras.zh: 在自己的服务器上而不是在云中托管微软服务的组织在一定程度上幸免于难。

paras.en: The outage is one of the longest in Microsoft's history and the second disruption to its services this year.
paras.zh: 这次中断是微软历史上最长的中断之一，也是今年其服务的第二次中断。

paras.en: On Tuesday, Apple said it was working to restore its systems after an internal update caused an outage that affected customer services, including iCloud and Apple Pay.
paras.zh: 周二，苹果公司表示，在一次内部更新导致中断影响了 iCloud 和 Apple Pay 等客户服务后，该公司正在努力恢复系统。

paras.en: The issue was not caused by a cyberattack, Apple said.
paras.zh: 苹果表示，该问题不是由网络攻击引起的。

paras.en: An internal network the National Security Agency uses to communicate classified information was offline Tuesday after what the agency described as "temporary degradation" during "routine maintenance."
paras.zh: 国家安全局用于传达机密信息的内部网络周二处于离线状态，该机构称该网络在“例行维护”期间出现“暂时性能下降”。

paras.en: The problem disrupted the operations of NSANet, a classified internal network used by employees of the agency, according to a defence official who was not authorized to discuss the matter by name and spoke to The Associated Press on the condition of anonymity.
paras.zh: 一位未获授权讨论此事并不愿透露姓名的国防官员表示，该问题扰乱了 NSANet 的运行，该网络是该机构员工使用的机密内部网络。

paras.en: - Canada-wide flight grounding unlikely, says aviation expert
paras.zh: - 航空专家表示，加拿大范围内的航班不太可能停飞

paras.en: - United Airlines says issue affecting departing flights has been resolved
paras.zh: - 联合航空表示影响离港航班的问题已得到解决

paras.en: "While some internal systems were affected, mission-critical capabilities remain fully operational and our ability to defend national security continues," the NSA said.
paras.zh: 美国国家安全局表示：“虽然一些内部系统受到影响，但关键任务功能仍然全面运行，我们捍卫国家安全的能力仍在继续。”

paras.en: "NSA's infrastructure is designed with multiple layers of redundancy to maintain operations during planned maintenance or unexpected events."
paras.zh: “国家安全局的基础设施设计有多层冗余，以便在计划维护或意外事件期间维持运行。”

paras.en: The intelligence agency did not provide any additional details on the cause of the outage or the scope of the disruption.
paras.zh: 情报机构没有提供有关停电原因或中断范围的任何其他详细信息。

paras.en: With files from Reuters and The Associated Press
paras.zh: 来自路透社和美联社的文件

articles.title: ICJ to rule on Rohingya genocide case against Myanmar: What to know

paras.en: The International Court of Justice (ICJ) will deliver on Thursday its long-awaited judgment in The Gambia's landmark genocide case against Myanmar, seven years after the case was lodged in The Hague.
paras.zh: 国际法院（ICJ）将于周四就冈比亚针对缅甸的具有里程碑意义的种族灭绝案件做出人们期待已久的判决，此时距离该案在海牙提起七年后。

paras.en: The Gambia filed the case with the United Nations' top court in November 2019, formally accusing the Southeast Asian nation of breaking its obligations under the 1948 UN Genocide Convention.
paras.zh: 冈比亚于 2019 年 11 月向联合国最高法院提起诉讼，正式指控这个东南亚国家违反 1948 年《联合国种族灭绝公约》规定的义务。

paras.en: In documents and hearings, The Gambia has alleged that Myanmar waged a deliberate campaign of arson, rape and murder in Rakhine State from 2016 to 2017, intending to wipe out the area's ethnic Rohingya minority, in whole or in part.
paras.zh: 冈比亚在文件和听证会上声称，2016年至2017年，缅甸在若开邦蓄意纵火、强奸和谋杀，意图全部或部分消灭该地区的罗兴亚少数民族。

paras.en: A UN fact-finding mission later concluded that some 10,000 people likely died in the pogroms. Another 700,000 Rohingya fled the country to neighboring Bangladesh, where most of them still live today in the world's largest refugee settlement.
paras.zh: 联合国实况调查团后来得出结论，大约有 10,000 人可能在大屠杀中死亡。另有 70 万罗兴亚人逃离该国前往邻国孟加拉国，其中大多数人至今仍居住在世界上最大的难民安置点。

paras.en: Even before 2016, the predominantly Muslim Rohingya had been subjected to decades of persecution by the Buddhist-majority country's government, with many forced into resettlement camps and most denied citizenship.
paras.zh: 甚至在 2016 年之前，以穆斯林为主的罗兴亚人就已经遭受了佛教徒占多数的国家政府数十年的迫害，许多人被迫进入安置营，大多数人被剥夺公民身份。

paras.en: A number of cases over Myanmar's treatment of the Rohingya have been filed in courts around the world. The ICJ will be the first to issue a ruling.
paras.zh: 许多有关缅甸对待罗兴亚人的案件已在世界各地的法院提起。国际法院将首先做出裁决。

paras.en: "The Rohingya people have been waiting for justice for decades for the atrocities and crimes committed against [us]. There were no venues available in [Myanmar]… International venues were the only hope," said Aung Kyaw Moe, a prominent Rohingya activist whose family was forced to flee the country during the pogroms.
paras.zh: “几十年来，罗兴亚人一直在等待针对[我们]犯下的暴行和罪行的正义。[缅甸]没有可用的场所……国际场所是唯一的希望，”著名的罗兴亚活动人士昂觉莫(Aung Kyaw Moe)说，他的家人在大屠杀期间被迫逃离该国。

paras.en: "We've come over many years to a situation where a judgment will be delivered, and the expectation from the Rohingya community is very high," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们多年来一直面临着即将做出判决的情况，罗辛亚社区的期望非常高。”

paras.en: A month after The Gambia lodged its case with the ICJ in 2019, Nobel laureate Aung San Suu Kyi, Myanmar's de facto civilian leader at the time, traveled to The Hague to contest the allegations, calling them "incomplete and incorrect."
paras.zh: 冈比亚于 2019 年向国际法院提起诉讼一个月后，诺贝尔奖得主、当时的缅甸事实上的文职领导人昂山素季前往海牙对这些指控提出质疑，称这些指控“不完整且不正确”。

paras.en: The move tarnished her international reputation as a human rights icon. Many human rights advocates criticized her for defending the very military that had persecuted her for most of her life.
paras.zh: 此举玷污了她作为人权偶像的国际声誉。许多人权倡导者批评她捍卫了迫害她一生的军队。

paras.en: In 2020, ahead of a final judgment, the ICJ issued emergency "provisional measures" ordering Myanmar to take all steps "within its power" to prevent acts of genocide against the Rohingya, an order rights groups say it has blatantly ignored.
paras.zh: 2020年，在做出最终判决之前，国际法院发布了紧急“临时措施”，命令缅甸“在其权力范围内”采取一切措施，防止针对罗兴亚人的种族灭绝行为，但人权组织表示，缅甸公然忽视了这一命令。

paras.en: Myanmar's military went on to oust the country's democratically elected government the following year, placing Aung San Suu Kyi under arrest and setting off a bloody civil war that continues to rage.
paras.zh: 次年，缅甸军方推翻了该国民选政府，逮捕了昂山素季，并引发了一场持续激烈的血腥内战。

paras.en: Myanmar also challenged both the court's jurisdiction over the alleged crimes and The Gambia's right to lodge the case, both of which the ICJ rejected in 2022.
paras.zh: 缅甸还对法院对所指控罪行的管辖权以及冈比亚提起诉讼的权利提出质疑，国际法院于 2022 年驳回了这两项指控。

paras.en: The ICJ then held 14 days of hearings this January for Myanmar and The Gambia to make their arguments before the panel. While Myanmar called one witness, The Gambia called three, as well as an expert.
paras.zh: 国际法院随后于今年 1 月为缅甸和冈比亚举行了为期 14 天的听证会，向专家组陈述其论点。缅甸传唤了一名证人，而冈比亚则传唤了三名证人和一名专家。

paras.en: As The Gambia has accused Myanmar of breaking several articles of the Genocide Convention, Thursday's judgment could be "fairly complicated," said Melanie O'Brien, a professor of international law at the University of Western Australia and past president of the International Association of Genocide Scholars.
paras.zh: 西澳大利亚大学国际法教授、国际种族灭绝学者协会前主席梅兰妮·奥布莱恩表示，由于冈比亚指责缅甸违反了《种族灭绝公约》的几项条款，周四的判决可能“相当复杂”。

paras.en: The convention outlines that states have a duty to prevent and punish genocide and to establish effective penalties for those found responsible. The ICJ could rule in Myanmar's favor on some of these provisions and against it on others.
paras.zh: 该公约概述了各国有责任防止和惩罚种族灭绝行为，并对责任人制定有效的惩罚措施。国际法院可以对其中一些条款做出有利于缅甸的裁决，而对另一些条款作出不利的裁决。

paras.en: "So, there's quite a lot of layers here. They'll be looking at all of those issues, along with, of course, delving into the facts of the case and the individual crimes of genocide and whether or not Myanmar committed those individual crimes with the intent to destroy the Rohingya," O'Brien said.
paras.zh: “所以，这里有很多层面。他们将研究所有这些问题，当然，还会深入研究案件的事实和种族灭绝的个人罪行，以及缅甸是否犯下这些个人罪行，目的是消灭罗辛亚人，”奥布莱恩说。

paras.en: Proving Myanmar's intent behind the alleged atrocities is the key question the ICJ is grappling with.
paras.zh: 证明缅甸所指控的暴行背后的意图是国际法院正在努力解决的关键问题。

paras.en: Myanmar argues that its actions were strictly part of a legitimate counterinsurgency and counterterrorism operation, and that those actions could not at the same time be judged as acts of genocide.
paras.zh: 缅甸辩称，其行动严格来说是合法的反叛乱和反恐行动的一部分，这些行动不能同时被判定为种族灭绝行为。

paras.en: Days before the Myanmar military launched its heaviest operations in Rakhine, in August 2017, the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army, an armed group based in the state, staged a coordinated attack on more than 30 police posts, killing several officers.
paras.zh: 2017 年 8 月，缅甸军方在若开邦发起最大规模行动的前几天，驻扎在若开邦的武装组织若开罗兴亚救世军对 30 多个警察哨所发动了协同袭击，造成数名警察死亡。

paras.en: The Gambia argues that Myanmar's actions can qualify as both counterinsurgency and genocide at the same time. It also argues that the sexual violence and killing of children that accompanied the operations are proof that genocide was part of the goal.
paras.zh: 冈比亚认为，缅甸的行动可以同时被视为反叛乱和种族灭绝。它还认为，伴随行动而来的性暴力和杀害儿童证明种族灭绝是目标的一部分。

paras.en: "It directly undermines Myanmar's argument that this was a legitimate counterterrorism operation," said Michael Becker, an associate professor of international human rights law at Trinity College Dublin and a former associate legal officer at the ICJ.
paras.zh: 都柏林三一学院国际人权法副教授、国际法院前助理法律官员迈克尔·贝克尔表示：“这直接削弱了缅甸关于这是一次合法反恐行动的论点。”

paras.en: "Because evidence of those types of atrocities are very hard to square with the idea that this had some other purpose beyond terrorizing the Rohingya population and indeed taking actions to try to destroy them," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“因为此类暴行的证据很难与这样的观点相一致，即除了恐吓罗兴亚人并采取行动试图摧毁他们之外，还有其他目的。”

paras.en: O'Brien and Becker said The Gambia's case against Myanmar is a chance for the ICJ to clarify how it weighs such circumstantial or indirect evidence when judging whether genocide has taken place.
paras.zh: 奥布莱恩和贝克尔表示，冈比亚针对缅甸的案件是国际法院澄清在判断种族灭绝是否发生时如何权衡此类间接或间接证据的一个机会。

paras.en: Because investigators were denied access to Rakhine State, they had to rely on interviews with victims and witnesses who had fled Myanmar and on reports by the UN and other groups.
paras.zh: 由于调查人员被拒绝进入若开邦，他们不得不依赖对逃离缅甸的受害者和证人的采访以及联合国和其他组织的报告。

paras.en: "And how the court deals with that, whether the ICJ accepts or rejects The Gambia's view or Myanmar's view of genocidal intent and how you prove it, this will have major repercussions for other cases," said Becker.
paras.zh: 贝克尔说：“法院如何处理这一问题，无论国际法院接受还是拒绝冈比亚或缅甸关于种族灭绝意图的观点，以及如何证明这一点，这将对其他案件产生重大影响。”

paras.en: The ICJ is grappling with some of the same questions in cases between the Democratic Republic of Congo and Rwanda, Ukraine and Russia, and South Africa and Israel.
paras.zh: 国际法院正在努力解决刚果民主共和国与卢旺达、乌克兰与俄罗斯、南非与以色列之间案件中的一些相同问题。

paras.en: "I'm sure that the parties in the other cases will pick up on what the court rules in this case and add it to their own cases," said O'Brien.
paras.zh: 奥布莱恩说：“我确信其他案件的当事人会了解法院在本案中的裁决，并将其添加到自己的案件中。”

paras.en: "And even though this case will only be binding on The Gambia and Myanmar, the court itself may also refer to its own law in their future cases," she added.
paras.zh: “尽管此案仅对冈比亚和缅甸具有约束力，但法院本身也可能在未来的案件中参考自己的法律，”她补充道。

paras.en: The ICJ's judgment may have some effect on not only other cases but other courts as well.
paras.zh: 国际法院的判决不仅可能对其他案件产生一定影响，也可能对其他法院产生一定影响。

paras.en: The International Criminal Court — which, unlike the ICJ, tries individuals and not states — is considering an arrest warrant request for Myanmar coup leader Min Aung Hlaing in a trial on alleged crimes against humanity committed against the Rohingya. Becker and O'Brien say a finding of genocide by the ICJ could bolster the case for granting the warrant.
paras.zh: 与国际法院不同的是，国际刑事法院审判的是个人而非国家，该法院正在考虑对缅甸政变领导人敏昂莱发出逮捕令，以审理涉嫌针对罗兴亚人犯下的反人类罪。贝克尔和奥布莱恩表示，国际法院对种族灭绝的裁决可能会支持批准逮捕令。

paras.en: What a finding of genocide would actually do for the Rohingya is another key question.
paras.zh: 种族灭绝的发现实际上会对罗兴亚人产生什么影响是另一个关键问题。

paras.en: Enforcing any reparations or restitution the court may order would rest with the UN Security Council. But with China and Russia, both allies of Min Aung Hlaing's regime, holding veto power on the council, there are serious doubts about whether it would act on any court order on Myanmar.
paras.zh: 执行法院可能下令的任何赔偿或归还将由联合国安理会负责。但由于敏昂莱政权的盟友中国和俄罗斯在该委员会中拥有否决权，因此人们严重怀疑该委员会是否会按照法院针对缅甸的命令采取行动。

paras.en: Aung Kyaw Moe remains hopeful that the Rohingya will one day receive justice.
paras.zh: 昂觉莫仍然希望罗兴亚人有一天能得到正义。

paras.en: "Despite these challenges, there are a lot of hopes that we can [move] toward the betterment of the Rohingya people, including compensation, reparations, transitional justice in the domestic setting in the long term," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“尽管面临这些挑战，但我们仍然抱有很大的希望，希望我们能够为改善罗兴亚人的生活而努力，包括从长远来看，在国内环境中提供赔偿、赔偿和过渡司法。”

articles.title: India: Online censorship grows after 'Cockroach' protests

paras.en: A video showing a young girl crying as she spoke about alleged police brutality during the youth-led Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) protests in July. A video examining the Hindu nationalist Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh's (RSS) contribution to the rise of India's ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). A satirical cartoon criticizing Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government.
paras.zh: 一段视频显示，一名年轻女孩在谈到 7 月份青年领导的蟑螂人民党 (CJP) 抗议活动中涉嫌警察的暴行时哭泣。这段视频探讨了印度教民族主义者国民党 (RSS) 对印度执政党印度人民党 (BJP) 崛起的贡献。批评总理纳伦德拉·莫迪政府的讽刺漫画。

paras.en: These are among the examples of content that have recently been restricted on social media in India.
paras.zh: 这些是最近在印度社交媒体上受到限制的内容的例子。

paras.en: Content creator CitySavitri describes herself as a "nobody" in the world of social media. She had started making videos just two months ago and had around 600 followers on Instagram.
paras.zh: 内容创作者 CitySavitri 将自己描述为社交媒体世界中的“无名小卒”。她两个月前才开始制作视频，在 Instagram 上拥有大约 600 名粉丝。

paras.en: Yet a video looking at the RSS's role in the BJP's 2014 election victory was restricted in India within an hour of being posted. It was the first of three videos she posted that faced restrictions.
paras.zh: 然而，一段关于 RSS 在印度人民党 2014 年选举胜利中所扮演的角色的视频在发布一小时后就在印度受到限制。这是她发布的三个受到限制的视频中的第一个。

paras.en: The experience made her feel that "anti-government commentary" was being monitored and curtailed.
paras.zh: 这次经历让她感到“反政府评论”正在受到监控和限制。

paras.en: "It is very plain and simple to understand," the content creator told DW.
paras.zh: “它非常简单易懂，”内容创作者告诉德国之声。

paras.en: Independent journalist Sadhika Tiwari was covering the CJP protest in New Delhi on July 20, when police used batons and tear gas against demonstrators.
paras.zh: 7 月 20 日，独立记者萨迪卡·蒂瓦里 (Sadhika Tiwari) 报道了新德里的 CJP 抗议活动，当时警察对示威者使用了警棍和催泪瓦斯。

paras.en: Tiwari's video of a frightened young girl crying and speaking about police brutality garnered around 10 million views within hours, she said, before it was restricted in India.
paras.zh: 蒂瓦里表示，一段视频中一名受惊的年轻女孩哭泣着谈论警察的暴行，几个小时内就获得了大约 1000 万次观看，但该视频在印度受到限制。

paras.en: Political cartoonist Satish Acharya has also faced repeated restrictions, with Instagram blocking his profile twice recently.
paras.zh: 政治漫画家 Satish Acharya 也多次面临限制，Instagram 最近两次屏蔽了他的个人资料。

paras.en: In May 2025, during the conflict between India and Pakistan, independent digital news outlet Maktoob Media's X account was withheld in India while it was reporting on the escalating crisis, its founder and editor Aslah Kayyalakkath told DW.
paras.zh: 独立数字新闻媒体 Maktoob Media 的创始人兼编辑 Aslah Kayyalakkath 告诉德国之声，2025 年 5 月，在印度和巴基斯坦之间的冲突期间，独立数字新闻媒体 Maktoob Media 的 X 账户在报道不断升级的危机时在印度被扣押。

paras.en: "We received no official notice or email from either the government or X. It was our readers who first alerted us to the blocking," he said.
paras.zh: “我们没有收到来自政府或 X 的正式通知或电子邮件。是我们的读者首先提醒我们封锁的，”他说。

paras.en: Maktoob Media said it contacted Indian officials and X but received no response. Access to the account was restored a few days later, again without an explanation.
paras.zh: Maktoob Media 表示，它联系了印度官员和 X，但没有收到回复。几天后，该帐户的访问权限再次恢复，但没有做出任何解释。

paras.en: Kayyalakkath said Maktoob's content from the July protest also faced restrictions. "Suppressing independent journalism undermines transparency, accountability and democratic values," he said.
paras.zh: Kayyalakkath 表示，Maktoob 七月抗议活动的内容也面临限制。 “压制独立新闻业破坏了透明度、问责制和民主价值观，”他说。

paras.en: Several of the content creators and journalists interviewed by DW said they received no prior notification or explanation for the restrictions.
paras.zh: 德国之声采访的几位内容创作者和记者表示，他们事先没有收到有关这些限制的通知或解释。

paras.en: Some users were not sure if their content had been blocked at the government's request or proactively by the social media platforms.
paras.zh: 一些用户不确定他们的内容是否是应政府要求或社交媒体平台主动屏蔽的。

paras.en: When asked for comment, Meta, the parent company of Facebook and Instagram, pointed DW to a website statement noting users can appeal content and account restrictions.
paras.zh: 当被要求置评时，Facebook 和 Instagram 的母公司 Meta 向德国之声指出了一份网站声明，指出用户可以对内容和帐户限制提出申诉。

paras.en: At the heart of the debate are India's IT Rules, 2021, amended in February 2026. Section 79 of India's IT Act protects social media platforms and other intermediaries from liability for content posted by third parties, provided they meet certain legal conditions.
paras.zh: 争论的核心是于 2026 年 2 月修订的印度 2021 年 IT 规则。印度 IT 法第 79 条保护社交媒体平台和其他中介机构不对第三方发布的内容承担责任，前提是它们满足某些法律条件。

paras.en: One such requirement, introduced through the February 2026 amendments, is to remove or disable access to specified unlawful content within three hours of receiving a valid court order or a reasoned government notice. The previous deadline was 36 hours.
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月修正案引入的其中一项要求是，在收到有效的法院命令或合理的政府通知后三个小时内删除或禁止访问特定的非法内容。之前的截止日期是 36 小时。

paras.en: Failure to comply can result in intermediaries losing their liability protection.
paras.zh: 不遵守规定可能会导致中介机构失去责任保护。

paras.en: The government's Sahyog portal, which coordinates takedown requests between law enforcement, platforms and telecom providers, has faced criticism over the pace at which notices are issued.
paras.zh: 政府的 Sahyog 门户负责协调执法部门、平台和电信提供商之间的删除请求，该门户因发布通知的速度而面临批评。

paras.en: Meta said it uses automated tools and technologies to detect and review content that may violate its community standards. It also automatically restricts access to certain types of content in India to comply with legal requirements under the IT rules.
paras.zh: Meta 表示，它使用自动化工具和技术来检测和审查可能违反其社区标准的内容。它还会自动限制对印度某些类型内容的访问，以遵守 IT 规则的法律要求。

paras.en: Pranesh Prakash, a technology law and policy adviser, said the amended rules allow authorized police officials to notify intermediaries about content they consider unlawful without necessarily filing a formal complaint or initiating other legal proceedings.
paras.zh: 技术法律和政策顾问普拉内什·普拉卡什 (Pranesh Prakash) 表示，修订后的规则允许授权警察官员将他们认为非法的内容通知中介机构，而无需提出正式投诉或启动其他法律程序。

paras.en: "This has led to the worst period of social media censorship that India has ever seen, with digital news media accounts being blocked, cartoonists' accounts being blocked, and even mere discussions of an opposition leader's memoirs being blocked," he said. "Clearly, none of these disclosed any 'unlawful acts.'"
paras.zh: 他说：“这导致了印度有史以来最严重的社交媒体审查时期，数字新闻媒体账户被封锁，漫画家的账户被封锁，甚至只是对反对派领导人回忆录的讨论也被封锁。” “显然，这些都没有披露任何‘非法行为’。”

paras.en: Prakash also raised concerns about the lack of public information on government requests to remove content, saying this made it difficult to assess the scale of restrictions.
paras.zh: 普拉卡什还对政府要求删除内容的公开信息缺乏表示担忧，称这使得评估限制规模变得困难。

paras.en: The Software Freedom Law Center, India (SFLC.in), a digital rights organization, said the growing reliance on automated takedowns raised serious concerns about transparency, accountability and due process.
paras.zh: 数字版权组织印度软件自由法律中心 (SFLC.in) 表示，对自动删除的日益依赖引发了人们对透明度、问责制和正当程序的严重担忧。

paras.en: "There is little transparency about the processes through which content is identified, flagged and restricted, or whether there is any meaningful human oversight before a takedown is implemented," SFLC.in told DW.
paras.zh: SFLC.in 告诉德国之声：“内容识别、标记和限制的流程几乎不透明，或者在实施删除之前是否存在任何有意义的人为监督。”

paras.en: The organization also tested X's verification process by submitting a takedown request against one of its own posts using a fake email address. X registered the request, raising questions about how it verified the identity and authority of those submitting requests.
paras.zh: 该组织还通过使用虚假电子邮件地址针对其自己的帖子之一提交删除请求来测试 X 的验证流程。 X 登记了该请求，引发了关于它如何验证提交请求者的身份和权限的问题。

paras.en: After SFLC.in alerted the company, X introduced email verification codes for people submitting takedown requests.
paras.zh: 在 SFLC.in 向该公司发出警报后，X 为提交删除请求的人引入了电子邮件验证码。

paras.en: "A channel that lets anyone pose as a law enforcement official can be misused to silence lawful speech," SFLC.in said.
paras.zh: SFLC.in 表示：“任何人都可以冒充执法官员的渠道可能会被滥用来压制合法言论。”

paras.en: X did not respond to DW's request for a comment.
paras.zh: X 没有回应德国之声的置评请求。

paras.en: The Indian government denies that it is censoring online content.
paras.zh: 印度政府否认正在审查在线内容。

paras.en: While the ministry did not respond to DW's latest request for a comment, in an email response to DW in August, Vinod Kumar, chief of media and communications at the Information Technology Ministry, said Instagram posts by students and protesters following the July CJP protests "are not being taken down as alleged."
paras.zh: 虽然该部没有回应德国之声最新的置评请求，但信息技术部媒体和通讯主管维诺德·库马尔(Vinod Kumar)在8月发给德国之声的电子邮件中表示，学生和抗议者在7月CJP抗议活动后在Instagram上发布的帖子“并未像所指控的那样被删除”。

paras.en: "Media enjoys freedom in India. The Government does not censor online content," Kumar said, adding that the government only acts against "objectionable content."
paras.zh: 库马尔说：“媒体在印度享有自由。政府不会审查在线内容。”他补充说，政府只会针对“令人反感的内容”采取行动。

paras.en: Under the Indian IT rules, "unlawful content" generally refers to material which could threaten India's sovereignty and integrity, disturb public order, incite violence, or constitute defamation.
paras.zh: 根据印度信息技术规则，“非法内容”一般是指可能威胁印度主权和完整、扰乱公共秩序、煽动暴力或构成诽谤的内容。

paras.en: However, social media influencers such as university professor Madri Kakoti, alias Dr. Medusa, continue to report restrictions. Kakoti's Instagram account was restricted in India on November 16 without notice, she said, along with that of satirist Shamita Yadav.
paras.zh: 然而，大学教授马德里·卡科蒂（又名美杜莎博士）等社交媒体影响者继续报告限制措施。她说，11 月 16 日，卡科蒂 (Kakoti) 的 Instagram 账户以及讽刺作家沙米塔·亚达夫 (Shamita Yadav) 的账户在没有事先通知的情况下在印度受到限制。

paras.en: Rights groups including Human Rights Watch have warned that expanding content restrictions could chill free expression and encourage self-censorship among journalists, creators and ordinary users.
paras.zh: 人权观察组织等人权组织警告称，扩大内容限制可能会抑制言论自由，并鼓励记者、创作者和普通用户进行自我审查。

paras.en: Acharya, however, said he would continue his work.
paras.zh: 然而，阿查里亚表示他将继续他的工作。

paras.en: "The Indian Constitution gives me the right to draw political cartoons," he said. "It's totally democratic to question and criticize the government in India."
paras.zh: “印度宪法赋予我画政治漫画的权利，”他说。 “质疑和批评印度政府是完全民主的。”

paras.en: For Tiwari, the issue goes beyond the reach of a single video. It is also about preserving a record of what happened, after the Delhi Police denied allegations of using excessive force during the July 20 protest in front of the Supreme Court.
paras.zh: 对于蒂瓦里来说，这个问题超出了单个视频的范围。在德里警方否认 7 月 20 日最高法院前抗议期间过度使用武力的指控后，这也是为了保留所发生事件的记录。

paras.en: "We have seen several other videos now, and it's well established why that girl was crying, and that the Delhi Police used force and lied about it," she said.
paras.zh: “我们现在已经看到了其他几个视频，那个女孩哭泣的原因已经很明确，德里警方对此使用了武力并撒了谎，”她说。

paras.en: "Still, I want that video back up because it needs to stay for posterity. I think that's the larger idea: they want to take this stuff down so it fades from memory, allowing them to categorically deny it later when we have little left to show for what happened."
paras.zh: “不过，我还是希望那个视频能被备份，因为它需要为后代保留。我认为这是一个更大的想法：他们想把这些东西拿下来，这样它就会从记忆中消失，让他们在以后当我们几乎没有什么可以展示所发生的事情时断然否认它。”

articles.title: North Korea expanded uranium enrichment plant, says IAEA head

paras.en: United Nations (UN) nuclear watchdog chief Rafael Grossi said on Wednesday North Korea has built an extension on its original uranium-enrichment plant at the Yongbyon nuclear complex.
paras.zh: 联合国核监督机构负责人拉斐尔·格罗西周三表示，朝鲜已在宁边核设施的原铀浓缩工厂基础上扩建。

paras.en: The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) has been unable to access North Korea since Pyongyang expelled its inspectors in 2009. It now relies primarily on satellite imagery to monitor the country's nuclear activity.
paras.zh: 自平壤于 2009 年驱逐核查人员以来，国际原子能机构 (IAEA) 一直无法进入朝鲜。该机构现在主要依靠卫星图像来监测该国的核活动。

paras.en: Grossi addressed the ongoing operation of enrichment facilities at Yongbyon and Kangson during a quarterly meeting of the IAEA's Board of Governors.
paras.zh: 格罗西在国际原子能机构理事会季度会议上谈到了宁边和康村浓缩设施的持续运行情况。

paras.en: Kangson lies just southwest of Pyongyang, while the much larger Yongbyon facility is located farther north of the capital.
paras.zh: 康村位于平壤西南部，而规模大得多的宁边设施位于首都更北的地方。

paras.en: "Since mid-September 2026, a further extension to the original Yongbyon enrichment facility has been under construction with the new extension externally complete by late October 2026," Grossi said, with no further details.
paras.zh: 格罗西表示：“自 2026 年 9 月中旬以来，原宁边浓缩设施的进一步扩建工程一直在建设中，新的扩建工程将于 2026 年 10 月下旬外部完工。”但他没有透露更多细节。

paras.en: He said the ongoing expansion of North Korea's uranium enrichment program remains "a cause for serious concern."
paras.zh: 他表示，朝鲜不断扩大的铀浓缩计划仍然“令人严重关切”。

paras.en: Enriched uranium is used as fuel for nuclear power plants and the nuclear reactors that run naval ships and submarines. It can also be used in nuclear weapons.
paras.zh: 浓缩铀用作核电站以及海军舰艇和潜艇运行的核反应堆的燃料。它也可用于核武器。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump floated the possibility of a meeting with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un as he went to China to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在前往中国会见中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京时提出了与朝鲜领导人金正恩会面的可能性。

paras.en: Meanwhile, North Korean state media — which typically operates behind the global news cycle — has only released images of Kim visiting a ski resort and Mount Paektu, making no mention of possible Shenzhen travel plans.
paras.zh: 与此同时，朝鲜官方媒体——通常落后于全球新闻周期——只发布了金正恩参观滑雪胜地和白头山的照片，没有提及可能的深圳旅行计划。

paras.en: Kim has said he aims to arm the nation with an expansive nuclear force to counter the US and South Korea.
paras.zh: 金正恩表示，他的目标是用扩大的核力量武装国家，以对抗美国和韩国。

paras.en: In March, soon after the US and Israel launched strikes on Iran, Kim accused Washington of "global terrorism and aggression."
paras.zh: 今年三月，美国和以色列对伊朗发动袭击后不久，金正恩指责华盛顿“实施全球恐怖主义和侵略”。

paras.en: The Iran war reinforced North Korea's long-standing view that it needs a nuclear arsenal to be able to defend itself against what it sees as its two largest enemies, South Korea and the US.
paras.zh: 伊朗战争强化了朝鲜长期以来的观点，即它需要核武库才能抵御其视为最大的两个敌人——韩国和美国。

paras.en: North Korea has been subject to various international sanctions over its nuclear weapons development and use of ballistic missile technology. But Pyongyang has repeatedly flouted the restrictions.
paras.zh: 朝鲜因其核武器开发和弹道导弹技术的使用而受到各种国际制裁。但平壤一再无视这些限制。

paras.en: In September 2024, North Korea revealed its first covert uranium-enrichment plant. Kim delivered a speech then, including a call for "exponentially" expanding the country's nuclear arsenal.
paras.zh: 2024 年 9 月，朝鲜公布了其第一座秘密铀浓缩工厂。金正恩随后发表讲话，其中包括呼吁“指数级”扩大该国的核武库。

paras.en: In April, Grossi told reporters that his agency had confirmed "a rapid increase” in activities at nuclear facilities in North Korea.
paras.zh: 四月，格罗西告诉记者，他的机构已证实朝鲜核设施的活动“迅速增加”。

paras.en: In September, the IAEA passed resolutions at its annual conference regarding concerns about the North Korean nuclear program.
paras.zh: 9月，国际原子能机构在年度会议上通过了有关朝鲜核计划担忧的决议。

paras.en: Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of Kim Jong Un, said in response that the country's nuclear-armed status was "absolute."
paras.zh: 金正恩的妹妹金与正回应说，该国的核武器地位是“绝对的”。

paras.en: She called those expecting denuclearisation "idiots."
paras.zh: 她称那些期待无核化的人为“白痴”。

articles.title: Israeli court extends Gaza doctor Abu Safia’s detention without charge

paras.en: An Israeli court has extended the detention of Hussam Abu Safia, the director of Gaza’s Kamal Adwan Hospital, who remains held without charge amid repeated calls for his release.
paras.zh: 以色列法院延长了对加沙卡迈勒阿德万医院院长胡萨姆·阿布·萨菲亚 (Hussam Abu Safia) 的拘留期限，在多次要求释放他的呼声中，他仍然未经指控而被关押。

paras.en: Abu Safia’s lawyer said that a court in Beersheba decided on Wednesday to extend the physician’s detention for a further six months, according to Abu Safia’s account on X.
paras.zh: 据阿布·萨菲亚 (Abu Safia) 在 X 上的报道，阿布·萨菲亚 (Abu Safia) 的律师表示，贝尔谢巴 (Beersheba) 的一家法院周三决定将这名医生的拘留再延长六个月。

paras.en: The court said that Abu Safia “poses a threat to the State of Israel”, his lawyer reported.
paras.zh: 据阿布·萨菲亚的律师报道，法院称阿布·萨菲亚“对以色列国构成威胁”。

paras.en: “Dr Hussam questioned why his detention order was being renewed once again, expressing that he is being punished for fulfilling his humanitarian mission and professional duty as a doctor at Kamal Adwan Hospital in northern Gaza,” the social media post added.
paras.zh: 社交媒体帖子补充道：“胡萨姆博士质疑为何再次延长他的拘留令，并表示他因履行人道主义使命和作为加沙北部卡迈勒阿德万医院医生的职业职责而受到惩罚。”

paras.en: The Israeli army detained Abu Safia in December 2024, along with other staff members and patients, during a raid on the hospital in northern Gaza.
paras.zh: 2024 年 12 月，以色列军队在袭击加沙北部的医院时拘留了阿布·萨菲亚以及其他工作人员和患者。

paras.en: International agencies and rights groups have called for the physician’s release on multiple occasions, highlighting reports that he is being subjected to abuse in detention.
paras.zh: 国际机构和人权组织多次呼吁释放这名医生，并强调了有关他在拘留期间遭受虐待的报道。

paras.en: The Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) said in July that Israel “must immediately release Dr Abu Safiya, or promptly charge him with a recognizable criminal offence and grant him a fair trial”.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员办事处（人权高专办）7 月表示，以色列“必须立即释放阿布·萨菲亚博士，或立即指控他犯有可识别的刑事罪行，并给予他公正的审判”。

paras.en: OHCHR added that it received information indicating Abu Safia “has been subjected to torture and other ill-treatment, including prolonged solitary confinement, repeated severe assaults resulting in grave injuries, and denial of medical care”.
paras.zh: 人权高专办补充说，它收到的信息表明阿布·萨菲亚“遭受酷刑和其他虐待，包括长期单独监禁、多次严重袭击导致严重受伤，以及拒绝提供医疗服务”。

paras.en: Physicians for Human Rights Israel (PHRI) said last week it had obtained an independent medical review of Abu Safia’s records showing a significant loss of weight, a drop in haemoglobin levels and chest pain that was not properly investigated.
paras.zh: 以色列人权医生组织 (PHRI) 上周表示，他们已对阿布·萨菲亚的记录进行了独立医学审查，结果显示阿布·萨菲亚的体重明显下降、血红蛋白水平下降，而且胸痛，但并未得到适当调查。

paras.en: “Not only has he been deprived of his freedom without trial, but he is also being denied his basic right to an independent medical examination,” PHRI’s Naji Abbas said.
paras.zh: PHRI 的纳吉·阿巴斯 (Naji Abbas) 表示：“他不仅未经审判就被剥夺了自由，而且还被剥夺了接受独立体检的基本权利。”

paras.en: Last week, the Supreme Court dismissed a petition seeking the release of 14 doctors, including hospital directors and specialists in essential medical fields, who are being held in Israeli prisons without being charged or brought to trial.
paras.zh: 上周，最高法院驳回了一项要求释放 14 名医生的请愿书，其中包括医院院长和基本医疗领域的专家，这些医生被关押在以色列监狱中，没有受到指控或审判。

paras.en: PHRI argued that the prolonged arbitrary detentions – in some cases for more than two years – constitute a violation of their individual rights and further undermine Gaza’s healthcare system, which faces a severe shortage of medical professionals.
paras.zh: PHRI 认为，长期任意拘留——在某些情况下超过两年——构成了对他们个人权利的侵犯，并进一步破坏了加沙的医疗保健系统，该系统面临着医疗专业人员的严重短缺。

articles.title: Trump and Putin to meet one-on-one in China Thursday

paras.en: Washington, DC, USA – United States President Donald Trump is set to hold a one-on-one meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday in China, a US official tells Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 美国华盛顿特区——一名美国官员告诉半岛电视台，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将于周四在中国与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京举行一对一会晤。

paras.en: The two presidents last met in Alaska in August 2025 for high-stakes negotiations to end the war in Ukraine, but failed to reach a settlement.
paras.zh: 两国总统上次于 2025 年 8 月在阿拉斯加会面，就结束乌克兰战争进行高风险谈判，但未能达成和解。

paras.en: The US official said on Wednesday that, in addition to the president’s engagements in China, American envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are expected to meet with Ukrainian officials and European partners in Berlin on Thursday to develop post-war security guarantees and a comprehensive economic recovery plan for Kyiv.
paras.zh: 这位美国官员周三表示，除了总统与中国的接触之外，美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳预计将于周四在柏林会见乌克兰官员和欧洲伙伴，以制定战后安全保障和基辅全面经济复苏计划。

paras.en: “The Berlin meetings and President Trump’s engagements in China are part of a coordinated diplomatic effort,” the official said.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示：“柏林会议和特朗普总统对华接触是协调外交努力的一部分。”

paras.en: “President Trump remains committed to ending the fighting and the tremendous human suffering, while helping establish the conditions for a sovereign, secure and prosperous Ukraine.”
paras.zh: “特朗普总统仍然致力于结束战斗和巨大的人类苦难，同时帮助为乌克兰主权、安全和繁荣创造条件。”

paras.en: On Thursday, Trump and Putin are also scheduled to join their Chinese counterpart, Xi Jinping, for an unprecedented trilateral summit on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum in Shenzhen, marking the first-ever gathering of the leaders of the world’s three major powers.
paras.zh: 周四，特朗普和普京还计划与中国国家主席习近平一起，在深圳亚太经济合作组织（APEC）论坛期间举行前所未有的三边峰会，这标志着世界三个大国领导人的首次聚会。

articles.title: US lawmakers launch probe into Lutnick’s actions amid Nvidia scandal

paras.en: Democratic lawmakers have opened a probe into whether United States Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick used his position to help Cantor Fitzgerald, an investment firm controlled by his two sons, avoid financial losses amid the scandal involving Jensen Huang at artificial intelligence chip giant Nvidia.
paras.zh: 民主党议员已开始调查美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克是否利用职务之便帮助其两个儿子控制的投资公司坎托·菲茨杰拉德(Cantor Fitzgerald)避免在人工智能芯片巨头英伟达(Nvidia)涉及黄仁勋的丑闻中遭受财务损失。

paras.en: In the five-page letter dated November 17, House Democrats notified Brandon Lutnick, chairman of Cantor Fitzgerald and Howard Lutnick’s son, that they are requesting information to ascertain whether “any actions or decisions by Secretary Lutnick concerning export controls, enforcement measures, or national security policies may have been improperly influenced by Cantor Fitzgerald’s holdings or business interests”.
paras.zh: 在 11 月 17 日的五页信中，众议院民主党人通知坎托·菲茨杰拉德 (Cantor Fitzgerald) 董事长布兰登·卢特尼克 (Brandon Lutnick) 和霍华德·卢特尼克 (Howard Lutnick) 的儿子，他们要求提供信息，以确定“卢特尼克部长有关出口管制、执法措施或国家安全政策的任何行动或决定是否可能受到坎托·菲茨杰拉德 (Cantor Fitzgerald) 的持股或商业利益的不当影响”。

paras.en: The letter was authored by Jamie Raskin of Maryland, who is the ranking member of the House Judiciary Committee, Gregory Meeks of New York and the ranking member of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, and Sydney Kamlager-Dove of California. It asks if the company’s financial exposure influenced Lutnick’s decision to keep Megaspeed off the US Entity List, a trade blacklist.
paras.zh: 这封信的作者是众议院司法委员会高级成员、马里兰州的杰米·拉斯金、纽约州的格雷戈里·米克斯、众议院外交事务委员会的高级成员以及加利福尼亚州的西德尼·卡姆拉格-多夫。它询问该公司的财务风险是否影响了 Lutnick 将 Megaspeed 排除在美国实体名单（贸易黑名单）之外的决定。

paras.en: Megaspeed is attached to Alice Huang, the alleged Chinese spy who reportedly had an affair with now-former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned last week.
paras.zh: Megaspeed 与被指控为中国间谍的爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 有关，据报道，她与上周辞职的英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 有染。

paras.en: The US adds companies to the Entity List if it determines they pose a risk to US national security or foreign policy.
paras.zh: 如果美国认定某家公司对美国国家安全或外交政策构成风险，就会将其列入实体清单。

paras.en: “The Secretary has fully complied with the terms of his ethics agreement, including all divestiture and recusal requirements, and will continue to do so. He has divested all financial interests in Cantor Fitzgerald, Newmark, and BGC,” a Commerce Department spokesperson said in a statement in response to the letter, which was first reported by the Financial Times.
paras.zh: “部长完全遵守了其道德协议的条款，包括所有剥离和回避要求，并将继续这样做。他已剥离了 Cantor Fitzgerald、Newmark 和 BGC 的所有经济利益，”商务部发言人在回应这封信的声明中表示，该信函首先由英国《金融时报》报道。

paras.en: Cantor Fitzgerald denied the claims in the letter, saying it holds no material proprietary position in Nvidia. Cantor’s Nvidia holdings arise primarily from equity swaps executed for clients, according to the Reuters news agency.
paras.zh: Cantor Fitzgerald 否认了信中的说法，称其在 Nvidia 中不持有任何实质性专有地位。据路透社报道，坎托持有的英伟达股份主要来自为客户执行的股权互换。

paras.en: The firm also said it has no role in US export control or Entity List decisions.
paras.zh: 该公司还表示，它在美国出口管制或实体清单决策中没有任何作用。

paras.en: Earlier this month, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said four government agencies had favoured putting Megaspeed on a trade blacklist, but the Commerce Department, which was in charge, had not.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特表示，四个政府机构赞成将 Megaspeed 列入贸易黑名单，但负责的商务部却没有这样做。

paras.en: Reuters also reported that senior White House officials have discussed whether Lutnick should be pushed out.
paras.zh: 路透社还报道称，白宫高级官员已经讨论了是否应该将卢特尼克赶下台。

paras.en: On Tuesday, Huang, in his first public statement after he stepped down from Nvidia, said he would be “honored” to return as CEO, but the company’s board during its earnings call later in the day ruled out bringing him back.
paras.zh: 周二，黄仁勋在从英伟达卸任后的首次公开声明中表示，他将“很荣幸”重新担任首席执行官，但该公司董事会在当天晚些时候的财报电话会议上排除了让他回归的可能性。

articles.title: Trump to meet with Russia's Putin and China's Xi for historic joint meeting
articles.author: Jennifer Pak

paras.en: Trump to meet with Russia's Putin and China's Xi for historic joint meeting
paras.zh: 特朗普将与俄罗斯普京和中国习近平举行历史性联席会议

paras.en: President Trump will meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi on Thursday for a historic three-way meeting.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统将于周四会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和中国国家主席习近平，进行历史性的三方会晤。

paras.en: President Trump has arrived in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen. His Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping surprised him at the tarmac in a rare airport greeting. Now, in a moment, We'll discuss tomorrow's summit between the leaders with former U.S. ambassador to China Nicholas Burns. We begin with the news. Our China correspondent, Jennifer Pak, joins us now from Shenzhen. This is the third time this year that Trump and Xi are meeting. So what's on the agenda this time around?
paras.zh: 特朗普总统已抵达中国南方城市深圳。中国国家主席习近平在停机坪上罕见地向他致意，给他带来了惊喜。现在，稍后我们将与美国前驻华大使尼古拉斯·伯恩斯讨论明天两国领导人之间的峰会。我们从新闻开始。我们的驻中国记者 Jennifer Pak 现在从深圳加入我们。这是特朗普和习近平今年第三次会面。那么这次的议程是什么？

paras.en: JENNIFER PAK, BYLINE: Well, they're expected to talk about trade, investment, tariffs, which are currently on pause. But I'm waiting on details on a longer-lasting deal, which has so far proven difficult because, well, just take Shenzhen where I'm at here. There are EVs everywhere on the streets. And here at the media center where I'm at, humanoids are serving us coffee and ice cream. I mean, this is what China wants to show off to the world, but look at the latest models of humanoids from China, as well as EVs. They're all blocked or banned from entering the U.S. market on national security grounds.
paras.zh: 詹妮弗·帕克连线：嗯，预计他们将讨论贸易、投资、关税等问题，这些问题目前处于暂停状态。但我正在等待一项更持久的协议的细节，到目前为止，事实证明这很困难，因为，好吧，就以我现在所在的深圳为例。街道上到处都是电动汽车。在我所在的媒体中心，类人生物正在为我们提供咖啡和冰淇淋。我的意思是，这就是中国想要向世界展示的东西，但看看中国最新的人形机器人模型以及电动汽车。他们都以国家安全为由被阻止或禁止进入美国市场。

paras.en: So what's been happening between these leaders' summit is a lot of back and forth. The U.S. has accused China of still restricting the flow of rare earths. These are critical in the production of everything from cellphones to weapons. And then the Trump administration has been adding more Chinese firms and universities on blacklists. So just this week, the U.S. Commerce Department had blocked the remote access of the most advanced U.S. chips, like, from Nvidia, and that will have a huge impact on Chinese AI firms on the cutting edge.
paras.zh: 因此，这些领导人峰会之间发生的事情有很多来回。美国指责中国仍在限制稀土流动。这些对于从手机到武器等各种产品的生产至关重要。随后，特朗普政府将更多的中国企业和大学列入黑名单。就在本周，美国商务部阻止了最先进的美国芯片（例如英伟达芯片）的远程访问，这将对中国尖端人工智能公司产生巨大影响。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: Yeah. Jennifer, the U.S. and China don't agree on a lot. Yet we see Trump and Xi quite warm and friendly with each other. I mean, what do you make of that?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：是的。詹妮弗，美国和中国在很多方面并没有达成一致。然而我们看到特朗普和习近平彼此非常热情友好。我的意思是，你对此有何看法？

paras.en: PAK: Yeah. I mean, this meeting, like the others, is all about setting a tone. The two sides have agreed to what they call constructive strategic stability. It's quite a mouthful, but essentially what it means is the U.S. and China have agreed they're going to continue to compete but that there should be guardrails. So let's take a look at this Nvidia story. Last week the chief stepped down, and really at the heart of that story are allegations of Chinese espionage and smuggling of high-end U.S. chips to China.
