paras.en: The researchers suggest that the two mutational signatures are linked to a toxin called colibactin, which is produced by gut bacteria such as Escherichia coli that contain genes encoding polyketide synthase enzymes, called pks-positive bacteria. The toxin might damage DNA in healthy colon crypts—tubelike mucus glands that line the colon and rectum—potentially prompting tumor growth.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，这两种突变特征与一种名为大肠杆菌素的毒素有关，这种毒素是由大肠杆菌等肠道细菌产生的，这些细菌含有编码聚酮合酶的基因，称为 pks 阳性细菌。这种毒素可能会损害健康结肠隐窝（排列在结肠和直肠内的管状粘液腺）中的 DNA，从而可能促进肿瘤生长。

paras.en: “Modeling investigations seem to find that [pks-positive E. coli] colonize very, very young animals, probably in the first decade of life,” says Ng, who was not involved in the study. “One of the hypotheses is that perhaps [some] young children are colonized with pks-positive E. coli.” Past evidence has found high levels of pks-positive E. coli in infants without any associated negative health effects or higher risk of cancer. But Ng says further research studies are needed to determine the extent of pks-positive bacteria in children and the possible effects on health outcomes.
paras.zh: “模型研究似乎发现，[PKS 阳性大肠杆菌] 在非常非常年幼的动物中定植，可能是在生命的最初十年，”未参与这项研究的 Ng 说。 “其中一个假设是，也许[一些]幼儿体内感染了 pks 阳性大肠杆菌。”过去的证据发现婴儿体内的 pks 阳性大肠杆菌含量很高，但没有任何相关的负面健康影响或更高的癌症风险。但吴表示，还需要进一步研究来确定儿童中 pks 阳性细菌的程度以及对健康结果可能产生的影响。

paras.en: A group of researchers, including Ng’s team, plans to confirm these findings in a larger population in the U.S. and elsewhere. The scientists are also aiming to better understand the prevalence of pks-positive E. coli in children.
paras.zh: 包括吴恩达团队在内的一组研究人员计划在美国和其他地方的更多人群中证实这些发现。科学家们还希望更好地了解 pks 阳性大肠杆菌在儿童中的流行情况。

paras.en: When Ng looks through her microscope at young patients’ tissue samples, she tries to coax stories out of the tumors—little signs of their progression and characteristics. Are there certain molecular traits that make some tumors spread faster or more aggressively than others?
paras.zh: 当吴通过显微镜观察年轻患者的组织样本时，她试图从肿瘤中找出故事——肿瘤进展和特征的小迹象。是否存在某些分子特征使某些肿瘤比其他肿瘤扩散得更快或更剧烈？

paras.en: For instance, Ng’s and Cercek’s teams have independently found that people who are younger than age 35 when they’re diagnosed with colon cancer tend to die more quickly than any other age group. People in their 20s and 30s, groups where the rates are rising most steeply, have the worst survival outcomes—even compared with patients in their 60s, Ng says.
paras.zh: 例如，Ng 和 Cercek 的团队独立发现，在 35 岁以下被诊断患有结肠癌的人往往比任何其他年龄组的人死亡得更快。 Ng 说，20 多岁和 30 多岁的人是发病率上升最快的群体，他们的生存结果最差——即使与 60 多岁的患者相比也是如此。

paras.en: Under the microscope, younger individuals’ tumor cells can appear more disorganized and abnormal compared with healthy tissue, Ng explains. Past research has shown that early-onset colorectal cancers in patients under age 40 also have higher rates of signet ring cell carcinoma—a type of cancer that is highly aggressive.
paras.zh: 吴解释说，在显微镜下，与健康组织相比，年轻人的肿瘤细胞可能显得更加混乱和异常。过去的研究表明，40 岁以下的早发性结直肠癌患者患印戒细胞癌（一种高度侵袭性的癌症）的几率也较高。

paras.en: “It’s a specific pathology feature that tends to indicate more aggressive behavior and that tends to be more common in younger patients,” Ng says. “Younger patients also have tumors more commonly in the left side of the colon and the rectum compared with older patients, and we don’t really understand why that is.”
paras.zh: “这是一种特定的病理学特征，往往表明更具攻击性的行为，并且在年轻患者中更常见，”吴说。 “与老年患者相比，年轻患者的左侧结肠和直肠也更常见肿瘤，但我们并不真正明白其中的原因。”

paras.en: Ng has mapped out every single cell in early-onset colorectal tumors so she can compare them with later-onset tumors to get more granular detail. The study was recently accepted for publication in Nature Medicine.
paras.zh: 吴已经绘制出了早发性结直肠肿瘤中的每一个细胞，这样她就可以将它们与晚发性肿瘤进行比较，以获得更细致的细节。该研究最近被《自然医学》杂志接受发表。

paras.en: More research is needed to better clarify the molecular structure of these tumors before scientists can draw conclusions or shape treatments around them, says Cercek, who is continuing to chip away at these theories. “Maybe I’ll be able to tell you in a couple of years,” she adds.
paras.zh: 切尔塞克表示，在科学家得出结论或制定针对这些肿瘤的治疗方法之前，需要进行更多的研究来更好地阐明这些肿瘤的分子结构，他正在继续完善这些理论。 “也许几年后我就能告诉你，”她补充道。

paras.en: Meanwhile researchers are pursuing a parallel line of inquiry: whether subtle, chronic changes in healthy colon tissue may set the stage for cancer to develop.
paras.zh: 与此同时，研究人员正在进行平行的探究：健康结肠组织的微妙、慢性变化是否可能为癌症的发展奠定基础。

paras.en: One day, while performing surgery on a young patient with colorectal cancer, Emina Huang noticed something strange about the colon tissue: it was firmer than typical healthy tissue.
paras.zh: 有一天，在为一位患有结直肠癌的年轻患者进行手术时，Emina Huang 注意到结肠组织的一些奇怪之处：它比典型的健康组织更坚固。

paras.en: “When I was in the operating room, I just wondered: Was I really feeling that the young people’s colons were stiffer? Was it my imagination?” recalls Huang, a surgical scientist who has been studying the genesis of colorectal cancer at the University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center.
paras.zh: “当我在手术室的时候，我就想：我真的感觉年轻人的结肠更僵硬吗？是我的想象吗？”黄回忆道，他是一位在德克萨斯大学西南医学中心研究结直肠癌起源的外科科学家。

paras.en: Huang’s lab has been investigating the role of chronic gut inflammation in abnormal cell growth for more than two decades. Inflammation that goes unchecked by the immune system’s typical control measures has been strongly connected to various types of cancers; people with inflammatory bowel disease, for instance, appear to have an increased risk of developing colorectal cancer, for reasons that aren’t entirely clear, Huang says.
paras.zh: 二十多年来，黄的实验室一直在研究慢性肠道炎症在异常细胞生长中的作用。不受免疫系统典型控制措施控制的炎症与各种类型的癌症密切相关。黄说，例如，患有炎症性肠病的人患结直肠癌的风险似乎更高，其原因尚不完全清楚。

paras.en: To validate what Huang noticed in the operating room, she and her team conducted a biomechanical study of colon tissue collected from 19 people aged 57 to 70 and 14 people aged 42 to 46 with stage II or III tumors. Describing the results in a recent paper in Advanced Science, the researchers said young people with colorectal cancer had stiffer tumors than older individuals. Even more striking, their normal, noncancerous tissues were also firmer than those of older patients with colorectal cancer.
paras.zh: 为了验证黄在手术室中注意到的情况，她和她的团队对从 19 名 57 至 70 岁的人和 14 名 42 至 46 岁的 II 期或 III 期肿瘤患者身上采集的结肠组织进行了生物力学研究。研究人员在《先进科学》最近发表的一篇论文中描述了这一结果，称患有结直肠癌的年轻人比老年人的肿瘤更坚硬。更引人注目的是，他们的正常非癌组织也比老年结直肠癌患者的组织更坚固。

paras.en: Huang suggests the rigid tissue may arise from chronic inflammation that leads to fibrosis, or tissue scarring. This scarring “is the root of many types of evil, from high blood pressure to cardiac disease to kidney failure to liver failure,” she says. Instead of focusing on the immune cells needed to fight harmful pathogens that are typically involved in temporary inflammation, her team focused on fibroblasts—cells that make strands of collagen, a protein that supports tissue structure. Under scarring conditions, collagen is more abundant and has a different arrangement.
paras.zh: 黄认为僵硬的组织可能是由导致纤维化或组织疤痕的慢性炎症引起的。她说，这种疤痕“是多种邪恶的根源，从高血压到心脏病，从肾衰竭到肝衰竭”。她的团队没有关注对抗通常与暂时性炎症有关的有害病原体所需的免疫细胞，而是关注成纤维细胞——产生胶原链的细胞，胶原蛋白是一种支持组织结构的蛋白质。在疤痕条件下，胶原蛋白更加丰富并且具有不同的排列。

paras.en: “What we found is that the collagen in these [younger] patients is thicker, and it’s more aligned, instead of being like a crisscross network,” Huang says. Similar to strands of dried spaghetti, the collagen is more linear, she says, which makes it “easier for the cancer cells to crawl and move.”
paras.zh: “我们发现，这些[年轻]患者的胶原蛋白更厚，而且排列更整齐，而不是像纵横交错的网络，”黄说。她说，与干意大利面类似，胶原蛋白更加线性，这使得“癌细胞更容易爬行和移动”。

paras.en: Activation of specific collagen-producing fibroblasts could prime tissues to become ideal environments for cancerous spread, the findings suggest. Additional genetic analysis of the samples revealed higher expression of genes linked to collagen metabolism, blood vessel formation and inflammation in cancer tissues from young individuals compared with those of older patients.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，特定的产生胶原蛋白的成纤维细胞的激活可以使组织成为癌症扩散的理想环境。对样本的额外基因分析显示，与老年患者相比，年轻患者的癌症组织中与胶原代谢、血管形成和炎症相关的基因表达更高。

paras.en: These kinds of data could lead to new treatments, such as therapies to tamp down colorectal cancer–related inflammation or stop fibrosis, Huang says. They also could open up possibilities for preventive screening tests that are less invasive than the current most common approach, colonoscopy. Huang has concepts in mind for a noninvasive tissue stiffness test but says the work is still in very early stages.
paras.zh: 黄说，此类数据可能会带来新的治疗方法，例如抑制结直肠癌相关炎症或阻止纤维化的疗法。它们还可以为预防性筛查测试开辟可能性，这些测试比目前最常见的方法结肠镜检查侵入性更小。黄已经想到了无创组织硬度测试的概念，但表示这项工作仍处于非常早期的阶段。

paras.en: When Cheatem received his diagnosis, he was 42—three years younger than the age at which people in the U.S. without a family history of colorectal cancer are advised to start screening for the illness. His tumor was right on the border between stages II and III. If clinicians had caught it at stage II, he wouldn’t have needed chemotherapy, which came with a host of side effects that interfered with his life and work.
paras.zh: 当 Cheatem 收到诊断结果时，他 42 岁，比美国无结直肠癌家族史的人建议开始筛查该疾病的年龄小三岁。他的肿瘤正好处于 II 期和 III 期的边界。如果临床医生在第二阶段发现它，他就不需要化疗，化疗会带来许多副作用，干扰他的生活和工作。

paras.en: On his “off” weeks, when Cheatem wasn’t getting an infusion of chemo, he could work, eat and exercise more normally. But as treatment progressed, his “off” weeks started to resemble his “on” weeks: he’d be overcome with nausea, exhaustion and persistent sensitivity to cold. “Because my chemotherapy was in the winter, I had gloves on, like, pretty much all hours of the day because of the pain attributed to the cold sensitivity,” he says. “Touching something cold was more like sticking your finger in a socket.”
paras.zh: 在他的“休息”周，当奇特姆没有接受化疗时，他可以更正常地工作、饮食和锻炼。但随着治疗的进展，他的“休息”周开始与“开启”周相似：他会被恶心、疲惫和持续对寒冷的敏感性所困扰。 “因为我的化疗是在冬天进行的，所以我几乎全天都戴着手套，因为寒冷敏感会带来疼痛，”他说。 “触摸冰冷的东西更像是把手指伸进插座里。”

paras.en: Colorectal cancer and its treatments can be incredibly demanding regardless of a person’s age, but younger individuals can experience additional burdens. “They’re in the midst of their careers. Some of the very youngest ones are still in the midst of their education,” Ng says. Many people need to work to stay on health insurance, and many are caregivers themselves—80 percent of people with early-onset colorectal cancer have children under the age of 18 when diagnosed. For those who plan to have more children, treatments can negatively affect fertility, Ng adds.
paras.zh: 无论一个人的年龄如何，结直肠癌及其治疗都可能非常困难，但年轻人可能会承受额外的负担。 “他们正处于职业生涯中。一些最年轻的人仍在接受教育，”吴说。许多人需要工作才能维持健康保险，而且许多人本身就是看护者——80% 的早发性结直肠癌患者在诊断时有 18 岁以下的孩子。 Ng 补充道，对于那些计划生育更多孩子的人来说，治疗可能会对生育能力产生负面影响。

paras.en: Both her center and Cercek’s clinic for young-onset colorectal cancer offer psychological and social support to improve the quality of life of people who are recovering from the disease. Their teams are also testing therapies that minimize toxicity from treatment—but finding colorectal cancer early has always been directly tied to better health outcomes.
paras.zh: 她的中心和切尔塞克的年轻发病结直肠癌诊所都提供心理和社会支持，以改善疾病康复者的生活质量。他们的团队还在测试可最大限度减少治疗毒性的疗法，但及早发现结直肠癌始终与更好的健康结果直接相关。

paras.en: Experts attribute the decline in mortality from the disease among older adults to screening and early detection. The younger age groups experiencing the sharpest rise in rates aren’t included in the current screening recommendations.
paras.zh: 专家将老年人疾病死亡率的下降归因于筛查和早期发现。目前的筛查建议不包括发病率上升最快的年轻年龄组。

paras.en: Earlier screening could help untangle some of these questions. But it’s difficult, with the current evidence, to argue for screening people at younger and younger ages—particularly if the growth of colorectal cancer potentially starts in childhood or adolescence.
paras.zh: 早期筛查可能有助于解决其中一些问题。但根据目前的证据，很难主张对越来越年轻的人进行筛查，特别是如果结直肠癌的生长可能从儿童期或青春期开始的话。

paras.en: “We have to prove that there really is enough reason to make that recommendation to a 15-year-old or a 20-year-old,” Jaffee says. She adds that health disparities already prevent many people who are eligible from getting screened, and insurance doesn’t always cover screening.
paras.zh: “我们必须证明确实有足够的理由向 15 岁或 20 岁的人提出这一建议，”贾菲说。她补充说，健康差异已经阻止了许多有资格接受筛查的人，而且保险并不总是涵盖筛查。

paras.en: Colonoscopy is considered the most accurate available screening option—and clinicians can remove precancerous polyps while doing the exam—but the procedure is invasive and almost always requires sedation and intensive bowel prep. More accessible tests could make it easier to screen people earlier. At-home stool tests—such as Cologuard and others that detect cancer-linked DNA markers or blood in stool—can help provide initial assessments to determine whether someone should get further follow-up diagnostic procedures, Jaffee says. A blood test for colon cancer has been approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration and was recently recommended by the American Cancer Society, although the USPSTF has not endorsed it because it’s shown to be less effective at catching very early-stage cancers. Jaffee says more advanced, accurate blood tests could be a cheaper first-step screening option for young individuals without known risk factors. Such tests might have caught Cheatem’s cancer at an earlier stage.
paras.zh: 结肠镜检查被认为是最准确的筛查选择，临床医生可以在检查时切除癌前息肉，但该过程是侵入性的，几乎总是需要镇静剂和强化肠道准备。更方便的测试可以让人们更容易更早地进行筛查。 Jaffee 说，家庭粪便测试（例如 Cologuard 和其他检测与癌症相关的 DNA 标记物或粪便中的血液）可以帮助提供初步评估，以确定某人是否应该接受进一步的后续诊断程序。结肠癌的血液检测已获得美国食品和药物管理局的批准，并且最近得到了美国癌症协会的推荐，尽管 USPSTF 尚未认可它，因为它被证明在发现非常早期的癌症方面效果较差。贾菲表示，对于没有已知风险因素的年轻人来说，更先进、更准确的血液检测可能是一种更便宜的第一步筛查选择。此类测试可能会在早期发现 Cheatem 的癌症。

paras.en: Painting has helped Cheatem manage the physical and emotional toll of cancer during and even after his treatment, he says. After he entered remission, he was inspired to create an art exhibition of self-portraits and important objects that reflected his experience. One piece from the series stands out to him now: a photorealistic painting of sliced and squeezed limes paired with a bunch of green grapes.
paras.zh: 他说，绘画帮助奇特姆在治疗期间甚至治疗后控制了癌症对身体和情感的伤害。病情缓解后，他受到启发，创作了一场自画像和反映他经历的重要物品的艺术展。现在，该系列中的一件作品对他来说很突出：一幅逼真的画作，由切片和挤压的酸橙与一串绿葡萄搭配而成。

paras.en: During chemotherapy, when Cheatem’s nausea would wreak havoc, he could stomach only green grapes and warm water with a squeeze of lime juice. Those fruits, he says, remain symbols of relief—a reminder of the “magic combination” that kept him going.
paras.zh: 在化疗期间，当奇特姆感到恶心时，他只能吃青葡萄和挤了酸橙汁的温水。他说，这些水果仍然是一种解脱的象征，提醒着他坚持下去的“神奇组合”。

articles.title: This magic mushroom can kill
articles.author: Tina Hesman Saey

paras.en: People who eat this tiny magic mushroom may hit a lethal low instead of getting high.
paras.zh: 吃了这种微小的神奇蘑菇的人可能会陷入致命的低谷，而不是变得兴奋。

paras.en: The fungus makes hallucinogenic psilocybin and deadly amatoxin, researchers report November 11 in Current Biology. Dubbed “dark magic mushrooms,” it is the first species of fungus discovered to make both types of compounds.
paras.zh: 研究人员 11 月 11 日在《当代生物学》杂志上报道称，这种真菌会产生致幻性裸盖菇素和致命的鹅膏毒素。它被称为“黑魔法蘑菇”，是第一种被发现能产生这两种化合物的真菌。

paras.en: Chemist and fungal biologist Andrew Kunik found the dark magic mushroom in 2025 growing on a decaying moss-covered palm trunk in a central Florida wetland. Kunik, who was then doing post-baccalaureate research in the lab of fungal biologist Matthew Smith at the University of Florida in Gainesville, identified the mini mushroom as Galerina indica.
paras.zh: 化学家兼真菌生物学家安德鲁·库尼克 (Andrew Kunik) 于 2025 年在佛罗里达州中部湿地的一棵腐烂的长满青苔的棕榈树干上发现了这种黑魔法蘑菇。库尼克当时正在盖恩斯维尔佛罗里达大学真菌生物学家马修·史密斯的实验室进行学士学位后研究，他将这种迷你蘑菇鉴定为 Galerina indica。

paras.en: That species had not been reported in Florida before, Kunik says. “It’s quite rare and unusual.” He also found two other new related species, tagged with the placeholder names Galerina species 1 and Galerina species 2.
paras.zh: 库尼克说，佛罗里达州以前从未报道过该物种。 “这是非常罕见和不寻常的。”他还发现了另外两个新的相关物种，并用占位符名称 Galerina 物种 1 和 Galerina 物种 2 进行了标记。

paras.en: Other researchers had previously described G. indica’s appearance and found DNA signatures that distinguish the fungus from related species. But no one had cataloged the mushroom’s complete chemical or genetic makeup.
paras.zh: 其他研究人员此前曾描述过 G. indica 的外观，并发现了将这种真菌与相关物种区分开来的 DNA 特征。但没有人对这种蘑菇的完整化学或基因组成进行分类。

paras.en: Related Galerina species make amatoxins, deadly chemicals that can kill in even tiny amounts and are found in death cap mushrooms and other species. Kunik and colleagues looked for those toxins in G. indica and the two other new Galerina species. G. indica makes a previously undiscovered form of amatoxin the team is calling alpha-proamanitin, the chemical analysis revealed.
paras.zh: 相关的 Galerina 物种会产生鹅膏毒素，这是一种致命的化学物质，即使微量也能致人死亡，死帽蘑菇和其他物种中也存在这种毒素。 Kunik 和同事在 G. indica 和另外两个新的 Galerina 物种中寻找这些毒素。化学分析显示，G. indica 会产生一种以前未被发现的鹅膏毒素，该团队将其称为 α-鹅膏毒原。

paras.en: The small mushroom also had blue bruises, a clue that it might make psilocybin, a psychedelic chemical being tested as a treatment for mental health disorders. Fungi usually make either amatoxin or psilocybin. Not both. Galerina species 1 also makes psilocybin but doesn’t make amatoxin, and species 2 makes neither.
paras.zh: 这种小蘑菇也有蓝色的瘀伤，这表明它可能会产生裸盖菇素，一种迷幻化学物质，正在测试用于治疗精神健康障碍。真菌通常产生鹅膏毒素或裸盖菇素。两者都不是。 Galerina 物种 1 也产生裸盖菇素，但不产生鹅膏毒素，而物种 2 则两者都不产生。

paras.en: “This finding shows that there’s a lot more diversity in [fungal] chemistry and the ways that they’re combined than we had really thought about,” says Anne Pringle, a mycologist at the University of Wisconsin–Madison who was not involved in the work.
paras.zh: “这一发现表明，[真菌]化学及其组合方式的多样性比我们真正想象的要多得多，”威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的真菌学家安妮·普林格尔（Anne Pringle）说，她没有参与这项工作。

paras.en: Discovering these dual compounds in one mushroom was both exciting and required further analysis to confirm, Kunik says. “Surprising discoveries require great depth of evidence,” he says.
paras.zh: 库尼克说，在一种蘑菇中发现这些双重化合物既令人兴奋，又需要进一步分析来证实。 “令人惊讶的发现需要大量深入的证据，”他说。

paras.en: A complete workup of the mushroom’s DNA revealed genes for producing both types of chemicals. Ancestors of these dark magic mushrooms probably picked up those genes by swapping DNA with other species. Such DNA swapping, called horizontal gene transfer, is one way that organisms can quickly evolve new traits, like when bacteria exchange antibiotic resistance genes with unrelated species.
paras.zh: 对蘑菇 DNA 的完整分析揭示了产生这两种化学物质的基因。这些黑魔法蘑菇的祖先可能通过与其他物种交换 DNA 获得了这些基因。这种 DNA 交换被称为水平基因转移，是生物体快速进化出新性状的一种方式，就像细菌与不相关物种交换抗生素抗性基因一样。

paras.en: Ancestors of G. indica and its relatives probably acquired amatoxin genes early on. Those toxins are made by many of G. indica’s cousins, which indicates that amatoxins are probably heirlooms passed down from common ancestors. Ancestors of species 1 and species 2 seem to have dropped the amatoxin genes at some point since they no longer make the compounds.
paras.zh: G. indica 及其近亲的祖先很可能很早就获得了鹅膏毒素基因。这些毒素是由许多 G. indica 的表亲产生的，这表明鹅膏毒素可能是从共同祖先遗传下来的传家宝。物种 1 和物种 2 的祖先似乎在某个时候已经放弃了鹅膏毒素基因，因为它们不再制造这些化合物。

paras.en: The two psilocybin-producing species may have independently obtained the psychedelic genes in separate DNA swap meets, or a common ancestor may have picked up the genes and then passed them down to G. indica and species 1. There’s not enough known about the fungi’s family tree to sort out which scenario is correct.
paras.zh: 这两个产生裸盖菇素的物种可能在不同的 DNA 交换中独立获得了致幻基因，或者共同的祖先可能获得了这些基因，然后将它们传递给 G. indica 和物种 1。对真菌的家谱还没有足够的了解，无法确定哪种情况是正确的。

paras.en: And there’s another unsolved evolutionary mystery, Pringle says. “We still don’t know why mushrooms are poisonous.” Many scientists think it is for defending against predators, but hard evidence is lacking, she says.
paras.zh: 普林格尔说，还有另一个未解的进化之谜。 “我们仍然不知道为什么蘑菇有毒。”她说，许多科学家认为这是为了防御掠食者，但缺乏确凿的证据。

paras.en: “Can I eat it?” is often the first question people ask when finding a new mushroom, Pringle says. “I’m always so uncomfortable with that question and that conversation. And this paper confirms that, in fact, you should be uncomfortable.” After all, eating these dark magic mushrooms could send people tripping into the grave.
paras.zh: “我可以吃吗？”普林格尔说，这通常是人们在寻找新蘑菇时提出的第一个问题。 “我总是对这个问题和谈话感到不舒服。这篇论文证实，事实上，你应该感到不舒服。”毕竟，吃了这些黑魔法蘑菇可能会让人绊倒进坟墓。

articles.title: Stone Age children left fingerprints on ancient art projects
articles.author: Freda Kreier

paras.en: Children have been making art with help from grown-ups for millennia.
paras.zh: 几千年来，孩子们一直在成年人的帮助下进行艺术创作。

paras.en: Fragmented clay figurines dating as far back as 15,000 years ago, discovered in what is now Israel, preserve the fingerprints of both adults and young children. The finding suggests the grown-ups taught the kids how to shape and decorate clay, researchers report November 11 in PLOS One.
paras.zh: 在现在的以色列发现的泥人碎片可以追溯到 15,000 年前，保留了成人和幼儿的指纹。研究人员 11 月 11 日在 PLOS One 上报道称，这一发现表明大人教孩子们如何塑造和装饰粘土。

paras.en: Children’s contributions to prehistoric art and culture aren’t well understood. Concrete evidence of their involvement has been hard to find, says archaeologist Laurent Davin of the Hebrew University of Jerusalem.
paras.zh: 儿童对史前艺术和文化的贡献尚不清楚。耶路撒冷希伯来大学的考古学家劳伦特·达文说，很难找到他们参与其中的具体证据。

paras.en: In recent decades, researchers have found a handful of objects made by children — including 200,000-year-old rock art bearing child-sized handprints in Tibet and 30,000-year-old clay sculptures pockmarked with child-sized fingerprints in Czech Republic.
paras.zh: 近几十年来，研究人员发现了一些由儿童制作的物品，其中包括西藏有 20 万年历史、带有儿童大小手印的岩画，以及捷克共和国有 3 万年历史、有儿童大小手印的泥塑。

paras.en: Davin and colleagues hadn’t set out to find Stone Age children’s artwork. They were investigating whether the Natufian culture — a group of hunter-gatherers who formed some of the first permanent settlements in the Levant about 14,000 years ago — made clay art before the advent of agriculture in the region.
paras.zh: 达文和同事并没有打算寻找石器时代儿童的艺术品。他们正在调查纳图夫文化（大约 14,000 年前，一群狩猎采集者在黎凡特形成了第一个永久定居点）是否在该地区出现农业之前就制作了粘土艺术。

paras.en: The archaeologists came across the first set of fingerprints while sorting through 40 kilograms of clay collected at three Natufian sites, which range in age from 15,000 to 11,600 years old. Among tens of thousands of clay lumps, the team found some 150 fragments of sculptures, including 15 recognizable bird, gazelle and human figures. Around 60 of these pieces preserved fingerprints from where people had pinched or prodded the clay.
paras.zh: 考古学家在对三个纳图夫遗址收集的 40 公斤粘土进行分类时发现了第一组指纹，这些粘土的年龄从 15,000 岁到 11,600 岁不等。在数万块粘土块中，研究小组发现了约 150 件雕塑碎片，其中包括 15 件可辨认的鸟类、瞪羚和人物雕像。其中大约 60 件作品保存了人们捏或戳粘土时留下的指纹。

paras.en: The distances between the fingerprints’ ridges, which are influenced by age and sex, suggest that most of the figurines were made by women and children — some younger than 10. Only a few sets of fingerprints belonged to men. And the torso of one tiny human statue had both adult and child fingerprints, hinting that an elder and child had passed it back and forth. Davin suspects that the adult actively taught a child how to work the clay.
paras.zh: 指纹脊线之间的距离受年龄和性别的影响，表明大多数雕像是由妇女和儿童制作的——有些还不到 10 岁。只有几组指纹属于男性。一座小型人体雕像的躯干上同时有成人和儿童的指纹，这表明有一位老人和一个孩子来回走过它。达文怀疑成年人主动教孩子如何制作粘土。

paras.en: This evidence of intergenerational learning so far back in time is fascinating, says archaeologist Steven Dorland of Grand Valley State University in Allendale, Mich. It demonstrates how much researchers can learn from broadening their focus beyond adult males, he says. Dorland has used pottery to understand social learning in Indigenous societies of the Great Lakes region. He has even studied children’s fingerprints on some of those artifacts.
paras.zh: 密歇根州艾伦代尔市大谷州立大学的考古学家史蒂文·多兰说，这种迄今为止代际学习的证据令人着迷。他说，这表明研究人员可以通过将关注点扩大到成年男性之外来学到很多东西。多兰利用陶器来了解五大湖地区土著社会的社会学习。他甚至研究了其中一些文物上的儿童指纹。

paras.en: The purpose of the Natufian figurines is unclear. Most of the statues are less than 2 centimeters long and don’t display signs of intense use, the team found, suggesting they weren’t treated as precious heirlooms.
paras.zh: 纳图夫人雕像的用途尚不清楚。研究小组发现，大多数雕像长度不到 2 厘米，并且没有显示出频繁使用的迹象，这表明它们没有被视为珍贵的传家宝。

paras.en: Davin suspects the figurines may have represented stories, like how kids draw Disney characters today, he says. “Maybe the idea is that the role of children here is not necessarily to learn to make figurines, but more to learn the story behind them.”
paras.zh: 达文怀疑这些雕像可能代表了故事，就像今天孩子们如何画迪士尼人物一样，他说。 “也许这个想法是，孩子们在这里的角色不一定是学习制作雕像，更多的是了解它们背​​后的故事。”

articles.title: The ‘hell chicken’ dinosaur was a real terror — to fruit
articles.author: Jake Buehler

paras.en: More than 65 million years ago, a small, beaked dinosaur dubbed the “hell chicken” was a real terror – to fruit. Reconstruction of its beak and jaw suggest it mashed up fruit much like modern parrots.
paras.zh: 超过 6500 万年前，一种被称为“地狱鸡”的小型喙恐龙确实令人恐惧。它的喙和下巴的重建表明它可以像现代鹦鹉一样捣碎水果。

paras.en: It’s the first evidence of non-avian dinosaurs evolving specialized adaptations for eating fruit, and comes at a time when flowering plants were coming into their own, researchers report October 10 in Nature Communications.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 10 月 10 日在《自然通讯》杂志上报道，这是非鸟类恐龙进化出专门适应吃水果的第一个证据，并且出现在开花植物成熟的时期。

paras.en: In 2011, a fossil collector found much of the fossilized skeleton of an odd theropod dinosaur in eastern Montana and brought to the attention of David Evans, a paleontologist at the Royal Ontario Museum in Canada. Over the next several years, fossil collectors and paleontologists working in Montana and North and South Dakota unearthed four more partial skeletons.
paras.zh: 2011年，一位化石收藏家在蒙大拿州东部发现了一种奇怪的兽脚类恐龙的大部分化石骨架，并引起了加拿大皇家安大略博物馆古生物学家戴维·埃文斯的注意。在接下来的几年里，在蒙大拿州、北达科他州和南达科他州工作的化石收藏家和古生物学家又出土了四具部分骨骼。

paras.en: The dinosaur belonged to a particularly birdlike subgroup of beaked theropods called oviraptorosaurs that lived during the Cretaceous Period. This species probably weighed around 12 kilograms — about the size of a turkey.
paras.zh: 这种恐龙属于一种特别像鸟类的喙兽脚亚目亚群，称为偷蛋龙，生活在白垩纪时期。该物种的重量可能约为 12 公斤，相当于火鸡的大小。

paras.en: Evans and Greg Funston — a paleontologist at Stony Brook University in New York — and their colleagues named it Infernogallus jamesi, or ‘hell chicken,’ after its discovery in the Hell Creek geological formation and its overall poultrylike appearance.
paras.zh: 埃文斯和纽约石溪大学的古生物学家格雷格·芬斯顿以及他们的同事将其命名为 Infernogallus jamesi，即“地狱鸡”，因为它是在地狱溪地质构造中发现的，而且其整体外观像家禽。

paras.en: When the researchers studied Infernogallus’s skull and reconstructed the musculature, they discovered that it was no ordinary theropod. The construction of its jaw joints, muscles and palate suggest that it moved its jaw forward and back when eating rather than up and down like its chomping relatives.
paras.zh: 当研究人员研究火鸡的头骨并重建肌肉组织时，他们发现它不是普通的兽脚亚目恐龙。它的下颌关节、肌肉和上颚的结构表明，它在进食时前后移动下巴，而不是像它咀嚼的近亲那样上下移动。

paras.en: This chewing style is unique among non-avian dinosaurs but is strikingly similar to that of fruit-eating parrots. Funston and his colleagues think Infernogallus had adapted to a fruit-rich diet, deftly stripping the flesh from large seeds using its tongue and sliding jaw motions.
paras.zh: 这种咀嚼方式在非鸟类恐龙中是独一无二的，但与食果鹦鹉的咀嚼方式惊人相似。芬斯顿和他的同事认为火鸡已经适应了富含水果的饮食，能够利用舌头和滑动下巴的动作巧妙地从大种子上剥离果肉。

paras.en: These fruit-munching adaptations were surprising, Funston says. “But the more we delved into it, the more sense it made,” he says. “All the different lines of evidence seemed to converge on this one answer.”
paras.zh: 芬斯顿说，这些咀嚼水果的适应令人惊讶。 “但我们越深入研究它，它就越有意义，”他说。 “所有不同的证据似乎都集中在这个答案上。”

paras.en: Angiosperms — plants that produce flowers and fruits — were rapidly diversifying throughout the Cretaceous. Mounting evidence suggests that angiosperms were coevolving with Cretaceous animals, and that dinosaurs may have been eating their fruits. Infernogallus adds to that emerging picture. It’s possible that other ‘hell chicken’ relatives or other dinosaur groups were habitual fruit eaters too, Funston says.
paras.zh: 被子植物——产生花朵和果实的植物——在整个白垩纪迅速多样化。越来越多的证据表明，被子植物与白垩纪动物共同进化，恐龙可能一直在吃它们的果实​​。 Infernogallus 进一步丰富了这一新景象。芬斯顿说，其他“地狱鸡”亲戚或其他恐龙群体也可能习惯吃水果。

paras.en: “[The discovery] suggests that our picture of dinosaur ecology right before the Cretaceous extinction has been missing major puzzle pieces, and that dinosaurs were more diverse than we thought.”
paras.zh: “[这一发现]表明，我们对白垩纪灭绝之前的恐龙生态的了解一直缺少主要的拼图，而且恐龙比我们想象的更加多样化。”

articles.title: Something in The Sky Is Affecting How Much Energy Wind Farms Can Harvest
articles.author: Jess Cockerill

paras.en: The world is increasingly reliant on energy from offshore wind farms, but there's a lot we're still learning about how they work out in the wild.
paras.zh: 世界越来越依赖海上风电场的能源，但我们仍在了解它们在野外的运作方式。

paras.en: Most wind energy studies and models assume the skies are clear and dry. But in the real world, more often than not, our skies are cloudy – especially over the ocean.
paras.zh: 大多数风能研究和模型都假设天空晴朗干燥。但在现实世界中，我们的天空常常是多云的——尤其是在海洋上空。

paras.en: A new study published in the Journal of Renewable and Sustainable Energy reveals how clouds can affect the way wind turbines generate power, and how wind turbines affect the clouds.
paras.zh: 《可再生和可持续能源杂志》上发表的一项新研究揭示了云如何影响风力涡轮机发电的方式，以及风力涡轮机如何影响云。

paras.en: Scientists estimate that clouds typically cover about 67 percent of Earth's surface, based on satellite data. Above Earth's oceans, that coverage is even more extensive: research suggests less than 10 percent of the maritime sky is cloud-free at any given moment.
paras.zh: 根据卫星数据，科学家估计云通常覆盖地球表面的 67% 左右。在地球海洋之上，覆盖范围更加广泛：研究表明，在任何特定时刻，只有不到 10% 的海洋天空是无云的。

paras.en: As more countries invest in offshore wind farms to transition away from reliance on fossil fuels for energy, the influence of clouds is something we really need to know more about.
paras.zh: 随着越来越多的国家投资海上风电场以摆脱对化石燃料能源的依赖，我们确实需要更多地了解云的影响。

paras.en: "Accurately modeling wind farm-atmosphere interactions is essential for predicting power output and informing wind-farm design," writes a team led by physicist Davide Selvatici of the University of Twente in the Netherlands.
paras.zh: 荷兰特文特大学物理学家 Davide Selvatici 领导的团队写道：“准确模拟风电场与大气的相互作用对于预测功率输出和为风电场设计提供信息至关重要。”

paras.en: "The role of clouds in these interactions, however, remains poorly understood."
paras.zh: “然而，人们对云在这些相互作用中的作用仍然知之甚少。”

paras.en: Clouds are surprisingly complex things, made of water droplets or ice.
paras.zh: 云是一种极其复杂的东西，由水滴或冰组成。

paras.en: They are usually suspended between two key boundaries in the atmosphere.
paras.zh: 它们通常悬浮在大气中的两个关键边界之间。

paras.en: At the lower end, there's the atmospheric boundary layer (the air directly above the ground, which is influenced by friction from ground features like trees, hills, houses, and even the ocean's surface). At the top, there's the tropopause (the point where air stops getting cooler as altitude increases).
paras.zh: 在下端，有大气边界层（直接位于地面上方的空气，受到树木、山丘、房屋甚至海洋表面等地面特征的摩擦力的影响）。顶部是对流层顶（随着海拔的增加，空气不再变冷的点）。

paras.en: The atmospheric boundary layer rises and falls for many reasons, but the height of a wind turbine does not.
paras.zh: 大气边界层的上升和下降有多种原因，但风力涡轮机的高度却不会。

paras.en: Yet, it's the atmospheric boundary layer that wind energy is harvested from.
paras.zh: 然而，风能却是从大气边界层中获取的。

paras.en: This study focused exclusively on the influence of stratocumulus clouds, which sit low in the sky, often in a large, near-continuous bank, right at the top of the atmospheric boundary layer.
paras.zh: 这项研究专门关注层积云的影响，层积云位于天空较低的位置，通常位于大气边界层顶部的一个大的、近乎连续的云层中。

paras.en: Selvatici and team simulated wind farms blanketed by stratocumulus clouds under different conditions.
paras.zh: Selvatici 和团队模拟了不同条件下被层积云覆盖的风电场。

paras.en: They found that wind farms were able to harvest more wind energy when stratocumulus clouds were sitting under a layer of drier air.
paras.zh: 他们发现，当层积云位于较干燥的空气层下时，风电场能够收获更多的风能。

paras.en: That layer of dry air crowning the stratocumulus clouds has a cooling effect on the cloud itself, since dry air sends less heat back down to the cloud than moist air does.
paras.zh: 层积云顶部的那层干燥空气对云本身有冷却作用，因为干燥空气比潮湿空气返回云的热量更少。

paras.en: The cooled air becomes heavy, but as it sinks, the movement stirs up the atmospheric boundary layer, which swells, actually pushing the whole sandwich of clouds upwards.
paras.zh: 冷却后的空气变得很重，但当它下沉时，运动会搅动大气边界层，使边界层膨胀，实际上将整个云层向上推。

paras.en: The turbines, in turn, are able to catch more of that energy.
paras.zh: 反过来，涡轮机能够捕获更多的能量。

paras.en: Moist air on the cloud tops had the opposite effect. With less of a gradient of energy between the clouds and the air above them, there's less of an engine driving those powerful changes at the atmospheric boundary layer.
paras.zh: 云顶上的潮湿空气会产生相反的效果。由于云层和云层上方空气之间的能量梯度较小，驱动大气边界层发生剧烈变化的引擎也较少。

paras.en: The layer sits low over Earth's surface, which stymies the traveling winds, slowing them down – and draining them of energy – by the time they reach the wind farm.
paras.zh: 该层位于地球表面较低的位置，当风到达风电场时，它会阻碍行进的风，减慢它们的速度，并耗尽它们的能量。

paras.en: "An energy-budget analysis shows that the free-tropospheric conditions alter the boundary-layer depth and modify the downward turbulent transport of kinetic energy towards the wind farm," Selvatici and team conclude.
paras.zh: Selvatici 和团队得出结论：“能量预算分析表明，自由对流层条件改变了边界层深度，并改变了动能向风电场的向下湍流传输。”

paras.en: Interestingly, the turbines actually affect low, thin clouds, too.
paras.zh: 有趣的是，涡轮机实际上也会影响低而薄的云层。

paras.en: "For shallow boundary-layer clouds with cloud base close to the rotor top, wind farms can reduce liquid water content and cloud cover, consistent with satellite observations," the team writes.
paras.zh: 研究小组写道：“对于云底靠近转子顶部的浅边界层云，风电场可以减少液态水含量和云量，这与卫星观测结果一致。”

paras.en: "Our results suggest that two-way wind farm-cloud interactions should be considered when planning and deploying large offshore wind farms."
paras.zh: “我们的结果表明，在规划和部署大型海上风电场时，应考虑双向风电场-云交互。”

paras.en: It's pretty technical stuff, but these variables could have implications for wind farm projects, in terms of how the turbines are laid out, where they're built, and how much energy we can expect to get from them under different conditions.
paras.zh: 这是相当技术性的东西，但这些变量可能会对风电场项目产生影响，包括涡轮机的布局、建造地点以及我们在不同条件下期望从涡轮机获得多少能量。

paras.en: Next, the researchers want to build similar simulations for a wider range of weather conditions and different wind farm design features.
paras.zh: 接下来，研究人员希望针对更广泛的天气条件和不同的风电场设计特征建立类似的模拟。

paras.en: The research has been published in Journal of Renewable and Sustainable Energy.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《可再生和可持续能源杂志》上。

articles.title: FDA Approves First-of-Its-Kind Bone Repair Material Made From Pearl Shells
articles.author: David Nield

paras.en: When it comes to helping the human body repair bones, there are several options available to doctors – but they each come with drawbacks as well as advantages.
paras.zh: 在帮助人体修复骨骼方面，医生有多种选择，但每种选择都有缺点和优点。

paras.en: Now there's a new treatment on the table, in the US at least. PearlBone Putty 1600, made from sustainably sourced pearl shells, was just given 510(k) clearance by the country's Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
paras.zh: 现在，至少在美国，有一种新的治疗方法可供选择。 PearlBone Putty 1600 由可持续采购的珍珠贝制成，刚刚获得该国食品和药物管理局 (FDA) 的 510(k) 许可。

paras.en: That means PearlBone can now be marketed and sold in the US as a substance used for repairing bone fractures.
paras.zh: 这意味着 PearlBone 现在可以作为用于修复骨折的物质在美国上市和销售。

paras.en: It's the first replacement bone graft material to be made from nacre (or mother-of-pearl), the shiny layer inside oyster shells, but it does something smart to that raw material to make it suitable for setting bones in place – and it's been many years in the making.
paras.zh: 它是第一种由珍珠母（或珍珠母）（牡蛎壳内的闪亮层）制成的替代骨移植材料，但它对这种原材料做了一些巧妙的处理，使其适合将骨头固定到位，而且它的制作过程已经很多年了。

paras.en: The research team behind PearlBone developed a chemical reaction that turns the calcium carbonate of nacre into the calcium phosphate of human bone, ready for grafting, in the span of 24 hours.
paras.zh: PearlBone 背后的研究团队开发了一种化学反应，可在 24 小时内将珍珠质的碳酸钙转化为人骨的磷酸钙，为移植做好准备。

paras.en: "We developed and patented a technology that converts nacre, the mineralized structure of pearl shell, into a bone mineral matrix composite," says regenerative biologist Minghao Zheng from the University of Western Australia, one of the team behind PearlBone.
paras.zh: PearlBone 背后的团队之一、西澳大利亚大学的再生生物学家 Minghao Cheng 表示：“我们开发了一项技术并获得了专利，该技术可将珍珠层（珍珠壳的矿化结构）转化为骨矿物基质复合材料。”

paras.en: "Essentially, we found a way to accelerate a biomineralization process that took millions of years in nature, into a process that could be completed in a day."
paras.zh: “从本质上讲，我们找到了一种方法，可以将自然界中需要数百万年的生物矿化过程加速到一天内即可完成的过程。”

paras.en: The PearlBone researchers have previously published some of their work in the Materials & Design journal. In that study, they outline how their nacre-based calcium orthophosphate composite (NCOC) was produced.
paras.zh: PearlBone 研究人员此前已在《材料与设计》杂志上发表了他们的一些研究成果。在这项研究中，他们概述了基于珍珠质的正磷酸钙复合材料 (NCOC) 的生产过程。

paras.en: Using shells from the Pinctada maxima pearl oyster, found off the coast of Western Australia, the process requires grinding the shells into a powder and mixing the powder with a calcium phosphate salt and water.
paras.zh: 该过程使用西澳大利亚海岸发现的大珠母贝珍珠贝壳，将贝壳磨成粉末，并将粉末与磷酸钙盐和水混合。

paras.en: "Overall, our data showed that NCOC produced through self-setting reactions, presents advantages such as accelerated biodegradation and osteostimulative properties, making it a promising bone substitute for effective bone regeneration," write the researchers in their published paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在发表的论文中写道：“总的来说，我们的数据表明，通过自凝固反应产生的 NCOC 具有加速生物降解和骨刺激特性等优点，使其成为有效骨再生的有前途的骨替代品。”

paras.en: The operation is sustainable too, because it uses existing by-products of the pearl farming industry that would otherwise be discarded – it's basically recycling oyster shells.
paras.zh: 该业务也是可持续的，因为它使用了珍珠养殖业现有的副产品，否则这些副产品将被丢弃——它基本上是回收牡蛎壳。

paras.en: Ultimately, PearlBone could be used for almost any bone that's been damaged by injury or surgery. However, as the FDA requirements clarify that the grafts can't be "intrinsic to the stability" of the bone overall.
paras.zh: 最终，PearlBone 几乎可以用于治疗任何因受伤或手术而受损的骨骼。然而，正如 FDA 要求澄清的那样，移植物不能“本质上影响骨骼的稳定性”。

paras.en: In other words, it's used to fill gaps while a bone heals, potentially alongside other fittings like plates or screws.
paras.zh: 换句话说，它用于在骨头愈合时填充间隙，可能与板或螺钉等其他配件一起使用。

paras.en: One of the cleverest aspects of the material is the way it encourages natural bone cells to fill the gaps, supporting bone regrowth through a carefully calibrated structure, and then eventually being replaced by normal bone.
paras.zh: 该材料最聪明的方面之一是它鼓励天然骨细胞填充间隙，通过仔细校准的结构支持骨骼再生，然后最终被正常骨骼取代。

paras.en: "NCOC is a complex composition of biocompatible and biodegradable calcium salts and can maintain its mechanical strength, promote cell attachment, proliferation, and osteogenesis in vitro," write the researchers.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“NCOC 是一种生物相容性和可生物降解的钙盐的复杂组合物，可以在体外保持其机械强度，促进细胞附着、增殖和成骨。”

paras.en: Now it's another step towards being put to use in hospitals and clinics, PearlBone promises to be a valuable alternative to current approaches to bone grafts. The best existing option is to take bone from elsewhere in a patient's body, which guarantees a good match but can cause pain and extended surgery times.
paras.zh: 现在，PearlBone 朝着在医院和诊所使用的方向又迈出了一步，它有望成为当前骨移植方法的有价值的替代方案。现有最好的选择是从患者身体的其他部位取出骨头，这可以保证良好的匹配，但会导致疼痛和延长手术时间。

paras.en: Other artificial bone substitutes are also available, but don't always take as well, and can be limited in terms of strength and absorption rates.
paras.zh: 其他人造骨替代品也可用，但并不总是那么好，并且在强度和吸收率方面可能受到限制。

paras.en: The PearlBone Putty 1600 isn't going to be available for bone grafts right away. The biotech company responsible for PearlBone, Marine Biomedical, still needs to work with partners in the US to get it manufactured and sold to clinical and commercial partners.
paras.zh: PearlBone Putty 1600 不会立即用于骨移植。负责 PearlBone 的生物技术公司 Marine Biomedical 仍需要与美国的合作伙伴合作，将其生产出来并出售给临床和商业合作伙伴。

paras.en: And if you're interested in the financials as well as the science, there's a lot of potential here: The US is the biggest market in the world for orthopaedic products, with an estimated value of $1.1 billion a year.
paras.zh: 如果您对金融和科学感兴趣，这里有很大的潜力：美国是世界上最大的骨科产品市场，估计每年价值 11 亿美元。

paras.en: "[The FDA approval] reflects years of scientific research and extraordinary dedication," says Rolee Kumar, CEO at Marine Biomedical.
paras.zh: “[FDA 的批准]反映了多年的科学研究和非凡的奉献精神，”海洋生物医学首席执行官 Rolee Kumar 说。

articles.title: 2 Patients Have Been Hospitalized With Psychosis or Mania After Abruptly Stopping GLP-1s
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: Stopping GLP-1 drugs too abruptly can impact more than just the body – it can also potentially affect the brain.
paras.zh: 突然停止 GLP-1 药物不仅会影响身体，还可能影响大脑。

paras.en: Two recent cautionary tales have scientists concerned that for a rare few, discontinuing injections of tirzepatide (brand names Mounjaro or Zepbound) could contribute to psychiatric symptoms, like mania or hallucinations.
paras.zh: 最近的两个警示故事让科学家担心，对于极少数人来说，停止注射替泽帕肽（商品名 Mounjaro 或 Zepbound）可能会导致精神症状，如躁狂或幻觉。

paras.en: The two case studies were reported in the peer-reviewed medical journal The Primary Care Companion for Central Nervous System Disorders.
paras.zh: 这两个案例研究发表在同行评审的医学杂志《中枢神经系统疾病初级保健伴侣》中。

paras.en: The first patient discussed in the report was a 61-year-old man who presented at the hospital in October 2025 with worsening confusion and erratic behavior that had seemingly come out of nowhere.
paras.zh: 报告中讨论的第一位患者是一名 61 岁的男子，他于 2025 年 10 月入院，神志不清，行为古怪，似乎突然出现。

paras.en: The man reported that he was experiencing a low mood, worsening depression, paranoia, and both auditory and visual hallucinations.
paras.zh: 该男子报告说，他情绪低落，抑郁症恶化，偏执，并出现幻听和幻视。

paras.en: He had also developed a rare psychiatric symptom called Cotard delusion, in which someone believes they are dead, or that parts of their body are missing or no longer functional.
paras.zh: 他还出现了一种罕见的精神症状，称为科塔尔妄想，在这种症状中，有人认为自己已经死了，或者身体的某些部分缺失或不再具有功能。

paras.en: In August of that year, the patient had stopped tirzepatide due to nausea.
paras.zh: 同年8月，患者因恶心停用替西帕肽。

paras.en: The second patient was a 52-year-old man who also presented at hospital in the same month, this time for erratic behavior and mood swings.
paras.zh: 第二名患者是一名 52 岁的男子，他也在同月入院，这次是因为行为古怪和情绪波动。

paras.en: Doctors diagnosed the man as having a manic episode, as he was showing symptoms such as hyperverbal and disorganized speech, grandiosity, impulsivity, and irritability.
paras.zh: 医生诊断该男子患有躁狂发作，因为他表现出言语过多、言语混乱、浮夸、冲动和易怒等症状。

paras.en: The patient reported that he stopped tirzepatide abruptly the month before, after losing 100 pounds over six months.
paras.zh: 患者报告称，他在六个月内减重 100 磅后，于前一个月突然停用了替泽帕肽。

paras.en: In the weeks preceding his hospital visit, the patient had also increased cannabis use, which can be a risk factor for psychosis. In addition, his vitamin B12 levels were low, suggesting nutritional deficits.
paras.zh: 在就诊前几周，患者还增加了大麻的使用，这可能是精神病的危险因素。此外，他的维生素 B12 水平较低，表明营养不足。

paras.en: The patient was transferred to a psychiatric facility for further care.
paras.zh: 该患者被转移到精神病院接受进一步护理。

paras.en: Both of these patient experiences do not prove that stopping GLP-1 drugs can cause psychosis or mania, but the timing is suspicious.
paras.zh: 这两种患者的经历并不能证明停用GLP-1药物会导致精神病或躁狂症，但时机令人怀疑。

paras.en: "While likely not the sole factor, it is plausible that discontinuation of a GLP-1 receptor agonist may contribute to acute-onset mood or psychotic symptoms in a select population of at-risk patients (including patients with nutritional deficiencies associated with, or exacerbated by, GLP-1 use, such as the second patient with a low vitamin B12 level)," explain the authors of the case study.
paras.zh: 该案例研究的作者解释说：“虽然可能不是唯一因素，但停用 GLP-1 受体激动剂可能会导致特定高危患者群体急性发作的情绪或精神病症状（包括与 GLP-1 使用相关或因使用 GLP-1 而加剧营养缺乏的患者，例如第二位维生素 B12 水平较低的患者）。”

paras.en: It's also worth noting that both patients had a previous diagnosis of depression and anxiety, respectively.
paras.zh: 还值得注意的是，两名患者之前分别被诊断为抑郁症和焦虑症。

paras.en: This prior psychiatric history might have played a role in their symptoms.
paras.zh: 之前的精神病史可能对他们的症状产生了一定的影响。

paras.en: This isn't the first time that GLP-1 drugs have been linked to concerning psychiatric events, either.
paras.zh: 这也不是 GLP-1 药物第一次与精神疾病相关。

paras.en: GLP-1 receptors are also present in the brain, and evidence suggests these drugs can cross the blood-brain barrier.
paras.zh: GLP-1 受体也存在于大脑中，有证据表明这些药物可以穿过血脑屏障。

paras.en: What the medicine does once it is there is still largely unknown.
paras.zh: 这种药物到达那里后会起什么作用，目前仍不清楚。

paras.en: A few years ago, a European drug database recorded 481 psychiatric events associated with three GLP-1 drugs: semaglutide, liraglutide, and tirzepatide.
paras.zh: 几年前，欧洲药物数据库记录了 481 起与三种 GLP-1 药物相关的精神事件：索马鲁肽、利拉鲁肽和替泽帕肽。

paras.en: These outcomes are rare, making up just over 1 percent of the total reports related to these drugs, but researchers argued at the time that the serious, life-threatening nature of these events warranted additional research.
paras.zh: 这些结果很少见，仅占与这些药物相关的总报告的 1% 以上，但研究人员当时认为，这些事件严重且危及生命，需要进行更多研究。

paras.en: "While the neuropsychiatric effects of GLP-1 agonist treatment are increasingly recognized… the psychiatric implications of discontinuing these medications remain poorly characterized," explain the authors of these new case studies.
paras.zh: 这些新案例研究的作者解释说：“虽然 GLP-1 激动剂治疗的神经精神作用越来越受到认可……但停用这些药物的精神影响仍不清楚。”

paras.en: "Acute-onset mood or psychotic symptoms following GLP-1 receptor agonist discontinuation may represent an underrecognized clinical phenomenon."
paras.zh: “停用 GLP-1 受体激动剂后急性发作的情绪或精神病症状可能代表了一种未被充分认识的临床现象。”

paras.en: They say that prescribers should be aware of the potential for recent GLP-1 medication changes to contribute to psychiatric symptoms.
paras.zh: 他们说，处方医生应该意识到最近 GLP-1 药物变化可能导致精神症状。

paras.en: As more people use these novel medications, researchers are learning about more rare side effects.
paras.zh: 随着越来越多的人使用这些新型药物，研究人员正在了解更多罕见的副作用。

paras.en: GLP-1 drugs come with many benefits, but the more we learn about their potential cons, the better prepared patients and physicians are when something goes wrong.
paras.zh: GLP-1 药物有很多好处，但我们对其潜在缺点了解得越多，患者和医生在出现问题时就能做好更充分的准备。

paras.en: If this story has raised concerns or you need to talk to someone, please consult this list to find a 24/7 crisis hotline in your country, and reach out for help.
paras.zh: 如果这个故事引起了关注或者您需要与某人交谈，请查阅此列表以查找您所在国家/地区的 24/7 危机热线，并寻求帮助。

paras.en: The research has been published in Primary Care Companion for CNS Disorders.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《中枢神经系统疾病初级保健伴侣》上。

articles.title: ESA’s Hera spacecraft is flying rectangles around NASA’s asteroid crash site

paras.en: ESAâs Hera spacecraft is flying rectangles around NASAâs asteroid crash site
paras.zh: 欧空局的赫拉航天器正在绕美国宇航局小行星坠毁地点飞行矩形

paras.en: - Europeâs Hera spacecraft has arrived at the scene of NASAâs historic asteroid collision to uncover what really happened when a spacecraft slammed into Dimorphos in 2022. Its close-up investigation could reveal whether the impact left a crater or reshaped the asteroid entirely, providing crucial clues for protecting Earth from future threats.
paras.zh: - 欧洲的 Hera 航天器已抵达美国宇航局历史性小行星碰撞现场，以揭开 2022 年航天器撞击 Dimorphos 时到底发生了什么。它的近距离调查可能会揭示撞击是否留下了陨石坑或完全重塑了小行星​​，为保护地球免受未来威胁提供重要线索。

paras.en: The European Space Agency's Hera spacecraft has reached its destination, arriving near two asteroids that could help scientists learn how to protect Earth from dangerous space rocks. The spacecraft, which is roughly the size of a small car, is now traveling about 25 to 30 kilometers from the Didymos asteroid system as it begins its first scientific observations.
paras.zh: 欧洲航天局的赫拉航天器已经抵达目的地，到达两颗小行星附近，这可以帮助科学家了解如何保护地球免受危险的太空岩石的侵害。这艘航天器大约有一辆小型汽车那么大，目前正在距离迪迪莫斯小行星系统约 25 至 30 公里的地方行驶，开始进行首次科学观测。

paras.en: This initial stage, known as the "early characterization phase," is designed to give researchers a broad understanding of the two asteroids and their surroundings. Of particular interest is Dimorphos, the smaller asteroid that NASA deliberately struck with its DART spacecraft in 2022 to test whether a collision could change an asteroid's path.
paras.zh: 这个初始阶段被称为“早期表征阶段”，旨在让研究人员对这两颗小行星及其周围环境有广泛的了解。特别令人感兴趣的是 Dimorphos，这是 NASA 在 2022 年故意用 DART 航天器撞击的较小小行星，以测试碰撞是否会改变小行星的路径。

paras.en: "Our aim right now is to gather the big-picture findings of relevance to supporting the mission's planetary defense goals," explains mission scientist Michael Kueppers.
paras.zh: 任务科学家迈克尔·库珀斯解释说：“我们现在的目标是收集与支持任务的行星防御目标相关的总体发现。”

paras.en: "During this phase, our images will reveal for the first time what a small asteroid looks like globally, having experienced a hypervelocity impact in the context of the first asteroid deflection test, when NASA's DART spacecraft impacted it to change its orbit in 2022."
paras.zh: “在此阶段，我们的图像将首次揭示一颗小型小行星在全球范围内的样子，它在第一次小行星偏转测试中经历了超高速撞击，当时 NASA 的 DART 航天器于 2022 年撞击它改变了轨道。”

paras.en: "Previous predictions by our impact models suggested many different ways the asteroid body might react, but Hera will reveal which forecast was the correct one - if any!"
paras.zh: “我们的撞击模型之前的预测表明小行星体可能会产生多种不同的反应方式，但赫拉将揭示哪种预测是正确的 - 如果有的话！”

paras.en: Why Hera Is Flying in Rectangles Around Two Asteroids
paras.zh: 为什么赫拉要围绕两颗小行星呈矩形飞行

paras.en: Navigating around asteroids presents challenges that are very different from those encountered by spacecraft exploring planets. The main asteroid, Didymos, measures approximately 780 meters across and has gravitational pull about 40,000 times weaker than Earth's. Its smaller companion, Dimorphos, is just 151 meters wide and has gravity roughly 200,000 times weaker than Earth's.
paras.zh: 绕小行星航行所面临的挑战与探索行星的航天器所遇到的挑战截然不同。主要小行星 Didymos 直径约为 780 米，引力比地球弱约 40,000 倍。它的较小伴星 Dimorphos 仅有 151 米宽，重力大约比地球弱 200,000 倍。

paras.en: With gravity this weak, maintaining a conventional circular orbit is not practical. Hera instead travels around the shared center of gravity of the two asteroids, moving at a remarkably slow speed of approximately 12 centimeters per second. That is comparable to the pace of an insect crawling quickly across the ground.
paras.zh: 由于引力如此弱，维持传统的圆形轨道是不切实际的。相反，赫拉围绕两颗小行星的共同重心运行，移动速度非常慢，约为每秒 12 厘米。这相当于昆虫在地面上快速爬行的速度。

paras.en: Rather than following a smooth circular path, Hera moves along nearly straight trajectories. At alternating intervals of three and four days, the spacecraft fires its thrusters while moving away from the asteroids, changing direction by 90 degrees. These carefully timed maneuvers create a series of unusual "rectangular orbits" that keep Hera approximately 25 to 30 kilometers from the asteroid pair.
paras.zh: 赫拉不是沿着平滑的圆形路径移动，而是沿着近乎笔直的轨迹移动。每隔三天和四天，航天器会在远离小行星的同时发射推进器，改变方向 90 度。这些精心定时的操作创造了一系列不寻常的“矩形轨道”，使赫拉与这对小行星保持约 25 至 30 公里的距离。

paras.en: The unusual navigation strategy builds on experience gained during ESA's Rosetta comet mission. It also provides an important safety advantage. If a planned thruster firing fails, Hera will naturally drift farther from the asteroids instead of moving toward a potentially dangerous collision. Because the spacecraft travels so slowly, each course correction requires very little propellant.
paras.zh: 这一不同寻常的导航策略建立在欧空局罗塞塔彗星任务期间获得的经验之上。它还提供了重要的安全优势。如果计划的推进器发射失败，赫拉自然会漂离小行星更远，而不是走向潜在危险的碰撞。由于航天器运行速度如此缓慢，每次航向修正只需要很少的推进剂。

paras.en: Hera Prepares for a Closer Look at the Asteroids
paras.zh: 赫拉准备近距离观察小行星

paras.en: Next month, Hera is expected to begin its "detailed characterization phase," bringing it significantly closer to Didymos and Dimorphos. During this stage, the spacecraft will switch from rectangular flight paths to more complex hyperbolic trajectories shaped like bowties, beginning at distances of approximately 20 kilometers.
paras.zh: 下个月，Hera 预计将开始其“详细表征阶段”，使其与 Didymos 和 Dimorphos 更加接近。在此阶段，航天器将从大约 20 公里的距离开始，从矩形飞行路径切换到形状像蝴蝶结的更复杂的双曲线轨迹。

paras.en: The mission is directed from ESA's ESOC mission control center in Darmstadt, Germany. Despite Hera being approximately 196.5 million kilometers from Earth, controllers maintain contact with the spacecraft for about eight hours each day.
paras.zh: 该任务由欧空局位于德国达姆施塔特的 ESOC 任务控制中心指挥。尽管赫拉距离地球约 1.965 亿公里，但控制人员每天仍与航天器保持约八小时的联系。

paras.en: Communication is handled through four enormous Deep Space Antennas, each measuring 35 meters in diameter, at facilities in Argentina, Spain, and Australia.
paras.zh: 通信通过四个巨大的深空天线进行处理，每个天线的直径为 35 米，分别位于阿根廷、西班牙和澳大利亚。

paras.en: The mission control team also works closely with ESA's Flight Dynamics team. Using data transmitted by Hera, these specialists calculate its exact location relative to the two asteroids and develop the commands needed to guide it safely from one planned position to another.
paras.zh: 任务控制团队还与欧空局的飞行动力学团队密切合作。使用赫拉传输的数据，这些专家计算出它相对于两颗小行星的确切位置，并制定将其安全地从一个计划位置转移到另一个位置所需的命令。

paras.en: Investigating NASA's Historic Asteroid Collision
paras.zh: 调查美国宇航局历史性的小行星碰撞

paras.en: Hera's observations will help answer some of the biggest questions left unanswered by NASA's first asteroid deflection experiment.
paras.zh: 赫拉的观测结果将有助于回答美国宇航局首次小行星偏转实验中未解答的一些最大问题。

paras.en: On September 26, 2022, NASA's DART spacecraft deliberately collided with Dimorphos. The 580-kilogram spacecraft struck the asteroid at approximately 6.1 kilometers per second, producing a massive cloud of debris that spread across 10,000 kilometers of space.
paras.zh: 2022 年 9 月 26 日，NASA 的 DART 航天器故意与 Dimorphos 相撞。这艘重 580 公斤的航天器以每秒约 6.1 公里的速度撞击了小行星，产生了遍布 10,000 公里太空的巨大碎片云。

paras.en: The impact successfully changed Dimorphos' motion, shortening the time it takes to orbit Didymos by about 33 minutes. This was a major achievement for planetary defense, demonstrating that deliberately crashing a spacecraft into an asteroid could alter its trajectory.
paras.zh: 这次撞击成功地改变了 Dimorphos 的运动，将其环绕 Didymos 运行的时间缩短了约 33 分钟。这是行星防御的一项重大成就，表明故意将航天器撞向小行星可能会改变其轨道。

paras.en: However, the experiment also raised important questions. Scientists still do not know exactly how the impact changed Dimorphos itself. Did the collision excavate a large crater, or did it significantly reshape the entire asteroid?
paras.zh: 然而，该实验也提出了重要的问题。科学家们仍然不知道撞击是如何改变迪莫福斯本身的。这次碰撞是否挖出了一个大陨石坑，或者是否显着重塑了整个小行星？

paras.en: Researchers also need more precise information about Dimorphos' composition, internal structure, and mass. Understanding these properties could explain why the impact produced a much larger orbital change than computer simulations had predicted.
paras.zh: 研究人员还需要有关 Dimorphos 的成分、内部结构和质量的更精确信息。了解这些特性可以解释为什么撞击产生的轨道变化比计算机模拟预测的要大得多。

paras.en: These details are essential for developing the collision method, known as kinetic impact, into a dependable planetary defense strategy. If scientists can determine how different types of asteroids respond to being struck, they will be better equipped to predict the results of future attempts to redirect potentially hazardous objects.
paras.zh: 这些细节对于将碰撞方法（称为动能撞击）发展成可靠的行星防御策略至关重要。如果科学家能够确定不同类型的小行星对撞击的反应，他们将能够更好地预测未来尝试改变潜在危险物体方向的结果。

paras.en: A Close-Up Investigation of the Asteroid Crash Site
paras.zh: 小行星坠毁地点的近距离调查

paras.en: Over the coming months, Hera will conduct a detailed investigation of Dimorphos, effectively examining the scene of NASA's historic collision.
paras.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，赫拉将对迪莫弗斯进行详细调查，有效地检查美国宇航局历史性碰撞的现场。

paras.en: The spacecraft will use several scientific instruments to study the asteroid and will release two small CubeSats, each about the size of a shoebox. These miniature spacecraft will travel even closer to the asteroid to collect additional measurements, with the mission eventually advancing to landing operations.
paras.zh: 该航天器将使用多种科学仪器来研究这颗小行星，并将释放两个小型立方体卫星，每个立方体卫星大约有鞋盒大小。这些微型航天器将更加靠近小行星以收集更多测量数据，任务最终将进入着陆操作阶段。

paras.en: Together, the observations should provide scientists with a much clearer understanding of how Dimorphos responded to DART's impact and why the experiment worked so effectively. That knowledge could prove crucial if Earth ever faces a dangerous asteroid on a collision course.
paras.zh: 总之，这些观察结果应该可以让科学家们更清楚地了解 Dimorphos 如何应对 DART 的影响以及实验为何如此有效。如果地球在碰撞过程中遇到危险的小行星，这些知识可能至关重要。

paras.en: Materials provided by European Space Agency (ESA). Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由欧洲航天局 (ESA) 提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: This remarkable new material could solve a major carbon capture problem

paras.en: This remarkable new material could solve a major carbon capture problem
paras.zh: 这种非凡的新材料可以解决主要的碳捕获问题

paras.en: - Scientists have developed a new carbon capture material that turns moisture from an obstacle into an advantage, potentially solving a major problem with removing CO2 from industrial emissions. The material works even in extremely humid conditions and can be reused repeatedly, offering a promising path toward cheaper, more effective carbon capture.
paras.zh: - 科学家们开发出了一种新型碳捕获材料，可以将水分从障碍转变为优势，有可能解决从工业排放中去除二氧化碳的主要问题。该材料即使在极其潮湿的条件下也能工作，并且可以重复使用，为更便宜、更有效的碳捕获提供了一条有希望的途径。

paras.en: A newly developed material from Oregon State University could help solve one of the biggest challenges in industrial carbon capture: removing carbon dioxide from emissions that contain large amounts of water vapor. Instead of allowing moisture to interfere with the process, the material uses it to help maintain effective carbon capture.
paras.zh: 俄勒冈州立大学新开发的材料可以帮助解决工业碳捕获的最大挑战之一：从含有大量水蒸气的排放物中去除二氧化碳。该材料不会让水分干扰这一过程，而是利用水分来帮助保持有效的碳捕获。

paras.en: The researchers have filed a patent application for the innovation, which belongs to a class of materials known as metal-organic frameworks, or MOFs. Their findings, published in Angewandte Chemie, could help make carbon capture more practical and affordable for factories and other industrial facilities.
paras.zh: 研究人员已经为这项创新提交了专利申请，该创新属于一类被称为金属有机框架（MOF）的材料。他们的研究结果发表在《Angewandte Chemie》上，可以帮助工厂和其他工业设施使碳捕获变得更加实用和负担得起。

paras.en: The advance could have important implications for reducing greenhouse gas emissions. Industrial operations, including the burning of fossil fuels to produce energy, are major sources of atmospheric carbon dioxide. In the United States, industry accounts for 30% of total greenhouse gas emissions, according to the Environmental Protection Agency.
paras.zh: 这一进展可能对减少温室气体排放产生重要影响。工业生产，包括燃烧化石燃料来生产能源，是大气二氧化碳的主要来源。根据环境保护局的数据，在美国，工业排放量占温室气体排放总量的 30%。

paras.en: A New Material That Overcomes a Major Carbon Capture Problem
paras.zh: 一种克服主要碳捕获问题的新材料

paras.en: The new material, called BVR-X, has an unusual internal structure that keeps water and carbon dioxide largely separated within its microscopic pores. By directing the two substances into different regions, it prevents water molecules from occupying the spaces needed to capture carbon dioxide.
paras.zh: 这种名为 BVR-X 的新材料具有不寻常的内部结构，可在其微观孔隙内将水和二氧化碳很大程度上分离。通过将两种物质引导到不同的区域，它可以防止水分子占据捕获二氧化碳所需的空间。

paras.en: "This internal organization helps the material work under conditions that more closely resemble real industrial emissions," said Kyriakos Stylianou, professor of chemistry in the OSU College of Science.
paras.zh: 俄勒冈州立大学理学院化学教授 Kyriakos Stylianou 表示：“这种内部组织有助于材料在更接近真实工业排放的条件下工作。”

paras.en: MOFs are crystalline materials built from positively charged metal ions connected by organic molecules called ligands, which act as linkers. The metal ions form connection points, or nodes, while the linkers join them together into repeating structures resembling tiny cages. These structures contain extremely small pores that can trap gas molecules on their internal surfaces through a process called adsorption, much like a sponge holds substances within its structure.
paras.zh: MOF 是由带正电的金属离子构成的晶体材料，这些金属离子通过称为配体的有机分子连接，配体充当连接体。金属离子形成连接点或节点，而连接体将它们连接在一起形成类似于微小笼子的重复结构。这些结构包含极小的孔隙，可以通过吸附过程将气体分子捕获在其内表面，就像海绵将物质保留在其结构内一样。

paras.en: One of the advantages of MOFs is their remarkable adaptability. Scientists can combine different metals and organic linkers to create materials with specific characteristics. According to Stylianou, millions of MOF designs are theoretically possible. Researchers have already synthesized more than 100,000 distinct MOFs and predicted the properties of hundreds of thousands more.
paras.zh: MOF 的优点之一是其卓越的适应性。科学家可以将不同的金属和有机连接体结合起来，创造出具有特定特性的材料。 Stylianou 表示，理论上可以进行数百万种 MOF 设计。研究人员已经合成了超过 100,000 种不同的 MOF，并预测了数十万种的特性。

paras.en: Why Carbon Capture Needs Better Materials
paras.zh: 为什么碳捕获需要更好的材料

paras.en: "The capture of CO2 is critical for meeting net-zero emission targets," said Stylianou, who directs OSU's Materials Discovery Laboratory, known as the MaD Lab. "MOFs have shown a lot of promise because of their porosity and their structural versatility."
paras.zh: “捕获二氧化碳对于实现净零排放目标至关重要，”俄勒冈州立大学材料发现实验室（MaD 实验室）的负责人 Stylianou 说。 “MOFs 由于其多孔性和结构多功能性而显示出很大的前景。”

paras.en: Carbon dioxide is a major greenhouse gas released when fossil fuels are burned. As it accumulates in the atmosphere, it traps heat and contributes to global warming.
paras.zh: 二氧化碳是化石燃料燃烧时释放的主要温室气体。当它在大气中积聚时，它会吸收热量并导致全球变暖。

paras.en: One approach to addressing the problem involves removing carbon dioxide directly from the atmosphere. Facilities designed for this purpose are beginning to operate in different parts of the world. The world's largest such plant opened in Iceland in 2024, although its annual carbon removal capacity is still relatively small compared with global emissions. According to Stylianou, the facility can capture roughly as much carbon dioxide in one year as about 7,200 cars produce over the same period.
paras.zh: 解决这个问题的一种方法是直接从大气中去除二氧化碳。为此目的设计的设施已开始在世界不同地区运行。世界上最大的此类工厂于 2024 年在冰岛开业，尽管其年碳去除能力与全球排放量相比仍然相对较小。 Stylianou 表示，该设施一年内捕获的二氧化碳量大约相当于约 7,200 辆汽车同期产生的二氧化碳量。

paras.en: Capturing carbon dioxide before it reaches the atmosphere is another option, and the technologies used for this purpose are considerably more established. At factories and power plants, carbon capture systems can intercept emissions as they travel through exhaust systems and smokestacks. Some of these systems use MOFs to adsorb carbon dioxide molecules from the passing gases.
paras.zh: 在二氧化碳到达大气之前捕获二氧化碳是另一种选择，并且用于此目的的技术已经相当成熟。在工厂和发电厂，碳捕获系统可以拦截通过排气系统和烟囱的排放物。其中一些系统使用 MOF 来吸附通过气体中的二氧化碳分子。

paras.en: How Water Makes Industrial Carbon Capture Difficult
paras.zh: 水如何使工业碳捕获变得困难

paras.en: A major obstacle, however, is that industrial exhaust often contains substantial amounts of water vapor. Many MOFs that perform well in controlled laboratory experiments lose much of their carbon capture ability when exposed to the humid conditions found in actual smokestacks.
paras.zh: 然而，一个主要障碍是工业废气通常含有大量的水蒸气。许多在受控实验室实验中表现良好的 MOF 在暴露于实际烟囱中的潮湿条件时会失去大部分碳捕获能力。

paras.en: The gases can be dried before carbon dioxide is removed, but doing so requires additional equipment and energy. Those costs can become so significant that the overall process is no longer economically practical for industrial use.
paras.zh: 在去除二氧化碳之前可以对气体进行干燥，但这样做需要额外的设备和能源。这些成本可能变得如此之大，以至于整个过程对于工业用途来说不再经济实用。

paras.en: BVR-X offers a different approach. Rather than requiring moisture to be removed, the material responds to water in a way that preserves its ability to collect carbon dioxide. Its internal organization allows water and carbon dioxide to occupy different regions, helping prevent the competition that normally undermines carbon capture performance.
paras.zh: BVR-X 提供了一种不同的方法。该材料不需要去除水分，而是以一种保留其收集二氧化碳的能力的方式对水做出反应。其内部组织允许水和二氧化碳占据不同的区域，有助于防止通常会破坏碳捕获性能的竞争。

paras.en: "Water usually makes capturing carbon dioxide more difficult," he said. "Our new material does something unusual: It responds to water by changing in a way that lets it keep capturing CO2 effectively even under very humid conditions."
paras.zh: “水通常会使捕获二氧化碳变得更加困难，”他说。 “我们的新材料做了一些不寻常的事情：它通过改变方式对水做出反应，使其即使在非常潮湿的条件下也能保持有效地捕获二氧化碳。”

paras.en: Strong Performance Under Realistic Industrial Conditions
paras.zh: 现实工业条件下的强劲表现

paras.en: Laboratory tests demonstrated that BVR-X could efficiently capture carbon dioxide from a highly humid gas stream containing only 4% carbon dioxide.
paras.zh: 实验室测试表明，BVR-X 可以有效地从仅含 4% 二氧化碳的高湿气流中捕获二氧化碳。

paras.en: That concentration is particularly relevant to emissions from burning natural gas, where carbon dioxide makes up a relatively small proportion of the exhaust. Extracting it becomes especially difficult when large quantities of water vapor are also present.
paras.zh: 该浓度与燃烧天然气的排放尤其相关，其中二氧化碳在废气中所占比例相对较小。当还存在大量水蒸气时，提取它变得特别困难。

paras.en: The experiments therefore tested the material under conditions that resemble an important real-world challenge, "where separating a small amount of CO2 in the presence of substantial water is particularly challenging," said Stylianou.
paras.zh: 因此，实验在类似于现实世界的重要挑战的条件下测试了材料，“在存在大量水的情况下分离少量二氧化碳尤其具有挑战性，”Stylianou 说。

paras.en: The researchers also found that BVR-X could repeatedly capture and release carbon dioxide without losing its effectiveness over dozens of cycles. This ability to regenerate the material is important because commercial carbon capture systems must reuse their capture materials many times to keep operating costs manageable.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现，BVR-X 可以反复捕获和释放二氧化碳，而不会在数十次循环中失去其有效性。这种材料再生能力非常重要，因为商业碳捕获系统必须多次重复使用其捕获材料，以保持运营成本可控。

paras.en: "And the material can be regenerated and reused, maintaining performance through dozens of capture-and-release cycles and tolerating demanding conditions," he added. "Those are important qualities for practical carbon-capture technologies."
paras.zh: 他补充说：“这种材料可以再生和重复使用，通过数十次捕获和释放循环保持性能，并能承受苛刻的条件。” “这些是实用碳捕获技术的重要品质。”

paras.en: The results suggest that BVR-X could help overcome a major limitation of existing MOF technologies, particularly in industrial settings where removing moisture from exhaust gases would otherwise be costly.
paras.zh: 结果表明，BVR-X 可以帮助克服现有 MOF 技术的主要限制，特别是在工业环境中，否则从废气中去除水分的成本很高。

paras.en: The study brought together researchers from several institutions. Stylianou worked with MaD Lab members Ankit Yadav, Emmanuel Musa and Andrzej Gładysiak, along with Micah Hickethier, Chun-Wai Chang and Kai Shen Choong from the Oregon State College of Engineering.
paras.zh: 这项研究汇集了来自多个机构的研究人员。 Stylianou 与 MaD Lab 成员 Ankit Yadav、Emmanuel Musa 和 Andrzej Gładysiak，以及来自俄勒冈州立工程学院的 Micah Hickethier、Chun-Wai Chang 和 Kai Shen Choong 合作。

paras.en: Additional collaborators included scientists from the University of California, Berkeley; the University of Oregon; and the ARAMCO Research and Development Center.
paras.zh: 其他合作者包括来自加州大学伯克利分校的科学家；俄勒冈大学；以及阿美公司研发中心。

paras.en: Funding was provided by Saudi Aramco, the Murdock Charitable Trust, and a donor-advised fund established by Oregon State University alumni and retired public school teachers Brian and Marilyn Kleiner through the OSU Foundation.

articles.title: Ozempic and Mounjaro may have a surprising effect on your brain

paras.en: Ozempic and Mounjaro may have a surprising effect on your brain
paras.zh: Ozempic 和 Mounjaro 可能会对您的大脑产生惊人的影响

paras.en: - Blockbuster weight loss drugs like Ozempic and Mounjaro may do more than help people shed pounds, with growing evidence suggesting they could also influence brain health. Although studies have linked GLP-1 medications to a lower risk of dementia, major trials found that semaglutide did not slow Alzheimer's disease. Scientists suspect these drugs may be more effective at preserving memory and thinking abilities in people with obesity or diabetes, especially before cognitive problems appear.
paras.zh: - Ozempic 和 Mounjaro 等重磅减肥药的作用可能不仅仅是帮助人们减肥，越来越多的证据表明它们还可能影响大脑健康。尽管研究已将 GLP-1 药物与较低的痴呆风险联系起来，但主要试验发现索马鲁肽并不能减缓阿尔茨海默病。科学家怀疑这些药物可能更有效地保存肥胖或糖尿病患者的记忆和思维能力，尤其是在认知问题出现之前。

paras.en: Popular medications used to treat obesity and type 2 diabetes, including semaglutide and tirzepatide, may have effects that extend beyond weight loss and blood sugar control. These drugs also influence biological processes involved in brain function, raising questions about whether they could help preserve memory and thinking abilities.
paras.zh: 用于治疗肥胖和 2 型糖尿病的流行药物，包括索马鲁肽和替泽帕肽，其作用可能不仅仅限于减肥和控制血糖。这些药物还会影响涉及大脑功能的生物过程，引发人们对它们是否有助于保存记忆和思维能力的疑问。

paras.en: To examine this possibility, researchers from the University of Gothenburg and the University of Copenhagen reviewed the existing scientific evidence at the invitation of the journal Science.
paras.zh: 为了检验这种可能性，哥德堡大学和哥本哈根大学的研究人员应《科学》杂志的邀请审查了现有的科学证据。

paras.en: Studies involving animals suggest that GLP-1 medications can influence learning and memory. However, research involving humans has produced less consistent findings. Analyses of patient health records have found an association between GLP-1 treatment and a reduced risk of dementia among people with type 2 diabetes. These observational findings are encouraging, but they cannot determine whether the medications themselves are responsible for the lower risk.
paras.zh: 涉及动物的研究表明 GLP-1 药物可以影响学习和记忆。然而，涉及人类的研究得出的结果不太一致。对患者健康记录的分析发现，GLP-1 治疗与 2 型糖尿病患者患痴呆症的风险降低之间存在关联。这些观察结果令人鼓舞，但他们无法确定药物本身是否导致风险降低。

paras.en: More definitive results have also raised questions. In Novo Nordisk's EVOKE and EVOKE+ clinical trials, semaglutide failed to slow the progression of early Alzheimer's disease. Although the treatment affected several biological markers associated with Alzheimer's, those changes did not translate into a measurable slowing of the disease.
paras.zh: 更明确的结果也引发了疑问。在诺和诺德的EVOKE和EVOKE+临床试验中，索马鲁肽未能减缓早期阿尔茨海默病的进展。尽管治疗影响了与阿尔茨海默病相关的几种生物标志物，但这些变化并没有转化为可测量的疾病减缓。

paras.en: Why Weight Loss Drugs May Still Benefit the Brain
paras.zh: 为什么减肥药仍可能对大脑有益

paras.en: Despite the disappointing Alzheimer's results, researchers believe GLP-1 medications could still offer cognitive benefits to certain groups of patients.
paras.zh: 尽管阿尔茨海默病的结果令人失望，但研究人员认为 GLP-1 药物仍然可以为某些患者群体带来认知益处。

paras.en: People living with obesity or type 2 diabetes sometimes experience difficulties with attention, planning, and the speed at which they process information. These cognitive problems are often associated with metabolic health and blood vessel function, suggesting they may respond differently to treatment than the changes caused by Alzheimer's disease.
paras.zh: 肥胖或 2 型糖尿病患者有时会在注意力、计划和处理信息的速度方面遇到困难。这些认知问题通常与代谢健康和血管功能有关，这表明它们对治疗的反应可能与阿尔茨海默病引起的变化不同。

paras.en: Improving blood sugar regulation, metabolism, or vascular health could potentially help preserve cognitive abilities, even if the same medications cannot slow an established neurodegenerative disease.
paras.zh: 改善血糖调节、新陈代谢或血管健康可能有助于保持认知能力，即使相同的药物不能减缓已确定的神经退行性疾病。

paras.en: Stina Börchers, the review's first author and a researcher affiliated with both the University of Gothenburg and the University of Copenhagen, emphasizes the need to determine whether starting treatment earlier could make a difference.
paras.zh: 该综述的第一作者、哥德堡大学和哥本哈根大学的研究人员 Stina Börchers 强调需要确定尽早开始治疗是否会产生影响。

paras.en: "We need to find out whether these treatments can help people with obesity or diabetes preserve their cognitive abilities, particularly if treatment begins before cognitive problems become established. It is also important to identify which patients might benefit," says Stina Börchers.
paras.zh: “我们需要查明这些治疗是否可以帮助肥胖或糖尿病患者保持认知能力，特别是如果在认知问题出现之前开始治疗。确定哪些患者可能受益也很重要，”Stina Börchers 说。

paras.en: Unlocking New Treatments to Protect Memory
paras.zh: 解锁保护记忆的新疗法

paras.en: A central unanswered question is how GLP-1 medications might influence the brain. Their potential cognitive effects could result from improvements in metabolic health, direct actions within the brain, or a combination of both.
paras.zh: 一个尚未解答的核心问题是 GLP-1 药物如何影响大脑。它们潜在的认知效应可能来自代谢健康的改善、大脑内的直接作用或两者的结合。

paras.en: Understanding these mechanisms could help researchers identify which patients are most likely to benefit and potentially lead to medications designed specifically to support memory and other thinking abilities.
paras.zh: 了解这些机制可以帮助研究人员确定哪些患者最有可能受益，并可能导致专门设计用于支持记忆和其他思维能力的药物。

paras.en: Christoffer Clemmensen, the review's senior author and a research group leader at the University of Copenhagen, sees an opportunity to use increasingly advanced obesity treatments to explore the connection between metabolism and the brain.
paras.zh: 该评论的资深作者、哥本哈根大学研究小组组长克里斯托弗·克莱门森 (Christoffer Clemmensen) 看到了利用日益先进的肥胖治疗方法来探索新陈代谢与大脑之间联系的机会。

paras.en: "Obesity medicines are becoming increasingly sophisticated, offering new opportunities to understand how metabolic regulation influences brain function. By disentangling the direct and indirect effects of these drugs on the brain, we may ultimately be able to develop treatments specifically aimed at preserving cognitive function," says Christoffer Clemmensen.
paras.zh: “肥胖药物变得越来越复杂，为了解代谢调节如何影响大脑功能提供了新的机会。通过理清这些药物对大脑的直接和间接影响，我们最终可能能够开发出专门旨在保护认知功能的治疗方法，”克里斯托弗·克莱门森说。

paras.en: The researchers are calling for clinical trials that evaluate memory, attention, and other cognitive abilities beginning when patients first start treatment. Following these changes over time could help establish whether GLP-1 drugs genuinely protect brain function and clarify who might benefit most.
paras.zh: 研究人员呼吁从患者首次开始治疗时开始进行临床试验，评估记忆力、注意力和其他认知能力。随着时间的推移跟踪这些变化可以帮助确定 GLP-1 药物是否真正保护大脑功能并明确谁可能受益最大。

paras.en: They also stress that treatment is not without potential drawbacks, particularly for older adults and people who are physically frail. Rapid weight loss can lead to a reduction in muscle mass, which may weaken physical function and offset some of the possible benefits.
paras.zh: 他们还强调，治疗并非没有潜在的缺点，特别是对于老年人和身体虚弱的人。快速减肥会导致肌肉质量减少，这可能会削弱身体功能并抵消一些可能的好处。

paras.en: Careful monitoring will therefore be essential as researchers investigate whether today's weight loss and diabetes medications could eventually provide new ways to protect the brain.
paras.zh: 因此，当研究人员调查当今的减肥和糖尿病药物是否最终可以提供保护大脑的新方法时，仔细监测至关重要。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Gothenburg. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由哥德堡大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 17, 1967: NASA's Surveyor 6 moon probe makes 1st-ever successful launch and hop from the lunar surface
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Nov. 17, 1967, NASA's Surveyor 6 spacecraft made the first liftoff from the lunar surface.
paras.zh: 1967 年 11 月 17 日，美国宇航局的勘测者 6 号航天器首次从月球表面升空。

paras.en: Surveyor 6 was one of several robotic lunar missions NASA sent to scout the moon before sending humans there. It took television pictures of the surface and learned about the composition of lunar soil. Then came the big liftoff.
paras.zh: 勘测者 6 号是 NASA 在将人类送去月球之前派出的多项机器人月球任务之一。它拍摄了月球表面的电视照片并了解了月球土壤的成分。然后是大升空。

paras.en: First Surveyor 6 launched from the surface and hopped to another position about 8 feet (2 meters) away. Next, Surveyor 6 took pictures of its original landing site. Flight controllers on Earth could see the landing pad prints of Surveyor 6. They also saw an imprint from the rocket exhaust when Surveyor 6 lifted off.
paras.zh: 第一号测量员 6 号从地面发射并跳至约 8 英尺（2 米）外的另一个位置。接下来，测量者 6 号为其原始着陆点拍摄了照片。地球上的飞行控制人员可以看到测量者 6 号的着陆垫印记。他们还看到测量者 6 号升空时火箭排气留下的印记。

paras.en: Surveyor 6 showed that spacecraft could land on the moon, and lift off again. Less than two years later, humans did the same thing during Apollo 11.
paras.zh: 勘测者六号表明航天器可以登陆月球并再次升空。不到两年后，人类在阿波罗11号上做了同样的事情。

paras.en: NASA's Surveyor 6 spacecraft launched to the moon on Nov. 7, 1967 and made its first landing on the lunar surface on Nov. 10 of that year. It's primary mission was to make a soft landing on the moon in the Sinus Medii of the moon.
paras.zh: NASA 的勘测者 6 号宇宙飞船于 1967 年 11 月 7 日发射到月球，并于当年 11 月 10 日首次登陆月球表面。它的主要任务是在月球中窦软着陆。

paras.en: The probe took nearly 30,000 photos of the moon during its 16 days on the lunar surface, with the lander shutting down due to the onset of lunar night on Nov. 26. Surveyor 6 was the sixth and penultimate moon mission of NASA's Surveyor lunar program, so a lot of what it did (launching and landing on the moon) had been done before.
paras.zh: 该探测器在月球表面停留的 16 天里拍摄了近 30,000 张月球照片，着陆器因 11 月 26 日农历夜的到来而关闭。勘测者 6 号是 NASA 勘测者月球计划的第六次也是倒数第二次月球任务，因此它所做的很多事情（发射和登陆月球）之前都已经完成了。

paras.en: But a lunar liftoff? That was something new.
paras.zh: 但月球升空呢？那是新事物。

paras.en: "On November 17, as an engineering test to see if its rockets could be restarted on the Moon, Surveyor’s engines fired for 2.5 seconds, lifting the spacecraft 12 feet high and moving it 8 feet west of its original landing site, in the first powered liftoff from another celestial body," NASA wrote in a mission overview.
paras.zh: NASA 在一份任务概述中写道：“11 月 17 日，作为一项工程测试，看看其火箭是否可以在月球上重新启动，测量者号的发动机点火了 2.5 秒，将航天器提升到 12 英尺高，并将其移动到其原始着陆点以西 8 英尺，这是第一次从另一个天体进行动力升空。”

paras.en: The engineering test proved that a spacecraft could land on the moon, and then lift off and take flight once more. That capability was a core requirement for NASA's Apollo astronaut moon landings that followed, since astronauts needed a way to return home after visiting the moon.
paras.zh: 工程试验证明航天器可以登陆月球，然后升空并再次飞行。这种能力是随后美国宇航局阿波罗宇航员登月的核心要求，因为宇航员在访问月球后需要一种返回家园的方式。

paras.en: But there was critical science Surveyor 6 was able to do with the lunar hop.
paras.zh: 但勘测者 6 号能够对月球跳跃进行关键的科学研究。

paras.en: "This maneuver provided excellent views of the surface disturbances produced by the initial landing and the effects of firing rocket engines close to the lunar surface," scientists with the Lunar and Planetary Institute wrote in a summary. "Photography obtained after the hop contributed to the soil mechanics investigation."
paras.zh: 月球与行星研究所的科学家在一份总结中写道：“这次机动提供了关于初始着陆产生的表面扰动以及靠近月球表面发射火箭发动机的影响的绝佳视图。” “跳跃后获得的照片有助于土壤力学研究。”

paras.en: Surveyor 6 also had a bar magnet on its footpad that allowed scientists to test how magnetic the lunar regolith was at the landing site.
paras.zh: 勘测者 6 号的脚垫上还有一块磁条，科学家可以用它来测试着陆点月球风化层的磁性。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。
