paras.en: Donald Trump has said he doesn’t want to talk about Nvidia, the AI giant at the centre of a global espionage scandal, but AI will surely be on the agenda.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，他不想谈论处于全球间谍丑闻中心的人工智能巨头英伟达，但人工智能肯定会提上议程。

paras.en: Countries have called for stronger governance and regulation of AI, as worries grow about its potential for military use and the risks posed by rogue autonomous-agent tools.
paras.zh: 由于人们越来越担心人工智能的军事用途以及流氓自主代理工具带来的风险，各国呼吁加强对人工智能的治理和监管。

paras.en: The China-US talks could build on the AI “communication channel” agreed when Trump and Xi met in Washington in September, Reuters reports.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，中美会谈可能会以特朗普和习近平 9 月在华盛顿会晤时商定的人工智能“沟通渠道”为基础。

paras.en: The next step should be to agree on what constitutes a reportable incident, who has authority to communicate, how quickly notifications must occur and how information can be verified without disclosing sensitive capabilities,” said Marina Zhang from the University of Technology Sydney.
paras.zh: 下一步应该是就什么构成应报告事件、谁有权进行沟通、必须以多快的速度发出通知以及如何在不泄露敏感能力的情况下验证信息达成一致。”悉尼科技大学的玛丽娜·张说。

paras.en: Media reports have also suggested Xi, Putin and Trump may discuss the use of AI in nuclear weapons command systems.
paras.zh: 媒体报道还暗示，习近平、普京和特朗普可能会讨论在核武器指挥系统中使用人工智能。

paras.en: Trump’s predecessor Joe Biden and Xi had agreed in 2024 that any decision to use nuclear weapons should be controlled by humans, not by AI, the White House said.
paras.zh: 白宫表示，特朗普的前任乔·拜登和习近平在 2024 年同意，任何使用核武器的决定都应由人类控制，而不是由人工智能控制。

paras.en: Taiwan’s representative Stan Shih, founder of computer manufacturer Acer, is expected to arrive in Shenzhen with a delegation this morning.
paras.zh: 台湾代表、计算机制造商宏碁创始人施振荣预计将于今天上午率团抵达深圳。

paras.en: Among the 21 Apec member economies, Taiwan’s participation is particularly sensitive, given that host country China claims the self-governing democracy as its territory.
paras.zh: 在亚太经合组织 21 个成员经济体中，台湾的参与尤其敏感，因为东道国中国声称自治民主是其领土。

paras.en: Taiwan joined Apec in 1991 under the name “Chinese Taipei” and remains a full member despite its limited diplomatic recognition. Home to TSMC, the world’s leading contract chipmaker, the island plays a crucial role in the global supply of advanced semiconductors essential to AI, a key focus of discussions at the summit.
paras.zh: 台湾于 1991 年以“中华台北”名义加入亚太经合组织，尽管其外交承认有限，但仍然是正式成员。作为全球领先的代工芯片制造商台积电的所在地，该岛在人工智能所必需的先进半导体的全球供应中发挥着至关重要的作用，这也是峰会讨论的一个重点。

paras.en: Ahead of the summit, China reiterated that Taiwan’s participation in Apec must adhere to its “one-China principle”, a position rejected by Taipei, which insists that its participation as a forum member is not subject to Beijing’s policy.
paras.zh: 峰会前，中国重申台湾参与亚太经合组织必须遵守“一个中国原则”，但台北拒绝了这一立场，坚称其作为论坛成员的参与不受北京政策的约束。

paras.en: A Tuesday poll shows that 71.8% of respondents in Taiwan supported the government’s participation in the Shenzhen summit on “equal and dignified terms.”
paras.zh: 周二的民意调查显示，71.8%的台湾受访者支持政府以“平等和有尊严的条件”参加深圳峰会。

paras.en: Taiwan could also come up in talks between US President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping on the sidelines of the summit on Thursday.
paras.zh: 台湾问题也可能出现在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国领导人习近平周四峰会期间的会谈中。

paras.en: Asked on Tuesday whether Taiwan had communicated with Washington ahead of Trump’s talks with Chinese and Russian leaders, Taiwan’s foreign ministry spokesperson said communication channels with the US are “running smoothly” and the ministry is closely monitoring Trump’s meetings at the summit.
paras.zh: 周二，当被问及特朗普与中国和俄罗斯领导人会谈之前台湾是否与华盛顿进行沟通时，台湾外交部发言人表示，与美国的沟通渠道“运行顺利”，台湾外交部正在密切关注特朗普在峰会上的会晤。

paras.en: Trade tensions are likely to loom over the Apec summit this year, just a year after Trump and Xi Jinping reached a tenuous truce in their trade war on the sidelines of the last Apec summit in South Korea.
paras.zh: 今年的亚太经合组织峰会可能会出现贸易紧张局势，就在特朗普和习近平在韩国上次亚太经合组织峰会期间就贸易战达成脆弱休战一年后。

paras.en: The leaders’ “priority” would be “keeping the truce alive”, especially with another Trump-Xi meeting expected at the G20 summit in Miami in December, said Lizzi Lee, a fellow at the Asia Society Policy Institute (ASPI), as reported by Reuters.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，亚洲协会政策研究所 (ASPI) 研究员丽兹·李 (Lizzi Lee) 表示，领导人的“首要任务”将是“维持休战”，尤其是预计 12 月在迈阿密举行的 G20 峰会上将举行另一场习特会。

paras.en: Countries like Canada are also expected to be looking to broaden their trade partnerships – including with China – to reduce dependence on the United States.
paras.zh: 加拿大等国家预计也将寻求扩大贸易伙伴关系（包括与中国的贸易伙伴关系），以减少对美国的依赖。

paras.en: Trump has of course upended global trade order by imposing wide-ranging tariffs on many countries.
paras.zh: 特朗普当然对许多国家征收大范围关税，从而颠覆了全球贸易秩序。

paras.en: Kim Jong-un had plenty to gain from his three meetings with Donald Trump during the US president’s first term in office.
paras.zh: 金正恩在美国总统第一任期内与唐纳德·特朗普的三次会面中获益匪浅。

paras.en: Seven years on from their last meeting, along the heavily armed border dividing the Korean peninsula, speculation is mounting that the North Korean leader will end their estrangement at this week’s Apec summit in Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 距离上次会面已过去七年，在朝鲜半岛的武装边境线上，越来越多的人猜测朝鲜领导人将在本周于深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会上结束他们的隔阂。

paras.en: But some analysts are casting doubt on the likelihood of a fourth Trump-Kim meeting in the Chinese city.
paras.zh: 但一些分析人士对在中国城市举行第四次特金会的可能性表示怀疑。

paras.en: After making rapid progress with his country’s nuclear and missile programmes and forming a loose “axis of upheaval” with Beijing and Moscow, what, they ask, would Kim have to gain from another encounter with his American counterpart?
paras.zh: 他们问，在朝鲜的核计划和导弹计划取得快速进展并与北京和莫斯科形成松散的“动乱轴心”之后，金正恩将从与美国总统的再次遭遇中获得什么？

paras.en: Apec’s Chinese hosts say they have no information on a possible bilateral, while the US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, appeared to play down the prospect, saying preparations for a dialogue between Kim and Trump did not mean it would happen.
paras.zh: 亚太经合组织的中国东道主表示，他们没有关于可能举行双边会谈的信息，而美国国务卿马可·卢比奥似乎淡化了这一前景，称金正恩和特朗普之间对话的准备并不意味着这种情况会发生。

paras.en: Trump, who floated the idea just before leaving Washington on Monday, has raised the prospect of a resumption of nuclear diplomacy before, yet the men have not met since their brief meeting along the DMZ in June 2019, months after they failed to agree on how US would compensate Pyongyang for dismantling its nuclear arsenal.
paras.zh: 特朗普在周一离开华盛顿之前提出了这一想法，此前曾提出过恢复核外交的前景，但自 2019 年 6 月在非军事区举行短暂会面以来，两人就没有再会面，几个月前，他们未能就美国如何补偿平壤拆除其核武库达成一致。

paras.en: Speculation that Kim would make an appearance alongside other world leaders increased, however, after a report by Russia’s Interfax news agency quoted the Kremlin as saying Vladimir Putin could meet Kim if he attended the Apec summit.
paras.zh: 然而，俄罗斯国际文传电讯社援引克里姆林宫的报道称，如果弗拉基米尔·普京出席亚太经合组织峰会，他可能会与金正恩会面，因此有关金正恩将与其他世界领导人一起亮相的猜测有所增加。

paras.en: The Kremlin “wouldn’t do that unless they were certain he was going to meet”, Sydney Seiler, a former US national intelligence officer for North Korea, now at the Center for Strategic and International Studies, told Reuters. “I’m pretty confident something’s underway.”
paras.zh: 前美国朝鲜国家情报官员、现供职于战略与国际研究中心的西德尼·塞勒 (Sydney Seiler) 告诉路透社，克里姆林宫“除非确定他会面，否则不会这样做”。 “我非常有信心某些事情正在发生。”

paras.en: Others North Korea experts were more skeptical. Kim would have nothing to gain from a trip to Shenzhen except photo opportunities, said Kim Dong-yup, a professor at Kyungnam University’s Far East Institute. “Let’s say they offer to remove sanctions. But sanctions are already not working. There’s nothing to gain for Kim. Why would he go and open himself up to potential uncertainty?”
paras.zh: 其他朝鲜专家则持更为怀疑的态度。庆南大学远东研究所教授金东烨表示，金正恩从深圳之行除了拍照机会之外没有任何收获。 “假设他们提出取消制裁。但制裁已经不起作用了。对金正恩来说没有什么好处。他为什么要让自己暴露在潜在的不确定性之下呢？”

paras.en: North Korean state media have been silent on the speculation. Official photos released this week showed a smiling Kim, accompanied by his wife and daughter, perched on an armchair in the snow at a ski resort near the North Korea-China border.
paras.zh: 朝鲜官方媒体对这一猜测保持沉默。本周发布的官方照片显示，在中朝边境附近的一个滑雪胜地，微笑的金正恩在妻子和女儿的陪​​伴下，坐在雪地里的扶手椅上。

paras.en: Wearing aviator shades, a cigarette dangling from his fingers, Kim did not give the impression he was ready to resurrect his “friendship” with a weakened US president.
paras.zh: 金戴着飞行员墨镜，手指上叼着一支香烟，他并没有给人留下他准备恢复与一位衰弱的美国总统的“友谊”的印象。

paras.en: As mentioned earlier, Zelenskyy is undeniably concerned about the Apec trilateral meeting between the Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 如前所述，泽伦斯基无疑对唐纳德·特朗普、习近平和弗拉基米尔·普京之间的亚太经合组织三边会议感到担忧。

paras.en: Ukraine’s foreign minister Andriy Sybiga said earlier this week that a meeting between US, Chinese and Russian leaders would “only encourage Putin to continue this war”.
paras.zh: 乌克兰外交部长安德烈·西比加本周早些时候表示，美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人之间的会晤“只会鼓励普京继续这场战争”。

paras.en: Beijing has said the three leaders will discuss “safeguarding world peace”, but US officials say Trump is not expected to bring up Russia’s war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 北京表示，三位领导人将讨论“维护世界和平”，但美国官员表示，特朗普预计不会提及俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争。

paras.en: Beijing, insisting it is a neutral party, has never denounced the Russian invasion, and has instead called for peace talks.
paras.zh: 北京坚称自己是中立方，从未谴责俄罗斯的入侵，而是呼吁和平谈判。

paras.en: “Beijing will remain respectful of Russia’s own aims in the war and balance that with growing calls from Europe to exert a little more influence in that regard,” NTU’s Loh said, as reported by Reuters news agency.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，南洋理工大学的罗说：“北京将继续尊重俄罗斯在战争中的自身目标，并平衡欧洲日益要求在这方面发挥更大影响力的呼声。”

paras.en: Putin would probably have the most to gain from the trilateral meeting, ASPI’s Lee added.
paras.zh: ASPI 的 Lee 补充道，普京可能会从三边会议中获益最多。

paras.en: Just being at the table with Trump and Xi would elevate Russia’s standing and potentially shift the conversation toward a broader great-power bargain over European security.
paras.zh: 仅仅与特朗普和习近平坐在谈判桌上就能提升俄罗斯的地位，并有可能将对话转向更广泛的欧洲安全大国讨价还价。

paras.en: Yalta became a byword for betrayal. Will Trump, Xi and Putin enact another carve-up?
paras.zh: 雅尔塔成为背叛的代名词。特朗普、习近平和普京是否会再次瓜分？

paras.en: That is the question the Guardian’s diplomatic correspondent Patrick Wintour seeks to address in his piece about the expected, Putin, Trump and Xi, meeting at Apec on Thursday.
paras.zh: 这是《卫报》外交记者帕特里克·温图尔在其关于普京、特朗普和习近平预计将于周四在亚太经合组织会议上会面的文章中试图解决的问题。

paras.en: Some have likened the impending trilateral (pictured below) to the 1945 meeting between Stalin, Churchill and Roosevelt that that in effect carved up postwar Europe, between a communist-ruled east and a democratic, capitalist west.
paras.zh: 一些人将即将到来的三边会议（如下图所示）比作 1945 年斯大林、丘吉尔和罗斯福之间的会晤，这次会晤实际上将战后的欧洲瓜分在共产主义统治的东方和民主资本主义的西方之间。

paras.en: Among those concerned about the meeting, he writes, is Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 他写道，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基（Volodymyr Zelenskyy）是对这次会议感到担忧的人之一。

paras.en: It is a truism in diplomacy that if you are not around the table, the risk is that you, or your values, are on the menu and about to be carved up. Many excluded from the summit in Shenzhen, principally Ukraine but also eastern Europe and Baltic countries, Taiwan and even Iran, have reason to be nervous that their sponsors might abandon them in a complex geopolitical trade-off that Putin envisions, and Trump seems to endorse.
paras.zh: 外交上有一条不言而喻的道理：如果你不在谈判桌旁，那么你或你的价值观就会出现在菜单上并即将被瓜分的风险。许多被排除在深圳峰会之外的国家，主要是乌克兰，还有东欧和波罗的海国家、台湾，甚至伊朗，都有理由担心他们的赞助商可能会在普京所设想的复杂的地缘政治权衡中放弃他们，而特朗普似乎也支持这种权衡。

paras.en: The Australian prime minister, Anthony Albanese, has arrived in Shenzhen for the Apec summit, and confirmed he will join a leaders’ “family photo” despite the presence of Russia’s Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞已抵达深圳参加亚太经合组织峰会，并确认尽管俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京也在场，他仍将参加领导人的“全家福”。

paras.en: Albanese said he would respect the wishes of host country China and take part, echoing the explanation of the Canadian prime minister, Mark Carney. But, Albanese said would make clear Australia’s view on Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内斯表示，他将尊重东道国中国的意愿并参加，这与加拿大总理马克·卡尼的解释相呼应。但是，阿尔巴内塞表示将明确澳大利亚对俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的看法。

paras.en: This is a big power intervening in an illegal way to try to assert its will and underestimating the will and courage and conviction of the Ukrainian people to fight for their national sovereignty.
paras.zh: 这是一个大国以非法方式进行干预，试图维护自己的意志，低估了乌克兰人民争取国家主权的意愿、勇气和信念。

paras.en: After Tuesday’s Quad summit in Manila, Albanese talked up the cooperation of middle powers in this week’s roster of international summits.
paras.zh: 周二在马尼拉举行的四方峰会之后，阿尔巴尼斯在本周的国际峰会名单中谈到了中等强国的合作。

paras.en: Absolutely there is a role for middle power diplomacy, and we’ll see at Apec, the engagement that we’ll have with countries such as Canada and Mexico, Korea, Japan.
paras.zh: 中等强国外交绝对可以发挥作用，我们将在亚太经合组织上看到我们将与加拿大、墨西哥、韩国、日本等国家进行接触。

paras.en: They are important partners for Australia.
paras.zh: 他们是澳大利亚的重要合作伙伴。

paras.en: Albanese is due to meet China’s president Xi Jinping on Friday.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内塞将于周五会见中国国家主席习近平。

paras.en: Donald Trump, meanwhile, has not arrived in Shenzhen yet, writes our correspondent Rebecca Bailey, reporting from the Chinese tech hub.
paras.zh: 与此同时，我们的记者丽贝卡·贝利在中国科技中心报道称，唐纳德·特朗普尚未抵达深圳。

paras.en: He was last seen at the start of talks with Philippine president Ferdinand Marcos Jr in Manila, where Reuters reported he said he was not concerned about the situation in the hotly contested South China Sea.
paras.zh: 他最后一次出现是在马尼拉与菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯举行会谈时，据路透社报道，他表示他并不担心争议激烈的南海局势。

paras.en: The US alliance with the Philippines has never been better, Trump added.
paras.zh: 特朗普补充说，美国与菲律宾的联盟从未如此美好。

paras.en: The US leader also touted an expansion of defence cooperation with Manila and suggested US nuclear technology could help ease the country’s energy woes.
paras.zh: 这位美国领导人还宣扬扩大与马尼拉的防务合作，并表示美国的核技术可以帮助缓解该国的能源困境。

paras.en: Speaking to the press in Manila, US secretary of state Marco Rubio has addressed speculation that North Korean leader Kim Jong-un will attend the Apec summit.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥在马尼拉向媒体发表讲话，回应了有关朝鲜领导人金正恩将出席亚太经合组织峰会的猜测。

paras.en: Asked how serious the idea was, Rubio said:
paras.zh: 当被问及这个想法有多认真时，卢比奥说：

paras.en: It’s serious in the sense that I think the president has never viewed meeting and talking to someone as a concession. He has often made the case – and I think rightfully so – that, how are you going to solve problems with people you have disagreements with if you don’t speak to them, if you’re not willing to engage with them?
paras.zh: 从某种意义上说，这是严肃的，因为我认为总统从未将与某人会面和交谈视为让步。他经常提出这样的观点——我认为这是正确的——如果你不与那些与你有分歧的人交谈，如果你不愿意与他们接触，你将如何解决他们的问题？

paras.en: I think there’s been this conventional thought in American foreign policy that if you meet with someone, you give them credibility; if you meet with someone, you somehow are saying that everything they’re doing is good or right. And that’s not the way the president views it, and I’m glad he doesn’t view it that way.
paras.zh: 我认为美国外交政策中有这样一种传统观念：如果你会见某人，你就给了他们可信度；如果你遇到某人，你就在说他们所做的一切都是好的或正确的。总统并不这么看，我很高兴他不这么看。

paras.en: The president views it this way – if we have a problem with North Korea, the only way we’re ever going to solve it is if we engage with them. Now, that may not be possible, and I’m not telling you that there will be a meeting tomorrow. I’m just saying that that’s – the president is willing to meet and discuss, as he did during his first term. Whether that will lead to a positive outcome, we’ll never find out if we don’t try. And it may not happen, but he’s prepared to do it. He has made that clear in the past.
paras.zh: 总统是这样认为的——如果我们与朝鲜有问题，解决问题的唯一方法就是与他们接触。现在，这可能是不可能的，我也不会告诉你明天会有一个会议。我只是说，总统愿意开会讨论，就像他在第一个任期内所做的那样。如果我们不尝试，我们永远不会知道这是否会带来积极的结果。这可能不会发生，但他已经准备好了。他过去已经明确表示过这一点。

paras.en: Presidents Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin have just begun talks, according to state media from both countries, reports our correspondent, Rebecca Bailey, from Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 据我们驻深圳记者丽贝卡·贝利报道，据两国官方媒体报道，习近平主席和普京总统刚刚开始会谈。

paras.en: Earlier Putin told the Apec summit he expected tomorrow’s much anticipated trilateral meeting with Trump and Xi to be “highly useful”.
paras.zh: 普京早些时候在亚太经合组织峰会上表示，他预计明天备受期待的特朗普和习近平三边会议将“非常有用”。

paras.en: The Russian president took to the stage after Malaysia’s prime minister Anwar Ibrahim for a punchy speech that took aim at Russia’s detractors and pitched expanded economic cooperation with Apec.
paras.zh: 在马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣之后，俄罗斯总统上台发表了强有力的讲话，针对俄罗斯的批评者，并提出扩大与亚太经合组织的经济合作。

paras.en: Western sanctions imposed on Moscow since his 2022 invasion of Ukraine have “failed” and Russia has come through “with dignity”, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，自2022年入侵乌克兰以来，西方对莫斯科实施的制裁“失败了”，俄罗斯“有尊严地”渡过了难关。

paras.en: In a contemporary world full of turbulence, amidst the fragmentation of the global economy, and at a time when military-political risks are on the rise, what is desperately needed is unity rather than division, equality rather than hegemony, partnership rather than isolation, and dialogue rather than ultimatums.
paras.zh: 在当今世界动荡不安、全球经济碎片化、军事政治风险上升的背景下，迫切需要的是团结而不是分裂、平等而不是霸权、伙伴而不是孤立、对话而不是最后通牒。

paras.en: Well, the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) club has 21 members that represent more than 50% of global GDP and are home to about 2.7 billion people.
paras.zh: 亚太经合组织（APEC）俱乐部有 21 个成员，占全球 GDP 的 50% 以上，拥有约 27 亿人口。

paras.en: China, Russia and the US are three of the largest members. Others include Australia, Canada, Indonesia, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea, Singapore, and Vietnam.
paras.zh: 中国、俄罗斯和美国是最大的三个成员。其他国家包括澳大利亚、加拿大、印度尼西亚、日本、韩国、墨西哥、新西兰、巴布亚新几内亚、新加坡和越南。

paras.en: Read below our handy short explainer on how it all started.
paras.zh: 请阅读下面我们方便的简短解释，了解这一切是如何开始的。

paras.en: The Asia Group’s George Chen is at the CEO summit and sent the Guardian some thoughts on Xi’s speech, which he said was “largely expected”, featuring technology and innovation prominently.
paras.zh: 亚洲集团的陈乔治出席了首席执行官峰会，他向《卫报》表达了对习近平讲话的一些看法，他表示这次讲话“很大程度上符合预期”，突出强调了技术和创新。

paras.en: Xi positioned China as “a force for stability and predictability in an increasingly uncertain world”, he said.
paras.zh: 他表示，习近平将中国定位为“在日益不确定的世界中保持稳定和可预测性的力量”。

paras.en: While Xi never mentioned export controls, Nvidia or the United States directly in his speech, the underlying message was unmistakable: China intends to pursue a more open and cooperative approach to technology development. That message is likely to resonate with many countries in the Global South and reinforces Beijing’s effort to contrast its technology strategy with that of Washington.”
paras.zh: 尽管习近平在讲话中从未直接提及出口管制、英伟达或美国，但其背后的信息是明确无误的：中国打算在技术开发方面采取更加开放和合作的方式。这一信息可能会引起全球南方许多国家的共鸣，并加强北京将其技术战略与华盛顿进行对比的努力。”

paras.en: Xi Jinping calls for freer trade, greater cooperation on AI
paras.zh: 习近平呼吁更加自由的贸易、加强人工智能合作

paras.en: President Xi Jinping addressed the Apec CEO summit this morning. His speech called for the elimination of trade and investment barriers, as well as greater cooperation around artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 今天上午，习近平主席在亚太经合组织工商领导人峰会上发表讲话。他的讲话呼吁消除贸易和投资壁垒，并加强人工智能方面的合作。

paras.en: He also emphasised the importance of the World Trade Organization, and said China was expanding its imports of quality goods and services.
paras.zh: 他还强调了世界贸易组织的重要性，并表示中国正在扩大优质商品和服务的进口。

paras.en: We should not only eliminate trade and investment barriers... but also promote inclusive and balanced development.
paras.zh: 我们不仅要消除贸易和投资壁垒……还要促进包容、平衡发展。

paras.en: We should actively build partnerships for scientific and technological innovation, deepen cooperation in the digital economy and artificial intelligence and promote a green and low-carbon transition.”
paras.zh: 我们要积极构建科技创新伙伴关系，深化数字经济、人工智能合作，推动绿色低碳转型。”

paras.en: We’re back for day two of the Apec CEO Summit in China’s southern tech hub of Shenzhen. Today the summit will be addressed by APEC leaders, with President Xi Jinping set to give a keynote speech.
paras.zh: 我们回来参加在中国南方科技中心深圳举行的亚太经合组织工商领导人峰会的第二天。今天的峰会将由亚太经合组织领导人发表讲话，习近平主席将发表主旨演讲。

paras.en: Bilateral meetings will continue on the sidelines, although the most eye-catching – Xi and Donald Trump, and the US-China-Russia trilateral – won’t be until Thursday. Vladimir Putin arrived in Shenzhen this morning, greeted by a red carpet, soldiers and pom pom-waving dancers dressed in fuchsia and blue. Communist party politburo member Cai Qi, often described as Xi’s right-hand man, was there to meet him.
paras.zh: 双边会议将在场外继续举行，不过最引人注目的会议 — — 习近平和唐纳德·特朗普以及美中俄三边会议 — — 要到周四才会举行。弗拉基米尔·普京今天早上抵达深圳，迎接他的是红地毯、穿着紫红色和蓝色衣服的士兵和挥舞绒球的舞者。经常被称为习近平得力助手的中共中央政治局委员蔡奇在那里会见他。

paras.en: Trump will leave Manila, where he has been attending the Asean forum, later on Wednesday. The Associated Press reports that he has expressed excitement about his own welcome ceremony: “I hear we’re going to have quite a landing,” he told reporters. “It’s going to be a beautiful thing.”
paras.zh: 特朗普将于周三晚些时候离开马尼拉，他一直在那里参加东盟论坛。据美联社报道，他对自己的欢迎仪式表示了兴奋：“我听说我们将顺利着陆，”他告诉记者。 “这将是一件美好的事情。”

paras.en: Aside from the high-level hobnobbing, delegates are “working around the clock” to agree on a joint statement for Thursday, a senior Apec official told Reuters on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 亚太经合组织一位高级官员周二告诉路透社，除了高层交往之外，代表们还在“夜以继日地工作”，以就周四的联合声明达成一致。

paras.en: Carlos Kuriyama, director of the Apec policy support unit, said all 21 Apec members agreed on the need to ensure trade is “not only open, but also fair”.
paras.zh: APEC政策支持部门主任卡洛斯·栗山表示，所有21个APEC成员都同意需要确保贸易“不仅开放，而且公平”。

paras.en: He said they were also discussing the safe and responsible use of artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 他说，他们还在讨论安全和负责任地使用人工智能。

paras.en: They are working very hard to make sure that we can have a common language.”
paras.zh: 他们正在非常努力地确保我们能够拥有共同语言。”

paras.en: It’s been a big week already for diplomatic summits, with the most anticipated among them, the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) leader’s meeting, starting today in the Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 对于外交峰会来说，这已经是重要的一周，其中最受期待的是今天在中国科技中心深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议。

paras.en: Some observers have noted that we could be about to witness a Yalta 2.0, a reference to a major 1945 wartime conference attended by Churchill, Roosevelt and Stalin.
paras.zh: 一些观察家指出，我们可能即将见证雅尔塔 2.0，这是指 1945 年丘吉尔、罗斯福和斯大林出席的一次大型战时会议。

paras.en: That’s because the leaders of the US, China and Russia – namely Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin – will meet for trilateral talks at the summit to discuss the wars in Iran and Ukraine, denuclearisation, economics, tech and trade.
paras.zh: 这是因为美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人——即唐纳德·特朗普、习近平和弗拉基米尔·普京——将在峰会上举行三边会谈，讨论伊朗和乌克兰战争、无核化、经济、科技和贸易。

paras.en: Trump has also floated the possibility of meeting North Korea’s Kim Jong-un in what would be their first meeting of his second term.
paras.zh: 特朗普还提出了与朝鲜金正恩会面的可能性，这将是他第二任期内的首次会面。

paras.en: Here is a quick recap of the latest before the event kicks off:
paras.zh: 以下是活动开始前的最新情况的快速回顾：

paras.en: China’s foreign ministry said the leaders “will exchange views in-depth on safeguarding world peace and promoting strategic stability in major-power relations, which is of groundbreaking significance”. The ministry added that: “Stronger communication among China, Russia and the United States, along with managing differences and stabilising relations, serves the interests of all three countries.”
paras.zh: 中国外交部表示，领导人“将就维护世界和平、促进大国关系战略稳定深入交换意见，具有开创性意义”。该部补充说：“中俄美之间加强沟通，管控分歧，稳定关系，符合这三个国家的利益。”

paras.en: The Kremlin said: “The significance and symbolism of this meeting are hard to overestimate.” But it has dismissed comparisons with the 1945 Yalta meeting saying they were just “games of political scientists”.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫表示：“这次会议的意义和象征意义怎么估计都不为过。”但它否认了与 1945 年雅尔塔会议的比较，称这只是“政治科学家的游戏”。

paras.en: In a call this week, China’s top diplomat, Wang Yi, and the US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, “agreed on the importance of meaningful leader-level conversations to advance goals such as peace and denuclearisation”, the US state department said.
paras.zh: 美国国务院表示，在本周的一次通话中，中国最高外交官王毅和美国国务卿马可·卢比奥“一致认为，进行有意义的领导人级别对话对于推进和平与无核化等目标的重要性”。

articles.title: Philippines police ask prosecutors to charge Thomas Markle over child sex abuse material

paras.en: Police in the Philippines have asked prosecutors to charge Thomas Markle Sr, the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, with possession of and intent to distribute child sexual abuse material.
paras.zh: 菲律宾警方已要求检察官指控苏塞克斯公爵夫人梅根的父亲老托马斯·马克尔持有并意图传播儿童性虐待材料。

paras.en: Cebu province prosecutor Graeme Elmido told the BBC that police had filed documents requesting that Markle be charged on Monday.
paras.zh: 宿务省检察官格雷姆·埃尔米多 (Graeme Elmido) 告诉 BBC，警方已于周一提交文件，要求对马克尔提出指控。

paras.en: Earlier this month, Markle, 82, was separately arrested and charged in the US with possession of child sexual abuse material. The FBI said agents seized about 78 items, including film negatives, slides and books that they allege contained child sex abuse material, from storage units Markle rented.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，82 岁的马克尔在美国单独被捕，并被指控持有儿童性虐待材料。 FBI 表示，探员从马克尔租用的储藏室中查获了约 78 件物品，其中包括他们声称含有儿童性虐待材料的电影底片、幻灯片和书籍。

paras.en: Markle, who is in custody in the US, has previously denied the allegations. The BBC has contacted Markle's attorney for comment.
paras.zh: 在美国被拘留的马克尔此前否认了这些指控。 BBC 已联系马克尔的律师征求意见。

paras.en: Elmido told the BBC that Philippine National Police had asked prosecutors to charge Markle with "two counts of intent to distribute CSAEM [child sexual abuse and exploitation material], and one count of possession of CSAEM material".
paras.zh: 埃尔米多告诉 BBC，菲律宾国家警察已要求检察官指控马克尔“两项意图分发 CSAEM（儿童性虐待和性剥削材料）的罪名，以及一项持有 CSAEM 材料的罪名”。

paras.en: Last month, police in the Philippines obtained a warrant to examine devices allegedly removed from Markle's former home in the country.
paras.zh: 上个月，菲律宾警方获得搜查令，对据称从马克尔在该国的故居中移走的设备进行检查。

paras.en: Four boxes of material, including computers, phones, hard drives and old video tapes, were handed to officers by Meghan's half brother Thomas Markle Jr.
paras.zh: 梅根同父异母的弟弟小托马斯·马克尔将四箱材料交给了警方，其中包括电脑、手机、硬盘和旧录像带。

paras.en: Earlier this month, Markle Sr was arrested and charged in the US. He had initially been placed under house detention at his assisted living facility in Florida, but was taken back into custody last week after prosecutors alleged he removed his ankle monitor.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，老马克尔在美国被捕并受到指控。他最初被软禁在佛罗里达州的辅助生活设施中，但在检察官指控他取下脚踝监视器后，上周又被重新拘留。

paras.en: Meghan Markle has been estranged from her father since 2018. The BBC understands she broke contact with him last year, telling him she and the authorities knew he had abused young girls.
paras.zh: 自 2018 年以来，梅根·马克尔一直与父亲疏远。BBC 获悉，她去年与父亲断绝了联系，并告诉他，她和当局都知道他虐待了年轻女孩。

paras.en: In a previously shared statement after the allegations against her father emerged, Meghan wrote: "I am deeply distressed... my thoughts are with any children who may have been harmed."
paras.zh: 在针对她父亲的指控曝光后，梅根在此前发表的一份声明中写道：“我深感悲痛……我的心与所有可能受到伤害的孩子在一起。”

paras.en: She said she hoped it could be understood why she had largely cut off contact from her father and did "not allow him to have contact with our children".
paras.zh: 她说，她希望人们能够理解为什么她基本上切断了与父亲的联系，并且“不允许他与我们的孩子接触”。

articles.title: As Trump and Xi meet, China's AI dreams face an unexpected hurdle: the Nvidia spy scandal

paras.en: Jensen Huang is out but his shadow looms over the upcoming meeting between US President Donald Trump and his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping this week.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋缺席了，但他的阴影笼罩着美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国国家主席习近平本周即将举行的会晤。

paras.en: For Beijing, the former Nvidia CEO's dramatic fall is a major challenge - and not just because of claims that a Chinese spy may have honey-trapped Huang, one of the artificial intelligence industry's most influential figures.
paras.zh: 对北京来说，这位英伟达前首席执行官的急剧下台是一个重大挑战，而不仅仅是因为有人声称中国间谍可能对人工智能行业最有影响力的人物之一黄黄进行了诱捕。

paras.en: Rather, the allegations surrounding Huang and his affair with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang are turning into a new flashpoint in an already fragile US-China relationship.
paras.zh: 相反，围绕黄及其与中国女商人黄爱丽的风流韵事的指控正在成为本已脆弱的中美关系的新爆发点。

paras.en: US intelligence reports claim she had ties to Beijing's intelligence apparatus - in particular the Ministry of State Security, China's main civilian spy agency.
paras.zh: 美国情报报告称她与北京的情报机构有联系，特别是中国主要的民间间谍机构国家安全部。

paras.en: The claim remains unproven, but it has already reignited debate in Washington over exports of advanced chips to China and whether the Trump administration has been too willing to ease restrictions.
paras.zh: 这一说法尚未得到证实，但它已经在华盛顿重新引发了有关向中国出口先进芯片以及特朗普政府是否过于愿意放松限制的争论。

paras.en: For years now, advanced computer chips have been a key battleground in the US-China rivalry because they are essential for AI, supercomputing and military technology.
paras.zh: 多年来，先进的计算机芯片一直是中美竞争的关键战场，因为它们对于人工智能、超级计算和军事技术至关重要。

paras.en: Chinese officials are worried this scandal could strengthen voices in Washington who argue in favour of further limiting Chinese access to cutting-edge American tech.
paras.zh: 中国官员担心这一丑闻可能会增强华盛顿支持进一步限制中国获得美国尖端技术的声音。

paras.en: Just this week, the Trump administration introduced new export restrictions on Chinese firms that access advanced US chips in third countries such as Malaysia, Thailand or Brazil. They typically do this by renting computing power in data centres abroad to train their AI models. But some of the firms, like the one Alice Huang worked for, are also accused of smuggling chips to China, although they have denied this.
paras.zh: 就在本周，特朗普政府对在马来西亚、泰国或巴西等第三国获取先进美国芯片的中国公司实施了新的出口限制。他们通常通过在国外数据中心租用计算能力来训练他们的人工智能模型来做到这一点。但一些公司，比如黄爱丽工作过的公司，也被指控向中国走私芯片，尽管他们否认了这一点。

paras.en: Until now, this controversy appeared to be a sideshow in US-China relations. But with Beijing calling the new rules "economic coercion" on the eve of Trump arriving in Shenzhen, there is a growing risk it could become something much bigger.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，这场争议似乎只是美中关系中的一个小插曲。但随着北京在特朗普抵达深圳前夕将新规定称为“经济胁迫”，其规模可能变得更大的风险越来越大。

paras.en: Democrats, who will control Congress come January, have made their position clear. Last Wednesday top Democrat Ted Lieu told Politico the Trump administration had been "1,000%" too deferential to Nvidia, putting national security at risk, while fellow Democrat Zoe Lofgren suggested Congress would now be more likely to restrict sales of AI chips to China.
paras.zh: 一月份将控制国会的民主党人已经明确表明了自己的立场。上周三，民主党领袖泰德·刘 (Ted Lieu) 告诉 Politico，特朗普政府“1000%”对英伟达过于恭敬，使国家安全面临风险，而民主党同僚佐伊·洛夫格伦 (Zoe Lofgren) 则表示，国会现在更有可能限制向中国销售人工智能芯片。

paras.en: The BBC has approached the White House for comment.
paras.zh: BBC 已联系白宫寻求评论。

paras.en: Beijing's foreign ministry had described the spy claims as a "smear against China".
paras.zh: 北京外交部将这些间谍指控描述为“对中国的抹黑”。

paras.en: "The US should stop fabricating so-called espionage narratives to find pretexts for imposing technological blockades," spokesperson Mao Ning said last week.
paras.zh: “美方应停止编造所谓间谍言论，为实施技术封锁寻找借口，”发言人毛宁上周表示。

paras.en: The ministry also seemed keen to keep the meeting on track, saying the two countries had kept "close communication regarding interactions between the two heads of state".
paras.zh: 该部似乎也热衷于让会议保持在正轨上，并表示两国“就两国元首之间的互动保持着密切沟通”。

paras.en: For the last year, Trump and Xi have been seeking to stabilise relations after a damaging tariff war that almost brought trade between the two countries to a standstill.
paras.zh: 去年，在一场几乎导致两国贸易陷入停滞的破坏性关税战之后，特朗普和习近平一直在寻求稳定关系。

paras.en: The Trump administration's decision to permit sales of advanced Nvidia H200 chips to China in late 2025 was seen as evidence that both sides were searching for areas of co-operation, even while competition intensified.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府决定在 2025 年底允许向中国销售先进的 Nvidia H200 芯片，这被视为双方正在寻找合作领域的证据，即使竞争加剧。

paras.en: It was a rare move given Washington had spent years trying to limit China's access to the most advanced chips.
paras.zh: 鉴于华盛顿多年来一直试图限制中国获得最先进的芯片，这是一个罕见的举动。

paras.en: Many in the US have long viewed these chips as a national security issue, arguing they could strengthen China's military and surveillance capabilities. Jensen Huang, who rejects that claim, advocated lifting bans on the export of high-performing chips to China. Beijing argues the restrictions are an attempt to contain its rise.
paras.zh: 长期以来，许多美国人一直将这些芯片视为国家安全问题，认为它们可以增强中国的军事和监视能力。黄仁勋否认了这一说法，主张取消对中国出口高性能芯片的禁令。北京方面辩称，这些限制是为了遏制其崛起。

paras.en: History has taught Beijing and Washington that spy scandals rarely remain confined to the intelligence world.
paras.zh: 历史告诉北京和华盛顿，间谍丑闻很少只局限于情报界。

paras.en: Analysts in China already see echoes of an incident in 2023 when a suspected surveillance balloon drifted through the skies over the US before an American fighter jet shot it down. Beijing insisted it was a civilian meteorological airship that had strayed off course.
paras.zh: 中国的分析人士已经看到了2023年发生的事件的回声，当时一个可疑的监视气球飘过美国上空，然后被美国战斗机击落。北京坚称这是一艘偏离航线的民用气象飞艇。

paras.en: But a planned trip by then US Secretary of State Antony Blinken was cancelled and communication between the two governments deteriorated sharply.
paras.zh: 但时任美国国务卿安东尼·布林肯的访问计划被取消，两国政府之间的沟通急剧恶化。

paras.en: The incident showed how quickly a security dispute could overwhelm diplomatic efforts and push relations into a deep freeze.
paras.zh: 这一事件表明，安全争端可能会很快压垮外交努力，并使两国关系陷入深度冻结。

paras.en: "The mere passage of a balloon sent American public opinion and politicians into a state of high alert, as if a "Chinese threat" were looming directly overhead," said the state media outlet, the Global Times this week as it made a direct comparison with the Nvidia scandal.
paras.zh: 官方媒体《环球时报》本周将其与英伟达丑闻进行了直接比较，称“仅仅气球的通过就让美国舆论和政界人士进入了高度戒备状态，仿佛‘中国威胁’正迫在眉睫”。

paras.en: "No-one on the US side has ever apologised or taken responsibility for the genuine damage this caused to US-China relations," it added.
paras.zh: “美方没有人为此事对中美关系造成的真正损害道歉或承担责任，”声明补充道。

paras.en: The state-run outlet also questioned why the Nvidia story had emerged so soon after "the hard-won detente" between Beijing and Washington, following a meeting between the two countries' leaders in September.
paras.zh: 这家官方媒体还质疑，在中美两国领导人九月份会晤后，北京和华盛顿之间“来之不易的缓和”之后，为何英伟达的故事这么快就出现了。

paras.en: "Is someone behind the scenes pushing an agenda and stirring up confrontation?" it asked.
paras.zh: “是否有人在幕后推动议程、煽动对抗？”它问道。

paras.en: Both Trump and Xi have significant incentives to keep talking.
paras.zh: 特朗普和习近平都有很大的动力继续对话。

paras.en: China's economy remains under pressure and is increasingly reliant on exports. Xi needs trade to keep flowing and this meeting is a key stepping stone to replacing the current trade truce that is due to expire in January.
paras.zh: 中国经济仍然面临压力，对出口的依赖日益加大。习近平需要贸易保持畅通，这次会议是取代目前将于一月份到期的贸易休战的关键垫脚石。

paras.en: Meanwhile Trump has repeatedly touted his close relationship with Xi and argued that maintaining dialogue is essential to managing competition between the two powers.
paras.zh: 与此同时，特朗普一再宣扬他与习近平的密切关系，并认为保持对话对于管理两个大国之间的竞争至关重要。

paras.en: The US president is in his last two years and faces an uphill struggle to pass domestic legislation after the midterms. To counter this, he could be looking for some foreign policy wins.
paras.zh: 这位美国总统已经在他任期的最后两年，在中期选举后面临着通过国内立法的艰苦斗争。为了应对这一点，他可能会寻求一些外交政策上的胜利。

paras.en: He may also hope for Xi's help to end the war in the Middle East.
paras.zh: 他可能还希望习近平帮助结束中东战争。

paras.en: Neither side will want to be discussing intelligence concerns and technology controls instead of trade, investment and economic co-operation.
paras.zh: 双方都不想讨论情报问题和技术控制，而不是贸易、投资和经济合作。

paras.en: The summit is also being carefully choreographed by Beijing to show off its technological prowess in Shenzhen - a deeply symbolic choice of city.
paras.zh: 此次峰会也是北京精心策划的，目的是在深圳展示其技术实力，深圳是一座具有深刻象征意义的城市。

paras.en: It's home to some of the country's biggest tech companies and has become a showcase for Beijing's ambitions in AI and advanced manufacturing.
paras.zh: 它是中国一些最大科技公司的所在地，并已成为北京在人工智能和先进制造领域雄心的展示地。

paras.en: Also, given Washington's tighter restrictions on advanced chips, Beijing has options for retaliation.
paras.zh: 此外，鉴于华盛顿对先进芯片的限制更加严格，北京也有报复的选择。

paras.en: One of its most powerful tools is its dominance of key rare earth minerals. China processes much of the world's supply for materials that are used in everything from electric vehicles and smartphones to military equipment.
paras.zh: 其最强大的工具之一是其对关键稀土矿物的主导地位。中国加工了全球大部分材料供应，这些材料用于从电动汽车、智能手机到军事装备等各个领域。

paras.en: Analysts have long warned that technological restrictions can trigger a cycle of retaliation in which each side reaches for its strongest economic leverage.
paras.zh: 分析人士长期以来一直警告说，技术限制可能会引发报复循环，各方​​都会发挥其最强的经济杠杆作用。

paras.en: That would shift the current trend of US-China relations from engagement back towards mutual suspicion.
paras.zh: 这将使当前美中关系的趋势从接触转向相互猜疑。

articles.title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as it reports soaring sales

paras.en: Nvidia has firmly ruled out letting ousted co-founder Jensen Huang return as it revealed that sales doubled to more than $100bn.
paras.zh: Nvidia 坚决排除让被驱逐的联合创始人黄仁勋回归的可能性，因为该公司透露销售额翻了一番，超过 1000 亿美元。

paras.en: In the company's first results since Huang's dramatic exit last week, interim chief executive Colette Kress said it is "business as usual" and told investors: "We've got this."
paras.zh: 自黄上周戏剧性退出以来，该公司首次公布业绩，临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)表示，公司“一切照常”，并告诉投资者：“我们已经做到了。”

paras.en: Earlier on Tuesday, Huang said he would be "honoured" to return and lead Nvidia, having quit following alleged extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected spy for China.
paras.zh: 周二早些时候，黄仁勋表示，他将“很荣幸”重返英伟达并领导英伟达，此前他因涉嫌婚外情而辞职，其中包括与一名涉嫌中国间谍的婚外情。

paras.en: But Nvidia's chair Harvey Jones, said "The board does not intend to reinstate him."
paras.zh: 但英伟达董事长哈维·琼斯表示，“董事会不打算恢复他的职位。”

paras.en: Nvidia reported that sales for the three months to 25 October rose to $115.8bn (Â£86.9bn), with shares in the company jumping by 4.8% in after-hours trading.
paras.zh: 英伟达报告称，截至 10 月 25 日的三个月销售额升至 1,158 亿美元（869 亿英镑），该公司股价在盘后交易中上涨 4.8%。

paras.en: The company's profits also doubled from a year ago rising to $65bn. Sales from data centres, a significant part of Nvidia's business, also doubled to $107bn.
paras.zh: 该公司的利润也比一年前翻了一番，达到 650 亿美元。数据中心是英伟达业务的重要组成部分，其销售额也翻了一番，达到 1070 亿美元。

paras.en: The company said its rapid growth is poised to continue and revenue will rise by another 13% in the next quarter.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，其快速增长势头将持续，下一季度收入将再增长13%。

paras.en: Given the uncertainty surrounding the company after Huang's exit, financial analysts had been unsure that Nvidia would provide any forward-looking guidance.
paras.zh: 鉴于黄仁勋退出后公司面临的不确定性，财务分析师一直不确定英伟达是否会提供任何前瞻性指导。

paras.en: Daniela Hathorn, a senior analyst for trading platform Capital.com, said Nvidia's results "offer a strong answer to concerns that demand for AI infrastructure is cooling" and temper immediate worries that Huang was irreplaceable as a leader.
paras.zh: 交易平台 Capital.com 的高级分析师 Daniela Hathorn 表示，英伟达的业绩“为人们对人工智能基础设施需求正在降温的担忧提供了强有力的答案”，并缓解了人们对黄仁勋作为领导者的不可替代性的担忧。

paras.en: "The harder question is whether Nvidia can preserve the strategic advantage Huang helped build," Hathorn added. "His exit is unlikely to change orders already committed, but could matter more when Nvidia makes its next round of decisions on products, partnerships and investment."
paras.zh: “更难的问题是英伟达是否能够保留黄仁勋帮助建立的战略优势，”哈索恩补充道。 “他的退出不太可能改变已经承诺的订单，但当英伟达就产品、合作伙伴关系和投资做出下一轮决定时，影响可能会更大。”

paras.en: Kress seemed eager to stress that Nvidia can continue to not only succeed, but lead the ongoing AI buildout that is happening throughout the technology industry.
paras.zh: 克雷斯似乎急于强调，英伟达不仅可以继续取得成功，而且可以引领整个科技行业正在进行的人工智能建设。

paras.en: "It is business as usual," she said. "Our partners, our suppliers, all of them are 100% behind us."
paras.zh: “一切如常，”她说。 “我们的合作伙伴、我们的供应商，他们都 100% 支持我们。”

paras.en: She added that Nvidia's leadership team has "stood up very strongly over the last week... working seamlessly in all of their departments and projects".
paras.zh: 她补充说，英伟达的领导团队“在过去一周表现得非常强劲……在所有部门和项目中无缝工作”。

paras.en: "Our momentum is real. Our demand is accelerating. Our supply is growing. Our customers and our partners are with us, and employees are committed." Kress said before leaving the analyst call. "We've got this."
paras.zh: “我们的动力是真实的。我们的需求在加速。我们的供应在增长。我们的客户和合作伙伴与我们同在，员工也尽心尽力。”克雷斯在分析师电话会议结束前说道。 “我们有这个。”

paras.en: The interim chief executive also said Nvidia is no longer shipping Hopper data centre semiconductors to China.
paras.zh: 这位临时首席执行官还表示，英伟达将不再向中国运送 Hopper 数据中心半导体。

paras.en: The Hopper technology is in Nvidia's advanced H200 processors, which the firm won approval to sell in China after Huang's repeated lobbying efforts in Washington.
paras.zh: Hopper技术应用在英伟达先进的H200处理器中，经过黄仁勋在华盛顿的反复游说努力，该公司获得了在中国销售该处理器的许可。

paras.en: They had previously been restricted over concerns that selling them to China would give its industries and military an edge over the US.
paras.zh: 此前，由于担心将其出售给中国会使其工业和军事比美国更具优势，它们曾受到限制。

paras.en: Kress did not elaborate on why the shipments had been stopped.
paras.zh: 克雷斯没有详细说明为何停止发货。

paras.en: Jones saying earlier that the company would not answer analysts' questions about Huang or Nvidia's investigation into his conduct, he did address the search for a permanent replacement.
paras.zh: 琼斯早些时候表示，该公司不会回答分析师有关黄仁勋或英伟达对其行为的调查的问题，但他确实谈到了寻找永久替代者的问题。

paras.en: He said Nvidia is working with an executive search firm and is considering internal and external candidates, but that the company would not rush its selection.
paras.zh: 他表示，英伟达正在与一家猎头公司合作，正在考虑内部和外部候选人，但该公司不会仓促选择。

paras.en: "With the advanced technology and the national security dynamics in the marketplace, our new chief executive will have to navigate those waters carefully," Jones said. "The search will be thorough and we want to do it as quickly as possible, but we won't do it before we find the exact right person."
paras.zh: 琼斯说：“随着市场上的先进技术和国家安全动态，我们的新任首席执行官将必须小心谨慎地驾驭这些领域。” “搜索将是彻底的，我们希望尽快完成，但在找到合适的人选之前我们不会这样做。”

paras.en: Michael Monaghan from investment firm Founder ETFs is among those who want Huang back in the top job at Nvidia.
paras.zh: 投资公司 Founder ETFs 的迈克尔·莫纳汉 (Michael Monaghan) 是希望黄重回 Nvidia 最高职位的人之一。

paras.en: The Nvidia investor told the BBC that he is waiting to see the results of a thorough investigation into Huang's actions, instead of relying on "salacious allegations" made in the media.
paras.zh: 这位英伟达投资者告诉 BBC，他正在等待对黄的行为进行彻底调查的结果，而不是依赖媒体的“淫秽指控”。

paras.en: Nvidia's strong earnings are "from the machine that Jensen built" and a company tends to lose "its shine and vision" after an iconic founder leaves, Monaghan said.
paras.zh: 莫纳汉表示，英伟达的强劲盈利“来自詹森打造的机器”，而在一位标志性创始人离开后，公司往往会失去“光彩和愿景”。

articles.title: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian

paras.en: Off-Highway Brake & Friction Excellence is All-Italian
paras.zh: 卓越的非公路制动和摩擦性能均来自意大利

paras.en: SK Wellman, a company specializing in the production of brake and frictions components for off-highway, has a lively DNA. A historical reality in Orzinuovi (Bs), where the plant is still located, over the years it has undergone transformations and changes that have contributed to making it what it is today: an evolved company, able to grow in loyalty to the local Italian territory and to innovate its sector with creativity and flexibility worldwide. Today, as part of the CentroMotion Group and its Carlisle Brake & Friction division, SK Wellman is a leader in its segment, recognized and chosen by major brands in earthmoving, agricultural and construction machinery. Engineer Alessandro Gamba, Global Director of Friction Engineering, tells us about the ongoing growth.
paras.zh: SK Wellman 是一家专门生产非公路用制动和摩擦部件的公司，拥有活跃的基因。工厂仍位于 Orzinuovi (Bs) 的历史现实中，多年来，它经历了转型和变化，从而使其成为今天的样子：一家不断发展的公司，能够不断发展对意大利当地领土的忠诚度，并在全球范围内以创造力和灵活性创新其行业。如今，作为 CentroMotion 集团及其 Carlisle 制动与摩擦部门的一部分，SK Wellman 已成为该领域的领导者，受到土方、农业和建筑机械领域主要品牌的认可和选择。摩擦工程全球总监工程师 Alessandro Gamba 向我们介绍了持续增长的情况。

paras.en: "S.K. Wellman S.R.L. has 340 employees and a turnover of 127 million by 2023," Gamba begins. In the last five years, a strong push has come from the market but above all from the characteristics of SK, such as creativity, innovation, flexibility, which, in the final analysis, are the result of the greatest wealth of this company: people". They are the ones who make the Brescia-based company an authentic and tenacious company, to the point of being able to export not only their products successfully, but also their skills and design skills to the other plants of the Carlisle Brake & Friction division. The year 2023, which has just ended, confirms a positive performance in turnover for sales revenues alone, recording a slight decrease of -5% compared to the previous exceptional 2022 financial year; A year, the latter, probably unrepeatable for many realities of the Brescia and non-Brescia economy. In fact, 2023 was undoubtedly the year of change that helped people develop a greater ability to manage uncertainty, accepting and dealing with unexpected situations with more resilience.
paras.zh: “S.K. Wellman S.R.L. 拥有 340 名员工，到 2023 年营业额将达到 1.27 亿美元，”Gamba 开始说道。在过去的五年里，强大的推动力来自于市场，但最重要的是来自 SK 的特点，如创造力、创新性、灵活性，归根结底，这些都是这家公司最大财富的结果：“人”。正是他们使这家位于布雷西亚的公司成为一家真正的、顽强的公司，以至于不仅能够成功出口他们的产品，而且能够将他们的技能和设计技能出口到卡莱尔制动和摩擦部门的其他工厂。刚刚结束的 2023 年，仅销售收入就实现了积极的表现，与上一个出色的 2022 财年相比，略有下降 -5%；对于布雷西亚和非布雷西亚经济的许多现实来说，后者可能是不可重复的一年。事实上，2023 年无疑是变革的一年，帮助人们培养了更强的能力来管理不确定性，以更强的韧性接受和处理意外情况。

paras.en: "At the base of success there is a matrix organization developed thanks to group governance - explains the engineer -: a verticality driven on all functions and skills, able to define and guide processes on a global scale and generate best practices. And that's not all," adds Gamba, "we are one of the companies with the lowest level of turnover, and this allows us to transfer the experience of those who have been with us for a long time to young people, on whom we particularly focus. Added to this is a company population of 15 different nationalities, whose strong collaboration creates a truly serene working climate," says the HR Manager. It is no coincidence that the direction of growth is particularly social responsibility.
paras.zh: 工程师解释说：“成功的基础是通过集团治理形成的矩阵组织：所有职能和技能的垂直驱动，能够在全球范围内定义和指导流程并产生最佳实践。而这还不是全部，”Gamba 补充道，“我们是人员流动率最低的公司之一，这使我们能够将长期与我们在一起的人的经验传授给我们特别关注的年轻人。除此之外，公司人口还来自 15 个不同的国家，他们的强有力的合作创造了真正宁静的工作氛围，”人力资源经理说道。成长的方向尤其是社会责任并非巧合。

paras.en: "Among the main projects of SK Wellman and Carlisle - he observes - stands out Enactus, an international non-profit organization that, thanks to its activity, involves university students in the creation of sustainable entrepreneurial projects, helping to bridge the gap between university and business; and then Treedom, which involves the company's commitment to planting 1,600 trees in three years, involving its stakeholders in the project". Two more rare gems for the metalworking industry? A level of accidents at work that borders on zero, and the centrality of talent development. Towards excellence and beyond.
paras.zh: 他指出，“SK Wellman 和 Carlisle 的主要项目中，最突出的是 Enactus，这是一家国际非营利组织，通过其活动，让大学生参与创建可持续创业项目，帮助缩小大学和企业之间的差距；然后是 Treedom，该公司承诺在三年内种植 1,600 棵树，并让利益相关者参与到该项目中”。金属加工行业还有两颗稀有宝石吗？工作事故率接近于零，并且以人才发展为中心。迈向卓越并超越。

paras.en: Source: Il Corriere della Sera – edizione Lombardia
paras.zh: 资料来源：《晚邮报》——伦巴第版
