articles.title: A Holiday Season of Giving

paras.en: This holiday season, Carlisle Brake & Friction’s Medina location is proud to support 15 children of our colleagues who could use a little extra cheer. Our employees have generously donated toys, clothing, and other essential items to bring joy to these young lives.
paras.zh: 这个假期，Carlisle Brake & Friction 的麦地那办事处很荣幸能够为我们同事的 15 名孩子提供支持，他们需要一点额外的欢乐。我们的员工慷慨捐赠玩具、衣服和其他必需品，为这些年轻的生命带来欢乐。

paras.en: By coming together as a team, we’re demonstrating our commitment to making a positive impact on our community. We’re grateful for the kindness and generosity of our employees, and we hope this initiative will bring warmth and happiness to the children who receive these gifts.
paras.zh: 通过作为一个团队聚集在一起，我们展示了我们对为社区产生积极影响的承诺。我们感谢员工的善意和慷慨，希望这一举措能为收到这些礼物的孩子们带来温暖和快乐。

paras.en: Want to join us in spreading holiday cheer? Consider donating to Toys for Tots. This incredible organization ensures that every child experiences the joy of Christmas. Visit their website to find a drop-off location near you.
paras.zh: 想和我们一起传播节日的欢乐吗？考虑向 Toys for Tots 捐款。这个令人难以置信的组织确保每个孩子都能体验到圣诞节的欢乐。访问他们的网站查找您附近的下车地点。

articles.title: Falken wins Best Event Film at the 2026 International Motor Film Awards
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: Falken wins Best Event Film at the 2026 International Motor Film Awards
paras.zh: 《Falken》荣获 2026 年国际汽车电影奖最佳活动影片

paras.en: Falken has won Best Event Film at the 2026 International Motor Film Awards in Los Angeles. The Sumitomo Rubber Industries tyre brand was recognised for The Perfect Lap, which documents its motorsport team’s campaign at the 54th ADAC Ravenol 24h Nürburgring. This is the fourth time Falken has claimed the Best Event Film title, adding to previous victories in 2020, 2023, and 2024.
paras.zh: 《Falken》在洛杉矶举行的 2026 年国际汽车电影奖中荣获最佳活动影片。住友橡胶工业轮胎品牌因《完美单圈》而获得认可，该影片记录了其赛车队在第 54 届 ADAC Ravenol 24 小时纽博格林赛道上的表现。这是《Falken》第四次获得最佳赛事电影称号，之前曾在 2020 年、2023 年和 2024 年获得过该奖项。

paras.en: Marking Falken’s 27th appearance at the German endurance classic with its Porsche 911 GT3 R, The Perfect Lap captures operations both in the pit lane and out on the Nürburgring Nordschleife. The film highlights the rigorous demands of the event, where competing teams typically must complete between 156 and 162 clean laps to challenge for overall victory.
paras.zh: 法尔肯 (Falken) 驾驶保时捷 911 GT3 R 第 27 次亮相德国耐力经典赛，《完美单圈》记录了维修区和纽博格林北环赛道的行驶情况。影片凸显了这项赛事的严格要求，参赛车队通常必须完成 156 至 162 圈的干净圈数才能挑战总冠军。

paras.en: Produced in collaboration with specialist automotive production company FORMAT67, the project spanned six days of studio and on-location shooting around the circuit, utilising a U-Crane camera rig to track the Porsche at race speed. Falken confirmed the entire production, from live-action filming through to post-production, was completed entirely without the use of artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 该项目是与专业汽车制作公司 FORMAT67 合作制作的，历时六天的工作室和赛道周围的现场拍摄，利用 U-Crane 摄像机装置以比赛速度跟踪保时捷。法尔肯证实，整个制作过程，从真人拍摄到后期制作，完全没有使用人工智能。

paras.en: Evropi Dionysiadou, brand communications specialist at Dunlop Tyre Europe, commented: “The film symbolises precision, passion, teamwork and the relentless drive to extract the maximum performance time and time again – lap after lap, day and night. In this respect, endurance racing and the complex production of our film have a great deal in common.” Falken also thanked everyone who contributed to the film.
paras.zh: 邓禄普轮胎欧洲公司的品牌传播专家 Evropi Dionysiadou 评论道：“这部影片象征着精确、激情、团队合作以及一次又一次地追求最高性能的不懈动力——一圈又一圈，日日夜夜。在这方面，耐力赛和我们影片的复杂制作有很多共同点。”法尔肯还感谢所有为这部电影做出贡献的人。

articles.title: NFDA backs Milburn Review on youth employment, calls for motor retail NI relief
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: NFDA backs Milburn Review on youth employment, calls for motor retail NI relief
paras.zh: NFDA 支持米尔本评论青年就业，呼吁汽车零售 NI 救济

paras.en: The National Franchised Dealers Association (NFDA) has welcomed the recommendations of the Alan Milburn-led Review on tackling youth unemployment, while urging the government to include motor retail from the outset in proposed employer National Insurance reductions.
paras.zh: 全国特许经销商协会（NFDA）对艾伦·米尔本（Alan Milburn）领导的审查关于解决青年失业问题的建议表示欢迎，同时敦促政府从一开始就将汽车零售纳入拟议的雇主国民保险削减计划中。

paras.en: The Review outlines several measures designed to boost youth employment and skills, including an opportunity guarantee for 18- to 24-year-olds, targets to double apprenticeship completions by 2036, and financial incentives for recruiting employers. However, proposed reductions in employer National Insurance costs for younger workers are initially slated to focus on the retail and hospitality sectors, prompting the NFDA to call for immediate parity for automotive retailers.
paras.zh: 该审查概述了旨在促进青年就业和技能的多项措施，包括为 18 至 24 岁的年轻人提供机会保障、到 2036 年将学徒完成率翻一番的目标，以及对招聘雇主的经济激励。然而，拟议减少年轻工人的雇主国民保险费用最初计划集中在零售和酒店业，这促使 NFDA 呼吁立即为汽车零售商提供平等待遇。

paras.en: Sue Robinson, chief executive of the NFDA, said: “The automotive sector supports more than 600,000 jobs across the UK, from technicians and apprentices to customer-facing and digital roles, many of them skilled, secure and resilient to AI.
paras.zh: NFDA 首席执行官苏·罗宾逊 (Sue Robinson) 表示：“汽车行业为英国各地提供了超过 60 万个就业岗位，从技术人员和学徒到面向客户的数字岗位，其中许多岗位技能熟练、安全且能够适应人工智能。

paras.en: “Alan Milburn is right that too many young people cannot find the first rung of the career ladder, and a guarantee of a job, apprenticeship or training place, backed by employers, could change that. Testing major tax decisions for their effect on young people is welcome, and it should cover the cost of employing them.
paras.zh: “艾伦·米尔本（Alan Milburn）是对的，太多的年轻人无法找到职业阶梯的第一级，而雇主支持的工作、学徒或培训场所的保证可能会改变这种情况。测试重大税收决策对年轻人的影响是值得欢迎的，它应该涵盖雇用他们的成本。

paras.en: “Franchised dealers are already at the front line of this. NFDA’s Drive My Career platform connects young people with careers across automotive retail, and has done so for many years. We look forward to working with government to turn these recommendations into real jobs.”
paras.zh: “特许经销商已经站在了这方面的最前线。NFDA 的 Drive My Career 平台将年轻人与汽车零售行业的职业联系起来，多年来一直这样做。我们期待与政府合作，将这些建议转化为真正的就业机会。”

paras.en: Addressing the proposed payroll tax cuts directly, Robinson stressed that dealers should not be excluded from the initial rollout: “NFDA supports lower employer National Insurance for young workers, but dealers face the same rising employment costs as other retailers and should not be left waiting. NFDA will continue to press the government to include motor retail from the start and to set out a clear timetable, not leave it to ‘when fiscal conditions allow’.”
paras.zh: 罗宾逊在直接谈到拟议的工资税削减时强调，经销商不应被排除在最初的推出之外：“NFDA支持为年轻工人提供较低雇主的国民保险，但经销商与其他零售商一样面临着就业成本上升的问题，不应该等待。NFDA将继续敦促政府从一开始就将汽车零售纳入其中，并制定明确的时间表，而不是等到‘财政条件允许时’才实施。”

paras.en: The association reaffirmed its commitment to collaborating with policymakers to strengthen recruitment, training, and career pathways across the UK automotive retail sector.
paras.zh: 该协会重申其致力于与政策制定者合作，加强英国汽车零售行业的招聘、培训和职业道路。

articles.title: SEMA Honors Emerging Leaders with Visionary 8 Recognition
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: SEMA has named the 2026 recipients of its Visionary 8 program, recognizing eight emerging leaders whose work is advancing the automotive aftermarket. The honorees were announced at the 2026 SEMA Show in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: SEMA 公布了 Visionary 8 计划的 2026 名获奖者名单，表彰了八位致力于推动汽车售后市场发展的新兴领导者。获奖者名单在 2026 年拉斯维加斯 SEMA 车展上公布。

paras.en: Visionary 8 nominees must be 35 or younger, be active SEMA members and demonstrate achievements that positively impact their companies and the automotive aftermarket. Judges evaluated nominees on entrepreneurship, insight, integrity, responsibility and skill.
paras.zh: Visionary 8 提名者必须年龄在 35 岁或以下，是活跃的 SEMA 会员，并展示出对其公司和汽车售后市场产生积极影响的成就。评委们对被提名者的创业精神、洞察力、诚信、责任感和技能进行了评估。

paras.en: “The automotive aftermarket is built on passion, and this year’s honorees embody that spirit through their innovation, fresh ideas and solutions that grew and advanced the industry,” said SEMA Manger of Recognition Programs Joe Escobar. “Their achievements are strengthening businesses, expanding the industry’s reach and creating opportunities for the next generation.”
paras.zh: SEMA 认可计划经理 Joe Escobar 表示：“汽车售后市场是建立在激情之上的，今年的获奖者通过他们的创新、新颖的想法和解决方案体现了这种精神，推动了行业的发展和进步。” “他们的成就正在增强业务、扩大行业影响力并为下一代创造机会。”

paras.en: Braxton Boone, Owner, Boone Mobile Detailing
paras.zh: Braxton Boone，Boone Mobile Detailing 所有者

paras.en: Boone launched Boone Mobile Detailing while still in high school, growing it into a professional operation serving customers throughout the Richmond, Va., area. The company has earned a strong reputation for quality workmanship and customer service while expanding into specialized services such as paint correction, headlight restoration, clay bar treatments and paint protection. Through continuous learning and investment in his craft, Boone has created opportunities for others to develop skills within the automotive detailing industry.
paras.zh: Boone 在高中时就创办了 Boone Mobile Detailing，并将其发展成为为弗吉尼亚州里士满地区客户提供服务的专业运营商。该公司在优质工艺和客户服务方面赢得了良好的声誉，同时扩展到油漆校正、车头灯修复、粘土棒处理和油漆保护等专业服务。通过不断学习和对其工艺的投资，布恩为其他人创造了在汽车细节行业发展技能的机会。

paras.en: Justin Hartenstein Jr., Social Media Manager, Oracle Lighting
paras.zh: Justin Hartenstein Jr.，Oracle Lighting 社交媒体经理

paras.en: At just 19 years old, Hartenstein leads digital strategy and community growth for Oracle Lighting. In the first quarter of 2026 alone, his content generated more than 20 million views, significantly expanding the company’s reach and engagement. Drawing on his experience as both an enthusiast and content creator, he conceptualized and helped launch Oracle’s first lensless headlight, which, according to Oracle, set company sales records on launch day. His innovative approach to marketing continues to help shape the future of aftermarket brand engagement.
paras.zh: 年仅 19 岁的 Hartenstein 负责领导 Oracle Lighting 的数字战略和社区发展。仅在 2026 年第一季度，他的内容就产生了超过 2000 万次浏览，显着扩大了公司的影响力和参与度。凭借自己作为爱好者和内容创作者的经验，他构思并帮助推出了 Oracle 首款无透镜车头灯，据 Oracle 称，该车头灯在发布当天就创下了公司销售记录。他的创新营销方法继续帮助塑造售后市场品牌参与的未来。

paras.en: Dustin Korth, Senior Accounts Manager, MetaMartini
paras.zh: Dustin Korth，MetaMartini 高级客户经理

paras.en: Korth has helped modernize how aftermarket brands connect with enthusiasts by advancing creator-driven marketing, digital storytelling and community-focused engagement strategies. Through his work at MetaMartini, he has supported brands across the diesel, truck, performance, wheel and tire markets, while also contributing as an automotive journalist for Diesel World Magazine. As vice president of operations for River Valley Road Rally, Korth has helped grow enthusiast participation, strengthen industry partnerships and foster deeper connections within the automotive community.
paras.zh: Korth 通过推进创作者驱动的营销、数字故事讲述和以社区为中心的参与策略，帮助售后品牌与爱好者建立了现代化的联系。通过在 MetaMartini 的工作，他为柴油、卡车、高性能、车轮和轮胎市场的品牌提供支持，同时还担任《柴油世界》杂志的汽车记者。作为河谷公路拉力赛的运营副总裁，科思帮助提高了爱好者的参与度，加强了行业合作伙伴关系，并在汽车界建立了更深层次的联系。

paras.en: Kyle Kuhnhausen, President, Kuhnhausen Metal Concepts LLC
paras.zh: 凯尔·库恩豪森 (Kyle Kuhnhausen)，Kuhnhausen Metal Concepts LLC 总裁

paras.en: Kuhnhausen has earned national recognition for engineering-driven vehicle builds, including multiple top 12 finishes in the SEMA Battle of the Builders competition and the 2025 SEMA Best Engineered Vehicle award. Operating independently, he has pioneered integrations of modern drivetrains and technology into vintage vehicles while developing practical solutions shared across the builder community. Beyond his own projects, Kuhnhausen has mentored aspiring builders through the SEMA Young Guns program, industry education programs and hands-on training opportunities.
paras.zh: Kuhnhausen 在工程驱动型车辆制造方面赢得了国家认可，包括在 SEMA 建造者之战竞赛中多次进入前 12 名，并荣获 2025 年 SEMA 最佳工程车辆奖。他独立运营，率先将现代动力传动系统和技术集成到老式车辆中，同时开发了在建筑商社区中共享的实用解决方案。除了自己的项目之外，库恩豪森还通过 SEMA Young Guns 计划、行业教育计划和实践培训机会来指导有抱负的建筑商。

paras.en: Sean Leger, Owner, Emerald City Hot Rods
paras.zh: Sean Leger，Emerald City Hot Rods 老板

paras.en: Leger founded Emerald City Hot Rods in 2020 with a vision of blending traditional coachbuilding techniques with modern performance and design. Since then, he has grown the company into a custom fabrication shop specializing in handcrafted automotive artistry. By completing nearly every aspect of each build in-house, including design, fabrication, engineering and custom interiors, Leger has helped preserve traditional craftsmanship while introducing ideas that inspire builders and enthusiasts throughout the aftermarket industry.
paras.zh: Leger 于 2020 年创立了 Emerald City Hot Rods，其愿景是将传统车身制造技术与现代性能和设计融为一体。从那时起，他将公司发展成为一家专门从事手工汽车艺术的定制制造店。通过在内部完成每个建造的几乎每个方面，包括设计、制造、工程和定制内饰，Leger 帮助保留了传统工艺，同时引入了激励整个售后行业的建造者和爱好者的创意。

paras.en: Erik Nave, COO & Marketing Director, Titan Fuel Tanks
paras.zh: Erik Nave，Titan Fuel Tanks 首席运营官兼营销总监

paras.en: Nave began his career at Titan Fuel Tanks as a marketing specialist and inventory control professional before rising to serve as both chief operating officer and marketing director. He has built a reputation for transforming ideas into measurable business growth through strategic marketing initiatives, product launches and customer-focused messaging. By identifying industry trends, customer needs and market opportunities, Nave has helped increase brand visibility, strengthen customer trust and drive company growth.
paras.zh: Nave 在 Titan Fuel Tanks 开始了他的职业生涯，担任营销专家和库存控制专业人员，然后升任首席运营官和营销总监。他因通过战略营销计划、产品发布和以客户为中心的信息传递将想法转化为可衡量的业务增长而享有盛誉。通过识别行业趋势、客户需求和市场机会，Nave 帮助提高品牌知名度、增强客户信任并推动公司发展。

paras.en: Ray Padilla, Chief Executive Officer, Auto Film Mastery & Media Tune
paras.zh: Ray Padilla，Auto Film Mastery & Media Tune 首席执行官

paras.en: Padilla created the annual Auto Film Mastery Conference (AFMC) six years ago to help automotive film and detailing shop owners grow their businesses. Through Auto Film Mastery, he has developed educational courses, training programs and industry resources that help business owners improve operations and achieve growth. He is also the owner of Media Tune, a marketing company which helps automotive shops expand their reach and achieve business success.
paras.zh: 六年前，帕迪拉创办了年度汽车贴膜大师会议 (AFMC)，以帮助汽车贴膜和美容店业主发展业务。通过 Auto Film Mastery，他开发了教育课程、培训计划和行业资源，帮助企业主改善运营并实现增长。他还是 Media Tune 的所有者，这是一家营销公司，帮助汽车商店扩大业务范围并取得商业成功。

paras.en: Rashmi Sinha, Chief Innovation Officer & Co-Founder, Revv
paras.zh: Rashmi Sinha，Revv 首席创新官兼联合创始人

paras.en: Sinha co-founded Revv with Adi Bathla in 2022. As the company’s technical leader, she built Revv’s initial codebase and established the engineering systems that enabled rapid product development and deployment. Her hands-on approach to software development and adoption of emerging AI technologies helped accelerate the company’s growth and continues to shape its product innovation strategy.
paras.zh: Sinha 于 2022 年与 Adi Bathla 共同创立了 Revv。作为公司的技术负责人，她构建了 Revv 的初始代码库，并建立了可实现快速产品开发和部署的工程系统。她对软件开发和新兴人工智能技术的采用的实践方法帮助加速了公司的发展，并继续制定其产品创新战略。

paras.en: Nominations for the 2027 SEMA Visionary 8 will open in summer 2027 at sema.org/awards.
paras.zh: 2027 年 SEMA Visionary 8 提名将于 2027 年夏季在 sema.org/awards 开放。

articles.title: Kaeser Introduces Redesigned DSG Oil-Free Series Air Compressors
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Kaeser Compressors, Inc. has announced the launch of its redesigned DSG Series oil-free rotary screw compressors from 125 to 250 hp. Each DSG model outperforms the market in both cfm flow and specific performance (kW/100 cfm) — establishing a new benchmark for best-in-class energy efficiency. These 125-, 150-, 175-, 200- and 250-hp models are available both air and water-cooled, in both fixed and variable speed control.
paras.zh: Kaeser 压缩机公司宣布推出重新设计的 DSG 系列无油螺杆压缩机，功率范围为 125 至 250 马力。每个 DSG 型号在 cfm 流量和比性能 (kW/100 cfm) 方面均优于市场，为一流的能效树立了新基准。这些 125、150、175、200 和 250 马力型号均提供风冷和水冷、定速和变速控制。

paras.en: Unmatched Efficiency and Flow Performance
paras.zh: 无与伦比的效率和流量性能

paras.en: Core mechanical innovations include the new SIGMA XG 40 airend, water jacket cooling, variable-speed cooling fan and an IE4/IE5 Ultra-Premium Efficiency motor drive system. This next-generation DSG Series achieves an average 10% total system efficiency gain:
paras.zh: 核心机械创新包括新型 SIGMA XG 40 主机、水套冷却、变速冷却风扇和 IE4/IE5 超高效电机驱动系统。新一代 DSG 系列的总系统效率平均提高 10%：

paras.en: - Air-cooled fixed speed models feature up to a 11% increase in volume flow (achieving up to 1169 cfm at 125 psig) and an average 8.5% reduction in specific power.
paras.zh: - 风冷定速型号的体积流量增加高达 11%（在 125 psig 下达到 1169 cfm），比功率平均降低 8.5%。

paras.en: - Water-cooled fixed speed models offer up to a 9% increase in volume flow and an average 7% reduction in specific energy requirements.
paras.zh: - 水冷定速型号的体积流量增加高达 9%，特定能源需求平均减少 7%。

paras.en: - DSG units have an expanded pressure range up to 160 psig to support a wider range of applications.
paras.zh: - DSG 装置的压力范围扩大至 160 psig，以支持更广泛的应用。

paras.en: - Sigma Frequency Control (VFD) models outperform competing market models across mid-to-high plant air demand profiles.
paras.zh: - Sigma 频率控制 (VFD) 型号在中高工厂空气需求情况下优于市场竞争型号。

paras.en: - The patented Kaeser Sealing Air System (K-SAS) creates an active, pressurized air barrier between the oil-lubricated bearings and the compression chamber, ensuring 100% oil-free compression permanently.
paras.zh: - 获得专利的 Kaeser 密封空气系统 (K-SAS) 在油润滑轴承和压缩室之间形成主动加压空气屏障，确保永久 100% 无油压缩。

paras.en: Maintenance and serviceability have also been significantly streamlined in this new design. Improved accessibility to heat exchangers and other components reduces service time, and automatic bearing lubrication eliminates a service task. Further, longer component life significantly extends service intervals. Airend design life has been expanded to 60,000-plus hours, gearbox oil change intervals lengthened to 18,000 hours and condensate drain service intervals tripled to 18,000 hours.
paras.zh: 在这种新设计中，维护和可维修性也得到了显着简化。改进了热交换器和其他部件的可及性，减少了维修时间，自动轴承润滑消除了维修任务。此外，更长的部件寿命显着延长了维修间隔。主机设计寿命延长至 60,000 多个小时，变速箱换油周期延长至 18,000 小时，冷凝水排放保养周期延长至三倍，达到 18,000 小时。

paras.en: DSG XG airends feature safe, biocompatible PEEK coating, an organic polymer with superior heat and wear resistance. Every component contacting the air stream is fully compliant with FDA and VO 1935 regulations, backed by ISO 8573-1 Class 0 residual oil certification and ISO 22000 compliance. DSG compressors and their manufacturing process are silicone-free.
paras.zh: DSG XG 主机采用安全、生物相容性 PEEK 涂层，这是一种具有卓越耐热性和耐磨性的有机聚合物。每个接触气流的组件均完全符合 FDA 和 VO 1935 法规，并获得 ISO 8573-1 0 级渣油认证和 ISO 22000 合规性支持。 DSG 压缩机及其制造过程不含硅。

paras.en: All DSG models are available with an integrated i.HOC dryer to remove moisture using the heat of compression to regenerate the desiccant bed without wasting compressed air or requiring the additional power consumption of heaters and blowers as with two-tower desiccant dryers. This further increases the energy efficiency of the entire system. Flexible, integrated water cooling options allow you to optimize operating temperature, efficiency, dewpoint and recoverable heat without additional equipment and external piping.
paras.zh: 所有 DSG 型号均配备集成 i.HOC 干燥机，利用压缩热去除水分，使干燥剂床再生，而不会像两塔干燥剂干燥机那样浪费压缩空气或需要额外的加热器和鼓风机功耗。这进一步提高了整个系统的能源效率。灵活的集成水冷却选项使您能够优化工作温度、效率、露点和可回收热量，而无需额外的设备和外部管道。

paras.en: The new DSG Series comes standard with the latest generation Sigma Control. Featuring a capacitive color touchscreen, RFID access control, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity, actively monitoring integrated vibration and Pt100 sensors, and automatic motor greasing, the system is fully cybersecurity-ready and easily integrates into smart factory architectures and master controllers like the Sigma Air Manager (SAM) 4.0.
paras.zh: 全新 DSG 系列标配最新一代 Sigma Control。该系统配备电容式彩色触摸屏、RFID 访问控制、Wi-Fi 和蓝牙连接、主动监控集成振动和 Pt100 传感器以及自动电机润滑，完全支持网络安全，并可轻松集成到智能工厂架构和 Sigma Air Manager (SAM) 4.0 等主控制器中。

paras.en: Kaeser engineers reduced the unit footprint by 9%, freeing up critical floor space and simplifying the replacement of aging equipment without compromising service access.
paras.zh: Kaeser 工程师将设备占地面积减少了 9%，释放了关键的占地面积并简化了老化设备的更换，同时又不影响服务访问。

paras.en: For more information, visit us.kaeser.com/oilfree. To be connected with your local authorized Kaeser representative, call (877) 417-3527.
paras.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 us.kaeser.com/oilfree。要联系当地授权的 Kaeser 代表，请致电 (877) 417-3527。

articles.title: Central States Collision Conference Set for April 23-24, 2027
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Kansas Auto Body Association, Nebraska Auto Body Association, Missouri Auto Body Association and Oklahoma Auto Body Association announced that the Central States Collision Conference (CSCC) will be held April 23-24, 2027 in Wichita, Kan.
paras.zh: 堪萨斯州汽车车身协会、内布拉斯加州汽车车身协会、密苏里州汽车车身协会和俄克拉荷马州汽车车身协会宣布，中部各州碰撞会议 (CSCC) 将于 2027 年 4 月 23 日至 24 日在堪萨斯州威奇托举行。

paras.en: The conference will feature two days of practical education, industry connections and the latest products and technology for collision repair professionals across the Central States.
paras.zh: 会议将为中部各州的碰撞修复专业人员提供为期两天的实践教育、行业联系以及最新产品和技术。

paras.en: Topics will cover areas such as marketing, OE certifications, right to appraisal, total loss valuations, insurance negotiations and more, offering practical insights and ideas you can put to work at your collision repair facility.
paras.zh: 主题将涵盖营销、原厂设备认证、评估权、全损估价、保险谈判等领域，提供实用的见解和想法，供您在碰撞修复设施中运用。

paras.en: Attendees can also explore equipment, technology and services on the trade show floor. Connect directly with vendors and suppliers, discover new solutions and hear vendor spotlights on the trade show stage.
paras.zh: 与会者还可以在展会现场探索设备、技术和服务。直接与供应商和供应商联系，发现新的解决方案并在贸易展览舞台上聆听供应商的关注。

paras.en: Last but not least, the CSCC will offer the power of networking — connect with shop owners, managers, technicians and industry professionals from across the Central States. Share experiences, learn from others and build relationships that extend beyond the conference.
paras.zh: 最后但并非最不重要的一点是，CSCC 将提供网络的力量——与来自中部各州的店主、经理、技术人员和行业专业人士建立联系。分享经验、向他人学习并建立超越会议范围的关系。

paras.en: The CSCC will bring together the people who keep the collision repair industry moving forward. From shop owners and managers to technicians and industry partners, CSCC will create space to learn from one another, explore what’s new and strengthen the collision repair industry.
paras.zh: CSCC 将汇集推动碰撞修复行业向前发展的人们。从店主和经理到技术人员和行业合作伙伴，CSCC 将创造相互学习的空间，探索新事物并加强碰撞修复行业。

paras.en: Whether you’re looking for fresh ideas, new connections or solutions to everyday shop challenges, the CSCC is your opportunity to step away from the day-to-day and invest in what’s next.
paras.zh: 无论您是在寻找新的想法、新的联系还是应对日常商店挑战的解决方案，CSCC 都是您摆脱日常事务并投资于未来的机会。

paras.en: For more information, visit cscconference.org.
paras.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 cscconference.org。

articles.title: Collision Consulting provides consumer handout on new Washington claims handling rules
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: New claims handling rules in Washington State have prompted Collision Consulting to update a consumer handout that outlines how to manage auto claims in the state.
paras.zh: 华盛顿州新的索赔处理规则促使碰撞咨询公司更新了一份消费者手册，概述了如何管理该州的汽车索赔。

paras.en: The changes went into effect Oct. 18, and are extensive.
paras.zh: 这些变化于 10 月 18 日生效，内容广泛。

paras.en: Consumer Consulting, an appraisal and investigations company owned by Jeff Butler, states that the new rules give claimants stronger rights to inspections, written explanations, data transparency, and prompt responses.
paras.zh: 杰夫·巴特勒 (Jeff Butler) 旗下的评估和调查公司消费者咨询公司 (Consumer Consulting) 表示，新规则赋予索赔人更强的检查、书面解释、数据透明度和及时答复的权利。

paras.en: The handout provides consumers eight rights they have while managing an auto claim.
paras.zh: 该讲义为消费者提供了在管理汽车索赔时拥有的八项权利。

paras.en: It starts with the right to choose a repair facility.
paras.zh: 首先是选择维修机构的权利。

paras.en: “The insurer may not unreasonably deny your chosen repair facility’s estimate,” the handout states. “If it pays less, it must promptly disclose all reasons, explain the policy basis for rejecting the estimate or invoice, and document the decision in its claim file.”
paras.zh: 宣传单上写道：“保险公司不得无理拒绝您选择的维修机构的估价。” “如果支付较少，则必须立即披露所有原因，解释拒绝估价或发票的保单依据，并将决定记录在索赔文件中。”

paras.en: The handout adds that consumers do not have to accept a photo-only estimate when the damage is disputed. It states that if a virtual inspection was used and there’s a disagreement over the amount of loss, the consumer can request an in-person inspection.
paras.zh: 该讲义补充说，当损坏有争议时，消费者不必接受仅照片的估计。它指出，如果使用虚拟检查并且对损失金额存在分歧，消费者可以要求亲自检查。

paras.en: “The insurer must conduct its in-person inspection within five business days, unless another time is agreed,” the handout states.
paras.zh: 讲义中写道：“除非双方同意其他时间，否则保险公司必须在五个工作日内进行现场检查。”

paras.en: Supplements and final invoices also now have a five-business day response requirement, the handout states. It adds that the insurance company is required to respond in writing to both the claimant and the repair facility with its determination of covered amounts. Rejected items must be tied to applicable policy language, the facts of the loss, or both.
paras.zh: 讲义指出，补充品和最终发票现在也有五个工作日的回复要求。它还补充说，保险公司必须以书面形式答复索赔人和维修机构，确定承保金额。被拒绝的物品必须与适用的保单语言、损失事实或两者相关联。

paras.en: Insurance companies also must explain in writing how labor and material costs and repair processes were determined, at claimant request, the handout states.
paras.zh: 该讲义指出，保险公司还必须应索赔人的要求，以书面形式解释如何确定劳动力和材料成本以及维修流程。

paras.en: “If it relies on a database, survey, estimating system, or benchmark for labor or material pricing, request the data date, geographic source, and the businesses that supplied the cost data,” the handout adds. “A reasonable investigation may not rely solely on a database.”
paras.zh: 讲义补充道：“如果依赖于数据库、调查、估算系统或劳动力或材料定价基准，请要求提供数据日期、地理来源以及提供成本数据的企业。” “合理的调查可能不仅仅依赖于数据库。”

paras.en: Consumers also can request to be included in all insurance communication with the repair shop, the handout states. It adds that the insurer must allow claim information by email, mail, fax, or in-person delivery.
paras.zh: 宣传单称，消费者还可以要求将其纳入与维修店的所有保险沟通中。它还补充说，保险公司必须允许通过电子邮件、邮件、传真或亲自交付索赔信息。

paras.en: The insurance company also is responsible for the accuracy of its evaluation and must consider newly discovered loss-related damage.
paras.zh: 保险公司还对其评估的准确性负责，并且必须考虑新发现的与损失相关的损害。

paras.en: “Estimates prepared by the insurer must be made by a competent person with relevant expertise, training, and experience to evaluate your damaged vehicle, and the insurer is responsible for the accuracy of its repair documentation and evaluations,” the handout states. “The insurer must consider additional loss-related damage discovered by the claimant or repair facility.”
paras.zh: 该讲义指出：“保险公司准备的估算必须由具有相关专业知识、培训和经验的合格人员进行，以评估您受损的车辆，并且保险公司对其维修文件和评估的准确性负责。” “保险公司必须考虑索赔人或维修机构发现的与损失相关的额外损害。”

paras.en: Additionally, an investigation must not solely rely upon databases.
paras.zh: 此外，调查不能仅仅依赖数据库。

paras.en: First-party insureds may request portions of their claim file, including estimates, notes, reports, photographs, and communications, the handout states. The insurance company has 15 business days to provide the requested documents.
paras.zh: 该讲义指出，第一方被保险人可以索取其索赔文件的部分内容，包括估计、注释、报告、照片和通信。保险公司有 15 个工作日提供所需文件。

paras.en: Claims investigations generally must be completed within 30 calendar days or the insurer must provide written reasons and continued 30-day updates.
paras.zh: 索赔调查通常必须在 30 个日历日内完成，或者保险公司必须提供书面理由并持续 30 天更新。

paras.en: Lastly, the handout also gives details on the right-to-appraisal law that was passed last year.
paras.zh: 最后，讲义还详细介绍了去年通过的评估权法。

paras.en: “Under RCW 48.18.620, every automobile insurance policy with first-party physical damage coverage must include a Right to Appraisal,” the handout says.
paras.zh: “根据 RCW 48.18.620，每份包含第一方物理损坏承保的汽车保险单都必须包含评估权，”讲义上写道。

paras.en: The document gives steps on how consumers can use the right-to-appraisal:
paras.zh: 该文件给出了消费者如何使用评估权的步骤：

paras.en: - “Each party selects a competent and disinterested appraiser within 10 days.
paras.zh: - “各方在 10 天内选出一位有能力且公正的评估师。

paras.en: - “Appraisers independently evaluate the actual cash value and amount of loss.
paras.zh: - “评估师独立评估实际现金价值和损失金额。

paras.en: - “If the appraisers disagree, they select a neutral umpire.
paras.zh: - “如果鉴定员不同意，他们会选择一名中立的裁判。

paras.en: - “If they cannot agree on an umpire, the Washington State Insurance Commissioner appoints one.
paras.zh: - “如果他们不能就裁判员达成一致，则由华盛顿州保险专员任命一名。

paras.en: - “Any agreement by two of the three (either both appraisers or one appraiser and the umpire) is binding.
paras.zh: - “三人中的两人（两名评估员或一名评估员和裁判员）达成的任何协议均具有约束力。

paras.en: - “The appraisal process must be completed within 30 days.”
paras.zh: - “评估过程必须在 30 天内完成。”

paras.en: Photo courtesy of Nutthaseth Vanchaichana/iStock
paras.zh: 照片由 Nutthaseth Vanchaichana/iStock 提供

articles.title: California insurance department holding AI use public workshop, launches survey
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: The California Department of Insurance (CDI) will hold a public workshop on Dec. 15 and is conducting an industry survey to help establish consumer safeguards for using artificial intelligence in insurance, according to a CDI press release.
paras.zh: 据加州保险部 (CDI) 新闻稿称，加州保险部 (CDI) 将于 12 月 15 日举办公开研讨会，并正在进行行业调查，以帮助建立在保险中使用人工智能的消费者保障措施。

paras.en: CDI invites consumers, insurance companies, researchers, technology developers, advocates, and the public to help shape how emerging technologies are used within the nation’s largest insurance market.
paras.zh: CDI 邀请消费者、保险公司、研究人员、技术开发人员、倡导者和公众帮助塑造新兴技术在全国最大的保险市场的使用方式。

paras.en: CDI says input from its “Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence (RUAI) Survey” and upcoming workshop will inform future regulatory and policy considerations to protect consumers while supporting responsible innovation. CDI says it is surveying a representative sample: “California-admitted insurance companies or groups that wrote at least $250 million in annual California premiums during 2025, selected California-admitted InsurTech companies, and selected insurance companies and groups that transact insurance business through managing general agents.” Survey responses are due by Dec. 30.
paras.zh: CDI 表示，其“负责任地使用人工智能 (RUAI) 调查”和即将举行的研讨会的意见将为未来的监管和政策考虑提供信息，以保护消费者，同时支持负责任的创新。 CDI 表示，它正在调查一个具有代表性的样本：“2025 年加州年度保费至少为 2.5 亿美元的加州认可的保险公司或集团、选定的加州认可的保险科技公司，以及通过管理总代理进行保险业务的精选保险公司和集团。”调查回复截止日期为 12 月 30 日。

paras.en: “AI and other advanced analytical technologies are increasingly being used across the insurance industry to support claims processing, fraud detection, customer service, underwriting support, and operational decision-making,” the release states. “While these tools can improve efficiency and enhance customer experiences, they also present risks when not properly designed, tested, monitored, governed, and overseen.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称：“人工智能和其他先进分析技术越来越多地应用于保险行业，以支持索赔处理、欺诈检测、客户服务、承保支持和运营决策。” “虽然这些工具可以提高效率并增强客户体验，但如果设计、测试、监控、治理和监督不当，它们也会带来风险。

paras.en: “Without appropriate safeguards, AI systems may produce inaccurate outcomes, compromise sensitive personal information, reduce transparency, or amplify unfair bias and discrimination.”
paras.zh: “如果没有适当的保障措施，人工智能系统可能会产生不准确的结果，损害敏感的个人信息，降低透明度，或放大不公平的偏见和歧视。”

paras.en: Commissioner Ricardo Lara adds that “consumers should never be left wondering whether an algorithm, rather than a fair and accountable process, determined their outcome.”
paras.zh: 专员里卡多·拉拉 (Ricardo Lara) 补充道，“消费者永远不应该怀疑他们的结果是否是由算法而不是公平和负责任的过程决定的。”

paras.en: During the workshop, participants are encouraged to share their experiences, concerns, and recommendations regarding transparency, fairness, privacy, human oversight, accountability, and insurer responsibility for technologies supplied by third-party vendors. It begins at 10 a.m. For more information and to register, click here.
paras.zh: 在研讨会期间，鼓励参与者分享他们对第三方供应商提供的技术的透明度、公平性、隐私、人工监督、问责制和保险公司责任的经验、担忧和建议。上午 10 点开始。欲了解更多信息并进行注册，请点击此处。

paras.en: The release notes that the workshop won’t focus on specific regulatory text, and the invitation is not a Notice of Proposed Action. CDI says that any future formal regulatory proposal would include a separate public process and additional opportunities for public comment.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿指出，研讨会不会关注具体的监管文本，邀请函也不是拟议行动通知。 CDI 表示，未来的任何正式监管提案都将包括单独的公共流程和额外的公众评论机会。

articles.title: Allstate planning round of layoffs in restructuring with AI push
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: P&C Specialist reports Allstate plans to lay off up to 10% of its employees under a company restructuring “aimed at streamlining operations in an AI-driven efficiency push.”
paras.zh: P&C Specialist 报告称，Allstate 计划在公司重组中裁员多达 10%，“旨在通过人工智能驱动的效率提升来简化运营”。

paras.en: Sources didn’t confirm the exact number; however, they said up to 10% of Allstate’s workforce could be affected, according to the article. The company’s 2025 annual report states that it employs 53,000.
paras.zh: 消息人士没有证实确切的数字；然而，据文章称，Allstate 多达 10% 的员工可能会受到影响。该公司 2025 年年度报告称，拥有 53,000 名员工。

paras.en: “Layoffs hit across the organization, including at unit National General and in customer service, underwriting, legal, inside sales, casualty, design, human resources, information technology, claims and support, said sources, who asked not to be named, discussing internal issues,” the article states. “The cuts are not tied to individual performance but stem from broader organizational realignment at Allstate, they said.”
paras.zh: 文章称，“整个组织都遭到了裁员，包括国家综合部门以及客户服务、承保、法律、内部销售、伤亡、设计、人力资源、信息技术、索赔和支持部门。”在讨论内部问题时，不愿透露姓名的消息人士称。他们表示：“裁员与个人绩效无关，而是源于好事达更广泛的组织调整。”

paras.en: Allstate hasn’t commented on the reported layoffs.
paras.zh: 好事达尚未对裁员消息发表评论。

paras.en: In its Nov. 5 Q3 earnings call, Allstate CEO Tom Wilson said the company will launch a personal agentic assistant (PAA) next year, which it has been working on for a year.
paras.zh: 在 11 月 5 日的第三季度财报电话会议上，Allstate 首席执行官汤姆·威尔逊 (Tom Wilson) 表示，该公司将于明年推出个人代理助理 (PAA)，该公司已经为此投入了一年的时间。

paras.en: “The advent of personal agentic assistants, or PAAs, gives us the opportunity to serve consumers who prefer to have a machine to handle their transactions, such as Muse, Spark, Dot, you go down the list,” he said. “The introduction of PAAs creates opportunity for Allstate, given our capabilities, and an upcoming launch of our own personal agentic assistant that is focused on protection.
paras.zh: “个人代理助理（PAA）的出现让我们有机会为那些喜欢用机器来处理交易的消费者提供服务，比如 Muse、Spark、Dot，等等，”他说。 “考虑到我们的能力，以及即将推出的专注于保护的个人代理助理，PAA 的推出为 Allstate 创造了机会。

paras.en: “To thrive in this world of highly sophisticated agents, you need sophisticated pricing, since they’re likely going to do more price comparisons. Secondly, some consumers may still have a brand preference or want a local agent, so we have a broad set of opportunities for them. When ALLIE [Allstate’s Large Language Intelligent Ecosystem] is fully deployed, and the PAAs have expanded their capabilities, this will give customers straight-through processing on servicing claims… Its value proposition includes more accurate pricing, given our insurance expertise, than the general-purpose PAAs will have.”
paras.zh: “要在这个高度复杂的代理世界中蓬勃发展，您需要复杂的定价，因为他们可能会进行更多的价格比较。其次，一些消费者可能仍然有品牌偏好或想要本地代理，因此我们为他们提供了广泛的机会。当 ALLIE [Allstate 的大语言智能生态系统] 全面部署，并且 PAA 扩展了其功能时，这将为客户提供直接的服务索赔处理……考虑到我们的保险专业知识，其价值主张包括比通用 PAA 更准确的定价。有。”

paras.en: Allstate began designing and building ALLIE several years ago, according to Wilson, who noted in the call that “like most companies, we are using AI to do an increasing amount of coding.”
paras.zh: Wilson 表示，Allstate 几年前就开始设计和构建 ALLIE，他在电话中指出，“像大多数公司一样，我们正在使用人工智能来进行越来越多的编码。”

paras.en: In Q3, Allstate used AI to write over 12 million lines of code — 3.6 times higher than in Q1, Wilson said. P&C Specialist reported that Allstate also uses AI to generate or review nearly 10 million outbound claim emails annually.
paras.zh: Wilson 表示，第三季度，Allstate 使用 AI 编写了超过 1200 万行代码，是第一季度的 3.6 倍。 P&C Specialist 报告称，Allstate 每年还使用人工智能生成或审查近 1000 万封出站索赔电子邮件。

paras.en: In Q2, Wilson explained that ALLIE uses agentic AI “to improve customer value, lower cost, and increase growth.”
paras.zh: 在第二季度，Wilson 解释说 ALLIE 使用代理人工智能“来提高客户价值、降低成本并促进增长”。

paras.en: P&C Specialist notes that Allstate’s P&C unit underwriting profit fell 30.1% in Q3 to $2.02 billion from Q3 2025.
paras.zh: P&C Specialist 指出，Allstate 的 P&C 部门承保利润在第三季度下降了 30.1%，至 2025 年第三季度的 20.2 亿美元。

paras.en: “The latest cuts follow several rounds of workforce reductions carried out under the carrier’s ‘Transformative Growth Plan,’ which was launched in 2019 to reshape distribution, introduce lower-cost products, and streamline claim processing,” P&C Specialist reports. “In one of the larger downsizings, the insurer cut 3,800 jobs in September 2020. The carrier is also overhauling its exclusive agency network of about 6,000 agents by three operating models based on agency size, staffing, and local presence.”
paras.zh: P&C Specialist 报告称：“最近的裁员是在该航空公司根据 2019 年推出的‘转型增长计划’进行了几轮裁员之后进行的，该计划旨在重塑分销、推出低成本产品并简化索赔处理。” “在规模较大的裁员中，这家保险公司于 2020 年 9 月裁员 3,800 人。该保险公司还根据代理规模、人员配置和当地业务，通过三种运营模式对其约 6,000 名代理人组成的独家代理网络进行彻底改革。”

paras.en: The article notes “a broader trend across the personal lines insurance industry” regarding layoffs.
paras.zh: 文章指出了关于裁员的“整个个人保险行业的更广泛趋势”。

paras.en: “USAA has conducted multiple rounds of layoffs in recent months, with the latest affecting at least 400 employees across its IT department,” the article states. “In October, GEICO cut about 100 employees, most of them in its Florida legal department. Farmers Insurance laid off at least 370 employees in June.”
paras.zh: 文章称：“USAA 近几个月来进行了多轮裁员，最新一次影响了其 IT 部门至少 400 名员工。” “10 月份，GEICO 裁减了大约 100 名员工，其中大部分是佛罗里达州法律部门的员工。Farmers Insurance 6 月份裁掉了至少 370 名员工。”

paras.en: P&C Specialist also reported in September that Allstate plans to shift “routine” customer service away from agents and into “a new service infrastructure” that includes phone, digital self-service tools, centralized service teams, and agentic AI.
paras.zh: P&C Specialist 在 9 月份还报道称，Allstate 计划将“常规”客户服务从代理商转移到“新的服务基础设施”，其中包括电话、数字自助服务工具、集中服务团队和代理人工智能。

paras.en: In May, State Farm changed its compensation and benefits package for 19,000 agents, with some saying it would substantially reduce their earnings.
paras.zh: 今年 5 月，State Farm 改变了 19,000 名代理商的薪酬和福利方案，一些人表示这将大幅减少他们的收入。

paras.en: Chart provided in Allstate Q3 earnings press release
paras.zh: 好事达第三季度收益新闻稿中提供的图表

articles.title: Federated Auto Parts Launches Holiday Diecast Giveaway
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: To celebrate the holiday season, Federated Auto Parts is conducting its annual diecast giveaway. Five winners of a limited-edition Federated collectible will be announced each Friday on the Federated Facebook pages now through the announcement of final winners on Dec. 11.
paras.zh: 为了庆祝节日，联邦汽车配件公司正在举办年度压铸赠品活动。限量版 Federated 收藏品的五名获奖者将于每周五在 Federated Facebook 页面上公布，并于 12 月 11 日公布最终获奖者。

paras.en: “The holiday season is the perfect time to give back to our Facebook followers, and our annual diecast giveaway is one way we can show our appreciation,” said John Marcum, director of marketing at Federated Auto Parts. “These limited-edition Federated collectibles are sure to be a hit with the winners, whether they add them to their collections, give them as stocking stuffers or keep them as a special holiday treat.”
paras.zh: Federated Auto Parts 营销总监约翰·马库姆 (John Marcum) 表示：“节日季是回馈 Facebook 粉丝的最佳时机，每年的压铸赠品是我们表达谢意的一种方式。” “这些限量版联邦收藏品肯定会受到获奖者的欢迎，无论他们将它们添加到他们的收藏中，将它们作为圣诞礼物还是将它们作为特殊的节日礼物。”

paras.en: To enter for a chance to win, visit Federated Auto Parts and Federated Car Care on Facebook by Dec. 3 and click on the mobile link in the first post to complete the entry form. Participants can earn extra entries by sharing the contest with Facebook friends.
paras.zh: 要获得获奖机会，请于 12 月 3 日之前访问 Facebook 上的 Federated Auto Parts 和 Federated Car Care，然后单击第一篇文章中的移动链接来填写报名表。参赛者可以通过与 Facebook 好友分享比赛来赚取额外的参赛资格。

articles.title: Choosing Between Wax and Ceramic Coatings
articles.author: Scott Shriber

paras.en: Traditional car wax, particularly carnauba-based products, creates a protective barrier on a vehicle’s paint. However, UV exposure and water gradually degrade that protection, requiring regular reapplication. Ceramic coatings offer longer-lasting protection by bonding with the surface.
paras.zh: 传统车蜡，特别是巴西棕榈蜡产品，可以在车辆油漆上形成保护屏障。然而，紫外线照射和水会逐渐降低这种保护作用，需要定期重新涂抹。陶瓷涂层通过与表面粘合提供更持久的保护。

paras.en: It’s important to emphasize proper surface preparation, including removing dirt and contaminants with clay bars or specialized cleaning mitts before application.
paras.zh: 重要的是要强调适当的表面准备，包括在施工前用粘土棒或专门的清洁手​​套去除污垢和污染物。

paras.en: This video is sponsored by The Pronto Network.
paras.zh: 该视频由 Pronto Network 赞助。

articles.title: How Autel’s MaxiSYS Ultra enhances efficiency at Mighty Auto Pro
articles.author: Eric Garbe

paras.en: At Mighty Auto Pro in Medina, OH, efficient service backed by smart tools helps keep the shop running at a high level. One of those tools, the Autel MaxiSYS Ultra, has become essential for diagnosing and servicing vehicles quickly and accurately. For techs racing the clock, the Ultra delivers real efficiency gains.
paras.zh: 在俄亥俄州麦地那的 Mighty Auto Pro，智能工具支持的高效服务有助于保持车间的高水平运营。其中一款工具 Autel MaxiSYS Ultra 已成为快速准确地诊断和维修车辆的必备工具。对于争分夺秒的技术人员来说，Ultra 可以带来真正的效率提升。

paras.en: It covers nearly every make and model from 1996 and up—U.S., Asian and European, with deep OE-level access. One tap identifies the vehicle and the next runs a fast full-system scan. The visual topology map shows module status across networks, a must for working on today’s complex vehicles.
paras.zh: 它涵盖了 1996 年及以后的几乎所有品牌和型号（美国、亚洲和欧洲），并具有深入的原厂级访问权限。轻按一下即可识别车辆，然后轻按一下即可运行快速的全系统扫描。可视化拓扑图显示跨网络的模块状态，这是当今复杂车辆工作的必备条件。

paras.en: Technicians can view and graph live data, run active tests, perform special functions and handle coding and adaptations. The service menu includes over 40 one-touch resets and calibrations like DPF regen, throttle body reset and brake bleed.
paras.zh: 技术人员可以查看实时数据并绘制图表、运行主动测试、执行特殊功能以及处理编码和调整。服务菜单包括 40 多种一键式重置和校准，例如 DPF 再生、节气门体重置和制动放气。

paras.en: Included in the package is the VCMI, a 5-in-1 tool combining a VCI, 4-channel scope, multimeter, CANBUS tester and waveform generator.
paras.zh: 套件中包含 VCMI，这是一款 5 合 1 工具，结合了 VCI、4 通道示波器、万用表、CANBUS 测试仪和波形发生器。

paras.en: For shops looking to streamline diagnostics while covering a wide range of vehicles, the Autel MaxiSYS Ultra offers the power and flexibility to get more done in less time.
paras.zh: 对于希望简化诊断并覆盖各种车辆的商店来说，Autel MaxiSYS Ultra 提供了强大的功能和灵活性，可以在更短的时间内完成更多工作。

articles.title: NTN Holds Community Spirit & Engagement Event
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: NTN Bearing Corp. of America held its Community Spirit & Engagement Event at the Elk Grove Township Food Pantry in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, on Tuesday, October 27. A team of twelve NTN employees volunteered to help combat food insecurity and support local families ahead of Thanksgiving.
paras.zh: 美国 NTN 轴承公司于 10 月 27 日星期二在伊利诺伊州埃尔克格罗夫村的埃尔克格罗夫镇食品储藏室举办了社区精神与参与活动。由 12 名 NTN 员工组成的团队自愿在感恩节前帮助应对粮食不安全问题并为当地家庭提供支持。

paras.en: Volunteers spent the morning assembling approximately 400 Thanksgiving food bags that will be distributed to families throughout the community. Designed as a “trick-or-treat” style shopping experience, team members worked together at various food stations, collecting and packing items including cooking oil, canned vegetables, canned pumpkin, mashed potatoes, macaroni and cheese, gravy, brownie mix, and other household necessities.
paras.zh: 志愿者花了一上午的时间组装了大约 400 个感恩节食品袋，这些食品袋将分发给整个社区的家庭。设计为“不给糖就捣蛋”式的购物体验，团队成员在各个食品站一起工作，收集和包装物品，包括食用油、罐装蔬菜、罐装南瓜、土豆泥、通心粉和奶酪、肉汁、布朗尼蛋糕和其他家庭必需品。

paras.en: In the afternoon, NTN employees assisted pantry staff with organizing and storing five pallets of donated food. According to the food pantry manager, the work completed by the NTN team in a few hours would have taken the pantry’s regular staff and volunteers up to a month to accomplish.
paras.zh: 下午，NTN员工协助食品储藏室工作人员整理并存放了五托盘的捐赠食品。据食品储藏室经理称，NTN 团队在几个小时内完成的工作需要储藏室的正式员工和志愿者长达一个月的时间才能完成。

paras.en: NTN’s Community Spirit & Engagement Program, launched in January 2023, includes contributing time and resources to charitable organizations, encouraging employees to take an active role in the local community, and building partnerships with other groups and organizations.
paras.zh: NTN 的社区精神和参与计划于 2023 年 1 月启动，包括向慈善组织贡献时间和资源、鼓励员工在当地社区发挥积极作用，以及与其他团体和组织建立合作伙伴关系。

paras.en: The Elk Grove Township Food Pantry provides food assistance and related support services to residents facing food insecurity, serving approximately 1,100 families each month through a client-choice model that allows households to access nutritious food and household essentials in a dignified and convenient manner. Through partnerships with community organizations, donors, and volunteers, the pantry helps ensure local families have access to the resources they need throughout the year and is expected to distribute the Thanksgiving food bags assembled during the event to nearly 900 families this holiday season.
paras.zh: Elk Grove Township Food Pantry 为面临粮食不安全的居民提供粮食援助和相关支持服务，每月通过客户选择模式为约 1,100 个家庭提供服务，使家庭能够以有尊严和便捷的方式获得营养食品和家庭必需品。通过与社区组织、捐助者和志愿者的合作，食品储藏室帮助确保当地家庭能够获得全年所需的资源，并预计在这个节日期间将活动期间收集的感恩节食品袋分发给近 900 个家庭。

articles.title: Mitchell 1 Adds QuickSpecs Feature for Faster Repair Lookup
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Mitchell 1 has added a “QuickSpecs” feature in its ProDemand repair information, aimed at helping technicians look things up faster.
paras.zh: Mitchell 1 在其 ProDemand 维修信息中添加了“QuickSpecs”功能，旨在帮助技术人员更快地查找问题。

paras.en: “When technicians need specification information, they need it immediately,” said Cami Hermann, marketing director for Mitchell 1. “QuickSpecs helps eliminate unnecessary scrolling and table hunting so users can get directly to the information they need and keep repairs moving. The enhancement is part of Mitchell 1’s broader effort to streamline technician workflow and improve efficiency throughout the repair process.”
paras.zh: Mitchell 1 营销总监 Cami Hermann 表示：“当技术人员需要规格信息时，他们会立即需要。QuickSpecs 有助于消除不必要的滚动和表格搜索，因此用户可以直接获取所需信息并保持维修进度。这项增强功能是 Mitchell 1 简化技术人员工作流程并提高整个维修过程效率的更广泛努力的一部分。”

paras.en: With added integration with 1Search Plus navigation, QuickSpecs now displays only the information directly related to the search entered by the user. For example, if a technician searches for “lug nut torque,” the system immediately surfaces the matching torque specifications instead of requiring users to scroll through large tables or unrelated information, the company said.
paras.zh: 通过与 1Search Plus 导航的集成，QuickSpecs 现在仅显示与用户输入的搜索直接相关的信息。该公司表示，例如，如果技术人员搜索“凸耳螺母扭矩”，系统会立即显示匹配的扭矩规格，而不需要用户滚动浏览大表格或不相关的信息。

paras.en: Mitchell 1 says it also redesigned the Common Specs Quick Link experience with a cleaner accordion-style layout Instead of searching through one long table, users can jump directly to the section they need.
paras.zh: Mitchell 1 表示，它还重新设计了 Common Specs Quick Link 体验，采用了更简洁的手风琴式布局，用户可以直接跳转到他们需要的部分，而不是在一张长表格中搜索。

paras.en: QuickSpecs currently supports 2015-2026 vehicles at launch, and Mitchell 1 says it expects to add coverage for 1995-2014 vehicles by the end of 2026.
paras.zh: QuickSpecs 目前在发布时支持 2015-2026 年生产的车辆，Mitchell 1 表示预计到 2026 年底将增加对 1995-2014 年生产车辆的覆盖范围。

articles.title: AutoZone’s Phil Daniele on ‘Putting Customers First’
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Phil Daniele, president and CEO of customer satisfaction at AutoZone.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 AutoZone 客户满意度总裁兼首席执行官 Phil Daniele。

paras.en: Daniele said the company’s commercial business has evolved significantly as it continues investing in the professional repair market. With commercial sales approaching $6 billion and programs in approximately 95% of its stores, AutoZone is strengthening its product quality, availability and delivery capabilities to better serve repair shops. Daniele emphasized the importance of OE-quality or better products, including its Duralast portfolio, alongside expanded assortments through its hub and mega hub strategy. Investments in technology, inventory optimization and a dedicated professional sales force are helping AutoZone get the right parts to shops faster while building stronger customer relationships.
paras.zh: Daniele 表示，随着公司继续投资专业维修市场，其商业业务已取得显着发展。 AutoZone 的商业销售额接近 60 亿美元，并在其约 95% 的商店中实施了该计划，因此正在加强其产品质量、可用性和交付能力，以更好地为维修店提供服务。 Daniele 强调了原厂品质或更好产品的重要性，包括其 Duralast 产品组合，以及通过其中心和大型中心战略扩大的品种。对技术、库存优化和专业销售队伍的投资正在帮助 AutoZone 更快地将合适的零件送到商店，同时建立更牢固的客户关系。

paras.en: AutoZone’s recent milestone of 8,000 stores globally reflects decades of expansion and continued growth opportunities, Daniele explained. The company also celebrated its 1,000th store in Mexico, expanded distribution capabilities there and broke ground on another facility. Looking ahead, AutoZone plans to continue opening stores across the United States, Mexico and Brazil. Daniele said that expansion creates opportunities not only to serve more customers but also to develop future leaders within the organization. AutoZone’s promote-from-within culture has helped employees build long-term careers, with many executives beginning their careers in stores.
paras.zh: Daniele 解释说，AutoZone 最近在全球拥有 8,000 家门店的里程碑反映了数十年的扩张和持续增长机会。该公司还庆祝其在墨西哥开设第 1,000 家商店，扩大了当地的分销能力，并在另一家工厂破土动工。展望未来，AutoZone 计划继续在美国、墨西哥和巴西开设门店。 Daniele 表示，扩张不仅创造了服务更多客户的机会，而且还为组织内培养未来的领导者创造了机会。 AutoZone 的内部晋升文化帮助员工建立了长期的职业生涯，许多高管都是在商店开始他们的职业生涯的。

paras.en: Delivering strong customer service remains central to AutoZone’s culture and operating philosophy. Daniele said empowering approximately 130,000 AutoZoners to consistently exceed customer expectations requires strong systems, processes and accountability. That means delivering quality parts quickly, ensuring accurate transactions and understanding each customer’s specific needs. Daniele emphasized that every interaction, from sales representatives to delivery drivers, contributes to the customer experience. By combining operational execution with a customer-first mindset, AutoZone aims to strengthen relationships and deliver the level of service that keeps customers coming back.
paras.zh: 提供强大的客户服务仍然是 AutoZone 文化和运营理念的核心。 Daniele 表示，要让大约 130,000 名 AutoZoners 持续超越客户期望，需要强大的系统、流程和问责制。这意味着快速交付优质零件，确保准确的交易并了解每个客户的具体需求。 Daniele 强调，从销售代表到送货司机的每一次互动都有助于提升客户体验。通过将运营执行与客户至上的理念相结合，AutoZone 旨在加强关系并提供高水平的服务，让客户成为回头客。

articles.title: Momentum USA Adds 12 Brake Part Numbers
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Momentum USA added 12 new part numbers to its brake friction and rotor catalog. This update expands coverage to over 5.3 million Vehicles in Operation (VIO) across North America.
paras.zh: Momentum USA 在其制动摩擦和转子目录中添加了 12 个新零件号。此更新将覆盖范围扩大到北美地区超过 530 万辆运营车辆 (VIO)。

paras.en: The new products include rear brake pads for Ford commercial vans; front ceramic pads for electric vehicles; and rotors for luxury and performance vehicles.
paras.zh: 新产品包括福特商用货车的后刹车片；电动汽车前陶瓷垫；以及豪华和高性能车辆的转子。

paras.en: - Ford Police Interceptor Utility & Explorer (2020–2026): Expanded coverage with the AmeriBrakes – Max Duty rear pad set (RAM2231), engineered specifically for high-stress stopping requirements.
paras.zh: - 福特警用 Interceptor Utility 和 Explorer（2020-2026）：AmeriBrakes – Max Duty 后垫套件 (RAM2231) 扩大了覆盖范围，专为满足高压力制动要求而设计。

paras.en: - Hyundai, Kia & Honda: Expanded coverage across models including the Hyundai Palisade, Santa Fe, and Santa Cruz; Kia Sorento and Carnival (PTC2381); as well as the Honda HR-V and Honda Clarity (PRC2116 / CE2116).
paras.zh: - 现代、起亚和本田：扩大了现代 Palisade、Santa Fe 和 Santa Cruz 等车型的覆盖范围；起亚索兰托和嘉年华 (PTC2381)；以及本田 HR-V 和本田 Clarity (PRC2116 / CE2116)。

paras.en: - Cadillac Lyriq & Chevy Blazer EV (2024–2027): Targeted front ceramic pad options (PRC2521) for modern GM EV platforms.
paras.zh: - 凯迪拉克 Lyriq 和雪佛兰 Blazer EV（2024-2027）：适用于现代通用汽车电动平台的有针对性的前陶瓷垫选项（PRC2521）。

paras.en: - Mercedes-Benz, Land Rover & Volvo: Added seven new Coated and R90 Euro Rotor SKUs to serve luxury sedans, sports coupes, and performance SUVs—including Mercedes-Benz S-Class, SLK, and C-Class models, Land Rover Defender and Range Rover Sport models (537200), and the Volvo XC60 (521480).
paras.zh: - 梅赛德斯-奔驰、路虎和沃尔沃：新增七种涂层和 R90 Euro Rotor SKU，为豪华轿车、运动轿跑车和高性能 SUV 提供服务，包括梅赛德斯-奔驰 S 级、SLK 和 C 级车型、路虎卫士和路虎揽胜运动车型 (537200) 以及沃尔沃 XC60 (521480)。

articles.title: Sonic Tools USA Relaunches Next S15 13-Drawer Toolbox
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Sonic Tools USA has relaunched its Next S15 toolbox, a 13-drawer storage unit with a load capacity of more than one ton. The toolbox can scale from a mobile service cart to a full-capacity tool center for technicians, shops and fleets.
paras.zh: Sonic Tools USA 重新推出了 Next S15 工具箱，这是一款具有 13 个抽屉的存储单元，负载能力超过一吨。该工具箱可以从移动服务车扩展到面向技术人员、商店和车队的全功能工具中心。

paras.en: The Next S15 measures 46.5 inches high, 65 inches wide and 26 inches deep. It includes molded bumpers, integrated side pockets, two spray can holders and a paper roll holder.
paras.zh: Next S15 尺寸为 46.5 英寸高、65 英寸宽、26 英寸深。它包括模制保险杠、集成侧袋、两个喷雾罐支架和一个纸卷支架。

paras.en: According to the company, the toolbox uses ball-bearing drawer slides with soft-close technology and provides full-extension access on all 13 drawers. An advanced drawer-blocking system provides anti-tilt protection. A stainless steel worktop with integrated side pockets comes standard for shop use and tire maintenance operations.
paras.zh: 据该公司称，该工具箱采用滚珠轴承抽屉滑轨和软关闭技术，并为所有 13 个抽屉提供完全伸展的通道。先进的抽屉阻挡系统提供防倾斜保护。带有集成侧袋的不锈钢工作台是商店使用和轮胎维护操作的标准配置。

paras.en: Applications range from compact quick-service carts to large-format storage for high-volume service and tire repair facilities, the company said.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，应用范围从紧凑型快速服务推车到用于大容量服务和轮胎修理设施的大型存储。

paras.en: The relaunch includes a redesigned foam insert system. Two medium foam inserts can combine to form one large insert to accommodate growing tool sets. Existing foam inserts transfer directly into the S15, allowing users to maintain their current layouts without rebuilding configurations, the company said.
paras.zh: 重新推出包括重新设计的泡沫插入系统。两个中等泡沫嵌件可以组合成一个大嵌件，以容纳不断增长的工具套件。该公司表示，现有的泡沫插入物可直接转移到 S15 中，允许用户保持当前的布局，而无需重建配置。

articles.title: AACF Receives $10,000 Donation Honoring Jon Owens
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The Automotive Aftermarket Charitable Foundation (AACF) expressed appreciation to WHBN LLC, a first-time donor, for its $10,000 gift in honor of Jon Owens, president of the AACF Board of Trustees. The contribution recognizes Owens’ three years of service as board president and supports emergency financial assistance for aftermarket employees and their families.
paras.zh: 汽车售后市场慈善基金会 (AACF) 对首次捐助者 WHBN LLC 向 AACF 董事会主席乔恩·欧文斯 (Jon Owens) 捐赠 10,000 美元表示感谢。该捐款是对欧文斯担任董事会主席三年的认可，并支持为售后员工及其家人提供紧急财务援助。

paras.en: “We made this donation in Jon Owens’ honor because we want the aftermarket industry to know how much we appreciate his service to AACF. Jon deserves to be recognized for the time and care he’s given to the Foundation,” said spokesman for WorkHardbeNice (WHBN) LLC, Doug Washbish.
paras.zh: WorkHardbeNice (WHBN) LLC 发言人 Doug Washbish 表示：“我们向 Jon Owens 捐款是为了纪念 Jon Owens，因为我们希望售后行业知道我们对他为 AACF 所做的服务有多么感激。Jon 为基金会付出的时间和关心值得得到认可。”

paras.en: As Owens nears the end of his term, AACF thanks him for the time he’s given to the Foundation and for using his role to bring attention to the challenges aftermarket families face when a crisis interrupts their income.
paras.zh: 在欧文斯的任期即将结束之际，AACF 感谢他为基金会付出的时间，并感谢他利用自己的角色让人们关注售后家庭在危机中断收入时所面临的挑战。

paras.en: AACF said gifts like this help the Foundation provide emergency grants when a serious illness, injury or natural disaster leaves a family struggling to cover expenses such as rent, utilities or groceries.
paras.zh: AACF 表示，当家庭因严重疾病、受伤或自然灾害而难以支付房租、水电费或杂货等费用时，此类礼物可以帮助基金会提供紧急补助金。

articles.title: NexaMotion Group Names Inaugural Vendors of the Year
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: NexaMotion Group (NMG) named UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) and Precision International the recipients of its first annual Vendor of the Year award. The program honors supplier partners whose commitment to NMG’s customers, team and strategy extends well beyond the purchase order.
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group (NMG) 将 UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) 和 Precision International 授予其首个年度供应商奖。该计划旨在表彰对 NMG 客户、团队和战略的承诺远远超出采购订单范围的供应商合作伙伴。

paras.en: For 50 years, from the founding of Transtar to the formation of NexaMotion Group, that kind of supplier partnership has been a cornerstone of how the company competes. Honorees were selected by NMG’s executive and supply chain leadership on availability, quality and responsiveness, and on a harder test: how far the supplier was willing to go in service of NMG’s strategy and its customers’ success.
paras.zh: 50 年来，从 Transtar 的成立到 NexaMotion 集团的成立，这种供应商合作伙伴关系一直是公司竞争的基石。获奖者是由 NMG 的高管和供应链领导层根据可用性、质量和响应能力以及更严格的测试选出的：供应商愿意在多大程度上为 NMG 的战略和客户的成功提供服务。

paras.en: “Anyone can fill an order. Our best partners help us build the business,” said Scott Weinstein, President of NexaMotion Group. “UAC and Precision International show up in the planning room, not just on the loading dock. They bring us coverage before our customers ask for it, they invest in our people and our shops, and when we make bold moves as a company they are right beside us. That is partnership, and it is what this award was created to honor.”
paras.zh: “任何人都可以填写订单。我们最好的合作伙伴帮助我们发展业务，”NexaMotion 集团总裁 Scott Weinstein 说道。 “UAC 和 Precision International 出现在规划室，而不仅仅是装货码头。他们在客户提出要求之前就为我们提供报道，他们对我们的员工和商店进行投资，当我们作为一家公司采取大胆行动时，他们就在我们身边。这就是合作伙伴关系，这也是这个奖项的设立的目的。”

paras.en: Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Mansfield, Texas, UAC designs and supplies automotive air conditioning components, from compressors and condensers to evaporators, driers, hose assemblies and electrical parts, backed by a factory audit process and an in-house validation team. NMG recently selected UAC as the lead air conditioning supplier for its general repair business, a decision shaped as much by UAC’s willingness to plan, train and invest alongside NMG’s teams as by the quality of its catalog. UAC is led by Francisco Coll, CEO, and Sophia Coll Crowley, CEO, with Luke Masters, Vice President of Business Development.

articles.title: FORVIA HELLA Secures Radar Sensor Orders
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: FORVIA HELLA secured significant series-production orders from three leading Chinese automakers for its latest generation of 77 GHz radar sensors. All three orders involve ForWave7e, the cost-optimized version of FORVIA HELLA’s ForWave radar family.
paras.zh: FORVIA HELLA 为其最新一代 77 GHz 雷达传感器获得了中国三大汽车制造商的大量批量生产订单。所有三个订单都涉及 ForWave7e，这是 FORVIA HELLA ForWave 雷达系列的成本优化版本。

paras.en: The three series-production projects target the European and Chinese automotive markets. The company expects series production to begin in the first and second quarters of 2027.
paras.zh: 这三个系列生产项目面向欧洲和中国汽车市场。该公司预计将于 2027 年第一季度和第二季度开始批量生产。

paras.en: FORVIA HELLA Expands Business With Chinese Automakers
paras.zh: FORVIA HELLA 扩大与中国汽车制造商的业务

paras.en: “The three series-production orders for radar sensors once again confirm the IGNITE strategy of the FORVIA Group and its consistent implementation,” said Peter Laier, CEO of FORVIA HELLA. “Electronics is our central growth area. At the same time, we are continuing to expand our business with Chinese car manufacturers and are also supporting them closely as they internationalize. In this way, we are pursuing one of the key strategic priorities of our business transformation: diversifying our customer portfolio, establishing Asia, Europe and the Americas as three equally strong regions, and making FORVIA HELLA more resilient over the long term.”
paras.zh: FORVIA HELLA 首席执行官 Peter Laier 表示：“雷达传感器的三个系列生产订单再次证实了 FORVIA 集团的 IGNITE 战略及其一贯实施。” “电子产品是我们的核心增长领域。与此同时，我们继续扩大与中国汽车制造商的业务，并在他们的国际化过程中密切支持他们。通过这种方式，我们正在追求业务转型的关键战略优先事项之一：使我们的客户组合多样化，将亚洲、欧洲和美洲建立为三个同样强大的地区，并使 FORVIA HELLA 更具长期弹性。”

paras.en: Radar Technology Supports Advanced Driver Assistance Systems
paras.zh: 雷达技术支持高级驾驶辅助系统

paras.en: 77 GHz radar sensors provide the technological basis for advanced driver assistance systems and automated driving functions.
paras.zh: 77 GHz 雷达传感器为高级驾驶辅助系统和自动驾驶功能提供技术基础。

paras.en: With its ForWave7 product family, FORVIA HELLA developed a platform using the latest generation of 77 GHz radar technology. Its variants address customer and market requirements across applications ranging from cost-efficient to performance-oriented. ForWave7e combines cost efficiency with high performance.
paras.zh: FORVIA HELLA 凭借其 ForWave7 产品系列开发了一个采用最新一代 77 GHz 雷达技术的平台。其变体可满足从经济高效到以性能为导向的各种应用的客户和市场需求。 ForWave7e 将成本效益与高性能结合在一起。

paras.en: In addition to ForWave7e, the product family includes ForWave7HD, a high-resolution radar variant. It serves as a key enabling technology for SAE Level 2+ and Level 3 automated driving.
paras.zh: 除了 ForWave7e 之外，该产品系列还包括 ForWave7HD，一种高分辨率雷达变体。它是 SAE 2+ 级和 3 级自动驾驶的关键使能技术。

paras.en: FORVIA HELLA also offers ForWave7CV, a variant specifically for truck applications. Two further versions, each with a different balance of cost and performance, complete the product family. All variants share a modular, scalable platform approach.
paras.zh: FORVIA HELLA 还提供 ForWave7CV，这是一种专门用于卡车应用的变体。另外两个版本，每个版本都具有不同的成本和性能平衡，完善了该产品系列。所有变体都共享模块化、可扩展的平台方法。

paras.en: Radar Technology Drives Electronics Growth
paras.zh: 雷达技术推动电子产品增长

paras.en: “Automated driving is one of the key market trends shaping the transformation of mobility. We expect around 90 percent of all newly produced vehicles worldwide to feature driver assistance or partial automation by 2030,” Jörg Weisgerber, managing director of electronics at FORVIA HELLA, said. “With our ForWave7 product family, we offer a scalable platform that enables us to meet the specific requirements of our customers and markets. Radar is therefore one of our most important growth drivers in Electronics across all regions.”
paras.zh: FORVIA HELLA 电子部门董事总经理 Jörg Weisgerber 表示：“自动驾驶是推动移动出行转型的关键市场趋势之一。我们预计，到 2030 年，全球约 90% 的新生产车辆将配备驾驶辅助或部分自动化功能。” “通过我们的 ForWave7 产品系列，我们提供了一个可扩展的平台，使我们能够满足客户和市场的特定要求。因此，雷达是我们所有地区电子产品最重要的增长动力之一。”

articles.title: NexaMotion Group Names Inaugural Vendors of the Year
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: NexaMotion Group (NMG) named UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) and Precision International the recipients of its first annual Vendor of the Year award. The program honors supplier partners whose commitment to NMG’s customers, team and strategy extends well beyond the purchase order.
paras.zh: NexaMotion Group (NMG) 将 UAC (Universal Air Conditioner, Inc.) 和 Precision International 授予其首个年度供应商奖。该计划旨在表彰对 NMG 客户、团队和战略的承诺远远超出采购订单范围的供应商合作伙伴。

paras.en: For 50 years, from the founding of Transtar to the formation of NexaMotion Group, that kind of supplier partnership has been a cornerstone of how the company competes. Honorees were selected by NMG’s executive and supply chain leadership on availability, quality and responsiveness, and on a harder test: how far the supplier was willing to go in service of NMG’s strategy and its customers’ success.
paras.zh: 50 年来，从 Transtar 的成立到 NexaMotion 集团的成立，这种供应商合作伙伴关系一直是公司竞争的基石。获奖者是由 NMG 的高管和供应链领导层根据可用性、质量和响应能力以及更严格的测试选出的：供应商愿意在多大程度上为 NMG 的战略和客户的成功提供服务。

paras.en: “Anyone can fill an order. Our best partners help us build the business,” said Scott Weinstein, President of NexaMotion Group. “UAC and Precision International show up in the planning room, not just on the loading dock. They bring us coverage before our customers ask for it, they invest in our people and our shops, and when we make bold moves as a company they are right beside us. That is partnership, and it is what this award was created to honor.”
paras.zh: “任何人都可以填写订单。我们最好的合作伙伴帮助我们发展业务，”NexaMotion 集团总裁 Scott Weinstein 说道。 “UAC 和 Precision International 出现在规划室，而不仅仅是装货码头。他们在客户提出要求之前就为我们提供报道，他们对我们的员工和商店进行投资，当我们作为一家公司采取大胆行动时，他们就在我们身边。这就是合作伙伴关系，这也是这个奖项的设立的目的。”

articles.title: Which animal would you most want to talk to, if you could?
articles.author: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry

paras.en: The idea of talking to animals like Dr. Dolittle might sound far-fetched, but researchers are making progress toward understanding how other species communicate. In a recent Live Science interview, University of California, Berkeley ethologist Julie Elie explained how she used artificial intelligence (AI) and behavioral experiments to decode the calls of zebra finches (Taeniopygia guttata). For instance, Elie was able to determine which calls the birds used to communicate over short distances versus longer distances.
paras.zh: 与杜立德博士这样的动物交谈的想法可能听起来很牵强，但研究人员在了解其他物种如何交流方面正在取得进展。在最近的《Live Science》采访中，加州大学伯克利分校动物行为学家 Julie Elie 解释了她如何使用人工智能 (AI) 和行为实验来解码斑胸草雀 (Taeniopygia guttata) 的叫声。例如，埃利能够确定鸟类使用哪些叫声进行短距离和长距离交流。

paras.en: Birds aren't the only animals scientists are hoping to understand. Researchers with Project CETI are using AI to decipher the clicks and calls of sperm whales, while a separate team (with the search for extraterrestrial intelligence, or SETI) conducted what they described as the first "conversation" between humans and a humpback whale. The whale, named Twain, responded to recorded calls played by researchers over a 20 minute period, a "conversation" scientists believe could help us figure out how to communicate with extraterrestrial life someday.
paras.zh: 鸟类并不是科学家希望了解的唯一动物。 CETI 项目的研究人员正在使用人工智能破译抹香鲸的点击声和叫声，而一个独立的团队（负责寻找外星智慧生物，简称 SETI）进行了他们所说的人类和座头鲸之间的首次“对话”。这只名叫吐温的鲸鱼对研究人员在 20 分钟内播放的录音电话做出了回应，科学家们认为这种“对话”有一天可以帮助我们弄清楚如何与外星生命进行交流。

paras.en: Closer to home, cats have already figured out how to use meows to get their human's attention, whether they're demanding food, affection or simply that we open the door for them (again). Whether this means they understand the human language or not is still up for debate, but it raises an interesting question: If we could understand what animals were saying, which species would you most want to talk to? Vote in our poll and let us know what you'd ask in the comments below!
paras.zh: 言归正传，猫已经学会了如何用喵喵声来引起人类的注意，无论它们是在要求食物、关爱，还是只是要求我们（再次）为它们开门。这是否意味着它们理解人类语言仍有争议，但这提出了一个有趣的问题：如果我们能理解动物在说什么，你最想与哪个物种交谈？在我们的民意调查中投票，并在下面的评论中告诉我们您想问什么！

paras.en: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry is the Content Manager at Live Science. Formerly, she was the Content Manager at Space.com and before that the Science Communicator at JILA, a physics research institute. Kenna is also a book author, with her upcoming book 'Octopus X' scheduled for release in spring of 2027. Her beats include physics, health, environmental science, technology, AI, animal intelligence, corvids, and cephalopods.
paras.zh: Kenna Hughes-Castleberry 是 Live Science 的内容经理。此前，她曾担任 Space.com 的内容经理，此前曾担任物理研究所 JILA 的科学传播员。肯纳还是一名书籍作者，她即将出版的新书《章鱼 X》计划于 2027 年春季发行。她的研究领域包括物理、健康、环境科学、技术、人工智能、动物智能、鸦科动物和头足类动物。
