paras.en: “There’s some shared concern on both sides that U.S. or Chinese models might be misused by bad actors and cause damage to the U.S., China, or other countries,” said Kyle Chan, a fellow at the Brookings Institution focusing on China’s technology development.
paras.zh: “双方都有一些共同的担忧，即美国或中国的模式可能会被不良行为者滥用，并对美国、中国或其他国家造成损害，”布鲁金斯学会(Brookings Institute)专注于中国技术发展的研究员凯尔·陈(Kyle Chan)表示。

paras.en: When Mr. Xi sits down with Mr. Trump in Shenzhen, he will be dealing with a president who will soon face a new constraint at home: a Democrat-controlled Congress.
paras.zh: 当习近平在深圳与特朗普坐下来时，他将面对一位很快将在国内面临新限制的总统：民主党控制的国会。

paras.en: Lawmakers may pressure Mr. Trump to tighten export controls against China or accelerate weapons sales to Taiwan, according to Ali Wyne, a senior research and advocacy adviser focusing on U.S.-China relations at the International Crisis Group. That means that “Xi will have to work much harder to keep Trump on side,” Mr. Wyne said.
paras.zh: 国际危机组织专注于美中关系的高级研究和宣传顾问阿里·韦恩表示，议员们可能会向特朗普施压，要求其加强对中国的出口管制或加速对台武器销售。这意味着“习近平必须更加努力才能让特朗普站在一边，”韦恩说。

paras.en: Mr. Trump will be the first American president to visit China twice in one calendar year.
paras.zh: 特朗普将成为首位一年内两次访华的美国总统。

paras.en: Analysts say the leaders’ summits, which have included state visits in Beijing and then in Washington, have been the only thing holding together a fragile détente between the two countries as they clash over A.I., export controls, Taiwan and other issues.
paras.zh: 分析人士表示，在两国在人工智能、出口管制、台湾和其他问题上发生冲突之际，领导人峰会（包括在北京和华盛顿进行国事访问）是维持两国之间脆弱缓和关系的唯一途径。

paras.en: The two sides declared a trade truce last year when they met in Busan, South Korea. That deal, which was to expire this month, has been extended until January.
paras.zh: 双方去年在韩国釜山会晤时宣布贸易休战。该协议原定于本月到期，现已延长至一月。

paras.en: China’s restrictions on the export of crucial rare-earth metals and rare-earth magnets, which are needed to manufacture most modern technology, remain one of the most difficult unresolved issues.
paras.zh: 中国对制造大多数现代技术所需的关键稀土金属和稀土磁体的出口限制仍然是最难解决的问题之一。

paras.en: Mr. Trump is likely to raise this with Mr. Xi, according to a senior U.S. administration official who said that China’s continued restrictions is one reason Washington only agreed to a two-month extension of the trade truce.
paras.zh: 一位美国政府高级官员表示，特朗普可能会向习近平提出这一问题，他表示，中国的持续限制是华盛顿仅同意将贸易休战延长两个月的原因之一。

paras.en: Ana Swanson contributed reporting from Washington, Aie Balagtas See from Manila, and Laura Chung from Sydney, Australia.
paras.zh: Ana Swanson 来自华盛顿、Aie Balagtas See 来自马尼拉和 Laura Chung 来自澳大利亚悉尼。

articles.title: Trump’s Whirlwind Asia Trip Begins in the Philippines
articles.author: The New York Times

paras.en: President Trump landed in Manila on Tuesday to begin a 48-hour Asia trip in which he will meet with Xi Jinping of China and other world leaders, with an unpredictable agenda that could include the future of American tariffs, nuclear arms control, the war in Ukraine and U.S. restrictions on advanced A.I. chips.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统周二抵达马尼拉，开始为期 48 小时的亚洲之行，期间他将与中国习近平和其他世界领导人会面，议程不可预测，其中可能包括美国关税的未来、核武器控制、乌克兰战争以及美国对先进人工智能的限制。筹码。

paras.en: Mr. Trump was scheduled to meet with President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. of the Philippines and attend a gathering of Southeast Asian leaders. After less than 24 hours in Manila, he will head to the APEC economic summit in Shenzhen, China, where he was expected to meet with Mr. Xi and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普原定会见菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯，并出席东南亚领导人聚会。在马尼拉停留不到24小时后，他将前往中国深圳参加亚太经合组织经济峰会，并预计会见习近平主席和俄罗斯总统普京。

paras.en: The brief itinerary appears to reflect Mr. Trump’s preferences. He dislikes big summits where he often is not the sole subject of attention. And he enjoys meeting with leaders of powerful nations — especially Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin, two authoritarian leaders he often talks about in admiring terms.
paras.zh: 简短的行程似乎反映了特朗普的偏好。他不喜欢大型峰会，因为在那里他常常不是唯一受到关注的对象。他喜欢与强国领导人会面，尤其是习近平和普京，他经常以钦佩的言辞谈论这两位独裁领导人。

paras.en: Mr. Trump will be meeting Mr. Xi for the third time this year, and a three-way meeting between China, Russia and the United States would be the first of its kind.
paras.zh: 特朗普今年将第三次会见习近平，而中国、俄罗斯和美国之间的双向会晤将是首次。

paras.en: On Tuesday, Mr. Trump caught the end of a dayslong meeting of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, or ASEAN, after issuing tariffs on countries across the region, even allies. Those moves added to a sentiment in Asia that the United States was not a reliable partner but rather one that treasured its commercial interests over its security interests. The only event of substance on the president’s schedule on Tuesday — signing what he had called a “trade deal” with Thailand — did not happen because Mr. Trump said it was still being finalized.
paras.zh: 周二，特朗普在东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）为期一天的会议结束后对该地区各国（甚至是盟友）征收关税。这些举动加剧了亚洲的一种情绪，即美国不是一个可靠的伙伴，而是一个重视商业利益而非安全利益的伙伴。总统周二日程上唯一的实质性活动——与泰国签署他所谓的“贸易协议”——没有发生，因为特朗普表示该协议仍在敲定中。

paras.en: Mr. Trump met with leaders from the so-called Quad — the United States, India, Japan and Australia — soon after his arrival. All three partners are smarting from high energy prices triggered by the Iran war, a conflict Mr. Trump never discussed with them before launching it in late February.
paras.zh: 特朗普抵达后不久就会见了所谓的“四方”——美国、印度、日本和澳大利亚的领导人。所有三个合作伙伴都对伊朗战争引发的高能源价格感到痛苦，特朗普在二月底发动战争之前从未与他们讨论过这场冲突。

paras.en: In Shenzhen — the heart of China’s robotics and artificial intelligence industries — Mr. Trump will pursue détente with Mr. Xi. He needs to extend a soon-expiring trade truce that limited tariffs on Chinese goods entering the United States in return for a Chinese commitment not to cut off rare earths and magnets.
paras.zh: 在中国机器人和人工智能产业的中心深圳，特朗普将寻求与习近平缓和关系。他需要延长即将到期的贸易休战协议，该休战协议限制了进入美国的中国商品的关税，以换取中国承诺不切断稀土和磁铁的供应。

paras.en: Then comes the main event: the meeting with Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin. Referring to the trilateral meeting, Mr. Trump told reporters before leaving Washington: “We are going to be talking about denuclearization, a tough subject because it is very hard for any of us to say we’ll get rid of our nukes.” Chinese officials have made clear they are not interested in nuclear talks until their arsenal is roughly the size of the American one.
paras.zh: 接下来是重头戏：与习近平和普京的会面。谈到三边会议，特朗普在离开华盛顿前对记者表示：“我们将讨论无核化，这是一个棘手的话题，因为我们中的任何人都很难说我们会放弃核武器。”中国官员已明确表示，除非其核武库规模大致相当于美国的核武库，否则他们对核谈判不感兴趣。

paras.en: Mr. Trump also said, “We will talk about Iran a little,” insisting the situation was in “very good shape.” Analysts say it is unlikely that the meeting will make any progress on Iran, with Russia happy to see energy prices elevated since the war began, and China eager to see them rapidly decline.
paras.zh: 特朗普还表示，“我们将稍微讨论一下伊朗”，并坚称局势“非常好”。分析人士表示，这次会议不太可能在伊朗问题上取得任何进展，俄罗斯乐于看到战争开始以来能源价格上涨，而中国则渴望看到能源价格迅速下跌。

paras.en: - North Korea: Mr. Putin could meet with Kim Jong-un if the North Korean leader also travels to China for the APEC summit, Russian state news agencies reported, citing the Kremlin’s spokesman. It was not clear whether Mr. Kim would attend the summit.
paras.zh: - 朝鲜：俄罗斯国家通讯社援引克里姆林宫发言人的话说，如果朝鲜领导人金正恩也前往中国参加亚太经合组织峰会，普京可能会见金正恩。目前尚不清楚金正恩是否会出席峰会。

paras.en: - Ukraine: Mr. Trump also said he would talk about Ukraine, on which Mr. Putin’s aides are engaging in talks with the U.S. and Ukrainian officials, but also renewing demands that NATO pull back its troops to where they were before the alliance expanded toward Russia.
paras.zh: - 乌克兰：特朗普还表示，他将谈论乌克兰问题，普京的助手正在与美国和乌克兰官员就乌克兰问题进行会谈，但他还再次要求北约将其部队撤回到该联盟向俄罗斯扩张之前的位置。

paras.en: President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia could meet with Kim Jong-un if the North Korean leader travels to China for the APEC summit this week, the Kremlin said, reflecting the deepening of ties between their countries in recent years.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫表示，如果朝鲜领导人金正恩本周前往中国参加亚太经合组织峰会，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京可能会见金正恩，这反映出近年来两国关系不断深化。

paras.en: Asked about the possibility of a meeting, Dmitri S. Peskov, the Kremlin spokesman, said on Monday that it would “of course” happen if Mr. Kim went to Shenzhen, the Chinese economic hub and host city, according to Russian state news agencies. North Korea has not confirmed whether Mr. Kim plans to attend the summit.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯国家通讯社报道，在被问及会面的可能性时，克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·S·佩斯科夫(Dmitri S. Peskov)周一表示，如果金正恩前往中国经济中心和主办城市深圳，那“当然”会发生。朝鲜尚未证实金正恩是否计划参加峰会。

paras.en: Mr. Putin and Mr. Kim have publicly met three times since 2022, and North Korea has been a key supporter of Russia’s military actions in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年以来，普京和金正恩已公开会面 3 次，朝鲜一直是俄罗斯在乌克兰军事行动的主要支持者。

paras.en: As the war in Ukraine nears its fifth anniversary, with no end in sight, the Kremlin is expected to use Mr. Putin’s many meetings at the APEC summit to showcase how Russia is regarded as one of the major international powers alongside the United States and China.
paras.zh: 随着乌克兰战争接近五周年，而且还看不到结束的迹象，预计克里姆林宫将利用普京在亚太经合组织峰会上的多次会面来展示俄罗斯如何被视为与美国和中国并列的主要国际大国之一。

paras.en: A visit by Mr. Kim would be a rare foray outside North Korea for the leader, and it would further raise the prospect that he could meet with President Trump in China. On the first day of his 48-hour trip to Asia, Mr. Trump told reporters that Mr. Kim “would like” to come to the APEC summit. The president has repeatedly said he would like to meet with Mr. Kim again.
paras.zh: 金正恩的访问将是这位领导人在朝鲜之外的罕见尝试，这将进一步提高他在中国与特朗普总统会面的可能性。在 48 小时亚洲之行的第一天，特朗普告诉记者，金正恩“愿意”参加 APEC 峰会。总统多次表示他希望再次与金正恩会面。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Mr. Putin is scheduled to meet with Xi Jinping, China’s leader. On Thursday, he is set to take part in a trilateral summit with Mr. Xi and Mr. Trump, the first meeting of its kind. The Kremlin said on Monday that it was working to arrange a bilateral meeting between Mr. Putin and Mr. Trump.
paras.zh: 普京计划于周三会见中国领导人习近平。周四，他将参加与习近平和特朗普举行的三边峰会，这是此类会议的首次。克里姆林宫周一表示，正在努力安排普京和特朗普之间的双边会晤。

paras.en: Before his departure for China, Mr. Putin met on Monday in the Kremlin with Jo Yong-won, a secretary of North Korea’s ruling Workers’ Party. During the meeting, Mr. Putin said that North Korea’s help in driving Ukrainian forces from the Kursk region of Russia last year “marked a new chapter in the history of military cooperation between our countries.”
paras.zh: 在启程前往中国之前，普京周一在克里姆林宫会见了朝鲜执政党劳动党书记赵甬元。普京在会见期间表示，去年朝鲜帮助将乌克兰军队赶出俄罗斯库尔斯克地区，“标志着我们两国军事合作历史的新篇章”。

paras.en: Moscow planned to unveil a monument in Kursk by the end of the year to honor the North Korean troops, Mr. Putin said.
paras.zh: 普京表示，莫斯科计划于今年年底前在库尔斯克揭幕一座纪念碑，以纪念朝鲜军队。

paras.en: During the final meeting of the day, with ASEAN leaders, President Trump told President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. of the Philippines: “I don’t want to date myself, but I knew your parents very well. They were great. I believe in genetics. They did a good job. You have very good genetics, I can tell you that.”
paras.zh: 在当天与东盟领导人的最后一次会议上，特朗普总统对菲律宾总统小费迪南德·R·马科斯说：“我不想和自己约会，但我很了解你的父母。他们很棒。我相信遗传学。他们做得很好。我可以告诉你，你有很好的遗传学。”

paras.en: It was not the first time Mr. Trump has praised the family of Mr. Marcos, who is the son of the dictator Ferdinand E. Marcos, who ruled the Philippines for 20 years, imposed martial law and was ousted in 1986.
paras.zh: 这并不是特朗普第一次赞扬马科斯的家人。马科斯是独裁者费迪南德·马科斯 (Ferdinand E. Marcos) 的儿子，费迪南德·马科斯统治菲律宾 20 年，实施戒严令，并于 1986 年被赶下台。

paras.en: The only event of substance on President Trump’s schedule today, the signing of a trade deal between the United States and Thailand, did not happen because it was still being finalized. Trump told reporters that “Thailand will eliminate all tariffs on U.S. imports” and that the United States would provide tariff relief, but the two sides signed only a memorandum about the agreement. The president said the deal would be done in the coming weeks.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统今天日程上唯一的实质性事件，即美国和泰国之间签署贸易协议，并未发生，因为该协议仍在敲定之中。特朗普对记者表示，“泰国将取消对美国进口产品的所有关税”，美国将提供关税减免，但双方仅签署了一份有关协议的备忘录。总统表示，该协议将在未来几周内完成。

paras.en: During an address to Quad leaders, President Trump called Prime Minister Narendra Modi of India, which is a member of the group, “a great leader and a friend of mine, highly respected by everybody all over the world.” The president also praised Modi as he stood with other leaders and took a few questions, calling him a “very tough man.”
paras.zh: 在向四方领导人发表讲话时，特朗普总统称该组织成员之一的印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪是“一位伟大的领导人，也是我的朋友，受到全世界所有人的高度尊重”。总统还称赞莫迪与其他领导人站在一起并回答了一些问题，称他是一个“非常强硬的人”。

paras.en: India and the United States are navigating a rocky patch in their relationship, largely tied to trade and India’s purchases of Russian oil. Although Modi and Trump signed an interim framework for a trade deal in February, talks have dragged on, frustrating both parties.
paras.zh: 印度和美国的关系正经历一段艰难的时期，这主要与贸易和印度购买俄罗斯石油有关。尽管莫迪和特朗普在二月份签署了贸易协议临时框架，但谈判却一拖再拖，令双方都感到沮丧。

paras.en: The Nvidia turmoil and its implications for the U.S.-China relationship is a backdrop to President Trump’s visit. On Tuesday, shares of technology companies in Asia tumbled after the Trump administration announced rules to restrict overseas access to advanced A.I. chips like those sold by Nvidia. In Hong Kong trading, Alibaba fell 5 percent, while Tencent’s stock dropped nearly 4 percent. The Chinese A.I. firms MiniMax Group fell 7 percent, and Z.AI Co. declined 5 percent.
paras.zh: 英伟达的动荡及其对中美关系的影响是特朗普总统访问的背景。周二，在特朗普政府宣布限制海外获取先进人工智能的规则后，亚洲科技公司的股价暴跌。像 Nvidia 销售的芯片一样。在香港交易中，阿里巴巴股价下跌 5%，而腾讯股价下跌近 4%。中国人工智能MiniMax Group 下跌 7%，Z.AI Co. 下跌 5%。

paras.en: In the United States, tech stocks stabilized from a sell-off the day before. Nvidia shares were up about 1 percent before the start of regular trading in New York. The company is set to report its latest financial results later on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 在美国，科技股从前一天的抛售中企稳。在纽约常规交易开始前，Nvidia 股价上涨了约 1%。该公司定于周二晚些时候公布最新的财务业绩。

paras.en: President Trump is expected to meet with Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul of Thailand on Tuesday in Manila to sign what the White House has described as a “trade deal.”
paras.zh: 预计特朗普总统将于周二在马尼拉会见泰国总理阿努丁·占维拉古 (Anutin Charnvirakul)，签署白宫所说的“贸易协议”。

paras.en: But Thailand’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs said in a statement on Tuesday that Bangkok was expecting to agree only on a “joint statement marking progress in negotiations.”
paras.zh: 但泰国外交部周二在一份声明中表示，曼谷预计只会就“标志着谈判取得进展的联合声明”达成一致。

paras.en: The dissonance comes amid growing signs within ASEAN, the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, that the United States is not a reliable partner. The meeting between Mr. Trump and Mr. Anutin is taking place on the sidelines of an ASEAN summit.
paras.zh: 这种不和谐之际，东盟内部越来越多的迹象表明美国不是一个可靠的合作伙伴。特朗普和阿努廷之间的会面是在东盟峰会期间举行的。

paras.en: For more than a year, Washington and Bangkok have been negotiating a new trade agreement that covers items like tariffs, food imports and labor rights.
paras.zh: 一年多来，华盛顿和曼谷一直在谈判一项新的贸易协定，涵盖关税、食品进口和劳工权利等项目。

paras.en: Last year, the United States battered Thailand with a 36 percent tariff, one of the steepest rates levied by Mr. Trump after his return to office. The United States is one of Thailand’s largest export markets, including for goods like pet food.
paras.zh: 去年，美国对泰国征收 36% 的关税，这是特朗普重返办公室后征收的最高税率之一。美国是泰国最大的出口市场之一，包括宠物食品等商品。

paras.en: Mr. Trump later reduced the tariffs to 19 percent, before the U.S. Supreme Court struck them down in February. The administration eventually found a way to still impose 12.5 percent tariffs on Thai goods.
paras.zh: 特朗普随后将关税降低至 19%，随后美国最高法院于 2 月份驳回了这些关税。政府最终找到了一种方法，仍然对泰国商品征收 12.5% 的关税。

paras.en: The signing of a U.S.-Thai trade deal might still be far off, requiring Thailand’s parliament to pass a law, but the meeting delivers an easy publicity win for Mr. Anutin and Mr. Trump, who is known to revel even in perceived success.
paras.zh: 美泰贸易协议的签署可能还很遥远，需要泰国议会通过一项法律，但这次会议为阿努丁和特朗普赢得了轻松的公众形象，众所周知，特朗普甚至对表面上的成功也感到陶醉。

paras.en: Pavida Pananond, an economist at Thammasat Business School in Bangkok, said, “The level of trust Thailand has in the U.S. is not at the same level as before all this economic weaponization of tariffs.”
paras.zh: 曼谷法政大学商学院经济学家帕维达·帕纳诺德 (Pavida Pananond) 表示，“泰国对美国的信任程度已与关税经济武器化之前不同。”

paras.en: After handing over the chairmanship of ASEAN to Singapore, President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. of the Philippines held a news conference. “President Trump has just arrived,” he said. “He is waiting for us to go to him and to invite him to this really very informal kind of summit.”
paras.zh: 菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯在将东盟轮值主席国交给新加坡后举行新闻发布会。 “特朗普总统刚刚抵达，”他说。 “他正在等待我们去找他并邀请他参加这个非常非正式的峰会。”

paras.en: Mr. Marcos ended his comments by apologizing for not taking more questions from journalists. “I cannot keep the president of the United States waiting,” he said. “Sorry.”
paras.zh: 马科斯先生在结束讲话时对没有回答记者更多问题表示歉意。 “我不能让美国总统等待，”他说。 “对不起。”

paras.en: At his hotel, President Trump sat down for a meeting with Quad leaders and took a few questions. He said that he was “not worried” about bank outages and that the United States would be “looking into” reports of plans by the Iranians to drop a dirty bomb in Washington. He also said that Kim Jong-un, the North Korean leader, would “like to come” to the APEC summit in Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统在下榻的酒店与四方领导人会面，并回答了一些问题。他表示，他“不担心”银行停业，美国将“调查”有关伊朗计划在华盛顿投下脏弹的报道。他还表示，朝鲜领导人金正恩“愿意来”参加在深圳举行的亚太经合组织峰会。

paras.en: Several hundred activists massed on Tuesday in central Manila to march to the Philippine International Convention Center, the venue for the Association of Southeast Asian Nations summit.
paras.zh: 周二，数百名活动人士聚集在马尼拉市中心，游行至东南亚国家联盟峰会举办地菲律宾国际会议中心。

paras.en: By the time President Trump landed in the city, the ranks of the protesters had swelled to thousands.
paras.zh: 当特朗普总统抵达该市时，抗议者队伍已扩大到数千人。

paras.en: Most of the demonstrators were university students who said that they were fed up with the government, which they said was more focused on preserving its relationship with the United States than helping impoverished Filipinos.
paras.zh: 大多数示威者是大学生，他们表示他们厌倦了政府，他们说政府更注重维护与美国的关系，而不是帮助贫困的菲律宾人。

paras.en: Cinna Sison, 18, who studies European languages at the University of the Philippines, said they were inspired by the recent mass protests in France.
paras.zh: 18 岁的西纳·西松 (Cinna Sison) 在菲律宾大学学习欧洲语言，她表示，法国最近的大规模抗议活动给他们带来了启发。

paras.en: “I love the French,” she said. “They know how to protest.”
paras.zh: “我喜欢法国人，”她说。 “他们知道如何抗议。”

paras.en: Ms. Sison said she had worn colorful makeup to mark her first time attending a demonstration. “I am here to show my solidarity with fellow young activists. We are here to show our disgust to the fascist Trump and to Marcos for kowtowing to his every wish,” she said, referring to President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. of the Philippines.
paras.zh: 西松女士说，她化了鲜艳的妆来纪念她第一次参加示威活动。 “我来这里是为了表达我对年轻活动人士的声援。我们来这里是为了表达我们对法西斯特朗普和马科斯屈服于他的每一个愿望的厌恶，”她指的是菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯。

paras.en: Mr. Trump is expected to hold a bilateral meeting with Mr. Marcos on Wednesday before he heads to China for an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit.
paras.zh: 预计特朗普将于周三与马科斯举行双边会晤，然后前往中国参加亚太经济合作组织峰会。

paras.en: The Philippine president, who earlier this year described Washington as a “steadfast partner,” has said little publicly about meeting Mr. Trump. His administration has hinted that the two sides are working on a military aid agreement.
paras.zh: 这位菲律宾总统今年早些时候将华盛顿描述为“坚定的伙伴”，但他很少公开谈论与特朗普会面的事情。他的政府暗示双方正在制定一项军事援助协议。

paras.en: In Manila, Ms. Sison wore a red scarf on her head and a red shirt with the words “Silicone not Silica” — a reference to Pax Silica, a U.S.-led consortium of countries aiming to create artificial intelligence supply chains independent of China.
paras.zh: 在马尼拉，西松头上戴着红围巾，身穿红色衬衫，上面写着“Silicone not Silica”——指的是 Pax Silica，这是一个以美国为首的国家财团，旨在创建独立于中国的人工智能供应链。

paras.en: Ms. Sison added that Pax Silica was a symbolic return of the Americans to the Philippines, the site of former U.S. military bases, as Washington leaned on a regional ally to counter China.
paras.zh: 西松补充道，“二氧化硅和平”象征着美国人重返菲律宾（美国前军事基地所在地），因为华盛顿依靠地区盟友来对抗中国。

paras.en: “Neighborliness is important, but it is not important to be subservient to U.S. interests,” she said.
paras.zh: “睦邻友好很重要，但屈服于美国利益并不重要，”她说。

paras.en: Nearby, Raja Bausing, a 22-year-old visual artist, was busy putting the finishing touches on a papier-mâché model of Mr. Trump holding Mr. Marcos.
paras.zh: 在附近，22 岁的视觉艺术家拉贾·鲍辛 (Raja Bausing) 正忙着对特朗普抱着马科斯的纸塑模型进行最后的修饰。

paras.en: “We want to show how Trump is a warmonger, while Marcos is a lap dog,” she said. “They are very disrespectful to Filipinos. Trump was welcomed in a grand way and yet we Filipinos are maltreated.”
paras.zh: “我们想展示特朗普是一个战争贩子，而马科斯是一只哈巴狗，”她说。 “他们对菲律宾人非常不尊重。特朗普受到了盛大的欢迎，但我们菲律宾人却受到了虐待。”

paras.en: President Trump landed in Manila on Tuesday, beginning a trip to Asia in which he will attend an ASEAN summit, greet members of the Quad, then travel to China for an APEC meeting.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统周二抵达马尼拉，开始亚洲之行，他将出席东盟峰会，会见四方成员，然后前往中国参加亚太经合组织会议。

paras.en: Here’s what those acronyms mean, as well as some highlights from previous summits — including gold crowns and awkward handshakes.
paras.zh: 以下是这些缩写词的含义，以及之前峰会的一些亮点——包括金冠和尴尬的握手。

paras.en: The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum is a group of 21 member economies, most of which are from that region. Its members also include Canada, Mexico, Australia, Russia and the United States. It promotes trade in Asia, but is not a free trade bloc. Its leaders meet annually, with the location rotating each year.
paras.zh: 亚太经济合作论坛由21个成员经济体组成，其中大部分来自该地区。其成员还包括加拿大、墨西哥、澳大利亚、俄罗斯和美国。它促进亚洲贸易，但不是一个自由贸易区。其领导人每年举行一次会议，地点也每年轮换。

paras.en: Meetings between world leaders on the sidelines of the summit can often overshadow the main proceedings. This year, in the Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen, Mr. Trump is expected to meet with President Xi Jinping of China and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia, as well as with Mr. Xi separately.
paras.zh: 世界领导人在峰会期间举行的会议往往会掩盖主要议程。今年，特朗普预计将在中国科技中心深圳会见中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京，并分别与习近平会面。

paras.en: Last year, when Mr. Trump visited the South Korean city of Gyeongju during the week of the APEC meeting, President Lee Jae Myung of South Korea gave him a replica of a gold crown that researchers believe was worn by an ancient Korean ruler. Mr. Trump also met with Mr. Xi in the nearby city of Busan, where the two struck a truce in their countries’ trade war.
paras.zh: 去年，当特朗普在亚太经合组织会议期间访问韩国庆州时，韩国总统李在明送给他一顶金王冠的复制品，研究人员认为这顶王冠是古代韩国统治者佩戴的。特朗普还在附近的釜山会见了习近平，两人在那里就两国的贸易战达成了休战协议。

paras.en: A notable incident happened in Sydney, Australia, in 2007, when a group of local television comedians brought an Osama bin Laden look-alike through security. The team came within yards of a hotel where President George W. Bush was staying.
paras.zh: 2007 年，澳大利亚悉尼发生了一起值得注意的事件，当时一群当地电视喜剧演员带着一个酷似奥萨马·本·拉登的人通过安检。该小组来到距离乔治·W·布什总统下榻的一家酒店仅几码远的地方。

paras.en: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations is a grouping of 11 countries — Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, East Timor and Vietnam — which promotes political cooperation and stability across the region. Its leaders meet twice annually.
paras.zh: 东南亚国家联盟由文莱、柬埔寨、印度尼西亚、老挝、马来西亚、缅甸、菲律宾、新加坡、泰国、东帝汶和越南等 11 个国家组成，旨在促进整个地区的政治合作与稳定。其领导人每年举行两次会议。

paras.en: The bloc was formed in 1967 and represents nearly 700 million people. Its economy and its role in global markets have strengthened in recent years. The United States also sees ASEAN as a geostrategic bulwark against China.
paras.zh: 该集团成立于 1967 年，代表近 7 亿人民。近年来，其经济及其在全球市场中的作用有所加强。美国还将东盟视为对抗中国的地缘战略堡垒。

paras.en: In 2009, an ASEAN meeting in Thailand fell into acrimony when Secretary of State Hillary Clinton compared North Korea’s leaders to “small children” when discussing their nuclear program. The country’s leadership, in turn, described Ms. Clinton as a “schoolgirl” and a “pensioner.”
paras.zh: 2009年，在泰国举行的东盟会议上，国务卿希拉里·克林顿(Hillary Clinton)在讨论朝鲜核计划时将朝鲜领导人比作“小孩子”，由此陷入了激烈的争吵。反过来，该国领导人将克林顿描述为“女学生”和“养老金领取者”。

paras.en: During the 2017 ASEAN summit in Manila, Mr. Trump grimaced while jostling with Southeast Asian leaders for an awkward cross-armed handshake that was captured in a group photograph.
paras.zh: 2017 年马尼拉东盟峰会期间，特朗普在与东南亚领导人推搡着尴尬地交叉双臂握手时做了个鬼脸，这张照片被记录在了合影中。

paras.en: The Quadrilateral Security Dialogue is an informal partnership between Australia, India, Japan and the United States, which was formed in part to counter China. It was proposed by Prime Minister Shinzo Abe of Japan in 2007.
paras.zh: 四边安全对话是澳大利亚、印度、日本和美国之间的非正式伙伴关系，其成立的部分目的是为了对抗中国。它是由日本首相安倍晋三于2007年提出的。

paras.en: Beijing opposed the initial discussion, lodging formal diplomatic protests. Australia withdrew in 2008 and the dialogue was put on hold for some time. But the grouping was revived in 2017 on the sidelines of an ASEAN conference.
paras.zh: 北京反对最初的讨论，并提出正式的外交抗议。 2008年澳大利亚退出，对话一度搁置。但该组织于 2017 年在东盟会议期间恢复。

paras.en: President Biden was the first U.S. president to convene a meeting among the leaders of the nations as a foursome. In 2024, he hosted the Quad leaders at his home in Wilmington, Del. Mr. Trump has appeared to be less enthusiastic about the partnership. Last year, he did not attend the Quad summit in India.
paras.zh: 拜登总统是第一位召开四国领导人会议的美国总统。 2024 年，他在特拉华州威尔明顿的家中接待了四方领导人。特朗普似乎对这种伙伴关系不太热衷。去年，他没有出席在印度举行的四方峰会。

paras.en: In May, Roseller Rodriguez, a mayor in the Philippines, was startled to learn from news reports that U.S. officials had arrived in his district to start an artificial intelligence hub.
paras.zh: 今年 5 月，菲律宾市长罗塞尔·罗德里格斯 (Roseller Rodriguez) 从新闻报道中惊讶地获悉美国官员已抵达他所在的地区建立人工智能中心。

paras.en: He saw a video of senior American and Filipino officials standing on a makeshift stage, unveiling a new initiative called Pax Silica.
paras.zh: 他看到一段视频，美国和菲律宾高级官员站在临时舞台上，推出了一项名为“Pax Silica”的新举措。

paras.en: Mr. Rodriguez had not been invited. Nor had he ever heard about the hub. Was it a data center? Where would the water and electricity come from? What would happen to the farmers living there?
paras.zh: 罗德里格斯先生没有受到邀请。他也从未听说过这个枢纽。这是一个数据中心吗？水和电从哪里来？住在那里的农民会怎样？

paras.en: Months later, he says he has few answers.
paras.zh: 几个月后，他说他几乎没有答案。

paras.en: “I’m not concerned with the geopolitics of Pax Silica,” Mr. Rodriguez said in his office in the municipality of Capas. “My problem is Pax Silica will be built in our community.”
paras.zh: “我不关心 Pax Silica 的地缘政治，”罗德里格斯在卡帕斯市的办公室里说。 “我的问题是 Pax Silica 将建在我们的社区中。”

paras.en: The United States started Pax Silica to unite partners around A.I. supply chains independent of China. The initiative is part of President Trump’s effort to counter Beijing’s economic and technological influence.
paras.zh: 美国成立了 Pax Silica，旨在联合人工智能领域的合作伙伴。供应链独立于中国。该倡议是特朗普总统对抗北京经济和技术影响力的努力的一部分。

paras.en: Trump administration officials have cast it as a 21st-century successor to Pax Americana, the era of relative peace among major powers after World War II.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府官员将其视为“美式和平”的 21 世纪继承者，即二战后大国之间相对和平的时代。

paras.en: The significance of Pax Silica, which 26 signatories have joined, has become heightened after revelations that Nvidia’s former chief executive, Jensen Huang, was targeted by Chinese intelligence, exposing the growing geopolitical stakes of the global A.I. race.
paras.zh: 在英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋成为中国情报部门目标的消息曝光后，已有 26 名签署者加入的 Pax Silica 的重要性变得更加突出，暴露了全球人工智能日益增长的地缘政治利益。种族。

paras.en: In the Philippines, America’s oldest ally in Asia, the backlash has been fierce.
paras.zh: 美国在亚洲最古老的盟友菲律宾对此的强烈反对。

paras.en: Dozens of Filipino performers greeted President Trump as he descended the stairs of Air Force One onto the tarmac of Ninoy Aquino Airport in Manila, waving flags and playing “Y.M.C.A.” by the Village People on drums and trumpets.
paras.zh: 当特朗普总统走下空军一号的楼梯，登上马尼拉尼诺·阿基诺机场的停机坪时，数十名菲律宾表演者挥舞着旗帜，演奏着《基督教青年会》，向他致意。村民们敲着鼓、吹着号角。

paras.en: President Vladimir V. Putin could meet with Kim Jong-un if the North Korean leader also travels to China for the APEC summit this week, Russian state news agencies reported, citing Dmitri S. Peskov, the Kremlin’s spokesman. Before his departure for China, Putin met on Monday with a secretary of North Korea’s ruling Workers’ Party. It was not yet clear whether the North Korean leader would attend the summit.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国家通讯社援引克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·S·佩斯科夫的话说，如果朝鲜领导人金正恩本周也前往中国参加亚太经合组织峰会，弗拉基米尔·V·普京总统可能会见金正恩。在启程前往中国之前，普京周一会见了朝鲜执政党劳动党书记。目前尚不清楚朝鲜领导人是否会出席峰会。

paras.en: President Trump has landed in Manila, lingering on the tarmac for a welcome ceremony before walking alone to Marine One. He has several events tonight, but he will not leave his hotel for them. A meeting with quad leaders, a U.S.-Thailand trade deal signing and a dinner will all be held at the resort where the president is staying. In other words, he showed up late to this summit, and the summit will be coming to him.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统降落在马尼拉，在停机坪上徘徊并举行欢迎仪式，然后独自走向海军陆战队一号。他今晚有几项活动，但他不会为此离开酒店。与四方领导人的​​会议、美泰贸易协议的签署以及晚宴都将在总统下榻的度假村举行。也就是说，他在这次峰会上来得晚了，而峰会终将到来。

paras.en: President Trump’s stopover at the Association of Southeast Asian Nations summit is part of a state visit to the Philippines, where he will be received with a 21-gun salute.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统在东南亚国家联盟峰会期间过境，是对菲律宾进行国事访问的一部分，菲律宾将鸣放21响礼炮迎接他。

paras.en: The last time he met President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. of the Philippines, he was full of praise for the Filipino leader.
paras.zh: 他上次会见菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯时，对这位菲律宾领导人赞不绝口。

paras.en: “Great family, great family legacy and highly respected in his country,” Mr. Trump said while hosting Mr. Marcos at the White House last year.
paras.zh: “伟大的家庭，伟大的家族遗产，在他的国家受到高度尊重，”特朗普去年在白宫接待马科斯时说道。

paras.en: But that legacy was long considered an obstacle to Mr. Marcos’s political ambitions. He is the son of the dictator Ferdinand E. Marcos, who ruled the Philippines for 20 years, imposed martial law and was ousted in 1986 by a nonviolent uprising. The elder Marcos died in exile in Hawaii, without facing trial on U.S. criminal charges that he had plundered the Philippine Treasury. Years later, a court found his estate liable for torture, summary executions and disappearances.
paras.zh: 但这一遗产长期以来被认为是马科斯政治野心的障碍。他是独裁者费迪南德·E·马科斯 (Ferdinand E. Marcos) 的儿子，独裁者费迪南德·马科斯 (Ferdinand E. Marcos) 统治菲律宾 20 年，实施戒严令，并于 1986 年因非暴力起义而被赶下台。老马科斯在夏威夷流亡期间去世，没有因美国对他掠夺菲律宾财政部的刑事指控而受到审判。多年后，法院认定他的财产应对酷刑、即决处决和失踪负责。

paras.en: The younger Marcos spent years rehabilitating his family’s image and won election in 2022. He is hosting Mr. Trump at his official residence, Malacañang Palace, which was also his childhood home.
paras.zh: 小马科斯花了数年时间恢复家族形象，并在 2022 年赢得大选。他在特朗普的官邸马拉干鄢宫接待特朗普，这里也是他儿时的家。

paras.en: Mr. Marcos and his wife, Liza Marcos, will receive Mr. Trump on Wednesday with a 21-gun salute. Mr. Trump is expected to sign the palace guest book, hold closed-door meetings, pose for a handshake, then attend a state luncheon held in his honor.
paras.zh: 马科斯先生和他的妻子丽莎·马科斯将于周三鸣放 21 响礼炮迎接特朗普先生。预计特朗普将在宫殿留言簿上签名、举行闭门会议、握手，然后出席为他举行的国宴。

paras.en: It is not clear whether Mr. Trump, who has a well-known affinity for autocratic leaders, will meet with Mr. Marcos’s mother, Imelda, 97, with whom he has socialized in New York. Ms. Marcos wielded immense power when her husband was president and later came to be known for her flamboyant lifestyle, shoe collection and unexplained wealth.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚特朗普是否会与马科斯97岁的母亲伊梅尔达会面，因为他对独裁领导人有着众所周知的好感。特朗普曾在纽约与她交往过。马科斯女士在丈夫担任总统期间掌握着巨大的权力，后来因其奢华的生活方式、鞋子收藏和不明财富而闻名。

paras.en: Mr. Marcos has said that when he called to congratulate Mr. Trump on his election victory in November 2024, Mr. Trump asked about Imelda Marcos.
paras.zh: 马科斯先生表示，当他打电话祝贺特朗普先生于 2024 年 11 月赢得大选时，特朗普询问了伊梅尔达·马科斯的情况。

paras.en: “My mother is really his friend, he knows my mother very well,” Mr. Marcos said, relaying the conversation. “He was asking about her, ‘How’s Imelda?’ I told him she sends her congratulations.”
paras.zh: “我的母亲确实是他的朋友，他非常了解我的母亲，”马科斯先生转述了谈话内容。 “他问起她，‘伊梅尔达怎么样？’我告诉他她向她表示祝贺。”

paras.en: After the pomp and circumstance at Malacañang, which traces its roots to the Spanish colonial era in the Philippines, Mr. Trump is headed to Shenzhen, China. The highlight of that leg of his trip will be a trilateral meeting with two strongmen: President Xi Jinping of China and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia.
paras.zh: 马拉干鄢宫的盛况和场面可以追溯到菲律宾的西班牙殖民时代，在结束之后，特朗普将前往中国深圳。他此行的亮点将是与两位强人的三方会晤：中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京。

paras.en: For the second year in a row, President Trump is attending the annual gathering of Southeast Asian leaders, a show of alliance to a region that the United States sees as a strategic and maritime counterweight to China.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统连续第二年参加东南亚领导人的年度聚会，这是美国与该地区结盟的表现，美国将这一地区视为对中国的战略和海上制衡。

paras.en: But Mr. Trump reached the gathering, held this year in Manila, only on Tuesday, just as the summit was wrapping up, and he is not expected to make any significant policies or diplomacy moves.
paras.zh: 但特朗普只是在周二峰会即将结束时才参加了今年在马尼拉举行的会议，预计他不会采取任何重大政策或外交举措。

paras.en: Mixed signals like this — to say nothing of Mr. Trump’s punishing tariffs — are adding to a widespread belief within ASEAN, the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, that the United States is not a reliable partner. That leaves the bloc balancing between Washington and Beijing, with which many of its members have deep trade partnerships.
paras.zh: 像这样的混合信号——更不用说特朗普的惩罚性关税——正在加剧东盟内部的普遍信念，即美国不是一个可靠的合作伙伴。这使得欧盟在华盛顿和北京之间保持平衡，许多成员国与华盛顿和北京有着深厚的贸易伙伴关系。

paras.en: “They’ve learned that the United States is not reliable, so a lot of the hedging has been away from the United States,” said Ted Osius, a former U.S. ambassador to Vietnam.
paras.zh: 美国前驻越南大使特德·奥修斯表示：“他们知道美国并不可靠，因此很多对冲措施都远离了美国。”

paras.en: The Philippines, America’s oldest security ally in Asia, provides a window into this balancing act.
paras.zh: 菲律宾是美国在亚洲最古老的安全盟友，为这种平衡行动提供了一个窗口。

paras.en: After taking office three years ago, President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. reversed his predecessor’s tilt toward China and pivoted back toward the United States. That stance contributed to many tense encounters between Filipino and Chinese vessels in the South China Sea, where Manila and Beijing have competing territorial claims.
paras.zh: 三年前，小费迪南德·马科斯总统上任后，扭转了前任对中国的倾斜，重新转向美国。这一立场导致菲律宾和中国船只在南海发生多次紧张冲突，马尼拉和北京在南海存在相互竞争的领土主张。

paras.en: As U.S. patrols in the South China Sea have dropped, Mr. Marcos has appeared to be more conciliatory toward Beijing. In August, he said that there was a “distinct possibility” that the Philippines and China could partner on oil and gas exploration in those waters despite their territorial feud.
paras.zh: 随着美国在南海的巡逻减少，马科斯似乎对北京更加和解了。 8月，他表示，尽管菲律宾和中国存在领土争端，但“明显有可能”在这些水域进行石油和天然气勘探合作。

paras.en: “Marcos Jr. already has begun a shift toward China, one that a single visit by Trump is unlikely to stop,” Joshua Kurlantzick, a senior fellow for Southeast Asia and South Asia at the Council on Foreign Relations, wrote last week.
paras.zh: “小马科斯已经开始转向中国，特朗普的一次访问不太可能阻止这种转变，”外交关系委员会东南亚和南亚高级研究员约书亚·科兰茨克(Joshua Kurlantzick)上周写道。

paras.en: On Sunday, China and ASEAN failed to agree on a code of conduct in the South China Sea — something the Philippines, which has some of the biggest stakes in the dispute, had vowed to secure while chairing the bloc this year.
paras.zh: 周日，中国和东盟未能就南海行为准则达成一致——在这场争端中拥有最大利害关系的菲律宾在今年担任东盟主席国期间曾发誓要确保这一准则。

paras.en: Chester Cabalza, president of International Development and Security Cooperation, a Philippine think tank, said: “Strategically, Manila opens its doors for conciliation with Beijing to stabilize normal ties. But on the ground, the real battle has yet to subside.”
paras.zh: 菲律宾智库国际发展与安全合作主席切斯特·卡巴尔扎表示：“从战略上讲，马尼拉敞开了与北京和解的大门，以稳定正常关系。但在实地，真正的战斗尚未平息。”

paras.en: Domestically, Mr. Marcos has to walk a tightrope, too.
paras.zh: 在国内，马科斯先生也必须走钢丝。

paras.en: “For Filipino fishermen and coastal communities, the South China Sea is not simply about a geopolitical dispute. It concerns livelihoods, access to maritime resources and national dignity,” said Arnaud Leveau, president of the Asia Centre, a Paris-based think tank. Any diplomatic accommodation perceived as sacrificing Filipino interests, he said, would therefore be politically risky.
paras.zh: “对于菲律宾渔民和沿海社区来说，南海不仅仅是地缘政治争端。它还关系到生计、海洋资源的获取和国家尊严，”巴黎智库亚洲中心主席阿诺·莱沃表示。他说，任何被视为牺牲菲律宾利益的外交和解都将具有政治风险。

paras.en: The wider region has been battered by the consequences of another Trump policy: the war in Iran. Southeast Asia depends heavily on oil and gas imports from the Middle East and was roiled by soaring prices of fuel. In the Philippines, crops rotted in fields because farmers could not afford to transport them to markets. In Thailand, public servants were asked to use stairs instead of elevators to reduce energy expenses.
paras.zh: 特朗普的另一项政策：伊朗战争，给更广泛的地区带来了沉重打击。东南亚严重依赖从中东进口石油和天然气，并受到燃料价格飙升的影响。在菲律宾，农作物在田里腐烂，因为农民无力将农作物运往市场。在泰国，公务员被要求使用楼梯而不是电梯，以减少能源支出。

paras.en: ASEAN comprises 11 nations — Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam and, since last year, East Timor — with vastly different degrees of freedom and wealth. The bloc represents almost 700 million people, or almost 10 percent of the global population.
paras.zh: 东盟由文莱、柬埔寨、印度尼西亚、老挝、马来西亚、缅甸、菲律宾、新加坡、泰国、越南以及去年以来的东帝汶等 11 个国家组成，自由度和财富水平差异很大。该集团代表了近 7 亿人口，即全球人口的近 10%。

paras.en: Making decisions on a consensus-basis and pledging not to interfere in one other’s internal affairs, the bloc has often been criticized as slow and ineffective, with the situation in Myanmar often cited as an example. A coup in that country in 2021 unleashed a civil war that ranks among the world’s most violent conflicts.
paras.zh: 该集团在协商一致的基础上做出决定，并承诺不干涉别国内政，因此经常被批评为缓慢和低效，缅甸的局势经常被引用作为例子。该国 2021 年发生政变，引发了一场内战，这场内战是世界上最暴力的冲突之一。

paras.en: Myanmar’s leaders remain barred from ASEAN summits, under an agreement that was extended on Monday. Still, almost half of the bloc’s member states have had bilateral engagements with Myanmar since the coup leader, Min Aung Hlaing, used stage-managed elections to take the post of president this year. Washington has also recently re-engaged in direct talks with Myanmar.
paras.zh: 根据周一延长的协议，缅甸领导人仍被禁止参加东盟峰会。尽管如此，自从政变领导人敏昂莱今年通过舞台选举就任总统以来，几乎一半的欧盟成员国与缅甸进行了双边接触。华盛顿最近还重新与缅甸进行直接谈判。

paras.en: Mr. Trump’s attendance at the summit, which concludes with an ASEAN-U.S. meeting, is part of a state visit to the Philippines. He is expected to hold a bilateral meeting with Mr. Marcos on Wednesday before heading to China for an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. Mr. Marcos has said little publicly about meeting Mr. Trump; but earlier this year, he described Washington as a “steadfast partner.” His administration has hinted that the two sides are working on a military aid agreement.
paras.zh: 特朗普出席峰会，峰会以东盟-美国会议结束。会议是对菲律宾进行国事访问的一部分。预计他将于周三与马科斯举行双边会晤，然后前往中国参加亚太经济合作组织峰会。马科斯很少公开谈论与特朗普会面的事。但今年早些时候，他将华盛顿描述为“坚定的伙伴”。他的政府暗示双方正在制定一项军事援助协议。

paras.en: In recent days, hundreds of demonstrators have gathered in Manila to protest Mr. Trump’s visit. They oppose his “Pax Silica” initiative, a move to build a supply chain for the artificial intelligence industry that bypasses China, saying it would exploit Philippine natural resources.
paras.zh: 最近几天，数百名示威者聚集在马尼拉，抗议特朗普的访问。他们反对他的“Pax Silica”倡议，该倡议旨在绕过中国为人工智能行业建立供应链，称这将开采菲律宾的自然资源。

paras.en: Renato Reyes, who led one of the protest groups on Sunday afternoon, said, “Marcos is so desperate to welcome Donald Trump that he will roll out the red carpet, even if Trump arrives late for the summit.”
paras.zh: 周日下午抗议团体之一的雷纳托·雷耶斯(Renato Reyes)表示，“马科斯非常渴望欢迎唐纳德·特朗普，即使特朗普在峰会上迟到，他也会铺上红地毯。”

paras.en: Aie Balagtas See contributed reporting from Manila, and Damien Cave from Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
paras.zh: Aie Balagtas See 贡献了来自马尼拉的报道，Damien Cave 贡献了来自越南胡志明市的报道。

paras.en: President Trump sets off this week for meetings in Asia that will culminate in a summit with two strongmen he has often praised: President Xi Jinping of China and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统本周将启程前往亚洲举行会议，最终将与他经常赞扬的两位强人举行峰会：中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京。

paras.en: It will be the first time the three men, who command the world’s largest nuclear arsenals, will have sat down together. Mr. Trump plans to discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons in the world and the war against Iran, according to a White House spokeswoman. He is not expected to bring up Russia’s war with Ukraine.
paras.zh: 这将是这三个掌握着世界上最大核武库的人第一次坐在一起。白宫发言人表示，特朗普计划讨论世界范围内削减核武器和针对伊朗的战争。预计他不会提及俄罗斯与乌克兰的战争。

paras.en: Mr. Trump will travel first to Manila, then to southern China, and will meet with regional leaders confronting an array of uncertainties. Those include the course of the war between the United States and Iran, high energy prices and mounting concern over the risks of artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 特朗普将首先前往马尼拉，然后前往中国南部，并将与面临一系列不确定因素的地区领导人会面。其中包括美国和伊朗之间的战争进程、高能源价格以及对人工智能风险日益增长的担忧。

paras.en: For Mr. Trump, the trip will be a pivot to foreign policy and relationships after American voters delivered a swift rebuke to his party in the midterm elections. His trip also comes as his administration faces scrutiny over a scandal involving the former chief executive of Nvidia, the tech giant, which has raised questions about Chinese espionage and American tech exports.
paras.zh: 对特朗普来说，在美国选民在中期选举中迅速谴责特朗普的政党之后，此行将成为外交政策和关系的一个支点。他此行之际，他的政府因涉及科技巨头英伟达前首席执行官的丑闻而面临审查，该丑闻引发了对中国间谍活动和美国科技出口的质疑。

paras.en: The highlight of Mr. Trump’s trip is expected to be his meeting with Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin on Thursday in China.
paras.zh: 特朗普此行的亮点预计将是周四在中国与习近平和普京的会面。

paras.en: The prospect of their summit has drawn comparisons to the 1945 conference in the Crimean city of Yalta, where the leaders of the United States, the Soviet Union and Britain met to decide the shape of postwar Europe.
paras.zh: 人们将这次峰会的前景与 1945 年在克里米亚城市雅尔塔举行的会议进行了比较，当时美国、苏联和英国的领导人在这次会议上决定了战后欧洲的形态。

paras.en: The White House has said that Mr. Trump wants to discuss the threat of nuclear proliferation. U.S. officials have expressed concerns about China’s accelerating nuclear buildup, expected to reach 1,000 nuclear warheads by 2030.
paras.zh: 白宫表示，特朗普希望讨论核扩散威胁。美国官员对中国加速核建设表示担忧，预计到 2030 年核弹头数量将达到 1,000 枚。

paras.en: The last nuclear arms control treaty between the United States and Russia expired in February. Trump administration officials have said that any new agreement on nuclear arms control must include China, but Beijing has shown no interest in the topic. China has an estimated 620 nuclear warheads, compared with the more than 5,000 that Russia and the United States have each, according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute.
paras.zh: 美国和俄罗斯之间的最后一项核武器控制条约已于二月到期。特朗普政府官员表示，任何新的核军控协议都必须包括中国，但北京方面对此话题没有表现出兴趣。据斯德哥尔摩国际和平研究所称，中国估计拥有 620 枚核弹头，而俄罗斯和美国各拥有 5,000 多枚核弹头。

paras.en: U.S. administration officials said they did not expect a deal out of the meeting, which they characterized as a starting point for discussions.
paras.zh: 美国政府官员表示，他们预计这次会议不会达成协议，他们将此次会议视为讨论的起点。

paras.en: The gathering has prompted concern in Ukraine that Mr. Putin might push for a deal, deciding Ukraine’s fate without Kyiv’s involvement. A U.S. administration official said Ukraine was not expected to be part of the discussion between the three leaders.
paras.zh: 这次聚会引起了乌克兰的担忧，人们担心普京可能会推动达成协议，从而在没有基辅参与的情况下决定乌克兰的命运。一位美国政府官员表示，预计乌克兰不会成为三位领导人之间讨论的一部分。

paras.en: Mr. Trump will start his trip in the Philippines, the oldest American treaty ally in the Asia-Pacific region, as the United States faces questions about its support for its partners in a region where China’s military and economic might continues to grow.
paras.zh: 特朗普将从菲律宾开始他的访问，菲律宾是美国在亚太地区最古老的条约盟友，而在中国的军事和经济实力持续增长的地区，美国对其伙伴的支持面临着质疑。

paras.en: In Manila, President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. plans to discuss with Mr. Trump the South China Sea, where the Philippines and China have competing claims. Philippine officials have said that they hope Mr. Trump’s visit might result in more American military assistance.
paras.zh: 在马尼拉，小费迪南德·R·马科斯总统计划与特朗普讨论南海问题，菲律宾和中国在南海存在相互争议的主权主张。菲律宾官员表示，他们希望特朗普的访问能够带来更多美国军事援助。

paras.en: Mr. Trump is also expected to meet with leaders of ASEAN, a Southeast Asian grouping of 11 nations, as well as a gathering of the so-called Quad grouping of the United States, India, Australia and Japan.
paras.zh: 预计特朗普还将与东盟（由 11 个国家组成的东南亚集团）领导人以及美国、印度、澳大利亚和日本组成的所谓“四方”集团的领导人会面。

paras.en: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese of Australia said on Sunday that he expected “lots of engagement” with Mr. Trump during the meetings.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞周日表示，他预计在会议期间与特朗普进行“大量接触”。

paras.en: “Obviously, that’s our most important ally,” he said. “But we want to see something constructive come out of that, including we want to see a de-escalation in the conflicts that are around the world.”
paras.zh: “显然，这是我们最重要的盟友，”他说。 “但我们希望看到一些建设性的结果，包括我们希望看到世界各地的冲突缓和。”

paras.en: Chinese analysts described the meeting of the Quad group, formed in part to counter China, as an effort by Mr. Trump to project power after his party’s defeat in the midterms. “Its symbolic value outweighs its practical value,” Xu Liping, a senior scholar at Guangdong University of Foreign Studies, told Shanghai Observer, a state-run outlet.
paras.zh: 中国分析人士称，四方集团的会议在一定程度上是为了对抗中国而成立的，是特朗普在共和党中期选举失败后投射权力的一次努力。 “它的象征价值超过了实用价值，”广东外语外贸大学高级学者徐立平告诉官方媒体《上海观察家报》。

paras.en: After Manila, Mr. Trump will travel to the Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen, where he will meet Mr. Xi on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation.
paras.zh: 离开马尼拉后，特朗普将前往中国科技中心深圳，并在亚太经合组织会议期间会见习近平。

paras.en: Jensen Huang, a key adviser who accompanied Mr. Trump on his last trip to China, will not be by his side. Mr. Huang helped shape the president’s views about technological competition with China and persuaded him to loosen restrictions on selling advanced chips to China.
paras.zh: 上次陪同特朗普访华的重要顾问黄仁勋将不会在他身边。黄先生帮助总统塑造了对与中国的技术竞争的看法，并说服他放宽了对中国出售先进芯片的限制。

paras.en: Mr. Huang stepped down from his role at Nvidia after revelations that he had an affair with a Chinese businesswoman, Alice Huang, who U.S. intelligence officials believe was collecting intelligence on Mr. Huang for Beijing. China has rejected the allegations, calling them “smears.” Ms. Huang has not responded to requests for comment.
paras.zh: 黄先生在被曝与中国女商人爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）有染后辞去了英伟达的职务，美国情报官员认为她正在为北京收集有关黄先生的情报。中国否认了这些指控，称其为“抹黑”。黄女士尚未回应置评请求。

paras.en: So far, the president has not raised the issue with Mr. Xi and is not expected to during their meeting on Thursday. But the saga is likely to cause unease in China about whether Washington will impose tighter controls on the export of technology to the country.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，总统尚未向习近平提出这个问题，预计也不会在周四的会议上提出。但这一事件可能会引起中国的不安，担心华盛顿是否会对向中国出口技术实施更严格的控制。

paras.en: As a result, U.S.-based analysts speculated that Mr. Xi might try to use his personal relationship with Mr. Trump to forestall such restrictions.
paras.zh: 因此，美国分析人士猜测，习近平可能会试图利用他与特朗普的个人关系来阻止此类限制。

paras.en: Yun Sun, director of the China program at the Stimson Center in Washington, said Mr. Huang’s downfall would likely mean “there is going to be more anxiety on the Chinese side about their access to American chips.” She expects Mr. Xi to emphasize the importance of easing U.S. controls on chip exports to China during their meeting.
paras.zh: 华盛顿史汀生中心中国项目主任孙云表示，黄仁勋的下台可能意味着“中方将对获得美国芯片感到更加焦虑”。她预计习近平会在会议上强调放松美国对中国芯片出口控制的重要性。

paras.en: Cooperation between China and the United States on artificial intelligence may be more difficult after the Nvidia scandal.
paras.zh: 英伟达丑闻之后，中美在人工智能领域的合作可能会更加困难。

paras.en: Still, there may be progress on the creation of a notification system that would allow the countries to alert each other about national security issues related to artificial intelligence, which the two sides agreed to in September.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，两国在建立通知系统方面可能会取得进展，该系统将允许两国就与人工智能相关的国家安全问题相互发出警报，双方于 9 月同意了这一点。

paras.en: “There’s some shared concern on both sides that U.S. or Chinese models might be misused by bad actors and cause damage to the U.S., China, or other countries,” said Kyle Chan, a fellow at the Brookings Institution focusing on China’s technology development.
paras.zh: “双方都有一些共同的担忧，即美国或中国的模式可能会被不良行为者滥用，并对美国、中国或其他国家造成损害，”布鲁金斯学会(Brookings Institute)专注于中国技术发展的研究员凯尔·陈(Kyle Chan)表示。

paras.en: When Mr. Xi sits down with Mr. Trump in Shenzhen, he will be dealing with a president who will soon face a new constraint at home: a Democrat-controlled Congress.
paras.zh: 当习近平在深圳与特朗普坐下来时，他将面对一位很快将在国内面临新限制的总统：民主党控制的国会。

paras.en: Lawmakers may pressure Mr. Trump to tighten export controls against China or accelerate weapons sales to Taiwan, according to Ali Wyne, a senior research and advocacy adviser focusing on U.S.-China relations at the International Crisis Group. That means that “Xi will have to work much harder to keep Trump on side,” Mr. Wyne said.
paras.zh: 国际危机组织专注于美中关系的高级研究和宣传顾问阿里·韦恩表示，议员们可能会向特朗普施压，要求其加强对中国的出口管制或加速对台武器销售。这意味着“习近平必须更加努力才能让特朗普站在一边，”韦恩说。

paras.en: Mr. Trump will be the first American president to visit China twice in one calendar year.
paras.zh: 特朗普将成为首位一年内两次访华的美国总统。

paras.en: Analysts say the leaders’ summits, which have included state visits in Beijing and then in Washington, have been the only thing holding together a fragile détente between the two countries as they clash over A.I., export controls, Taiwan and other issues.
paras.zh: 分析人士表示，在两国在人工智能、出口管制、台湾和其他问题上发生冲突之际，领导人峰会（包括在北京和华盛顿进行国事访问）是维持两国之间脆弱缓和关系的唯一途径。

paras.en: The two sides declared a trade truce last year when they met in Busan, South Korea. That deal, which was to expire this month, has been extended until January.
paras.zh: 双方去年在韩国釜山会晤时宣布贸易休战。该协议原定于本月到期，现已延长至一月。

paras.en: China’s restrictions on the export of crucial rare-earth metals and rare-earth magnets, which are needed to manufacture most modern technology, remain one of the most difficult unresolved issues.
paras.zh: 中国对制造大多数现代技术所需的关键稀土金属和稀土磁体的出口限制仍然是最难解决的问题之一。

paras.en: Mr. Trump is likely to raise this with Mr. Xi, according to a senior U.S. administration official who said that China’s continued restrictions is one reason Washington only agreed to a two-month extension of the trade truce.
paras.zh: 一位美国政府高级官员表示，特朗普可能会向习近平提出这一问题，他表示，中国的持续限制是华盛顿仅同意将贸易休战延长两个月的原因之一。

paras.en: Ana Swanson contributed reporting from Washington, Aie Balagtas See from Manila, and Laura Chung from Sydney, Australia.
paras.zh: Ana Swanson 来自华盛顿、Aie Balagtas See 来自马尼拉和 Laura Chung 来自澳大利亚悉尼。

articles.title: Jhené Aiko Is Bringing ‘Whimsy’ on the Road With H.E.R., Swae Lee & Karri: Here Are the Tour Dates
articles.author: Angel Diaz

paras.en: Jhené Aiko is heading out on a 37-city North American tour to support her first No. 1 album, Westside Whimsy.
paras.zh: Jhené Aiko 即将前往北美 37 个城市进行巡演，以支持她的第一张排名第一的专辑《Westside Whimsy》。

paras.en: Jhené Aiko Presents: Ark to Agartha – A Westside Whimsy Experience begins on Wednesday, March 10, in St. Louis at the Enterprise Center, and will end in her hometown of Los Angeles on Friday, May 21, at Crypto.com Arena. She’ll be supported by Swae Lee and Kari for every single tour date, while H.E.R. will be a special guest starting on Friday, March 26, at Barclays Center in Brooklyn, N.Y., until the final tour stop in L.A. Aiko’s last tour, 2024’s Magic Hour Tour, during which she performed songs from her album Chilombo, which debuted at No. 2 on the Billboard 200. She was supported by Coi Leray, Tink, Umi and Kiana Ledé on that trek.
paras.zh: Jhené Aiko 呈现：方舟到阿加莎 – 西区奇思妙想体验将于 3 月 10 日星期三在圣路易斯企业中心开始，并将于 5 月 21 日星期五在她的家乡洛杉矶 Crypto.com Arena 结束。每次巡演，她都会得到 Swae Lee 和 Kari 的支持，而 H.E.R.将于 3 月 26 日星期五在纽约布鲁克林巴克莱中心开始，直到 L.A. Aiko 最后一次巡演的最后一站，也就是 2024 年的 Magic Hour Tour 巡演的最后一站，期间她演唱了专辑《Chilombo》中的歌曲，该专辑首次亮相就在公告牌 200 强排行榜上排名第二。在那次长途跋涉中，她得到了 Coi Leray、Tink、Umi 和 Kiana Ledé 的支持。

paras.en: Westside Whimsy debuted at No. 1 after arriving in September, and features fellow California natives Ab-Soul, Tyga, Larry June, Kendrick Lamar and OHMA
paras.zh: Westside Whimsy 于 9 月抵达后首次亮相就排名第一，成员包括加州本地人 Ab-Soul、Tyga、Larry June、Kendrick Lamar 和 OHMA

paras.en: General onsale starts Friday, Nov. 20, at 10 a.m. local time via Live Nation. Verizon customers who are part of the carrier’s loyalty program will have access to an exclusive presale period for select shows on Wednesday, Nov. 18, at 10 a.m. local time to Thursday, Nov. 19, at 10 p.m. local time.
paras.zh: 常规发售将于当地时间 11 月 20 日星期五上午 10 点通过 Live Nation 开始。参与该运营商忠诚度计划的 Verizon 客户将可以享受当地时间 11 月 18 日星期三上午 10 点至 11 月 19 日星期四晚上 10 点精选节目的独家预售期。当地时间。

paras.en: There, of course, will also be VIP packages available ranging from premium tickets, exclusive access to the Westside Whimsy Soundbath Experience with Jhené Aiko, invitation to the pre-show VIP Lounge, specially designed VIP merchandise item and more.
paras.zh: 当然，这里还将提供 VIP 套餐，包括高级门票、与 Jhené Aiko 一起独家参与 Westside Whimsy Soundbath 体验、进入演出前 VIP 休息室的邀请、特别设计的 VIP 商品等等。

articles.title: Apple Music Outage: Company Says Streamer Is Back Online After Brief Disruption
articles.author: Chris Eggertsen

paras.en: Apple Music and other Apple services were experiencing outages on Tuesday (Nov. 17), Billboard has confirmed, with the company citing an “internal update” as the cause.
paras.zh: Billboard 证实，Apple Music 和其他苹果服务于周二（11 月 17 日）出现中断，该公司称原因是“内部更新”。

paras.en: “Many of our systems are back up and running after an internal update caused some outages this morning,” said an Apple spokesperson in a statement to Billboard. “We’re working to get the remaining systems online as soon as possible.”
paras.zh: 苹果发言人在给 Billboard 的一份声明中表示：“今天早上内部更新导致一些中断后，我们的许多系统都已恢复并运行。” “我们正在努力尽快让其余系统上线。”

paras.en: In addition to Apple Music, the App Store, Apple Pay, AppleCare and Apple Business were among the services experiencing outages or other access issues on Tuesday. As of press time, the spokesperson says Apple Music is back online.
paras.zh: 除了 Apple Music 之外，App Store、Apple Pay、AppleCare 和 Apple Business 等服务也在周二出现了中断或其他访问问题。截至发稿时，发言人表示 Apple Music 已恢复上线。

paras.en: The Apple outages are the latest in a rash of similar incidents over the past week. On Thursday (Nov. 12), Microsoft Outlook experienced an outage that lasted nearly 24 hours, causing disruption to business operations across the globe; Microsoft has since attributed the issue to “a latent defect” following a fix deployed for Microsoft 365 networking gateway servers, among other contributing factors. On Friday (Nov. 13), flights were grounded across the U.S. after the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) said it was experiencing technical issues. The FAA later claimed that “legacy equipment became unstable when data began flooding the FAA FTI network,” which “disrupted the system and created instability with aircraft communications and radar feeds.”
paras.zh: 苹果公司的宕机事件是过去一周发生的一系列类似事件中的最新一起。周四（11 月 12 日），Microsoft Outlook 发生了持续近 24 小时的中断，导致全球业务运营中断；此后，微软将该问题归因于为 Microsoft 365 网络网关服务器部署修复程序后的“潜在缺陷”以及其他影响因素。周五（11 月 13 日），美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 表示遇到技术问题后，美国各地的航班停飞。 FAA 后来声称，“当数据开始涌入 FAA FTI 网络时，旧设备变得不稳定”，这“扰乱了系统并造成了飞机通信和雷达馈送的不稳定。”

paras.en: So far this week, similar outages have affected companies including JPMorgan Chase, Wells Fargo, Bank of America and United Airlines. JPMorgan Chase has attributed its issues to a software bug while United Airlines blamed a “widespread system outage.” No companies or government agencies have cited cybersecurity incidents.
paras.zh: 本周到目前为止，类似的停电已经影响到摩根大通、富国银行、美国银行和联合航空等公司。摩根大通将其问题归咎于软件错误，而联合航空则将其归咎于“广泛的系统中断”。没有公司或政府机构提及网络安全事件。

articles.title: Chris Brown Gives Elderly Woman a Night to Remember With Sultry ‘Take You Down’ Performance in Los Angeles
articles.author: Michael Saponara

paras.en: Chris Brown has made a habit of bringing different women on stage for the “Take You Down” portion of his performance on the R&B Tour, but now he’s entered another age bracket.
paras.zh: 克里斯·布朗 (Chris Brown) 习惯于在 R&B 巡演中的“Take You Down”部分中邀请不同的女性登上舞台，但现在他进入了另一个年龄段。

paras.en: C. Breezy had an older woman — who goes by Ms. Joyce — escorted to the stage at Sunday night’s (Nov. 15) show inside Los Angeles’ SoFi Stadium, and she was dressed to impress for her moment, which found Ms. Joyce rocking a zebra-print mink coat, a furry hat and shades while walking with a red cane.
paras.zh: 周日晚上（11 月 15 日）在洛杉矶 SoFi 体育场举行的演出中，C. Breezy 邀请一位年长的女士（自称乔伊斯女士）登上舞台，她的着装给人留下了深刻的印象，乔伊斯女士穿着一件斑马纹貂皮大衣，戴着一顶毛茸茸的帽子，戴着墨镜，拄着红色拐杖行走。

paras.en: Clips quickly made the rounds on social media as CB serenaded Ms. Joyce on a stripper pole and then laid her down and danced on her on a red couch for the top 5 Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs chart hit, which had Ms. Joyce in a trance and in another dimension mentally.
paras.zh: Clips 很快就在社交媒体上疯传，CB 在脱衣舞杆上为乔伊斯女士唱了小夜曲，然后让她躺在红色沙发上，为热门 R&B/Hip-Hop 歌曲排行榜前 5 名跳舞，这让乔伊斯女士处于恍惚状态，精神上进入了另一个维度。

paras.en: Brown posted photos from the viral interaction. “Love her,” Breezy captioned the pictures, which Ms. Joyce should have framed and hung up somewhere in her home.
paras.zh: 布朗发布了病毒式互动的照片。 “爱她，”微风给这些照片加上了标题，乔伊斯女士应该把这些照片装裱起来挂在家里的某个地方。

paras.en: A bunch of the R&B star’s celebrity friends had a laugh at the heartwarming exchange and possible bucket list item for Ms. Joyce. “God bless your heart babe. You gave her a night she will NEVER forget,” actress Taraji P. Henson wrote.
paras.zh: 这位 R&B 明星的一群名人朋友对乔伊斯女士的温馨交流和可能的愿望清单项目大笑。 “上帝保佑你的心宝贝。你给了她一个她永远不会忘记的夜晚，”女演员塔拉吉·P·汉森写道。

paras.en: Rapper Ray Vaughn joked, “Life alert bout to go off!” And Lupe Fiasco called the move from Breezy “diabolical.”
paras.zh: 说唱歌手雷·沃恩开玩笑说：“生活警报即将响起！” Lupe Fiasco 称 Breezy 的举动是“恶魔般的”。

paras.en: With the Nov. 16 date at SoFi Stadium of the R&B Tour canceled, Ms. Joyce will have to travel to get another opportunity to get eye-to-eye with Breezy again.
paras.zh: 由于 11 月 16 日在 SoFi 体育场举行的 R&B 巡演取消，Joyce 女士将不得不前往寻找再次与 Breezy 面对面交流的机会。

paras.en: Next up, the lucrative trek is heading to New Orleans for a pair of shows this weekend before returning to Houston to finish off November. The R&B Tour is currently slated to wrap up in Tampa Bay, Fla., on Dec. 12.
paras.zh: 接下来，这个利润丰厚的长途跋涉将在本周末前往新奥尔良参加两场演出，然后返回休斯顿，结束 11 月的演出。 R&B 巡演目前定于 12 月 12 日在佛罗里达州坦帕湾结束。

paras.en: The R&B Tour became the highest-grossing and best-selling run for the month of September. According to Billboard Boxscore, the co-headlining tour with Usher grossed $77.4 million and sold 423,000 tickets across 10 shows in September.
paras.zh: R&B 巡演成为 9 月份票房最高、销量最高的巡演。根据 Billboard Boxscore 的数据，9 月份与亚瑟小子联合领衔的巡演 10 场演出的票房收入为 7,740 万美元，售出 423,000 张门票。

paras.en: On the awards front, Chris Brown also collected another pair of Grammy Award nominations, as his Brown (The Chocolate Edition) LP is up for best R&B album, while he’s nominated in best R&B collaboration or duo/group performance for his team-up with Leon Thomas on “Fallin’.”
paras.zh: 在奖项方面，克里斯·布朗还获得了另外两项格莱美奖提名，他的《布朗》（巧克力版）唱片获得了最佳 R&B 专辑奖，同时他还因与莱昂·托马斯合作的《Fallin’》获得了最佳 R&B 合作或二人/团体表演奖提名。

articles.title: Vans Warped Tour Orlando: Bands Support Each Other Over Two Days of Camaraderie and Rock Music After Flights Were Grounded
articles.author: Kimberly Nordyke

paras.en: The weekend’s delayed flights were certainly on everyone’s minds at the Vans Warped Tour in Orlando this weekend, as nearly 150 bands played to a crowd of nearly 50,000 wildly enthusiastic fans on each of its two days outside Camping World Stadium.
paras.zh: 本周末在奥兰多举行的 Vans Warped Tour 巡回赛上，每个人都在关注周末航班延误的情况，在露营世界体育场外的两天里，每天都有近 150 个乐队为近 50,000 名狂热粉丝表演。

paras.en: The festival kicked off over the weekend after the Federal Aviation Administration’s decision to ground flights on Friday and the aftermath of missed and delayed flights once the FAA allowed air travel to resume. On Saturday morning, Warped Tour founder Kevin Lyman said in an Instagram video that “a few bands” had to cancel due to the shutdown but “not as many as we thought. … Some bands have jumped in vans and [are] driving from as far away as Chicago and Houston.” The schedule for each day was adjusted, he said, to accommodate those delays and allow the bands more time to get to Orlando.
paras.zh: 联邦航空管理局决定周五停飞航班，以及联邦航空局允许恢复航空旅行后航班错过和延误的后果后，该节日于周末拉开帷幕。周六早上，Warped Tour 创始人凯文·莱曼 (Kevin Lyman) 在 Instagram 视频中表示，“一些乐队”由于停摆而不得不取消演出，但“数量没有我们想象的那么多……一些乐队已经跳上面包车，从芝加哥和休斯顿远道而来。”他说，每天的时间表都进行了调整，以适应这些延误，并让乐队有更多时间到达奥兰多。

paras.en: From a concertgoer’s perspective, the entire operation ran smoothly and on time despite many of the musicians having to overcome major travel hurdles to get there. Third Eye Blind frontman Stephan Jenkins told the crowd on Saturday night that he had left the previous morning at 9 a.m., spent the night in the airport and didn’t arrive in Orlando until just a few hours before his band hit the stage. “I didn’t know how it was gonna turn out; I didn’t know if I was gonna make it at all,” he said.
paras.zh: 从音乐会观众的角度来看，尽管许多音乐家必须克服主要的旅行障碍才能到达那里，但整个活动仍顺利且准时地进行。 Third Eye Blind 主唱斯蒂芬·詹金斯 (Stephan Jenkins) 于周六晚上告诉观众，他于前一天早上 9 点出发，在机场过夜，直到乐队登台前几个小时才抵达奥兰多。 “我不知道结果会如何；我根本不知道我是否能成功，”他说。

paras.en: “I’m so glad I got my ass here today,” Hot Chelle Rae’s Nash Overstreet told the crowd on Sunday afternoon. “I wish the rest of the band could have been here for you guys, but I could not let this go without showing up.” Also on Sunday, Set Your Goals, fronted by Jordan Brown and Matt Wilson, revealed that two of their band members were stuck at various airports across the U.S., and they had a substitute drummer and rhythm guitarist “step up to make this Set Your Goals show happen today. We have a bounty of [musicians] stepping in.”
paras.zh: “我很高兴今天能来到这里，”周日下午，热门 Chelle Rae 的纳什·奥弗斯特里特 (Nash Overstreet) 对人群说道。 “我希望乐队的其他成员也能在这里为你们服务，但我不能不出现就让这件事过去。”同样在周日，由乔丹·布朗和马特·威尔逊领衔的“设定你的目标”透露，他们的两名乐队成员被困在美国各地的机场，他们有一名替补鼓手和节奏吉他手“挺身而出，让今天的“设定你的目标”演出如期举行。我们有大量的[音乐家]介入。”

paras.en: Similarly, Reel Big Fish lead singer Aaron Barrett, who said he’d arrived only a few hours before his band took the stage, shared that fellow Warped Tour band Millington had agreed to help out his group if they needed anyone to step in. In fact, the two bands did take the stage together at the end of Reel Big Fish’s set for a high-energy ska take on A-ha’s “Take on Me,” which had the crowd going wild.
paras.zh: 同样，Reel Big Fish 主唱亚伦·巴雷特 (Aaron Barrett) 表示，他是在乐队登台前几个小时到达的，他表示，Warped Tour 乐队的同伴 Millington 已同意在需要任何人介入时为他的乐队提供帮助。事实上，在 Reel Big Fish 演出结束时，两支乐队确实一起登台，演绎了 A-ha 的《Take on Me》，演绎了充满活力的斯卡风格，让观众疯狂不已。

paras.en: There was a feeling of camaraderie across the two days, with the artists encouraging those in the crowd to make new friends and also support one another. On Saturday night, 311 lead singer Nick Hexum asked the crowd if they were “feeling the unity,” which received deafening applause. Third Eye Blind’s Jenkins told the concertgoers to “tap someone you don’t know on the shoulder and say hi,” and later, before the band launched into “Semi-Charmed Life,” he told festivalgoers to “put your arm around somebody.”
paras.zh: 这两天充满了友情，艺术家们鼓励人群结交新朋友并互相支持。周六晚上，311 主唱 Nick Hexum 问观众是否“感受到团结”，赢得了震耳欲聋的掌声。 Third Eye Blind 的詹金斯告诉音乐会观众“拍拍你不认识的人的肩膀并打个招呼”，后来，在乐队开始演奏“Semi-Charmed Life”之前，他告诉音乐节观众“用手臂搂住某人”。

paras.en: Sublime lead singer Jakob Nowell encouraged the Warped attendees to “try to make some friends out there. It’s about the memories you make.” In a poignant moment, he spoke about keeping traditions alive. “If my dad were up here, he’d say the same thing. This is for him. I love you, Dad,” he said of his father — Bradley Nowell, Sublime’s original lead singer and guitarist, who died in 1996 — before the band launched into “Badfish.”
paras.zh: 崇高的主唱雅各布·诺威尔（Jakob Nowell）鼓励扭曲的与会者“尝试在那里结交一些朋友。这是关于你留下的回忆。”在一个令人心酸的时刻，他谈到了保持传统的活力。 “如果我爸爸在这里，他也会说同样的话。这是给他的。我爱你，爸爸，”他谈到他的父亲——Sublime 最初的主唱兼吉他手布拉德利·诺厄尔 (Bradley Nowell)，于 1996 年去世——之后乐队推出了“Badfish”。

paras.en: Pierre Bouvier, lead singer of Saturday night’s closer Simple Plan, noted that he’d wished he’d been able to see Third Eye Blind’s performance, “but I could hear them, and they were great” before giving a shout-out to Sublime. Lolo, who’d performed the day prior for passengers on a Southwest Airlines flight, along with Simple Plan, The Used and Hoobastank, hit the stage with Simple Plan to perform “Jet Lag.” On the main stage, Hawthorne Heights’ JT Woodruff gave thanks to New Found Glory, saying his band wouldn’t exist without the latter, which the next day played on that very same stage.
paras.zh: 周六晚节目《Simple Plan》的主唱皮埃尔·布维尔 (Pierre Bouvier) 指出，他希望自己能够看到 Third Eye Blind 的表演，“但我能听到他们的声音，他们很棒”，然后才向 Sublime 致敬。 Lolo 前一天在西南航空公司的航班上为乘客表演过，与 Simple Plan、The Use 和 Hoobastank 一起登上舞台，与 Simple Plan 一起表演了《时差》。在主舞台上，霍桑高地 (Hawthorne Heights) 的 JT Woodruff 对 New Found Glory 表示感谢，并表示如果没有后者，他的乐队就不会存在，第二天，该乐队就在同一个舞台上演出。

paras.en: Throughout the weekend, various bands and solo artists also paid tribute to others by performing covers. Simple Plan did a rousing medley that included Smash Mouth’s “All Star,” Avril Lavigne’s “Sk8er Boi” and The Killers’ “Mr. Brightside.” Hot Chelle Rae performed a mashup of Spin Doctors’ “Two Princes,” LFO’s “Summer Girls” and Third Eye Blind’s “Semi-Charmed Life.” Third Eye Blind, meanwhile, included David Bowie’s “Heroes” in their set, while Bowling for Soup sang Wheatus’ “Teenage Dirtbag.” On another stage, Tillie sang “Lucky,” which she called Britney Spears’ “most emo song.”
paras.zh: 整个周末，各种乐队和独唱艺术家也通过翻唱表演向其他人致敬。 Simple Plan 制作了一首激动人心的混合曲，其中包括 Smash Mouth 的《All Star》、艾薇儿·拉维尼 (Avril Lavigne) 的《Sk8er Boi》和 The Killers 的《Mr. Brightside》。火辣的 Chelle Rae 表演了 Spin Doctors 的《Two Princes》、LFO 的《Summer Girls》和 Third Eye Blind 的《Semi-Charmed Life》的混搭。与此同时，Third Eye Blind 在他们的演出中加入了大卫·鲍伊的《Heroes》，而 Bowling for Soup 则演唱了 Wheatus 的《Teenage Dirtbag》。在另一个舞台上，蒂莉演唱了《Lucky》，她称其为布兰妮·斯皮尔斯“最情绪化的歌曲”。

paras.en: In a bit of a switcheroo, Simple Plan’s Bouvier took the drums from Chuck Comeau during “I’m Just a Kid,” which saw Comeau go crowd-surfing, while Bowling for Soup’s Jaret Reddick came out and finished the vocals for the song. (Earlier in the day, Bowling for Soup also hit the main stage, including their theme song to Phineas and Ferb on their set list. Continuing the TV theme song trend, Simple Plan invited fans dressed in Scooby-Doo costumes onstage while they performed their theme song to What’s New, Scooby-Doo? — a regular feature of their tours that allows the fans a special experience onstage.)
paras.zh: 在《I'm Just a Kid》中，Simple Plan 的 Bouvier 接手了 Chuck Comeau 的鼓，科莫在人群中冲浪，而 Bowling for Soup 的 Jaret Reddick 则出来完成了这首歌的演唱。 （当天早些时候，Bowling for Soup 也登上了主舞台，其中包括《飞哥与小佛》的主题曲。Simple Plan 延续了电视主题曲的趋势，邀请身着史酷比服装的粉丝登台表演《What’s New, Scooby-Doo?》的主题曲——这是他们巡演的常规节目，让粉丝在舞台上获得特殊的体验。）

paras.en: Other bands on the two-day bill included Phantom Planet, who ended their set with “California” to a wildly appreciative crowd; Jimmy Eat World, who got the crowd pumped up with “The Middle”; Gym Class Heroes, who performed “Stereo Hearts” sans Adam Levine; Save Ferris, who did two sets, including on the “Warped Unplugged” stage; and plenty of others, from Taking Back Sunday to The Summer Set to Thrice to Insane Clown Posse to Sleeping With Sirens.
paras.zh: 为期两天的演出中的其他乐队包括 Phantom Planet，他们以《California》结束了他们的演出，受到了观众的热烈欢迎。 Jimmy Eat World，他的《The Middle》让观众兴奋不已；体操班英雄 (Gym Class Heroes)，在亚当·莱文 (Adam Levine) 的带领下表演了《立体之心》(Stereo Hearts)；拯救费里斯，他做了两场演出，其中包括“Warped Unplugged”舞台；还有很多其他的作品，从《夺回周日》到《夏日场景》，到《三次》，到《疯狂小丑团》，再到《与警报器共眠》。

paras.en: As you might expect, festgoers were mostly decked out in black, Vans’ signature checkerboard pattern or a combination of both, with colorful hair, impressive mohawks and lots of tattoos and piercings, as befitting a rock concert. But there were some who donned costumes ranging from the aforementioned Scooby-Doo to a Ratatouille to bananas and hot dogs to one man who was dressed like Jesus Christ from head to toe, including a crown of “thorns.” On that theme, another man had a sign that read “Free Hugs & Prayers” and was seen speaking intimately with a woman who appeared to be in need of the latter and embracing another woman the next day.
paras.zh: 正如你所预料的那样，参加音乐节的人大多穿着黑色、Vans 标志性的棋盘图案或两者的组合，有着色彩缤纷的头发、令人印象深刻的莫霍克发型以及大量的纹身和穿孔，就像一场摇滚音乐会。但也有一些人穿着各种各样的服装，从前面提到的史酷比到料理鼠王，再到香蕉和热狗，再到一个从头到脚穿得像耶稣基督的人，包括一顶“荆棘”王冠。在这个主题上，另一名男子举着一个标语，上面写着“免费拥抱和祈祷”，有人看到他与一名似乎需要后者的女性亲密交谈，并在第二天拥抱了另一名女性。

paras.en: There was plenty of crowd-surfing inside the VIP area, with one of those banana-suited attendees spotted on the big screens. At one point, a woman in a wheelchair was being treated to the crowd-surfing experience. This, despite the event’s rather cleverly worded signs warning against the activity: “No moshing or crowd surfing. You mosh or crowd surf. You get hurt. Your mom sues. No more Warped.”
paras.zh: VIP 区域内挤满了人流，大屏幕上出现了其中一位穿着香蕉装的与会者。有一次，一名坐在轮椅上的女士正在接受人群冲浪体验。尽管该活动的措辞相当巧妙的标语警告人们不要参与这项活动：“禁止狂野或人群冲浪。你狂野或人群冲浪。你会受伤。你妈妈起诉。不要再扭曲了。”

paras.en: A half-pipe kept folks entertained with skateboarders doing stunts, while BMX athletes also did tricks inside the festival. Several bands engaged in meet-and-greets during the weekend, which also featured an assortment of food from giant turkey legs to smash burgers to funnel cakes to poké bowls.
paras.zh: U型管让滑板者表演特技为人们带来娱乐，而小轮车运动员也在节日期间表演特技。周末期间，几支乐队进行了见面会，其中还提供了各种各样的食物，从巨型火鸡腿到碎汉堡，从漏斗蛋糕到波克碗。

paras.en: The weekend ended with a literal bang, as Sunday’s closer, The Used, performed a cover of Nirvana’s “Smells Like Teen Spirit” while fireworks exploded in the night sky.
paras.zh: 周末在一声巨响中结束，周日的收官乐队 Theused 翻唱了 Nirvana 的《Smells Like Teen Spirit》，烟花在夜空中爆炸。

articles.title: Bat, Bond and Beyond: How Robert Pattinson Landed 007 (and What Comes Next)
articles.author: Erik Hayden

paras.en: Six months of searching for the next James Bond, so many notable actors auditioning, endless media speculation and fan casting, and the winner is … that guy who’s in everything.
paras.zh: 经过六个月的寻找下一个詹姆斯·邦德，这么多著名演员的试镜，无休止的媒体猜测和粉丝选角，最后的胜利者是……那个无所不能的人。

paras.en: Robert Pattinson is our seventh 007, and it’s rather tough to criticize Amazon MGM, producers and director Denis Villeneuve for selecting an actor who’s incredibly talented and has shown recent box office appeal. Villeneuve is on record as loving Pattinson’s riveting performance in Primetime, and surely the studio brass had to love that more than 75 percent of the A24 film’s opening-weekend audience cited Pattinson as their main reason for buying a ticket and that Primetime delivered a startlingly high percentage of Gen Z moviegoers (69 percent of the opening-weekend audience was under 30).
paras.zh: 罗伯特·帕丁森是我们的第七部 007，很难批评亚马逊米高梅、制片人和导演丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦选择了一位才华横溢且最近表现出票房吸引力的演员。维伦纽夫对帕丁森在黄金时段的引人入胜的表演有记录，电影公司高层肯定也喜欢这样的事实：在这部 A24 电影的首周末观众中，超过 75% 的观众将帕丁森视为他们购买门票的主要原因，而且黄金时段吸引了惊人高比例的 Z 世代电影观众（首周末观众中有 69% 年龄在 30 岁以下）。

paras.en: All of which surely helped Pattinson beat out the diverse pool of rival candidates (and by “diverse,” we mean athletic U.K.-born 36-year-old white guys who are also popular … just not as popular).
paras.zh: 所有这些无疑帮助帕丁森击败了多元化的竞争对手候选人（我们所说的“多元化”是指英国出生的 36 岁白人运动员，他们也很受欢迎……只是不那么受欢迎）。

paras.en: Plenty of observers note the ways in which the angular, brooding Pattinson has a strikingly different vibe compared to previous Bonds, seeming more like a candidate for the franchise’s villain than its hero. But it’s the actor’s A-list status that most sets him apart from Bond producers traditionally picking an up-and-coming actor who was merely familiar to audiences before putting him in a tux and passing him a Walther PPK.
paras.zh: 许多观察家注意到，棱角分明、沉思的帕丁森与之前的邦德电影相比，有着截然不同的氛围，看起来更像是该系列反派的候选人，而不是英雄。但最让他区别于邦德制片人的是这位演员的一线明星地位，传统上，邦德制片人会挑选一位观众熟悉的新星演员，然后让他穿上燕尾服，并递给他一张瓦尔特 PPK。

paras.en: When Amazon MGM took creative control of the James Bond franchise in February 2025 from gatekeepers Barbara Broccoli and her half brother Michael G. Wilson, ending the family’s decades-long stewardship of 007, everybody wondered what a Jeff Bezos-controlled Bond was going to look like. The studio’s previous attempt at a franchise asset landgrab — getting the rights to a Lord of the Rings prequel and releasing two seasons of a good-not-great The Rings of Power TV series — left many skeptical (particularly fanboys who regularly use the word “woke” as a pejorative).
paras.zh: 当亚马逊米高梅于 2025 年 2 月从看门人芭芭拉·布洛科利 (Barbara Broccoli) 和她同父异母的兄弟迈克尔·G·威尔逊 (Michael G. Wilson) 手中接管了詹姆斯·邦德系列的创意控制权，结束了家族长达数十年的 007 管理权时，每个人都想知道杰夫·贝索斯 (Jeff Bezos) 控制的邦德会是什么样子。该工作室之前曾尝试过抢夺特许经营权资产——获得《指环王》前传的版权，并发行了两季不太精彩的《权力指环》电视剧，但引起了许多人的怀疑（尤其是那些经常使用“醒来”这个词作为贬义词的粉丝）。

paras.en: But at every turn, the studio has signaled it desperately wants a four-quadrant Bond blockbuster: hiring the producers of the Harry Potter and Spider-Man films (David Heyman and Amy Pascal, respectively), the director of Dune and, now, a star that both accountants and indie film fans can love. Bond can never fail in his mission to save the world, and Amazon has stacked the deck to make sure its Bond will not fail to revive a 64-year-old franchise for the next generation.
paras.zh: 但在每一个转折点上，该工作室都表示迫切希望一部四象限的邦德大片：聘请了《哈利·波特》和《蜘蛛侠》电影的制片人（分别是大卫·海曼和艾米·帕斯卡）、《沙丘》的导演，以及现在会计师和独立电影迷都喜欢的明星。邦德拯救世界的使命永远不会失败，亚马逊已做好准备，确保其邦德不会失败，为下一代重振拥有 64 年历史的系列电影。

paras.en: “This has never happened before,” one agency partner says of the casting. “It speaks to the creative bankruptcy we’re facing. But also, this casting speaks to the likely down-the-middle direction we are going see with this movie.”
paras.zh: “这以前从未发生过，”一位代理合作伙伴谈到选角时说道。 “这说明了我们面临的创意破产。而且，这个选角也说明了我们在这部电影中可能看到的中间方向。”

paras.en: Pattinson’s popularity, however, comes with its own set of consequences, from existing brand endorsement deals (the actor has that Jaeger-LeCoultre on his wrist, but Bond has worn Omega watches for three decades), to his commitment to another major franchise, The Batman.
paras.zh: 然而，帕丁森的受欢迎也带来了一系列后果，从现有的品牌代言协议（演员手腕上戴着积家手表，但邦德三十年来一直佩戴欧米茄手表），到他对另一部主要系列电影《蝙蝠侠》的承诺。

paras.en: There likely won’t be a situation where Pattinson will be the face of Batman and Bond at the same time. The Batman: Part II is expected to finally wrap filming in early 2027 under Steven Soderbergh (who largely took over directing duties for the remaining principal photography from Matt Reeves, who stepped aside for a family matter in October). Skydance is aiming to get the film out in early 2028, while Bond 26 won’t likely land until later that year, at the earliest.
paras.zh: 帕丁森可能不会同时担任蝙蝠侠和邦德的代言人。 《蝙蝠侠：第二部》预计将于 2027 年初完成拍摄，由史蒂文·索德伯格 (Steven Soderbergh) 执导（他从马特·里夫斯 (Matt Reeves) 手中接管了剩余主要摄影的导演职责，而马特·里夫斯 (Matt Reeves) 在 10 月份因家庭事务而辞职)。 Skydance 的目标是在 2028 年初上映这部电影，而《邦德 26》最早也可能要到当年晚些时候才能上映。

paras.en: Reeves conceived his Batman films as a trilogy, but there’s a cloud of industry pessimism that a third Batman film will get made with Pattinson and Reeves given the second film will have taken six years and counting. Pattinson may no longer even be contractually obligated for another Batman film given the time the second has taken. Plus, Marvel executive turned DC Studios chief Jeremy Latcham is expected to want a Dark Knight who can not only support his own films but potentially integrate with other DC characters in team-up movies à la the MCU’s strategy.
paras.zh: 里夫斯将他的蝙蝠侠电影设想为三部曲，但业界对帕丁森和里夫斯将拍摄第三部蝙蝠侠电影感到悲观，因为第二部电影将花费六年时间并且还在继续。考虑到第二部蝙蝠侠电影所花费的时间，帕丁森甚至可能不再承担拍摄另一部蝙蝠侠电影的合同义务。此外，漫威高管、DC影业首席执行官杰里米·拉查姆预计希望黑暗骑士不仅能支持自己的电影，而且有可能按照漫威宇宙的策略，在合作电影中与其他DC角色融合。

paras.en: All this points to a likely reboot and recasting of Batman (which could messily mean the third Batman actor in a decade, but “messy” is DC’s modus operandi). “It had to end,” the partner noted of the current Batman franchise.
paras.zh: 所有这些都表明蝙蝠侠可能会重新启动和重新选角（这可能意味着十年内第三位蝙蝠侠演员，但“混乱”是DC的作案手法）。 “它必须结束，”合作伙伴在谈到当前的蝙蝠侠系列时说道。

paras.en: Yet Batman wasn’t the only project on Pattinson’s dance card. The actor has multiple projects in early development that haven’t been publicly reported, ranging from big-budget studio fare to art house projects. A couple producers with knowledge of Pattinson’s thinking don’t expect his Bond casting to mean he will ignore his art house passions.
paras.zh: 然而蝙蝠侠并不是帕丁森舞蹈卡上的唯一项目。这位演员有多个尚未公开报道的早期开发项目，从大预算的工作室费用到艺术屋项目。几位了解帕丁森想法的制片人并不认为他的邦德选角意味着他会忽视他对艺术的热情。

paras.en: “He is one of the most unusual of the A-list stars,” an insider says. “He watches shorts, scours the internet for material, contacts filmmakers himself — and he loves weird stuff.” Adds another who has worked with the actor, “You’re probably going to see a ‘one for them, two for me’ mentality.”
paras.zh: “他是一线明星中最不寻常的一位，”一位内部人士说道。 “他看短片，在互联网上搜索素材，亲自联系电影制片人——而且他喜欢奇怪的东西。”另一位与这位演员合作过的人补充道，“你可能会看到一种‘一个给他们，两个给我’的心态。”

paras.en: Still, a decade-plus commitment across multiple (reportedly three) films is going to take up a tremendous amount of time. A Bond film’s production timeline typically takes roughly eight months plus an extensive promo campaign, and it’s easy to imagine Amazon MGM’s first effort will go into overtime given the stakes.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，跨越多部（据报道为三部）电影的十多年承诺将占用大量时间。一部邦德电影的制作时间通常需要大约八个月，再加上广泛的宣传活动，考虑到风险，很容易想象亚马逊米高梅的第一次努力将陷入加班。

paras.en: The projects will also take a physical toll on the actor. While early reports suggested producers wanted to relaunch the franchise with a young Bond, the 40-year-old Pattinson is the oldest actor who tested for the role (and three years older than Daniel Craig when he was cast for Casino Royale). Pattinson also admitted that filming the fight scenes for The Batman: Part II was becoming tougher on his body.
paras.zh: 这些项目也会对演员的身体造成伤害。虽然早期报道称制片人希望让年轻的邦德重新推出该系列，但 40 岁的帕丁森是测试该角色的最年长的演员（比丹尼尔·克雷格在出演《皇家赌场》时大三岁）。帕丁森还承认，拍摄《蝙蝠侠：第二部》的打斗场面对他的身体来说变得越来越困难。

paras.en: “I’m definitely feeling my age when fighting a lot,” he told GQ in September. But Bond is generally a far more bruising role than Batman. Craig fractured his left ankle, tore his ACL, ruptured both calf muscles, tore a shoulder muscle and had two teeth knocked out across his Bond tenure.
paras.zh: “当我经常打架时，我确实会感觉到自己的年龄，”他在 9 月份告诉《GQ》。但邦德通常是一个比蝙蝠侠更令人痛苦的角色。克雷格在邦德任期内左脚踝骨折，十字韧带撕裂，小腿肌肉撕裂，肩部肌肉撕裂，两颗牙齿被打掉。

paras.en: Perhaps the biggest irony in all of this: Pattinson became a global star at 21 when he was cast as the co-lead in Twilight. Ever since, the actor has seemed like he was trying to subvert his franchise heartthrob status, bouncing between art house efforts and edgy roles in broad-appeal fare. Now he’s shackled himself to the most rigidly defined romantic action-hero archetype in cinema history with a multifilm commitment.
paras.zh: 也许这一切中最大的讽刺是：帕丁森在 21 岁时成为全球巨星，当时他被选为《暮光之城》的联合主演。从那时起，这位演员似乎一直在试图颠覆他的系列万人迷地位，在艺术作品和具有广泛吸引力的电影中的前卫角色之间摇摆。现在，他以多部电影的承诺将自己束缚在电影史上最严格定义的浪漫动作英雄原型上。

paras.en: Pattinson formally got the call he got the role on Sunday. He slowly started telling a very small number of trusted people, swearing them to secrecy. For Amazon, this is mission accomplished. For Pattinson, joining His Majesty’s Secret Service risks turning into, well, Bond-age.
paras.zh: 帕丁森周日正式接到电话，他得到了这个角色。他慢慢地开始告诉极少数值得信赖的人，让他们发誓保守秘密。对于亚马逊来说，这已经是使命完成了。对于帕丁森来说，加入国王陛下的特勤局可能会面临进入邦德年龄的风险。

paras.en: Borys Kit and Aaron Couch contributed to this report.
paras.zh: Borys Kit 和 Aaron Couch 对本报告做出了贡献。
