articles.title: In National Geographic’s “Expedition: Saving Our Seas,” it’s all hands on deck
articles.author: Carolyn Gramling

paras.en: As documentaries about Earth’s accelerating climate crisis go, Expedition: Saving Our Seas is surprisingly buoyant.
paras.zh: 正如有关地球日益加剧的气候危机的纪录片所言，《远征：拯救我们的海洋》出人意料地活跃。

paras.en: The ocean covers more than two-thirds of Earth’s surface. And “as the climate heats up, our seas are under pressure like never before,” narrator Auli’i Cravalho, the voice of the title character in Disney’s Moana, says at the opening of The National Geographic Society’s new documentary. The film documents how oceanographers are racing to document and mitigate climate change’s impacts on ocean and coastal habitats.
paras.zh: 海洋覆盖了地球表面三分之二以上的面积。 “随着气候变暖，我们的海洋面临着前所未有的压力，”迪士尼影片《莫阿娜》中主角的配音奥丽伊·克拉瓦略 (Auli'i Cravalho) 在国家地理学会新纪录片的开头说道。该影片记录了海洋学家如何竞相记录和减轻气候变化对海洋和沿海栖息地的影响。

paras.en: Expedition: Saving Our Seas premieres November 13 on the National Geographic Channel at 9pm EST and streams the next day on Disney+ and Hulu.
paras.zh: 《远征：拯救我们的海洋》于美国东部时间 11 月 13 日晚上 9 点在国家地理频道首播，并于次日在 Disney+ 和 Hulu 上播出。

paras.en: Despite that solemn mission, Expedition: Saving Our Seas is full of hope — and stunning visuals. The documentary offers a window into the scientists’ wonder and joy in their work as they discover new life forms in the depths of the Southern Ocean, or successfully nurture young corals threatened by warming in the Pacific Ocean.
paras.zh: 尽管肩负着庄严的使命，《远征：拯救我们的海洋》仍然充满希望——以及令人惊叹的视觉效果。这部纪录片为我们展示了科学家们在工作中的惊奇和喜悦，因为他们在南大洋深处发现了新的生命形式，或者成功地培育了受到太平洋变暖威胁的年轻珊瑚。

paras.en: The film opens with a twist on the usual world map: At the center is one great ocean, surrounded by land. Trivia buffs know Earth has five oceans: the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern and Arctic. But geographic names aside, these five oceans are just one, linked by a global system of currents known as the Great Ocean Conveyor Belt.
paras.zh: 影片一开始就改变了通常的世界地图：中心是一片巨大的海洋，周围是陆地。冷知识爱好者都知道地球有五大洋：太平洋、大西洋、印度洋、南方和北极。但撇开地理名称不谈，这五个大洋只是一个大洋，由称为大洋传送带的全球洋流系统连接起来。

paras.en: “It’s this giant connected ocean that ignores all of the political boundaries, ignores all of the names we call them,” says Andrew Thurber, a biological oceanographer at the University of California, Santa Barbara, whose research is among those featured in the film.
paras.zh: 加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校的生物海洋学家安德鲁·瑟伯（Andrew Thurber）说：“这是一个巨大的相连海洋，它无视所有的政治界限，无视我们对它们的所有名称。”他的研究也在影片中得到了体现。

paras.en: The documentary loosely follows the current’s path as it zips around the world from project to project.
paras.zh: 这部纪录片大致遵循了当今世界的潮流，从一个项目到另一个项目。

paras.en: The first project in the documentary is Thurber’s. He’s on board a research vessel in the frigid Southern Ocean, which rings Antarctica. Using a remotely-operated vehicle dubbed SuBastian, Thurber and his colleagues are scanning the seafloor, hunting for the world’s southernmost hydrothermal vent.
paras.zh: 纪录片中的第一个项目是瑟伯的。他在环绕南极洲的寒冷南大洋上的一艘科考船上。瑟伯和他的同事使用名为“苏巴斯蒂安”的远程操作车辆扫描海底，寻找世界最南端的热液喷口。

paras.en: Hydrothermal vents spew superhot, chemically-enriched seawater. In the generally nutrient-poor Southern Ocean, that makes these vents a potential food oasis to support deep sea life.
paras.zh: 热液喷口喷出超热、富含化学物质的海水。在普遍营养贫乏的南大洋，这使得这些喷口成为支持深海生物的潜在食物绿洲。

paras.en: Throughout the night, as the ROV scans the seafloor, Thurber and his colleagues stay glued to the video it sends back, oohing and aahing as never-before-seen life-forms come into view. “It was a marathon of excitement,” he says now.
paras.zh: 整个晚上，当遥控潜水器扫描海底时，瑟伯和他的同事们一直盯着它发回的视频，当前所未见的生命形式出现在视野中时，他们发出惊叹声和啊啊声。 “这是一场令人兴奋的马拉松，”他现在说道。

paras.en: Then they see it: A large black smoker, the southernmost hydrothermal vent ever found. And all around it: swarms of pregnant female krill.
paras.zh: 然后他们看到了：一个巨大的黑色烟雾，这是迄今为止发现的最南端的热液喷口。在它的周围：成群结队的怀孕雌性磷虾。

paras.en: “That blew all of our minds,” Thurber says. Krill are the keystone species of the entire Southern Ocean food web, a crucial food source for baleen whales, seals, penguins and fish. But krill are threatened by both industrial fishing and climate change. This discovery, Thurber says, helps make the case for a marine protected area, a region where fishing and other human activities should be restricted.
paras.zh: “这让我们所有人大吃一惊，”瑟伯说。磷虾是整个南大洋食物网的关键物种，是须鲸、海豹、企鹅和鱼类的重要食物来源。但磷虾同时受到工业捕捞和气候变化的威胁。瑟伯说，这一发现有助于建立海洋保护区，即应限制捕鱼和其他人类活动的区域。

paras.en: From the Southern Ocean, the Great Ocean Conveyor Belt flows thousands of kilometers to the north, where marine ecologist Maiyai Taal Hocheimy is tracking how the rising waters of the Atlantic Ocean are encroaching on Banjul, the capital of The Gambia in West Africa. Her hope is that salt-tolerant mangrove trees along the coast, with their dense network of soil-retaining roots, might help hold back the sea in the coming decades — provided that the community can be enlisted to help maintain the mangroves.
paras.zh: 大洋输送带从南大洋向北流动数千公里，海洋生态学家迈亚伊·塔尔·霍切米正在追踪大西洋上升的海水如何侵蚀西非冈比亚首都班珠尔。她希望，沿海的耐盐红树林及其密集的固土根系网络可能有助于在未来几十年内抑制海水的侵蚀——前提是社区可以参与帮助维护红树林。

paras.en: I found Hocheimy’s work especially inspiring because she is working to shape the future of oceanography. In 2017, she founded the GREAT (Gaining Research Experience in Africa for Tomorrow) Institute, the first aquatic and coastal science research institute in The Gambia. The mangrove project recruited young local scientists to help conduct the research.
paras.zh: 我发现 Hocheimy 的工作特别鼓舞人心，因为她正在努力塑造海洋学的未来。 2017年，她创立了GREAT（为明天在非洲获得研究经验）研究所，这是冈比亚第一个水生和沿海科学研究机构。红树林项目招募了当地年轻的科学家来帮助进行研究。

paras.en: “The goal is to train the next generation of environmental stewards,” Hocheimy says. “We have to show that mangroves have value, so they’ll understand and want to protect them. It is their future at stake.”
paras.zh: “我们的目标是培训下一代环境管理者，”霍切米说。 “我们必须证明红树林具有价值，这样他们就会理解并想要保护红树林。这关系到他们的未来。”

paras.en: That sentiment is echoed many times in the film — the importance not only of enlisting young scientists but also centering local scientists who pose new questions that oceanographers who parachute in from other places may not think to ask, says marine biogeochemist Kristina Brown.
paras.zh: 海洋生物地球化学家克里斯蒂娜·布朗（Kristina Brown）表示，这种观点在影片中多次得到呼应——不仅要招募年轻科学家，还要集中当地科学家提出新问题，而从其他地方跳伞而来的海洋学家可能不会想问这些问题。

paras.en: In the documentary, Brown, of the University of Manitoba in Canada, co-leads an expedition to explore the waters of Sherman Basin, a large bay north of the Arctic Circle in Nunavut, Canada. This region has been hunted and fished by Inuit people for centuries.
paras.zh: 在纪录片中，加拿大曼尼托巴大学的布朗与他人共同领导了一支探险队，探索谢尔曼盆地的水域，谢尔曼盆地是加拿大努纳武特地区北极圈以北的一个大海湾。几个世纪以来，这个地区一直被因纽特人狩猎和捕鱼。

paras.en: But it might change beyond all recognition in the next few decades, Brown says. So, the local Inuit community invited her to help create the first catalog of what species are present in the waters and on the seafloor. “[It’s] the first project I’ve been involved in where the local community both defined the research questions and have brought their own unique expertise to the research project.”
paras.zh: 但布朗表示，在接下来的几十年里，情况可能会发生翻天覆地的变化。因此，当地因纽特人社区邀请她帮助创建第一个水域和海底物种目录。 “[这是]我参与的第一个项目，当地社区既定义了研究问题，又为研究项目带来了自己独特的专业知识。”

paras.en: Watching how communities around the world are increasingly taking ownership of studies in their own waters was, for me, the most exciting takeaway of this documentary.
paras.zh: 对我来说，观看世界各地的社区如何越来越多地在自己的水域进行研究是这部纪录片最令人兴奋的收获。

paras.en: “We want to democratize access to the deep sea, to enable people who haven’t had access to these kinds of tools to ask more and new questions,” says Katy Croff Bell, the founder and president of the Ocean Discovery League, a nonprofit ocean exploration group based in Saunderstown, Rhode Island.
paras.zh: 位于罗德岛州桑德斯敦的非营利性海洋探索组织海洋探索联盟的创始人兼总裁凯蒂·克罗夫·贝尔 (Katy Croff Bell) 表示：“我们希望使进入深海的途径民主化，让那些无法使用这些工具的人们能够提出更多新问题。”

paras.en: As a result of inaccessibility, little of Earth’s vast ocean has been mapped, particularly the deep sea. Bell’s organization is developing inexpensive technologies such as a hardy little camera and sensor system dubbed DORIS, for Deep Ocean Research and Imaging System. It can descend to 6,000 meters and costs less than $10,000.
paras.zh: 由于交通不便，地球上广阔的海洋，尤其是深海，几乎没有被绘制出来。贝尔的组织正在开发廉价技术，例如用于深海研究和成像系统的耐用小型相机和传感器系统 DORIS。它可以下降到 6,000 米，成本不到 10,000 美元。

paras.en: Expedition: Saving Our Seas offers just a few scant minutes to each project before moving on around the globe to the next, so there’s no time to learn about each project in depth. But the overall takeaway of watching these vignettes, back to back, is that there is a young, energetic community of scientists taking on the challenge.
paras.zh: 探险：拯救我们的海洋在前往全球各地进行下一个项目之前，每个项目只提供了几分钟的时间，因此没有时间深入了解每个项目。但连续观看这些小插曲的总体收获是，有一个年轻、充满活力的科学家群体正在接受挑战。

paras.en: Mitigating climate change’s impacts on the oceans is, after all, a race against time. So it’s nice to think we might have all hands on deck.
paras.zh: 毕竟，减轻气候变化对海洋的影响是一场与时间的赛跑。因此，很高兴我们能够齐心协力。

articles.title: What to know about kratom and its powerful derivatives
articles.author: Bethany Brookshire

paras.en: For the past few years, addiction specialist Roopa Sethi has been seeing a new set of patients. They show up at the University of Kansas Health System hospital in Kansas City with what looks like severe opiate withdrawal: nausea, vomiting and muscle aches. They’re extremely anxious and sometimes hallucinating. But they haven’t taken an opioid, like fentanyl or heroin. Instead, they’ve used something labeled as kratom, though it may not contain kratom at all.
paras.zh: 在过去的几年里，成瘾专家鲁帕·塞西（Roopa Sethi）接诊了一批新的患者。他们出现在堪萨斯城堪萨斯大学健康系统医院，症状看起来像是严重的阿片戒断症状：恶心、呕吐和肌肉疼痛。他们极度焦虑，有时甚至产生幻觉。但他们没有服用芬太尼或海洛因等阿片类药物。相反，他们使用了标记为卡痛叶的东西，尽管它可能根本不含卡痛叶。

paras.en: Kratom is a plant used for chronic pain relief and to help people stay off opioids. But souped-up new versions with hyperpotent derivatives of the active compound are sold online and in gas stations. The derivatives act strongly on the body’s opioid receptors and are often far more powerful than the opioid drugs they are sometimes intended to replace. Kratom products — sold as pills, liquid shots, edibles and more — are often mislabeled, and state and federal regulations lag far behind.
paras.zh: 卡痛叶是一种用于缓解慢性疼痛并帮助人们远离阿片类药物的植物。但含有活性化合物超强衍生物的增强版新版本在网上和加油站出售。这些衍生物对人体的阿片受体产生强烈作用，并且通常比它们有时打算取代的阿片类药物更强大。卡痛产品（以药丸、液体注射剂、食品等形式出售）经常贴错标签，而且州和联邦法规远远落后。

paras.en: A 2026 survey estimated that about 5 million Americans have used kratom or similar products, and the increased use has sent kratom-related exposures up 1,200 percent from only 258 exposures in 2015, according to the National Poison Data System.
paras.zh: 根据国家毒物数据系统的数据，2026 年的一项调查估计，约有 500 万美国人使用过卡痛叶或类似产品，随着使用量的增加，与卡痛叶相关的接触量比 2015 年的 258 次增加了 1,200%。

paras.en: Now, newer versions of the substance can produce withdrawal symptoms like nausea and vomiting, which are often so severe they bring people to the hospital. Here’s what to know.
paras.zh: 现在，该物质的新版本可以产生恶心和呕吐等戒断症状，​​这些症状往往非常严重，导致人们去医院。以下是需要了解的内容。

paras.en: Kratom comes from the dried leaves of Mitragyna speciosa, a tree native to Southeast Asia. Dutch scientist Pieter Willem Korthals first described it in 1839. But “without a doubt, it was used likely for centuries prior to that” in countries including Thailand, Indonesia and Myanmar, says Oliver Grundmann, a pharmacologist at the University of Florida in Gainesville. “Wherever there is a stream, these trees are growing there.” People chewed the leaves for a stimulant effect and brewed them into a tea to treat pain,” Grundmann says.
paras.zh: 卡痛来自原产于东南亚的帽柱木 (Mitragyna spiosa) 的干燥叶子。荷兰科学家 Pieter Willem Korthals 于 1839 年首次描述了它。但佛罗里达大学盖恩斯维尔分校的药理学家奥利弗·格伦德曼 (Oliver Grundmann) 表示，“毫无疑问，它可能在此之前的几个世纪前就已在泰国、印度尼西亚和缅甸等国家使用”。 “哪里有溪流，哪里就有这些树。”人们咀嚼叶子以获得兴奋作用，并将它们泡成茶来治疗疼痛，”格伦德曼说。

paras.en: In the United States, kratom is billed pain treatment that is more “natural” than opiates like morphine, Sethi says. “When you take this product at low doses, it is used for waking up … but at higher doses it becomes opiate-like.” Others take it to treat withdrawal or cravings from opioid use.
paras.zh: 塞西说，在美国，卡痛叶被宣传为比吗啡等阿片类药物更“天然”的止痛药。 “当你服用低剂量的这种产品时，它是用来醒来的……但剂量较高时，它会变得像鸦片一样。”其他人则用它来治疗因使用阿片类药物而产生的戒断或渴望。

paras.en: The leaf form contains more than 40 different naturally occurring chemicals called alkaloids that could have psychoactive effects. The most important is mitragynine, which makes up two-thirds of the plant’s alkaloid content.
paras.zh: 叶子含有 40 多种不同的天然化学物质，称为生物碱，可能具有精神作用。最重要的是帽柱木碱，占植物生物碱含量的三分之二。

paras.en: Mitragynine acts on the body’s mu opioid receptors. These receptors — found in the brain, spinal cord and gut — usually respond to natural peptide signals in the body such as endorphins, signaling cells to produce pain relief and release chemicals like dopamine. The receptors get their name from the most famous drug that binds to them: opium. Mitragynine is not derived from or related to opium or morphine but it binds partially to the receptor.
paras.zh: 帽柱木碱作用于人体的 mu 阿片受体。这些受体存在于大脑、脊髓和肠道中，通常会对体内的天然肽信号（如内啡肽）做出反应，信号细胞产生止痛作用并释放多巴胺等化学物质。这些受体的名字来源于与其结合的最著名的药物：鸦片。帽柱木碱并非源自鸦片或吗啡，也与鸦片或吗啡无关，但它与受体部分结合。

paras.en: “It’s kind of like a dimmer switch versus turning on the lights,” says Mallory Pullman, a clinical toxicologist at the Mississippi Poison Control Center at the University of Mississippi Medical Center in Jackson. “You don’t fully light your room.”
paras.zh: “这有点像调光开关与开灯，”杰克逊密西西比大学医学中心密西西比毒物控制中心的临床毒理学家马洛里·普尔曼说。 “你的房间没有完全照亮。”

paras.en: Mitragynine also hits receptors that bind norepinephrine, serotonin and dopamine receptors, says Grundmann. The activity at adrenergic receptors creates a stimulant-like effect. “Now I think when we look at mitragynine, it’s primarily kind of this duality of the adrenergic and the opioid receptor activity,” he says, producing stimulating and depressive results in turn.
paras.zh: 格伦德曼说，帽柱木碱还会攻击与去甲肾上腺素、血清素和多巴胺受体结合的受体。肾上腺素能受体的活性产生类似兴奋剂的作用。 “现在我认为，当我们观察帽柱木碱时，它主要是肾上腺素能和阿片受体活性的二元性，”他说，依次产生刺激和抑制结果。

paras.en: What nature made, chemists and users are happy to tweak.
paras.zh: 化学家和用户很乐意对大自然的创造进行调整。

paras.en: As the kratom leaf is dried, Grundmann says, tiny amounts of mitragynine metabolize into another alkaloid, 7-hydroxymitragynine, or 7-OH. After someone takes kratom, the body also converts some mitragynine to 7-OH. The small chemical tweak changes the compound from one that binds partially to the mu opioid receptors to one that binds fully — like morphine or opium, Grundmann says. 7-OH binds 10 times more strongly to mu opioid receptors than mitragynine does. The resulting product is far more potent in its effects and addictive potential.
paras.zh: 格伦德曼说，当卡痛叶子干燥时，少量的帽柱木碱会代谢成另一种生物碱，7-羟基帽柱木碱或7-OH。服用卡痛叶后，身体还会将一些帽柱木碱转化为 7-OH。格伦德曼说，微小的化学调整将这种化合物从一种与μ阿片受体部分结合的化合物改变为一种完全结合的化合物，就像吗啡或鸦片一样。 7-OH 与 mu 阿片受体的结合强度是帽柱木碱的 10 倍。由此产生的产品的效果和成瘾潜力要强大得多。

paras.en: When people use the leaves alone, the amount of 7-OH is extremely limited. But by the mid-2010s, scientists found products with more than 500 percent more 7-OH than in the plant alone, and now, consumers can buy products labeled as pure 7-OH.
paras.zh: 当人们单独使用叶子时，7-OH的含量极其有限。但到了 2010 年代中期，科学家发现产品中的 7-OH 含量比植物本身多出 500% 以上，现在，消费者可以购买标记为纯 7-OH 的产品。

paras.en: While 7-OH can be described as “natural” because it can, in theory, occur in nature, toxicologists like Pullman are also seeing synthetic derivatives that are even stronger, including one molecule named MGM-15. MGM-15 is sold as a “research chemical” and is four times more powerful than 7-OH.
paras.zh: 虽然 7-OH 可以被描述为“天然”，因为理论上它可以存在于自然界中，但普尔曼等毒理学家也发现了更强的合成衍生物，包括一种名为 MGM-15 的分子。 MGM-15 作为“研究化学品”出售，其功效是 7-OH 的四倍。

paras.en: What is in kratom products may not always be what’s on the label, leaving users in the dark about what they are taking. In a 2026 analysis of 44 different kratom products, including tablets, dissolvable films and edibles, Pullman and her colleagues found that 85 percent of the products had contents that did not match the label. Some advertised kratom but contained very high levels of 7-OH. Others had alkaloids that weren’t listed at all.
paras.zh: 卡痛叶产品中的成分可能并不总是标签上的成分，这让用户对自己服用的成分一无所知。 2026 年，普尔曼和她的同事对 44 种不同的卡痛叶产品（包括片剂、可溶解薄膜和食品）进行了分析，发现 85% 的产品含量与标签不符。有些宣传卡痛叶但含有非常高含量的 7-OH。其他人则含有根本未列出的生物碱。

paras.en: It’s “very concerning at a consumer level if you can’t trust what’s actually on the label,” Pullman says.
paras.zh: 普尔曼说，“如果你不能相信标签上的实际内容，这对消费者来说是非常令人担忧的”。

paras.en: Sethi started hearing the word kratom about 10 years ago in her work with people seeking treatment for opioid use. “I would have patients intermittently tell me about kratom use,” she says. People were using kratom to stay off opioids, or to treat pain, and didn’t report being addicted to the plant.
paras.zh: 大约 10 年前，Sethi 在与寻求阿片类药物使用治疗的人们一起工作时开始听到卡痛叶这个词。 “我会让患者间歇性地告诉我卡痛叶的使用情况，”她说。人们使用卡痛叶来远离阿片类药物或治疗疼痛，但没有报告对这种植物上瘾。

paras.en: Now, it’s a different story, Sethi says.
paras.zh: 塞西说，现在情况不同了。

paras.en: Patients who started using kratom or 7-OH to get off opioids “now are having really bad withdrawal and cravings and ending up in the hospital,” she says. Some are seeking addiction treatment, not for opioids, but for kratom and 7-OH. In 2025, U.S. poison centers documented 3,434 kratom-related exposure reports, reported both by people who called the center and medical professionals. “I see less fentanyl and more kratom at this point, or more 7-OH,” Sethi says.
paras.zh: 她说，开始使用卡痛叶或 7-OH 来戒除阿片类药物的患者“现在戒断和渴望非常严重，最终住院了”。有些人正在寻求成瘾治疗，不是针对阿片类药物，而是针对卡痛叶和 7-OH。 2025 年，美国毒物中心记录了 3,434 份与卡痛叶相关的暴露报告，这些报告均由致电该中心的人员和医疗专业人员报告。 “此时我看到更少的芬太尼和更多的卡痛叶，或者更多的 7-OH，”Sethi 说。

paras.en: In July of 2026, the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration temporarily classified some kratom derivatives as Schedule I drugs, meaning they have high abuse potential and no medical use. Those derivatives include 7-OH and another related kratom derivative, mitragynine pseudoindoxyl or MGPI, as well as MGM-15 and its powerful sibling MGM-16. The DEA re-upped the temporary scheduling of MGM-15 and 16 and MGPI in October. 7-OH was temporarily placed in Schedule I at any dose higher than that found in the kratom plant. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has also issued statements warning consumers not to use the products. None of these measures affect the legality of the kratom leaf itself.
paras.zh: 2026 年 7 月，美国缉毒局暂时将一些卡痛叶衍生物归类为附表 I 药物，这意味着它们具有很高的滥用潜力且没有医疗用途。这些衍生物包括 7-OH 和另一种相关的卡痛衍生物、帽柱木碱假吲哚酚或 MGPI，以及 MGM-15 及其强大的同级 MGM-16。 DEA 于 10 月份重新调整了 MGM-15 和 16 以及 MGPI 的临时调度。 7-OH 暂时列入附表 I，其剂量高于卡痛厂中发现的剂量。美国食品和药物管理局也发表声明警告消费者不要使用这些产品。这些措施都不会影响卡痛叶本身的合法性。

paras.en: Regulations vary at the state level: Twenty-six states don’t regulate kratom at all, while six states and the District of Columbia list kratom’s ingredients as a Schedule I controlled substance, like the current federal scheduling. A further 18 states regulate sale and manufacture in some way.
paras.zh: 州一级的法规各不相同：26 个州根本不监管卡痛叶，而 6 个州和哥伦比亚特区将卡痛叶的成分列为附表 I 受控物质，就像目前的联邦附表一样。另外 18 个州以某种方式规范销售和制造。

paras.en: “I think there’s a lot more concern now, especially that there might be potential opioids out on the market,” Pullman says. Regulations are trying to thread the needle between banning the plant and banning high-potency derivatives, knowing that when one derivative gets smacked down, another will quickly appear in its place. That cycle is a familiar one, mirroring the evolution and development of synthetic opioids.
paras.zh: “我认为现在有更多的担忧，特别是市场上可能存在潜在的阿片类药物，”普尔曼说。法规正试图在禁止植物和禁止高效衍生品之间找到平衡点，因为他们知道，当一种衍生品被淘汰时，另一种衍生品很快就会出现在它的位置上。这一循环是常见的，反映了合成阿片类药物的演变和发展。

paras.en: “There’s risk with everything,” she says. “I think it’s important to distinguish the difference between a synthetic product versus the natural, and that way we can clearly attribute where the risk lies.”
paras.zh: “凡事都有风险，”她说。 “我认为区分合成产品与天然产品之间的差异很重要，这样我们就可以清楚地归因风险所在。”

articles.title: The U.S. just lost its measles elimination status. What now?
articles.author: Erin Garcia de Jesús

paras.en: After two years with nearly 100 measles outbreaks, thousands sickened and nearly a dozen deaths, the United States has officially lost its measles elimination status.
paras.zh: 两年来，美国爆发了近 100 起麻疹疫情，数千人患病，近十几人死亡，美国正式失去了麻疹消除地位。

paras.en: The highly contagious disease is now endemic in the United States, the Pan American Health Organization declared November 17. Analyses of cases dated from when the first outbreak began in 2025 in West Texas through part of 2026 revealed the virus has been spreading uninterrupted for more than a year. That benchmark signals measles is no longer under control.
paras.zh: 泛美卫生组织 11 月 17 日宣布，这种高度传染性的疾病目前在美国流行。对从 2025 年西德克萨斯州第一次疫情爆发到 2026 年部分时间的病例分析显示，该病毒已经不间断地传播了一年多。该基准表明麻疹不再受到控制。

paras.en: The United States is not alone. Mexico and Bolivia also lost their measles elimination status, PAHO announced; Canada had lost it in 2025. “Measles is resurging globally amid persistent gaps in vaccination coverage,” PAHO director Jarbas Barbosa said in a Nov. 17 news conference. “And this global trend is also affecting the Americas.” Countries will need to not only stop ongoing outbreaks, but also prove that no one caught measles within their borders for a full year to regain measles-free status.
paras.zh: 美国并不孤单。泛美卫生组织宣布，墨西哥和玻利维亚也失去了消除麻疹的地位；加拿大在 2025 年失去了这一点。“由于疫苗接种覆盖率持续存在差距，麻疹在全球范围内卷土重来，”泛美卫生组织主任贾巴斯·巴博萨 (Jarbas Barbosa) 在 11 月 17 日的新闻发布会上表示。 “这种全球趋势也正在影响美洲。”各国不仅需要阻止持续的疫情爆发，还需要证明一整年内没有人在其境内感染麻疹，才能恢复无麻疹状态。

paras.en: That won’t happen overnight. But there is a way, experts say. Vaccinating people across the country, particularly in areas with low vaccination rates, will stifle the virus’s spread. But so far, the U.S. federal public health response has taken a back seat to efforts from state and local health departments to curb ongoing outbreaks.
paras.zh: 这不会在一夜之间发生。但专家表示，有办法。在全国范围内为人们接种疫苗，特别是在疫苗接种率低的地区，将遏制病毒的传播。但到目前为止，美国联邦公共卫生应对措施已经退居次要地位，而州和地方卫生部门为遏制持续爆发的疫情做出了努力。

paras.en: Measles’s return “is an enormous black eye on the reputation of the United States,” said epidemiologist Jennifer Nuzzo of the Brown University School of Public Health in Providence, R.I., in a Nov. 9 webinar hosted by the university. The Americas led the global campaign to control the virus, and in 2016 the region became the first to eliminate measles transmission from all its countries.
paras.zh: 罗德岛州普罗维登斯布朗大学公共卫生学院的流行病学家 Jennifer Nuzzo 在 11 月 9 日由该大学主办的网络研讨会上表示，麻疹的卷土重来“对美国的声誉造成了巨大的打击”。美洲地区引领了全球控制病毒的运动，并于 2016 年成为第一个消除麻疹传播的国家。

paras.en: “To lose [elimination status] means we’re going backwards… meaning decades of progress lost,” Nuzzo said. “It’s an indicator of our lack of protection. It is an indicator of our lack of preparedness for disease threats in general.”
paras.zh: “失去[淘汰状态]意味着我们正在倒退……意味着几十年的进步都消失了，”努佐说。 “这表明我们缺乏保护。这表明我们总体上缺乏对疾病威胁的准备。”

paras.en: PAHO’s verdict comes amid a surge of measles not seen in the United States since 1991. Health officials have recorded more than 7,000 cases since the beginning of the West Texas outbreak. That tally includes nearly 2,300 measles cases in 2025 and 5,412 in 2026 as of November 12, according to the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Over 90 percent of cases have been in people who are unvaccinated or whose status is unknown. States report that 13 people have died, although the CDC so far recognizes only nine of those deaths.
paras.zh: 泛美卫生组织做出这一裁决之际，美国麻疹疫情自 1991 年以来从未出现过激增。自西德克萨斯州疫情爆发以来，卫生官员已记录了 7,000 多例病例。根据美国疾病控制与预防中心的数据，截至 11 月 12 日，这一数字包括 2025 年近 2,300 例麻疹病例和 2026 年 5,412 例麻疹病例。超过 90% 的病例发生在未接种疫苗或状况不明的人身上。各州报告称，已有 13 人死亡，但 CDC 迄今为止仅确认其中 9 人死亡。

paras.en: While mild measles symptoms include high fever, cough and a rash, roughly 1 in 5 people will be hospitalized with complications such as pneumonia or brain swelling. Children younger than 5 years and adults over 20 are more likely to get sick, as are pregnant women and their infants. At least 13 babies were born infected, called congenital measles, since the beginning of 2025, researchers report November 16 in NEJM Evidence. Those babies are at risk for developing dangerous brain swelling that is almost always fatal later on in life.
paras.zh: 虽然轻微的麻疹症状包括高烧、咳嗽和皮疹，但大约五分之一的人会因肺炎或脑肿胀等并发症而住院。 5 岁以下的儿童和 20 岁以上的成年人以及孕妇及其婴儿更容易生病。研究人员 11 月 16 日在《NEJM Evidence》上报告称，自 2025 年初以来，至少有 13 名婴儿出生时就受到感染，称为先天性麻疹。这些婴儿面临着发生危险的脑肿胀的风险，这种肿胀在以后的生活中几乎总是致命的。

paras.en: The measles, mumps and rubella, or MMR, vaccine helped eliminate measles from the United States in 2000. After that, cases still sometimes popped up. Those cases were mostly in unvaccinated people traveling from parts of the world where the virus still widely circulates. At least 95 percent of people in a community need to be vaccinated to prevent outbreaks.
paras.zh: 2000 年，麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹 (MMR) 疫苗帮助美国消除了麻疹。此后，病例仍时有出现。这些病例大多是来自病毒仍广泛传播的世界各地的未接种疫苗的人。社区中至少 95% 的人需要接种疫苗以预防疫情爆发。

paras.en: But widespread misinformation, including a disproven claim that the vaccine causes autism, means fewer children are receiving the MMR shot and more people are questioning its safety. According to the CDC, roughly 92 percent of kindergarteners across the United States had gotten the vaccine in 2025, down from 95 percent in 2019. And in 2025, 83 percent of U.S. adults viewed the MMR vaccine as safe, down from 86 percent in 2024, according to a survey from the University of Pennsylvania’s Annenberg Public Policy Center. Yet decades of evidence show the vaccine is safe and highly effective.
paras.zh: 但广泛存在的错误信息，包括未经证实的疫苗导致自闭症的说法，意味着接受 MMR 疫苗接种的儿童越来越少，而越来越多的人质疑其安全性。根据 CDC 的数据，到 2025 年，全美约 92% 的幼儿园儿童接种了疫苗，低于 2019 年的 95%。宾夕法尼亚大学安纳伯格公共政策中心的一项调查显示，2025 年，83% 的美国成年人认为 MMR 疫苗是安全的，低于 2024 年的 86%。然而数十年的证据表明该疫苗是安全且高效的。

paras.en: That measles made a comeback is not a surprise, says Nathan Lo, an infectious diseases physician and epidemiologist at Stanford University School of Medicine. Until recently, outbreaks were largely isolated to communities with low vaccination rates and quickly contained. But now, outbreaks seem to be more likely to spill over into neighboring communities, Lo says. “There’s a lot of potential connectedness between the outbreaks.”
paras.zh: 斯坦福大学医学院传染病医生兼流行病学家内森·洛 (Nathan Lo) 表示，麻疹卷土重来并不令人意外。直到最近，疫情主要局限于疫苗接种率较低的社区，并很快得到遏制。但现在，疫情似乎更有可能蔓延到邻近社区，罗说。 “疫情之间存在很多潜在的联系。”

paras.en: What’s more, some infected people aren’t getting tested, making them invisible to officials who are now struggling to trace chains of transmission. An outbreak that hit Arizona and Utah, for instance, was far larger than official numbers suggest, researchers reported July 15 in a preprint at medRxiv.org. The roughly 1,000 confirmed cases may represent just 20 to 30 percent of the outbreak’s true size.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，一些感染者没有接受检测，这使得目前正在努力追踪传播链的官员看不到他们。例如，研究人员 7 月 15 日在 medRxiv.org 上的预印本中报告称，亚利桑那州和犹他州爆发的疫情规模远远大于官方数据显示的规模。大约 1,000 例确诊病例可能仅占疫情真实规模的 20% 至 30%。

paras.en: A functional surveillance system is crucial to keeping outbreaks under control, Jonathan Temte, a family medicine physician at the University of Wisconsin School of Medicine and Public Health in Madison, said in the Brown University webinar. Without good surveillance across the entire country, “we can miss pockets out there if people aren’t reporting, if people are hiding cases.”
paras.zh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校医学与公共卫生学院的家庭医学医生乔纳森·特姆特在布朗大学网络研讨会上表示，功能齐全的监测系统对于控制疫情至关重要。如果全国范围内没有良好的监控，“如果人们不报告、如果人们隐瞒病例，我们可能会错过一些地方。”

paras.en: But surveillance alone won’t stop the virus from “popcorning across the country,” Nuzzo said. “Measles has returned, and it’s going to take vaccination to stop it.”
paras.zh: 但努佐说，仅靠监视并不能阻止病毒“在全国范围内传播”。 “麻疹卷土重来，需要接种疫苗来阻止它。”

paras.en: Over the last two years, measles outbreaks have popped up across the United States, sickening thousands of people since mid-January 2025. Most of those cases, shown by county where they were reported, are in people who are unvaccinated. Colors on the map indicate the relative number of cases reported. Green represents the lowest and red the highest number of cases. Notable outbreaks have appeared in Utah, Arizona, Texas, South Carolina, Wisconsin and Pennsylvania.
paras.zh: 过去两年，美国各地爆发了麻疹疫情，自 2025 年 1 月中旬以来，已有数千人患病。按报告所在县显示，大多数病例都是未接种疫苗的人。地图上的颜色表示报告病例的相对数量。绿色代表病例数量最少，红色代表病例数量最多。犹他州、亚利桑那州、德克萨斯州、南卡罗来纳州、威斯康星州和宾夕法尼亚州出现了明显的疫情爆发。

paras.en: Efforts to boost vaccine uptake could be targeted toward areas with low vaccination rates. Most places across the United States still have vaccination rates high enough to fend off measles, but not all. “Figuring out which ones are [high risk] can be a little tricky,” Lo says. “But if you do, then intervening in those places can be quite helpful to mitigate spread.”
paras.zh: 提高疫苗接种率的努力可以针对疫苗接种率低的地区。美国大多数地方的疫苗接种率仍然足够高，足以抵御麻疹，但并非全部。 “找出哪些是[高风险]可能有点棘手，”Lo 说。 “但如果你这样做，那么对这些地方进行干预对于减轻传播非常有帮助。”

paras.en: Homing in on school districts or individual schools could also help. State health departments typically report vaccination rates among school-age children by county. But that broad metric can hide high risk schools with low vaccination rates, epidemiologists Siyu Chen and Ana Bento reported in August in Nature Medicine. Computer simulations relying on data that included 50,000 schools across the United States showed that school-level estimates best revealed where the virus could gain a foothold. That was true even if county-level vaccination rates were close to 95 percent.
paras.zh: 关注学区或个别学校也可能有所帮助。州卫生部门通常按县报告学龄儿童的疫苗接种率。但流行病学家 Siyu Chen 和 Ana Bento 在 8 月的《自然医学》杂志上报道称，这一广泛的指标可能会掩盖疫苗接种率低的高风险学校。基于美国 50,000 所学校数据的计算机模拟显示，学校层面的估计最能揭示病毒可能在哪里立足。即使县级疫苗接种率接近 95%，情况也是如此。

paras.en: Another element that influenced where measles took off was whether communities with cases were near other areas with low vaccination rates, the team found. The outbreak in Texas, for instance, may have ended faster because communities with low vaccination rates were farther away from one another compared with outbreaks in South Carolina and Pennsylvania, says Bento, of Cornell University. Neighboring areas where many are unvaccinated may face longer-burning outbreaks. “Which is what we are now seeing,” Bento says.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，影响麻疹爆发地点的另一个因素是出现病例的社区是否靠近其他疫苗接种率较低的地区。康奈尔大学的本托说，例如，德克萨斯州的疫情可能结束得更快，因为与南卡罗来纳州和宾夕法尼亚州的疫情相比，疫苗接种率较低的社区彼此之间距离更远。许多人未接种疫苗的邻近地区可能会面临持续时间更长的疫情爆发。 “这就是我们现在所看到的，”本托说。

paras.en: Measles elimination status can be regained. The declaration that the virus is endemic is “not a punishment,” Bento says. It’s a sign that something needs to change. That might include vaccine catch-up campaigns, community outreach or getting rid of nonmedical vaccine exemptions.
paras.zh: 可以恢复麻疹消除状态。本托说，宣布该病毒为地方性病毒“不是一种惩罚”。这是一个迹象，表明有些事情需要改变。这可能包括疫苗追赶运动、社区外展或取消非医疗疫苗豁免。

paras.en: Local public health officials are “doing every last thing that you can imagine with limited resources,” health psychologist Noel T. Brewer said in a Nov. 12 webinar hosted by the Association of Health Care Journalists. But a cohesive plan at the federal level could bolster defenses before the virus arrives in new states, noted Brewer, of the University of North Carolina Gillings School of Global Public Health in Chapel Hill.
paras.zh: 健康心理学家诺埃尔·T·布鲁尔 (Noel T. Brewer) 在医疗保健记者协会 (Association of Health Care Journalists) 主办的 11 月 12 日网络研讨会上表示，当地公共卫生官员正在“利用有限的资源竭尽全力”。但北卡罗来纳大学教堂山吉林斯全球公共卫生学院的布鲁尔指出，联邦层面的一项有凝聚力的计划可以在病毒到达新州之前加强防御。

paras.en: Such efforts could be targeted toward areas with low vaccination rates. Most places across the United States still have vaccination rates high enough to fend off measles. “A subset [with low vaccination rates] are high risk,” Lo says. “Figuring out which ones are which can be a little tricky. But if you do, then intervening in those places can be quite helpful to mitigate spread.”
paras.zh: 这些努力可以针对疫苗接种率低的地区。美国大多数地方的疫苗接种率仍然很高，足以抵御麻疹。 “（疫苗接种率低的）子集是高风险的，”Lo 说。 “弄清楚哪些是哪些可能有点棘手。但如果你这样做了，那么对这些地方进行干预对于减轻传播非常有帮助。”

paras.en: There’s also wiggle room in the childhood vaccine schedule to provide kids extra protection. Normally children don’t get their first MMR dose until their first birthday. But doctors can give infants an extra MMR dose at 6 months if there is an active outbreak in their area. Pediatricians can also offer the second dose a month after the first one, rather than waiting until around the time children start kindergarten. Adults, particularly those who received only one dose, can also get a booster. It’s unclear whether health officials will officially recommend such actions.
paras.zh: 儿童疫苗接种计划中也有回旋余地，可以为孩子提供额外的保护。通常，儿童直到一岁生日才会接种第一剂 MMR 疫苗。但如果婴儿所在地区存在活跃的 MMR 疫情，医生可以在 6 个月大时给婴儿额外注射 MMR 剂量。儿科医生还可以在第一次注射后一个月注射第二剂，而不是等到孩子开始上幼儿园的时候。成年人，特别是那些只接受一剂疫苗的人，也可以获得加强疫苗。目前尚不清楚卫生官员是否会正式建议采取此类行动。

paras.en: “The problem is that there’s no trusted source for this vaccine decision anymore,” Lo says. Previous vaccine recommendations were up to the CDC’s Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices, which was disbanded in March after lawsuits blocked appointments made by Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. “Now, there’s a lot of different medical societies and initiatives to try and fill that void,” Lo says. But it’s unclear which would be best positioned to lead.
paras.zh: “问题是这个疫苗决定不再有可信的来源，”罗说。此前的疫苗建议由疾病预防控制中心的免疫实践咨询委员会提出，该委员会因诉讼阻止了卫生与公共服务部部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪的任命而于三月份解散。“现在，有很多不同的医学协会和倡议试图填补这一空白，”罗说。但目前尚不清楚谁最适合领导。

paras.en: CDC director Erica Schwartz has said the health agency will not be changing its response to ongoing outbreaks. “We’re going to be doing the same exact thing that we’ve been doing today, which is working with the states,” she told Reuters. The CDC did not respond to Science News requests for an interview, but shared in a Nov. 17 statement that the agency will “encourage MMR vaccination, expand access to vaccines, and help communities close gaps in protection.”
paras.zh: 疾病预防控制中心主任埃里卡·施瓦茨表示，该卫生机构不会改变对持续爆发的疫情的应对措施。她告诉路透社：“我们将做与今天一样的事情，即与各州合作。” CDC 没有回应《科学新闻》的采访请求，但在 11 月 17 日的一份声明中表示，该机构将“鼓励 MMR 疫苗接种，扩大疫苗接种范围，并帮助社区缩小保护差距。”

paras.en: Eliminating measles again will take dedicated resources and more funding funneled to public health departments across the country, Lo says. “You see increasing measles outbreaks and a lot of time and resources to contain these outbreaks at a time where you’re slashing budgets,” Lo says, “that’s a really bad mismatch.”
paras.zh: 罗说，再次消除麻疹需要专门的资源和更多的资金流入全国各地的公共卫生部门。罗说：“在削减预算的同时，麻疹疫情不断增加，需要大量时间和资源来控制疫情，这是一种非常严重的不匹配。”

paras.en: Public health responses to measles are expensive. Officials in New Mexico spent an estimated $5.4 million — over $53,000 per case — responding to a 2025 outbreak that was linked to West Texas. The CDC has provided an additional $100 million to states to help fight measles.
paras.zh: 针对麻疹的公共卫生应对措施成本高昂。新墨西哥州官员估计花费了 540 万美元（每个病例超过 53,000 美元）来应对 2025 年与西德克萨斯州有关的疫情。疾病预防控制中心已向各州额外提供 1 亿美元，以帮助抗击麻疹。

paras.en: Other countries have beaten back measles after an unwelcome return. Extensive vaccination campaigns helped Venezuela and Brazil regain measles elimination status after briefly losing it in 2017 and 2019. The Public Health Agency of Canada also announced that its nearly two-year-long outbreak officially ended in October, though it’s unclear when the country might earn its status back.
paras.zh: 在麻疹不受欢迎地卷土重来后，其他国家已经成功击退了麻疹。广泛的疫苗接种活动帮助委内瑞拉和巴西在 2017 年和 2019 年短暂失去麻疹消除地位后重新获得麻疹消除地位。加拿大公共卫生局还宣布，长达近两年的疫情于 10 月正式结束，但尚不清楚该国何时才能恢复麻疹消除地位。

paras.en: “It is not hopeless,” Nuzzo said. “It can be done, and I hope it will be done [in the United States].”
paras.zh: “这并非毫无希望，”努佐说。 “这是可以做到的，而且我希望（在美国）能够做到。”

articles.title: The hidden language of psychopathy is not what scientists expected

paras.en: The hidden language of psychopathy is not what scientists expected
paras.zh: 精神病的隐藏语言并不是科学家所期望的

paras.en: - Scientists have discovered that psychopathic traits are associated with surprisingly different patterns of language, with some individuals using more positive words and others expressing greater negativity or less anxiety. The findings challenge familiar stereotypes about psychopathy and suggest that the stories people tell about their lives may offer important clues about their personalities.
paras.zh: - 科学家发现，精神变态特征与令人惊讶的不同语言模式有关，一些人使用更积极的词语，而另一些人则表达更大的消极性或更少的焦虑。这些发现挑战了人们对精神病态的常见刻板印象，并表明人们讲述的生活故事可能提供有关他们性格的重要线索。

paras.en: The way people describe their lives may offer surprising clues about their personalities, including traits associated with psychopathy. A new study from the University of Mississippi challenges the familiar image of psychopaths as cold and emotionless, revealing that their patterns of language can be far more complex than expected.
paras.zh: 人们描述自己生活的方式可能会提供有关他们性格的令人惊讶的线索，包括与精神病相关的特征。密西西比大学的一项新研究挑战了人们所熟悉的精神变态者冷酷无情的形象，揭示了他们的语言模式可能比预期复杂得多。

paras.en: Researchers examined hundreds of personal life stories and discovered that three major traits associated with psychopathy, boldness, meanness, and disinhibition, were connected to distinctly different ways of using words. Some of the findings were particularly unexpected. For example, people who scored higher in meanness tended to use more positive language, while those with greater boldness used fewer words associated with anxiety.
paras.zh: 研究人员检查了数百个个人生活故事，发现与精神病态相关的三个主要特征：大胆、卑鄙和抑制解除，与截然不同的语言使用方式有关。有些发现特别出乎意料。例如，在刻薄方面得分较高的人倾向于使用更积极的语言，而在大胆方面得分较高的人则使用较少的与焦虑相关的词语。

paras.en: The findings, published in the journal Personality and Individual Differences, suggest that psychopathic traits can influence everyday communication in subtle ways that conventional stereotypes often overlook.
paras.zh: 发表在《人格与个体差异》杂志上的研究结果表明，精神变态特征可以以传统刻板印象经常忽视的微妙方式影响日常交流。

paras.en: "The goal here is not to diagnose psychopathy based on language," said Ky Bray, an Ole Miss doctoral candidate in psychology. "It's to point to the fact that psychopathy shows up in everyday behaviors, even subtle behaviors like language.
paras.zh: “我们的目标不是根据语言来诊断精神病，”密西西比大学心理学博士生凯·布雷 (Ky Bray) 说。 “它指出了这样一个事实，精神病态出现在日常行为中，甚至是语言等微妙的行为中。

paras.en: "If we want to understand psychopathy and the different traits that comprise it, we need to think creatively about how these traits shape social interaction."
paras.zh: “如果我们想了解精神病态以及构成它的不同特征，我们需要创造性地思考这些特征如何影响社会互动。”

paras.en: What 450 Life Stories Revealed About Psychopathy
paras.zh: 450 个生活故事揭示了哪些关于精神病态的内容

paras.en: The researchers used a psychological framework known as the Triarchic Model of Psychopathy, which examines three distinct personality dimensions. Boldness generally involves confidence and fearlessness, meanness reflects tendencies toward callousness and reduced empathy, and disinhibition involves difficulties with impulse control. According to Laura Drislane, an assistant professor of psychology at the University of Mississippi, these characteristics can affect ordinary behaviors, including how people describe their own experiences.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用了一种被称为精神病三元模型的心理框架，该模型检查了三个不同的人格维度。大胆通常涉及自信和无所畏惧，卑鄙反映了冷酷无情和同理心减少的倾向，而去抑制则涉及冲动控制的困难。密西西比大学心理学助理教授劳拉·德里斯兰 (Laura Drislane) 表示，这些特征会影响日常行为，包括人们如何描述自己的经历。

paras.en: To investigate these connections, Drislane and Bray recruited 450 participants, including college students and individuals who reported having been incarcerated. Each person responded to open questions about important moments in their life, including their greatest highs, lowest points, and major turning points.
paras.zh: 为了调查这些联系，Drislane 和 Bray 招募了 450 名参与者，其中包括大学生和自称曾被监禁的个人。每个人都回答了有关他们生活中重要时刻的开放性问题，包括他们的最高点、最低点和主要转折点。

paras.en: After writing their personal accounts, participants completed a questionnaire designed to measure their levels of psychopathic traits. The researchers then analyzed the written responses using specialized software that identifies patterns in word choice.
paras.zh: 在写下他们的个人账户后，参与者完成了一份旨在衡量他们的精神病特征水平的调查问卷。然后，研究人员使用专门的软件来分析书面回答，该软件可以识别单词选择的模式。

paras.en: The analysis focused on how frequently participants used language associated with different psychological categories, including positive and negative emotions, achievement, social influence or clout, and risk. By comparing these language patterns with the personality scores, the team identified several intriguing relationships.
paras.zh: 分析的重点是参与者使用与不同心理类别相关的语言的频率，包括积极和消极情绪、成就、社会影响力或影响力以及风险。通过将这些语言模式与性格分数进行比较，研究小组发现了一些有趣的关系。

paras.en: Surprising Differences in Positive and Negative Language
paras.zh: 积极和消极语言的惊人差异

paras.en: Participants with higher disinhibition scores generally used more negative words in their personal stories. They were also less likely to mention friends or use language connected to positive emotions and personal achievement.
paras.zh: 去抑制得分较高的参与者通常在个人故事中使用更多负面词汇。他们也不太可能提及朋友或使用与积极情绪和个人成就相关的语言。

paras.en: Meanness, however, showed a very different pattern. People scoring higher in this trait tended to use more positive language, along with more words related to achievement and rewards. They also used fewer expressions associated with negative emotions.
paras.zh: 然而，卑鄙却表现出截然不同的模式。在这一特质上得分较高的人倾向于使用更积极的语言，以及更多与成就和奖励相关的词语。他们还较少使用与负面情绪相关的表达方式。

paras.en: Boldness was associated with another distinctive pattern. Participants with higher scores used fewer anxiety-related words, including terms such as fear, afraid, and worry. Their personal accounts also contained fewer references to mental illness.
paras.zh: 大胆与另一种独特的模式相关。得分较高的参与者使用的与焦虑相关的词语较少，包括恐惧、害怕和担心等术语。他们的个人账户中提及精神疾病的内容也较少。

paras.en: These differences suggest that psychopathic traits do not produce a single recognizable style of communication. Instead, different characteristics are associated with different ways of describing emotions, goals, relationships, and personal experiences.
paras.zh: 这些差异表明，精神病态特征不会产生单一可识别的沟通方式。相反，不同的特征与描述情感、目标、关系和个人经历的不同方式相关。

paras.en: "What this tells us is the story we tell about our life has meaning," Drislane said. "It helps people make sense of their experiences, develop a worldview and a coherent sense of who they are.
paras.zh: “这告诉我们，我们讲述的生活故事是有意义的，”德里斯兰说。 “它帮助人们理解自己的经历，形成世界观，并对自己有一个连贯的认识。

paras.en: "What we're starting to see is that in psychopathy, there are traits that relate to differences in meaning-making and the ways people think about their life."
paras.zh: “我们开始看到，在精神病患者中，有些特征与意义创造和人们思考生活的方式的差异有关。”

paras.en: Why Psychopathy Is More Complex Than the Stereotypes
paras.zh: 为什么精神病比刻板印象更复杂

paras.en: The researchers also discovered that the relationship between personality traits and language changed depending on which question participants were answering. Someone describing a difficult experience, for example, might use language differently than when recalling a personal success.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现，人格特质和语言之间的关系会根据参与者回答的问题而变化。例如，某人描述困难经历时所用的语言可能与回忆个人成功时所用的语言不同。

paras.en: This variation is important because it challenges the assumption that psychopathy is characterized by consistently flat or emotionally empty communication. Instead, the findings indicate that language patterns depend on both the particular psychopathic trait and the context in which someone is telling their story.
paras.zh: 这种变化很重要，因为它挑战了精神病患者的特点是始终平淡或情感空洞的沟通这一假设。相反，研究结果表明，语言模式取决于特定的精神病特征和某人讲述故事的背景。

paras.en: "People tend to think of psychopathy as one thing, but it's actually multidimensional," Bray said. "What we mean when we say that everyone exists on this spectrum. Everyone has some degree of meanness, boldness, and disinhibition.
paras.zh: “人们倾向于认为精神病是一回事，但实际上它是多维的，”布雷说。 “当我们说每个人都存在于这个范围时，我们的意思是什么。每个人都有一定程度的卑鄙、大胆和去抑制。

paras.en: "Viewing it from a multidimensional perspective allows us to observe how those traits might manifest in nonforensic populations, in people who have not committed a crime. That allows us to see how these traits affect college students, business professionals, or interpersonal relationships."
paras.zh: “从多维度的角度来看，我们可以观察这些特征如何在非法医人群、没有犯罪的人身上表现出来。这使我们能够看到这些特征如何影响大学生、商业专业人士或人际关系。”

paras.en: Like many personality conditions, psychopathy is better understood as a spectrum rather than a simple distinction between people who have it and those who do not. At one extreme is the familiar cultural image of a "psychopath," while people at the opposite end score low in all three dimensions.
paras.zh: 与许多人格状况一样，精神病最好被理解为一个谱系，而不是对患有精神病的人和没有精神病的人之间的简单区分。一个极端是人们所熟悉的“精神病患者”的文化形象，而另一端的人们在所有三个方面的得分都很低。

paras.en: This approach allows researchers to examine psychopathic traits throughout the general population, including among people who have never committed a crime. It also helps explain why the same broad label can encompass individuals with very different personalities and behaviors.
paras.zh: 这种方法使研究人员能够检查整个人群的精神病特征，包括从未犯罪过的人。它还有助于解释为什么同一个广泛的标签可以涵盖性格和行为截然不同的个人。

paras.en: How Understanding Psychopathic Traits Could Improve Treatment
paras.zh: 了解精神病态特征如何改善治疗

paras.en: Recognizing these differences has implications beyond understanding everyday speech. Researchers have linked dimensions of psychopathy to serious outcomes, including criminal behavior, repeat offending, and intimate partner violence. Examining each trait separately may provide a clearer picture of how these risks develop.
paras.zh: 认识到这些差异的意义超出了理解日常言语的范围。研究人员将精神病态的各个方面与严重后果联系起来，包括犯罪行为、重复犯罪和亲密伴侣暴力。单独检查每个特征可以更清楚地了解这些风险是如何发展的。

paras.en: "That's in part why there's a movement away from calling people 'psychopaths,' because we don't view psychopathy as a category," Drislane said. "But psychopathic dimensions can predict important outcomes, things like crime, recidivism, or intimate partner violence.
paras.zh: 德里斯兰说：“这就是为什么有人开始不再称人们为‘精神病患者’，因为我们并不将精神病患者视为一个类别。” “但精神病态维度可以预测重要的结果，例如犯罪、累犯或亲密伴侣暴力。

paras.en: "What our research, including this paper, suggests is that it's important to look beyond that label and into the different components or dimensions of psychopathy, because each of those dimensions actually has a unique set of outcomes or things that it can predict."
paras.zh: “我们的研究，包括这篇论文，表明重要的是要超越这个标签，深入研究精神病的不同组成部分或维度，因为每个维度实际上都有一组独特的结果或可以预测的事情。”

paras.en: Researchers also emphasize that psychopathy can be treated, with interventions aimed at reducing problematic symptoms and behaviors. Understanding the psychological processes behind boldness, meanness, and disinhibition could help scientists develop more targeted approaches and potentially identify ways to prevent severe problems from emerging.
paras.zh: 研究人员还强调，精神病是可以治疗的，通过旨在减少有问题的症状和行为的干预措施。了解大胆、卑鄙和去抑制背后的心理过程可以帮助科学家开发更有针对性的方法，并有可能找到防止严重问题出现的方法。

paras.en: "If we want to be able to treat or ideally even prevent psychopathy from developing, we need to understand the mechanisms at play," she said. "That comes down to understanding the unique contributors for all three of these dimensions."
paras.zh: “如果我们希望能够治疗甚至理想情况下预防精神病的发展，我们需要了解起作用的机制，”她说。 “这归结为了解所有这三个维度的独特贡献者。”

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Mississippi. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由密西西比大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Ky Bray, Laura E. Drislane. Investigating interpersonal and affective features of psychopathy through language use. Personality and Individual Differences, 2026; 262: 113978 DOI: 10.1016/j.paid.2026.113978
paras.zh: - 基·布雷，劳拉·E·德里斯兰。通过语言使用调查精神病患者的人际和情感特征。性格和个体差异，2026； 262：113978 DOI：10.1016/j.paid.2026.113978

articles.title: Scientists tracked kids for 8 years. What they found about screen time was surprising

paras.en: Scientists tracked kids for 8 years. What they found about screen time was surprising
paras.zh: 科学家对孩子们进行了长达八年的追踪。他们对屏幕时间的发现令人惊讶

paras.en: - University of JyvÃ¤skylÃ¤ - JyvÃ¤skylÃ¤n yliopisto
paras.zh: - 于韦斯屈莱大学 - 于韦斯屈莱恩 yliopisto

paras.en: - A surprising Finnish study found that children who spent more time using screens tended to have better cognitive processing abilities as teenagers, challenging the assumption that screen time is always harmful. Researchers suggest that what children do on screens may matter more than how much time they spend using them.
paras.zh: - 芬兰的一项令人惊讶的研究发现，花更多时间使用屏幕的孩子在青少年时期往往具有更好的认知处理能力，这挑战了“屏幕时间总是有害的”这一假设。研究人员认为，孩子们在屏幕上做什么可能比他们花多少时间使用屏幕更重要。

paras.en: An eight-year study of children in Finland has revealed a surprising connection between screen time and brain function. Researchers found that children who spent more time using screens tended to have better cognitive processing abilities as teenagers, challenging the widespread assumption that screen time is necessarily harmful to developing brains.
paras.zh: 一项针对芬兰儿童长达八年的研究揭示了屏幕时间与大脑功能之间令人惊讶的联系。研究人员发现，花更多时间使用屏幕的孩子在青少年时期往往具有更好的认知处理能力，这挑战了“屏幕时间必然对大脑发育有害”的普遍假设。

paras.en: The findings suggest that the amount of time children spend in front of screens may be less important than how they use that time. Activities that encourage learning, creativity, and problem-solving could be particularly valuable. Researchers emphasize that the goal should not be to eliminate screen time, but to balance it with physical activity and mentally stimulating experiences.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，孩子们在屏幕前花费的时间可能并不重要，重要的是他们如何利用这些时间。鼓励学习、创造力和解决问题的活动可能特别有价值。研究人员强调，目标不应该是消除屏幕时间，而是平衡其与身体活动和精神刺激体验。

paras.en: The discovery comes amid growing concerns about insufficient physical activity among teenagers. A sedentary lifestyle has been linked to poorer academic performance, while regular exercise is known to support brain function, particularly in adults. However, scientists still have much to learn about how physical activity, sitting, and screen use during childhood influence thinking abilities later in adolescence.
paras.zh: 这一发现是在人们越来越担心青少年身体活动不足的情况下出现的。久坐的生活方式与较差的学习成绩有关，而众所周知，定期锻炼可以支持大脑功能，特别是对于成年人来说。然而，关于童年时期的体力活动、坐姿和屏幕使用如何影响青春期后期的思维能力，科学家们还有很多东西需要了解。

paras.en: These questions are especially important because childhood and adolescence are critical periods of brain development. Changes in attention, memory, and learning during these years can have lasting consequences, potentially influencing educational opportunities and career paths well into adulthood.
paras.zh: 这些问题尤其重要，因为童年和青春期是大脑发育的关键时期。这些年来注意力、记忆力和学习能力的变化可能会产生持久的影响，可能会影响成年后的教育机会和职业道路。

paras.en: To investigate these relationships, Finnish researchers examined how screen time, physical activity, and sedentary behavior from childhood through adolescence were associated with cognitive performance in teenagers. They also explored whether the connections differed between boys and girls and whether the intensity of physical activity made a difference.
paras.zh: 为了调查这些关系，芬兰研究人员研究了从童年到青春期的屏幕时间、体力活动和久坐行为如何与青少年的认知表现相关。他们还探讨了男孩和女孩之间的联系是否不同，以及体育活动的强度是否会产生影响。

paras.en: More Screen Time Linked to Better Thinking Skills
paras.zh: 更多的屏幕时间与更好的思维能力相关

paras.en: One of the study's most unexpected findings was that greater screen time throughout childhood was associated with better cognitive processing in adolescence.
paras.zh: 该研究最出人意料的发现之一是，整个童年时期更多的屏幕时间与青春期更好的认知处理有关。

paras.en: Cognitive processing refers to the mental abilities people use to take in information, pay attention, remember details, learn new things, and solve problems. These abilities play an important role in school performance and everyday decision-making.
paras.zh: 认知处理是指人们用来接收信息、注意、记住细节、学习新事物和解决问题的心理能力。这些能力在学校表现和日常决策中发挥着重要作用。

paras.en: The findings challenge the idea that all screen time should be viewed as harmful. However, the researchers caution that the relationship may depend on what children are actually doing while using digital devices. Watching videos, playing games that require strategic thinking, and engaging in educational activities may involve very different levels of mental effort.
paras.zh: 这些发现挑战了“所有屏幕时间都应该被视为有害”的观点。然而，研究人员警告说，这种关系可能取决于孩子在使用数字设备时实际在做什么。观看视频、玩需要战略思维的游戏以及参与教育活动可能涉及不同程度的脑力劳动。

paras.en: "The findings suggest that screen time can support children's and adolescents' cognitive processing. Presumably, the essential point here is what kind of things they do in their screen time. Teachers and parents should encourage children to use devices and screens in such ways that promote active thinking, problem-solving, creativity, and learning," states Doctoral Researcher Petri Jalanko from the University of Jyväskylä.
paras.zh: “研究结果表明，屏幕时间可以支持儿童和青少年的认知处理。大概，这里的要点是他们在屏幕时间做了什么样的事情。教师和家长应该鼓励孩子以促进积极思考、解决问题、创造力和学习的方式使用设备和屏幕，”于韦斯屈莱大学的博士研究员 Petri Jalanko 表示。

paras.en: "We should not regard screen time solely as harmful but seek balance between physical activity and screen time that promotes active thinking," Jalanko summarizes.
paras.zh: “我们不应该仅仅认为屏幕时间有害，而应该在体力活动和屏幕时间之间寻求平衡，以促进积极思考，”贾兰科总结道。

paras.en: Exercise Affects Boys' and Girls' Brains Differently
paras.zh: 运动对男孩和女孩大脑的影响不同

paras.en: The researchers also uncovered a more complicated picture of how physical activity relates to thinking and memory.
paras.zh: 研究人员还揭示了身体活动与思维和记忆之间关系的更复杂的图景。

paras.en: Among girls, spending more time engaged in light-intensity physical activity since childhood was associated with better working memory during adolescence. For boys, greater participation in guided physical activity over the same period was linked to stronger working memory.
paras.zh: 对于女孩来说，从童年起花更多时间从事低强度的体力活动与青春期更好的工作记忆有关。对于男孩来说，在同一时期更多地参与有指导的体育活动与更强的工作记忆有关。

paras.en: Working memory is the brain's ability to temporarily hold and use information. It allows someone to remember instructions while completing a task, keep track of numbers during mental calculations, or follow a conversation while processing new information.
paras.zh: 工作记忆是大脑暂时保存和使用信息的能力。它可以让人们在完成任务时记住指令，在心算时记录数字，或者在处理新信息时跟踪对话。

paras.en: Light-intensity physical activity generally includes relatively gentle movements that do not substantially increase breathing or heart rate. Guided physical activity refers to exercise carried out with some form of instruction or supervision, such as organized sports or structured exercise sessions.
paras.zh: 低强度身体活动通常包括相对温和的运动，不会显着增加呼吸或心率。有指导的身体活动是指在某种形式的指导或监督下进行的锻炼，例如有组织的运动或结构化的锻炼课程。

paras.en: The differences between boys and girls suggest that the relationship between exercise and brain health may depend on more than simply how much a person moves. The type of activity, how it is organized, and the individual's sex could all play a role.
paras.zh: 男孩和女孩之间的差异表明，运动和大脑健康之间的关系可能不仅仅取决于一个人的运动量。活动的类型、活动的组织方式以及个人的性别都可能发挥作用。

paras.en: Another Surprising Finding About Physical Activity
paras.zh: 关于身体活动的另一个令人惊讶的发现

paras.en: The study produced another counterintuitive result. Teenagers who reported spending less time in unsupervised physical activity tended to perform better on measures of cognitive processing.
paras.zh: 这项研究产生了另一个违反直觉的结果。那些在无人监督的体育活动上花费较少时间的青少年往往在认知处理测量方面表现更好。

paras.en: Yet when researchers used wearable sensors to objectively measure movement and heart rate, they found no association between overall physical activity or sedentary time and cognitive performance.
paras.zh: 然而，当研究人员使用可穿戴传感器客观测量运动和心率时，他们发现整体身体活动或久坐时间与认知表现之间没有关联。

paras.en: One possible explanation is that wearable devices measure movement without revealing what a person is actually doing. For example, a sensor may record periods of sitting or physical activity, but it cannot determine whether someone is solving a difficult problem, studying, participating in an organized activity, or simply resting.
paras.zh: 一种可能的解释是，可穿戴设备测量运动，但不会透露一个人实际在做什么。例如，传感器可以记录坐着或身体活动的时间，但它无法确定某人是在解决难题、学习、参加有组织的活动还是只是在休息。

paras.en: This distinction could help explain why questionnaire responses revealed relationships that were not apparent in the sensor measurements.
paras.zh: 这种区别可以帮助解释为什么调查问卷的回答揭示了传感器测量中不明显的关系。

paras.en: "Our study indicates that the connections of physical activity and sedentary behavior to cognitive processing are complex and depend on the sex, the type and assessment method of physical activity and sedentary time. Moreover, boys and girls may benefit from different types of physical activity in view of brain health," Jalanko adds.
paras.zh: “我们的研究表明，体力活动和久坐行为与认知处理的联系很复杂，取决于性别、体力活动和久坐时间的类型和评估方法。此外，考虑到大脑健康，男孩和女孩可能会从不同类型的体力活动中受益，”Jalanko 补充道。

paras.en: "However, we need more intervention studies to find out causal relations and sex differences in this respect. Moreover, it is important to examine more specifically the effects of the intensity of physical activity on changes taking place in cognitive processing."
paras.zh: “然而，我们需要更多的干预研究来找出这方面的因果关系和性别差异。此外，更具体地研究体力活动强度对认知过程变化的影响也很重要。”

paras.en: The findings come from an eight-year follow-up conducted as part of the PANIC study, a long-running Finnish research project investigating children's physical activity and nutrition.
paras.zh: 这些发现来自一项为期八年的跟踪调查，该研究是 PANIC 研究的一部分，该研究是芬兰一项长期研究项目，旨在调查儿童的身体活动和营养。

paras.en: The current analysis included 260 participants, consisting of 124 girls and 136 boys. Their average age at the adolescent assessment was 15.8 years.
paras.zh: 目前的分析包括 260 名参与者，其中 124 名女孩和 136 名男孩。他们的青少年评估平均年龄为 15.8 岁。

paras.en: Researchers collected information about physical activity and sedentary behavior using both questionnaires and wearable devices that combined heart rate monitoring with movement measurements. This approach allowed them to compare participants' reported activities with data collected by sensors.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用问卷和将心率监测与运动测量相结合的可穿戴设备收集有关身体活动和久坐行为的信息。这种方法使他们能够将参与者报告的活动与传感器收集的数据进行比较。

paras.en: To evaluate cognitive abilities, the researchers used the CogState test battery, a collection of computerized assessments designed to measure aspects of mental performance. The tests examined learning, attention, and working memory.
paras.zh: 为了评估认知能力，研究人员使用了 CogState 测试电池，这是一组旨在测量心理表现各个方面的计算机化评估。这些测试考察了学习、注意力和工作记忆。

paras.en: Importantly, the findings show associations rather than cause and effect. They do not establish that increasing screen time will improve a child's thinking abilities or that reducing certain types of exercise will produce cognitive benefits. Intervention studies, in which researchers deliberately change participants' activities and measure the results, are needed to determine whether these relationships are causal.
paras.zh: 重要的是，研究结果显示了关联而不是因果关系。他们并没有证实增加屏幕时间会提高孩子的思维能力，或者减少某些类型的运动会产生认知益处。需要进行干预研究，研究人员故意改变参与者的活动并测量结果，以确定这些关系是否是因果关系。

paras.en: Nevertheless, the results offer an important perspective on the continuing debate over children's screen use. Rather than treating all time spent with digital devices as equally harmful, the researchers suggest paying closer attention to whether those activities encourage active thinking and learning.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，研究结果为有关儿童屏幕使用的持续争论提供了重要的视角。研究人员建议不要将所有花在数字设备上的时间都视为同样有害，而是更密切地关注这些活动是否鼓励积极的思考和学习。

paras.en: The research also highlights the importance of considering different forms of physical activity rather than focusing exclusively on the total amount of exercise children receive.
paras.zh: 该研究还强调了考虑不同形式的体育活动的重要性，而不是仅仅关注儿童接受的运动总量。

paras.en: Together, the findings suggest that supporting healthy brain development may require a more nuanced approach, one that combines physical activity with opportunities for learning, creativity, and mental engagement, including those that take place on screens.
paras.zh: 总之，研究结果表明，支持健康的大脑发育可能需要采取更细致的方法，将身体活动与学习、创造力和精神参与的机会（包括那些在屏幕上进行的活动）结合起来。

paras.en: The study was published in the scientific journal Pediatric Exercise Science.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在科学杂志《儿科运动科学》上。

articles.title: A mysterious twist in the universe’s oldest light could reveal new physics

paras.en: A mysterious twist in the universeâs oldest light could reveal new physics
paras.zh: 宇宙最古老的光的神秘扭曲可能揭示新的物理学

paras.en: - Scientists have spotted hints of a mysterious rotation in the universeâs oldest light that could reveal new physics and shed light on dark matter and dark energy. A new technique developed at UC San Diego could help rule out misleading telescope errors, bringing researchers closer to determining whether the strange signal is real.
paras.zh: - 科学家们发现了宇宙最古老的光中神秘旋转的迹象，这可能揭示新的物理现象并揭示暗物质和暗能量。加州大学圣地亚哥分校开发的一项新技术可以帮助排除误导性的望远镜错误，使研究人员更接近确定奇怪信号是否真实。

paras.en: A mysterious twist in the universe's oldest light could offer clues to physics that scientists have yet to discover. But before researchers can determine whether this subtle signal reveals something extraordinary about the cosmos, they must answer a crucial question: Is the effect actually coming from the universe, or could it be an illusion created by the telescopes observing it?
paras.zh: 宇宙最古老的光的神秘扭曲可能为科学家尚未发现的物理学提供线索。但在研究人员确定这种微妙的信号是否揭示了宇宙的非凡之处之前，他们必须回答一个关键问题：这种效应实际上来自宇宙，还是可能是观测它的望远镜产生的幻觉？

paras.en: The mystery centers on the cosmic microwave background (CMB), a faint glow of radiation left over from approximately 380,000 years after the Big Bang. This ancient light provides a remarkable snapshot of the "baby universe" as it existed nearly 13.8 billion years ago, allowing scientists to investigate conditions from the earliest stages of cosmic history.
paras.zh: 这个谜团集中在宇宙微波背景辐射（CMB）上，这是大爆炸后约 38 万年留下的微弱辐射光。这种古老的光提供了近 138 亿年前存在的“婴儿宇宙”的非凡快照，使科学家能够研究宇宙历史最早阶段的条件。

paras.en: When the universe was about 380,000 years old, it had cooled enough to become transparent, allowing light to travel freely through space. As radiation scattered off free electrons during this transition, it acquired a small amount of linear polarization. Polarization describes the direction in which light's electric field oscillates, and a similar effect occurs when sunlight scatters through Earth's atmosphere.
paras.zh: 当宇宙大约有 38 万年的时候，它已经冷却到足以变得透明，允许光线在太空中自由传播。当辐射在此跃迁期间从自由电子散射时，它获得了少量的线性偏振。偏振描述了光电场振荡的方向，当阳光穿过地球大气层散射时，也会发生类似的效应。

paras.en: Now, observations suggest that the polarization of this ancient radiation may have shifted slightly as the light traveled across the universe. This possible rotation, called cosmic birefringence, is especially intriguing because it could point to physical processes not explained by the Standard Model, the leading theory describing fundamental particles and their interactions. Confirming the effect might even provide new insights into dark matter and dark energy (see Sidebar).
paras.zh: 现在，观察表明，当光穿过宇宙时，这种古老辐射的偏振可能发生了轻微的变化。这种可能的旋转被称为宇宙双折射，特别有趣，因为它可能指向标准模型无法解释的物理过程，标准模型是描述基本粒子及其相互作用的主要理论。确认这种效应甚至可能为暗物质和暗能量提供新的见解（参见侧栏）。

paras.en: A Mysterious Cosmic Signal or a Telescope Error?
paras.zh: 神秘的宇宙信号还是望远镜错误？

paras.en: There is a major obstacle to interpreting this potential discovery. An extremely small error in how a telescope's polarization detectors are aligned can produce a signal that looks almost identical to cosmic birefringence.
paras.zh: 解释这一潜在发现存在一个重大障碍。望远镜偏振探测器的排列方式中的极小误差就可以产生看起来几乎与宇宙双折射相同的信号。

paras.en: To help address this problem, physicists at the University of California San Diego developed a new technique for checking how accurately different groups of detectors measure polarization angles. They tested their approach using existing observations collected by the European Space Agency's Planck satellite, which mapped the universe's ancient radiation in extraordinary detail.
paras.zh: 为了帮助解决这个问题，加州大学圣地亚哥分校的物理学家开发了一种新技术，用于检查不同组探测器测量偏振角的准确度。他们利用欧洲航天局普朗克卫星收集的现有观测结果测试了他们的方法，该卫星非常详细地绘制了宇宙古代辐射图。

paras.en: The research was led by Postdoctoral Fellow Anto I. Lonappan, Chancellor's Distinguished Professor of Physics Brian Keating, and Associate Professor of Physics Kam Arnold. Their findings were published in The Astrophysical Journal Letters.
paras.zh: 该研究由博士后研究员 Anto I. Lonappan、校长杰出物理学教授 Brian Keating 和物理学副教授 Kam Arnold 领导。他们的发现发表在《天体物理学杂志快报》上。

paras.en: Separating Real Cosmic Effects From Instrument Errors
paras.zh: 将真实的宇宙效应与仪器误差分开

paras.en: Previous studies have suggested that the polarization of the CMB may have rotated by just a fraction of a degree over its nearly 14 billion years of travel. Although that sounds insignificant, such a tiny change could have enormous implications for fundamental physics.
paras.zh: 先前的研究表明，宇宙微波背景辐射的极化在其近 140 亿年的旅行中可能只旋转了零点几度。尽管这听起来微不足道，但如此微小的变化可能对基础物理学产生巨大影响。

paras.en: Unfortunately, a telescope whose polarization detectors are misaligned by a similarly small angle could produce precisely the same apparent rotation. If every detector shares the same alignment error, the resulting measurements cannot distinguish that error from a genuine rotation of the cosmic signal.
paras.zh: 不幸的是，偏振探测器未对准类似小角度的望远镜可能会产生完全相同的表观旋转。如果每个探测器都有相同的对准误差，则所得的测量结果无法将该误差与宇宙信号的真实旋转区分开来。

paras.en: The UC San Diego researchers found a way to investigate the problem from another angle. Rather than relying on a single combined measurement, they compared separate polarization maps generated by different groups of detectors.
paras.zh: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校的研究人员找到了一种从另一个角度研究这个问题的方法。他们没有依赖单一的组合测量，而是比较了不同组探测器生成的单独的偏振图。

paras.en: If cosmic birefringence is real, its effect should appear consistently across all these maps. By comparing the maps with one another, the researchers can effectively eliminate any rotation shared by all of them. What remains reveals differences in the calibration of the individual detector groups, making it possible to identify inconsistencies that might otherwise complicate the search for new physics.
paras.zh: 如果宇宙双折射是真实的，那么它的影响应该在所有这些地图上一致地出现。通过将地图相互比较，研究人员可以有效地消除所有地图共享的任何旋转。剩下的内容揭示了各个探测器组的校准差异，从而可以识别不一致之处，否则可能会使新物理学的搜索变得复杂。

paras.en: "The signal we are looking for is incredibly small, so we have to be certain that we are seeing the universe and not our instrument," said Lonappan. "Our method gives us a complementary way to check that distinction. Before interpreting a tiny rotation as new physics, we want to know that the calibration itself can be trusted."
paras.zh: 洛纳潘说：“我们正在寻找的信号非常小，因此我们必须确定我们看到的是宇宙，而不是我们的仪器。” “我们的方法为我们提供了一种补充方法来检查这种区别。在将微小旋转解释为新物理学之前，我们想知道校准本身是否可信。”

paras.en: Testing the Mystery With Planck Satellite Data
paras.zh: 用普朗克卫星数据检验这个谜团

paras.en: To evaluate their technique, the researchers analyzed eight polarization maps produced using Planck observations. They then compared their findings with results from an established approach called the Minami-Komatsu analysis, which is used to distinguish instrumental rotation from possible cosmic birefringence.
paras.zh: 为了评估他们的技术，研究人员分析了使用普朗克观测产生的八张偏振图。然后，他们将他们的发现与称为南小松分析的既定方法的结果进行了比较，该方法用于区分仪器旋转与可能的宇宙双折射。

paras.en: Although the two methods rely on different assumptions, they produced consistent results. This agreement provides an important independent check on how relative detector calibration errors are being assessed.
paras.zh: 尽管这两种方法依赖于不同的假设，但它们产生了一致的结果。该协议为如何评估相对探测器校准误差提供了重要的独立检查。

paras.en: The new approach also has a deliberate limitation. Because it removes any rotation common to all the maps, it cannot independently measure the overall polarization angle or determine how much the universe itself may have rotated the light. Establishing that absolute rotation still requires an independent reference for calibrating the overall angle.
paras.zh: 新方法也有一个故意的限制。因为它消除了所有地图共有的任何旋转，所以它无法独立测量整体偏振角或确定宇宙本身可能使光旋转了多少。建立绝对旋转仍然需要一个独立的参考来校准整体角度。

paras.en: To demonstrate how their findings fit with existing measurements, the researchers combined their reconstruction of relative calibration differences with the common calibration value inferred from the established analysis. This produced an estimated cosmic birefringence angle of 0.37 ± 0.12 degrees, matching the Minami-Komatsu result.
paras.zh: 为了证明他们的发现如何与现有测量相吻合，研究人员将相对校准差异的重建与从已建立的分析中推断出的通用校准值结合起来。这产生了 0.37 ± 0.12 度的估计宇宙双折射角，与南小松的结果相匹配。

paras.en: Importantly, this agreement does not independently confirm that the ancient light has actually rotated. Instead, it shows that the new method can reproduce results from the existing framework while providing a separate way to examine potential calibration problems.
paras.zh: 重要的是，该协议并没有独立证实远古之光实际上已经旋转。相反，它表明新方法可以重现现有框架的结果，同时提供一种单独的方法来检查潜在的校准问题。

paras.en: Searching for Gravitational Waves From the Early Universe
paras.zh: 寻找早期宇宙的引力波

paras.en: The technique could also play an important role in another major pursuit in cosmology: the search for gravitational waves generated during the universe's earliest moments.
paras.zh: 该技术还可以在宇宙学的另一项主要研究中发挥重要作用：寻找宇宙最早时刻产生的引力波。

paras.en: To understand why, scientists distinguish between two patterns of polarization in the cosmic microwave background, known as E modes and B modes.
paras.zh: 为了理解其中的原因，科学家区分了宇宙微波背景中的两种偏振模式，即 E 模式和 B 模式。

paras.en: E modes were first detected in 2002. They arise from density variations in the early universe and form symmetric polarization patterns. B modes have a different appearance, featuring patterns that resemble curls or swirls.
paras.zh: E 模式于 2002 年首次被发现。它们源自早期宇宙的密度变化，并形成对称的偏振模式。 B 模式具有不同的外观，具有类似卷曲或漩涡的图案。

paras.en: One known source of B modes is gravitational lensing, which occurs when the gravity of matter between Earth and the early universe bends and distorts the path of ancient light. Scientists have already observed B modes created through this process.
paras.zh: B模式的一种已知来源是引力透镜效应，当地球和早期宇宙之间的物质引力弯曲并扭曲古代光的路径时就会发生这种现象。科学家们已经观察到通过这个过程产生的 B 模式。

paras.en: However, researchers are also searching for a different kind of B mode that could have been produced by primordial gravitational waves. These ripples in spacetime may have originated during an extremely early period of rapid cosmic expansion, known as inflation. The distinctive B mode signal associated with those primordial gravitational waves has not yet been detected.
paras.zh: 然而，研究人员也在寻找一种可能由原初引力波产生的不同类型的 B 模式。这些时空涟漪可能起源于宇宙快速膨胀的极早期时期，即所谓的暴胀。与这些原始引力波相关的独特 B 模式信号尚未被发现。

paras.en: Finding it would provide powerful evidence about gravitational waves in the early universe and could offer strong support for particular models of cosmic inflation, potentially transforming scientists' understanding of how the universe began.
paras.zh: 发现它将为早期宇宙中的引力波提供强有力的证据，并可为宇宙膨胀的特定模型提供强有力的支持，有可能改变科学家对宇宙如何开始的理解。

paras.en: Why Extremely Precise Measurements Matter
paras.zh: 为什么极其精确的测量很重要

paras.en: The challenge is that even a slight error in a telescope's polarization calibration can cause some of the much stronger E-mode signal to appear incorrectly as B modes. This contamination could make an instrumental artifact look like an exciting cosmological discovery.
paras.zh: 面临的挑战是，即使望远镜的偏振校准中出现轻微错误，也可能导致一些更强的 E 模式信号错误地显示为 B 模式。这种污染可能会使一件仪器制品看起来像是一个令人兴奋的宇宙学发现。

paras.en: The UC San Diego method could help prevent such mistakes by identifying differences in polarization angle calibration among detector groups. That makes it a potentially valuable tool for future experiments searching for the extremely faint signatures of primordial gravitational waves.
paras.zh: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校的方法可以通过识别探测器组之间偏振角校准的差异来帮助防止此类错误。这使得它成为未来寻找原始引力波极其微弱特征的实验的潜在有价值的工具。

paras.en: This kind of independent verification will become increasingly important as observatories develop the ability to measure cosmic polarization with greater precision. One example is the Simons Observatory, where Keating serves as principal investigator.
paras.zh: 随着天文台开发出更精确地测量宇宙偏振的能力，这种独立验证将变得越来越重要。一个例子是西蒙斯天文台，基廷担任首席研究员。

paras.en: As these instruments become more sensitive, researchers will need equally rigorous methods for confirming that the faint signals they detect are genuine features of the universe rather than imperfections in their equipment.
paras.zh: 随着这些仪器变得更加灵敏，研究人员将需要同样严格的方法来确认他们检测到的微弱信号是宇宙的真实特征，而不是设备的缺陷。

paras.en: "The detection of primordial B modes would transform our understanding of the early universe, so the measurement must survive rigorous calibration checks," said Keating. "Anto has developed a useful new framework for testing relative polarization-angle calibration. This is ultimately about knowing when we can trust a measurement."
paras.zh: 基廷说：“对原始 B 模式的探测将改变我们对早期宇宙的理解，因此测量结果必须能够通过严格的校准检查。” “Anto 开发了一个有用的新框架来测试相对偏振角校准。这最终是为了了解我们何时可以信任测量结果。”

paras.en: Beyond the Standard Model: Dark Matter and Dark Energy
paras.zh: 超越标准模型：暗物质和暗能量

paras.en: The possibility of cosmic birefringence is particularly fascinating because it could reveal physics that lies beyond the Standard Model.
paras.zh: 宇宙双折射的可能性特别令人着迷，因为它可以揭示超出标准模型的物理学。

paras.en: Although this framework has been remarkably successful at describing fundamental particles and their interactions, it cannot explain everything in the universe. Among its most important unanswered questions are the identity of dark matter and the origin and observed magnitude of dark energy. Together, these mysterious components account for approximately 95% of the universe's total energy density.
paras.zh: 尽管这个框架在描述基本粒子及其相互作用方面非常成功，但它无法解释宇宙中的一切。其中最重要的未解答问题包括暗物质的身份以及暗能量的起源和观测到的大小。这些神秘成分加起来约占宇宙总能量密度的 95%。

paras.en: One possible explanation for cosmic birefringence involves a hypothetical field associated with particles resembling axions. Such a field could interact with light and gradually alter its polarization as it crosses the universe. However, these particles have not been confirmed to exist, and they would not necessarily be responsible for dark matter.
paras.zh: 对宇宙双折射的一种可能的解释涉及与类似轴子的粒子相关的假设场。这样的场可以与光相互作用，并在光穿过宇宙时逐渐改变其偏振。然而，这些粒子尚未被证实存在，并且它们不一定是暗物质的原因。

paras.en: Other theoretical explanations connect the possible rotation to fields associated with dark energy, the mysterious phenomenon linked to the accelerating expansion of the universe.
paras.zh: 其他理论解释将可能的旋转与暗能量相关的场联系起来，暗能量是与宇宙加速膨胀有关的神秘现象。

paras.en: If cosmic birefringence is eventually confirmed, it could provide an entirely new way to investigate these cosmic mysteries and reveal evidence of physical laws beyond those currently understood.
paras.zh: 如果宇宙双折射最终得到证实，它可以提供一种全新的方法来研究这些宇宙之谜，并揭示超出目前理解范围的物理定律的证据。

paras.en: For now, the first challenge is ensuring that the subtle signal can be trusted. By giving researchers another way to identify potential measurement errors, the new technique strengthens the foundation for future discoveries that could reshape our picture of the universe.
paras.zh: 目前，第一个挑战是确保微妙的信号是可信的。通过为研究人员提供另一种方法来识别潜在的测量误差，这项新技术为未来可能重塑宇宙图景的发现奠定了基础。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of California - San Diego. Original written by Michelle Franklin. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由加州大学圣地亚哥分校提供。原文由米歇尔·富兰克林撰写。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Anto I. Lonappan, Brian Keating, Kam Arnold. Differential Polarization Calibration: A Consistency Test for Cosmic Birefringence. The Astrophysical Journal Letters, 2026; 1009 (1): L12 DOI: 10.3847/2041-8213/aea401
paras.zh: - 安托·I·洛纳潘、布莱恩·基廷、卡姆·阿诺德。差分偏振校准：宇宙双折射的一致性测试。天体物理学杂志快报，2026 年； 1009 (1)：L12 DOI：10.3847/2041-8213/aea401

articles.title: Astronomers discover rare black holes that formed when stars failed to go supernova
articles.author: Robert Lea

paras.en: Gravitational waves have revealed a population of black holes that may have been born when masssive stars failed to go supernova.
paras.zh: 引力波揭示了一群黑洞，这些黑洞可能是在大质量恒星未能变成超新星时诞生的。

paras.en: Most of us know the origin story of black holes, or we thought we did. Massive stars run out of the fuel for nuclear fusion and their cores collapse. As this happens, the stars' outer layers expand outwards. Shockwaves from the core collapse strike the outer layers, triggering a supernova explosion. The collapsed core creates a black hole.
paras.zh: 我们大多数人都知道黑洞的起源故事，或者我们认为我们知道。大质量恒星耗​​尽了核聚变的燃料，它们的核心就会崩溃。当这种情况发生时，恒星的外层向外膨胀。核心塌陷产生的冲击波撞击外层，引发超新星爆炸。塌陷的核心形成了一个黑洞。

paras.en: However, new research based on gravitational wave data collected by LIGO (Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory) and its gravitational wave detector partners, Virgo and KAGRA (Kamioka Gravitational Wave Detector), suggests this might not be the complete picture of black hole birth. The team behind the research suggests some massive stars go out with a whimper rather than a bang and that these "failed supernovas" can also spawn black holes.
paras.zh: 然而，基于 LIGO（激光干涉引力波天文台）及其引力波探测器合作伙伴 Virgo 和 KAGRA（神冈引力波探测器）收集的引力波数据的新研究表明，这可能不是黑洞诞生的完整图景。研究背后的团队认为，一些大质量恒星会发出呜咽声而不是爆炸声，这些“失败的超新星”也可能产生黑洞。

paras.en: The hint of this comes from the over 300 black hole collisions spotted by LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA since the detectors first "heard" ripples in space from these distant events in 2015.
paras.zh: 自 2015 年探测器首次“听到”这些遥远事件在太空中产生的涟漪以来，LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 发现的 300 多次黑洞碰撞就暗示了这一点。

paras.en: "A vast majority of the merging black holes in the universe are about 10 times the mass of our sun," LIGO team member Katerina Chatziioannou, of the California Institute of Technology (Caltech), said in a statement. "Our data are showing that this group of black holes may have a common origin — they may be a distinct subpopulation that failed to go supernova.
paras.zh: 加州理工学院 (Caltech) 的 LIGO 团队成员 Katerina Chatziioannou 在一份声明中表示：“宇宙中绝大多数合并黑洞的质量约为太阳的 10 倍。” “我们的数据表明，这组黑洞可能有一个共同的起源——它们可能是一个独特的亚群，未能成为超新星。

paras.en: "These results represent a connection between the gravitational-wave data and underlying astrophysics we are trying to extract."
paras.zh: “这些结果代表了引力波数据与我们试图提取的基础天体物理学之间的联系。”

paras.en: Mass and spin of black holes indicate stars died with a whimper not a bang
paras.zh: 黑洞的质量和旋转表明恒星的死亡只是一声呜咽，而不是一声巨响

paras.en: Currently, there is no hard evidence of failed supernovas, but their existence is well supported theoretically. In fact, scientists think there is a vast population of massive stars out there that imploded rather than exploded, directly collapsing into black holes. And these may be black holes with around ten times the mass of the sun (10 solar masses) found in merging pairs.
paras.zh: 目前，还没有失败的超新星的确凿证据，但它们的存在在理论上得到了很好的支持。事实上，科学家认为，那里有大量的大质量恒星是内爆而不是爆炸，直接塌缩成黑洞。这些黑洞的质量可能是太阳质量的十倍左右（10个太阳质量），是在合并对中发现的。

paras.en: Chatziioannou led a team that examined gravitational wave data to confirm this concept. To do this, they looked at the distribution of the masses of 257 black hole mergers detected by the LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA network over the past 10 years.
paras.zh: Chatziioannou 领导的团队检查了引力波数据，以证实这一概念。为此，他们研究了过去 10 年 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 网络检测到的 257 个黑洞合并的质量分布。

paras.en: This revealed a peak of 10-solar-mass black holes that represented 75% of the entire sample. If this was expected, what the team found that wasn't predicted was a lack of black holes with masses 12 to 16 times the mass of the sun.
paras.zh: 这揭示了 10 个太阳质量黑洞的峰值，占整个样本的 75%。如果这是预料之中的，那么研究小组发现，没有预料到的是缺乏质量为太阳质量 12 到 16 倍的黑洞。

paras.en: "We see 10 solar-mass black holes merging all the time," team member Isaac Legred of the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign said. "But why are, say, 14 solar-mass black holes so rare? The gap we see in the distribution of masses indicates there may be a special cocktail of internal physics that goes into forming the abundance of 10 solar-mass black holes."
paras.zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校的团队成员艾萨克·莱格雷德说：“我们一直看到 10 个太阳质量的黑洞正在合并。” “但是为什么 14 个太阳质量黑洞如此罕见？我们在质量分布中看到的差距表明，可能存在一种特殊的内部物理混合物，可以形成大量的 10 个太阳质量黑洞。”

paras.en: The researchers also looked at the spin rates of black holes in mergers, a telltale signature of how they formed. This revealed that 10-solar-mass black holes seemed to have a distinct range of spin speeds. This indicates a common origin, perhaps the implosion of a massive star without a supernova explosion.
paras.zh: 研究人员还研究了合并过程中黑洞的自转速率，这是黑洞形成方式的一个明显特征。这表明 10 个太阳质量的黑洞似乎具有不同的旋转速度范围。这表明了一个共同的起源，也许是一颗大质量恒星的内爆，没有发生超新星爆炸。

paras.en: "We can look up at the sky and try to study historical records of massive stars that failed to explode, but it's challenging because they just vanish without exploding, leaving a dark patch of sky," Legred concluded. "With this study, we show the gravitational-wave data are consistent with most binary black holes forming from a very special kind of failed supernova, but more research is needed.
paras.zh: 莱格雷德总结道：“我们可以仰望天空，尝试研究未爆炸的大质量恒星的历史记录，但这很有挑战性，因为它们没有爆炸就消失了，留下了一片黑暗的天空。” “通过这项研究，我们表明引力波数据与大多数由一种非常特殊的失败超新星形成的双黑洞是一致的，但还需要更多的研究。

paras.en: "Black holes are born in some of the most extreme environments in the universe, so the prospect of better understanding their formation is very exciting."
paras.zh: “黑洞诞生于宇宙中一些最极端的环境中，因此更好地了解它们的形成的前景非常令人兴奋。”

paras.en: The team's research was published on Tuesday (Nov. 10) in the journal Physical Review D.
paras.zh: 该团队的研究成果于周二（11 月 10 日）发表在《物理评论 D》杂志上。

paras.en: Robert Lea is a science journalist in the U.K. whose articles have been published in Physics World, New Scientist, Astronomy Magazine, All About Space, Newsweek and ZME Science. He also writes about science communication for Elsevier and the European Journal of Physics. Rob holds a bachelor of science degree in physics and astronomy from the U.K.’s Open University. Follow him on Twitter @sciencef1rst.
paras.zh: 罗伯特·李 (Robert Lea) 是一位英国科学记者，其文章发表在《物理世界》、《新科学家》、《天文学杂志》、《All About Space》、《新闻周刊》和《ZME Science》上。他还为爱思唯尔和《欧洲物理学杂志》撰写有关科学传播的文章。 Rob 拥有英国开放大学物理和天文学理学学士学位。在 Twitter 上关注他@sciencef1rst。
