paras.en: Showcasing the leading on-board computing platform for machine intelligence and HMI solutions. New products, designed specifically to meet the needs of agricultural machinery, include 10- and 12-inch smart terminals, central vehicle computing with monitors, and 5- and 7-inch displays featuring programmable soft keys for tactile control. The CCpilot V1090 and V1290 are the first displays with an integrated network switch that makes it easier to incorporate elements like camera systems, sensors and precision systems, into one display computer. The vehicle computer and monitors (CrossCore A100 with monitors from 10 to 12 inches) highlight the new centralized computing architecture. This approach provides a flexible, scalable platform for vehicle intelligence. It includes innovative component life cycle management and increased support for functional safety.
paras.zh: 展示用于机器智能和 HMI 解决方案的领先机载计算平台。专为满足农业机械需求而设计的新产品包括10英寸和12英寸智能终端、带显示器的中央车辆计算以及具有用于触觉控制的可编程软键的5英寸和7英寸显示器。 CCpilot V1090 和 V1290 是首款具有集成网络交换机的显示器，可以更轻松地将摄像头系统、传感器和精密系统等元素整合到一台显示计算机中。车载电脑和显示器（CrossCore A100，显示器尺寸从10英寸到12英寸）突出了新的集中式计算架构。这种方法为车辆智能提供了一个灵活、可扩展的平台。它包括创新的组件生命周期管理和增加对功能安全的支持。

paras.en: Highlighting how Elliott’s flexible planting products deliver precision performance, highly operational reliability and mechanical advantages without the need for additional power sources. The flexible drive and control shaft products bring enhanced performance to original equipment machinery, providing simple and dependable aftermarket upgrades for an ongoing return on your investment. Five different flexible drive shaft agricultural systems are available, and the assemblies fit most planters on the market today.
paras.zh: 重点介绍 Elliott 的灵活种植产品如何在无需额外电源的情况下提供精确的性能、高度的运行可靠性和机械优势。灵活的驱动和控制轴产品为原始设备机械带来了增强的性能，提供简单可靠的售后升级，为您带来持续的投资回报。有五种不同的柔性驱动轴农业系统可供选择，这些组件适合当今市场上的大多数播种机。

paras.en: Featuring the latest innovations in thermal management solutions, including intake throttle valves, hot- and cold-side exhaust gas recirculation valves, and exhaust back-pressure valves for diesel, gas and hydrogen internal combustion engines.
paras.zh: 采用热管理解决方案的最新创新，包括柴油、燃气和氢气内燃机的进气节流阀、热侧和冷侧废气再循环阀以及排气背压阀。

paras.en: Presenting the latest solutions to help operators sense, see and know more. Show attendees will find a broad portfolio of products, including displays, clusters and sensors for vehicle and equipment monitoring in demanding applications. The displays are built on a microcontroller architecture which offers lean performance with inherent support for key features including fast boot (typically around a second for instant access to machine data). Visitors to Agritechnica can get a hands-on look at the display range, from 1.3 to 4.3 inches, with demos to show general I/O, CAN channel support and application examples. The displays can share multiple screens of information, with intuitive navigation, including diagnostic codes and machine status. The platform offers devices with robust and compact housings suitable to withstand the toughest environments and designed to easily fit 52 or 86 mm SAE case sizes to make installation simple for new and existing cabins.

paras.en: Showcasing the Power-Packer portfolio of manual and electric pumps and cylinders for hydraulic cab tilt and hood-lift applications, as well as the latest electro-hydraulic actuator. paras.en: Learn about Weasler’s range of products, from drive shafts and torque limiters to dampers and other components, all designed using the best technology to solve our customers’ power transmission problems. Products are engineered for reliability and precision, ensuring the seamless operation and longevity of agricultural equipment.
paras.zh: 了解 Weasler 的产品系列，从传动轴和扭矩限制器到阻尼器和其他组件，所有产品均采用最佳技术设计，旨在解决客户的动力传输问题。产品的设计注重可靠性和精确性，确保农业设备的无缝运行和使用寿命。

articles.title: Champions crowned at the Top Awards 2026 finals
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: Champions crowned at the Top Awards 2026 finals
paras.zh: 2026 年 Top Awards 总决赛冠军加冕

paras.en: The UK’s leading independent workshops, technicians, service advisors, and apprentices have been named national champions at the Top Awards 2026, following a day of demanding practical and commercial assessments. Held at the Delphi Academy in Warwick on Saturday 14 November, the finals drew record attendance from across the automotive aftermarket. Competitors underwent high-pressure diagnostic challenges and business evaluations before the winners were announced that evening at the DoubleTree by Hilton in Coventry.
paras.zh: 经过一天严格的实践和商业评估，英国领先的独立工作室、技术人员、服务顾问和学徒被评为 2026 年顶级奖项的全国冠军。决赛于 11 月 14 日星期六在沃里克的德尔福学院举行，汽车售后市场的出席人数创历史新高。当晚在考文垂希尔顿逸林酒店宣布获奖者之前，参赛者们经历了高压诊断挑战和业务评估。

paras.en: In the flagship Top Technician competition, John Hall of North Yorkshire-based John Hall Auto Electrician secured the 2026 title after finishing as runner-up in both 2022 and 2025, edging out second-place finisher Kristopher Williams of Fords of Winsford. Finalists faced five 50-minute live fault-finding tasks designed to test diagnostic logic and methodical testing under pressure. Reflecting on his approach, Hall emphasised the importance of procedural discipline over shortcuts: “If you approach every job with the correct procedure, you usually end up with the right result. It might not be quick, but it’s the right way of doing it.”
paras.zh: 在旗舰顶级技师竞赛中，来自北约克郡的 John Hall Auto Electrician 公司的 John Hall 在 2022 年和 2025 年获得亚军后，击败了第二名来自 Fords of Winsford 的 Kristopher Williams，夺得了 2026 年冠军。决赛入围者面临五个 50 分钟的实时故障查找任务，旨在测试压力下的诊断逻辑和系统测试。霍尔在反思他的方法时强调了程序纪律比捷径更重要：“如果你用正确的程序处理每项工作，你通常会得到正确的结果。它可能不会很快，但这是正确的方法。”

paras.en: Now in its second year, the Top Apprentice title went to Jacob Knight of Bristol-based SF Tebby & Son, who impressed judges across real-world mechanical, electrical, and diagnostic scenarios. Customer-facing excellence was also recognised, with Mike Chubb of Sumner Auto Electrics winning the Service Advisor Award.
paras.zh: 今年是第二年，最佳学徒称号授予了总部位于布里斯托尔的 SF Tebby & Son 的 Jacob Knight，他在现实世界的机械、电气和诊断场景中给评委留下了深刻的印象。面向客户的卓越表现也得到了认可，Sumner Auto Electrics 的 Mike Chubb 赢得了服务顾问奖。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Top Garage 2026 celebrated independent businesses across six size-based categories, evaluated by commercial and technical panels on operational standards, customer care, and sustainable growth. Aldershot MOT Centre emerged as a double winner on the night, claiming the Top Garage title for businesses with seven to nine employees alongside the Ben Workplace Health & Wellbeing Award for its commitment to staff welfare and positive workplace culture.
paras.zh: 与此同时，Top Garage 2026 庆祝了六个基于规模的类别的独立企业，并由商业和技术小组对运营标准、客户服务和可持续增长进行评估。奥尔德肖特 MOT 中心当晚荣获双料冠军，因其对员工福利和积极的工作场所文化的承诺，获得了拥有 7 至 9 名员工的企业的“最佳车库”称号，以及“本工作场所健康与福祉奖”。

paras.en: Ryan Fuller, managing director of Top Awards, commented: “Congratulations to all our 2026 winners and finalists. Seeing apprentices step up alongside master technicians and business owners shows the clear pathway this trade offers. Today’s Top Apprentice is tomorrow’s Top Technician or Top Garage owner.”
paras.zh: Top Awards 董事总经理 Ryan Fuller 评论道：“祝贺所有 2026 年获奖者和决赛入围者。看到学徒​​与技术大师和企业主一起进步，表明了这一行业提供的清晰途径。今天的顶级学徒就是明天的顶级技师或顶级车库老板。”

paras.en: Entries for the 2027 competition will open in January.
paras.zh: 2027 年比赛的参赛作品将于 1 月开放。

articles.title: Axalta Support Hub Drives Growth and Peak Efficiency
articles.author: Axalta

paras.en: The automotive refinish sector is moving faster than ever. Modern collision centers face constant pressure to adapt to rapid technological shifts, advanced paint systems, and evolving operational demands. Compounding these challenges is an industry-wide shortage of skilled workforce talent. In this environment, running a profitable bodyshop requires more than just premium paint products. It requires a comprehensive support system that simplifies operations, ensures consistency, and drives long-term business growth.
paras.zh: 汽车修补漆行业的发展速度比以往任何时候都快。现代碰撞中心面临着适应快速技术变革、先进油漆系统和不断变化的操作需求的持续压力。使这些挑战更加复杂的是全行业熟练劳动力人才的短缺。在这种环境下，经营一家盈利的车身修理厂需要的不仅仅是优质油漆产品。它需要一个全面的支持系统来简化运营、确保一致性并推动长期业务增长。

paras.en: To help collision repair centers navigate these pressures, Axalta acts as a centralized support hub. By offering robust technical education, digital business solutions, and dedicated hands-on assistance, Axalta provides a standardized, “plug-and-play” model built for the reality of modern shop operations.
paras.zh: 为了帮助碰撞修复中心应对这些压力，艾仕得充当了集中支持中心。通过提供强大的技术教育、数字业务解决方案和专门的实践帮助，艾仕得提供了针对现代商店运营现实而构建的标准化“即插即用”模型。

paras.en: The Power of a Standardized Paint Department
paras.zh: 标准化油漆部门的力量

paras.en: For collision businesses looking to expand or optimize multiple locations, operational variance is the enemy of efficiency. Standardizing the entire paint department on a single product line—such as Axalta’s Spies Hecker Hi-TEC system—creates a flexible framework where refinishers can work fluidly across different facilities.
paras.zh: 对于寻求扩展或优化多个地点的碰撞业务来说，运营差异是效率的敌人。将整个涂装部门标准化在一条产品线上——例如艾仕得的 Spies Hecker Hi-TEC 系统——创建了一个灵活的框架，修补工可以在不同的设施中流畅地工作。

paras.en: This plug-and-play strategy has been a cornerstone of success for many multi-shop operators. By establishing the same paint department setup at every facility, they eliminated the traditional friction of scaling up.
paras.zh: 这种即插即用策略已成为许多多商店运营商的成功基石。通过在每个工厂建立相同的油漆部门设置，他们消除了传统的扩大规模的摩擦。

paras.en: When every shop uses identical paint management software and digital color-matching tools, the workforce becomes highly versatile. If a painter at one location takes a vacation or a shop experiences a sudden surge in volume, a technician from a sister shop can step in immediately without needing to learn a new system. This consistency eliminates downtime, stabilizes cycle times, and keeps production moving seamlessly.
paras.zh: 当每家商店都使用相同的油漆管理软件和数字配色工具时，员工队伍就会变得高度多样化。如果某个地点的油漆工休假或商店的业务量突然激增，姊妹店的技术人员可以立即介入，而无需学习新系统。这种一致性消除了停机时间，稳定了周期时间，并保持生产无缝进行。

paras.en: True comprehensive support means looking at a collision repair center’s health holistically, extending far beyond the technical application of coatings. Axalta’s support network operates both inside the spray booth and inside the front office to maximize overall profitability.
paras.zh: 真正的全面支持意味着全面关注碰撞修复中心的健康状况，远远超出了涂层的技术应用范围。艾仕得的支持网络在喷漆室和前台内部运作，以最大限度地提高整体盈利能力。

paras.en: On the technical side, Axalta provides instant access to expert problem-solving. When shops encounter difficult color matches or complex substrates, dedicated representatives provide immediate on-site help, spraying out test cards and working directly alongside painters in the booth to provide assistance. For deeper skills development, technicians receive targeted, in-person training at the shop or advanced coursework at dedicated regional training campuses.
paras.zh: 在技​​术方面，艾仕得提供即时专家问题解决服务。当商店遇到配色困难或基材复杂时，专门的代表会立即提供现场帮助，喷出测试卡并直接与展位内的油漆工一起提供帮助。为了更深入的技能发展，技术人员在商店接受有针对性的现场培训，或在专门的区域培训校园接受高级课程。

paras.en: On the operational side, the support hub leverages data to eliminate waste and protect margins. Dedicated representatives frequently analyze product usage, running granular reports to compare performance variables across multiple shop locations. These metrics feed into strategic management meetings, allowing shop owners and regional managers to catch material overuse or workflow bottlenecks early.
paras.zh: 在运营方面，支持中心利用数据来消除浪费并保护利润。专职代表经常分析产品使用情况，运行详细报告来比较多个商店位置的性能变量。这些指标反馈到战略管理会议中，使店主和区域经理能够及早发现材料过度使用或工作流程瓶颈。

paras.en: Furthermore, this centralized support addresses the total customer journey. Recognizing that shop success begins the moment a vehicle owner calls, training resources extend to front-office staff, providing specialized instruction in phone handling, customer service, and conversion strategies to ensure more jobs make it through the door.
paras.zh: 此外，这种集中支持解决了整个客户旅程。认识到商店的成功始于车主打电话的那一刻，培训资源延伸到前台员工，提供电话处理、客户服务和转换策略方面的专门指导，以确保更多的工作机会。

paras.en: A Collaboration Built for Sustainable Growth
paras.zh: 为可持续增长而建立的合作

paras.en: When a collision repair center chooses a paint partner, they are investing in the future scale of their business. A reliable support partner removes the guesswork from expansion. As independent shops transition into multi-shop operations, having an expert team step in to design new mixing rooms, configure hardware, and establish inventory backups ensures that new locations hit peak productivity from day one.
paras.zh: 当碰撞修复中心选择油漆合作伙伴时，他们正在对其未来的业务规模进行投资。可靠的支持合作伙伴可以消除扩展过程中的猜测。随着独立商店转变为多商店运营，拥有专家团队介入设计新的混合室、配置硬件并建立库存备份，可确保新地点从第一天起就达到最高生产力。

paras.en: Ultimately, advanced training and central support should not be viewed as an extra operational chore. They represent a direct, necessary reinvestment into the commercial health of the collision repair center. By maximizing the value of every ounce of paint, optimizing booth throughput, and elevating the skills of the entire team, continuous support transforms the challenges of a changing market into a reliable driver of long-term revenue growth.
paras.zh: 最终，高级培训和中央支持不应被视为额外的运营琐事。它们代表了对碰撞修复中心商业健康的直接、必要的再投资。通过最大化每一盎司油漆的价值、优化展位吞吐量以及提升整个团队的技能，持续的支持将不断变化的市场挑战转化为长期收入增长的可靠驱动力。

paras.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.axalta.com
