articles.title: GEICO Philanthropic Foundation donates $100K to Collision Engineering
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: GEICO’s Philanthropic Foundation has donated $100,000 to the Collision Engineering Career Alliance for standardized tools to attract students and strengthen the pipeline of skilled collision repair technicians nationwide, a news release states.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，GEICO 慈善基金会已向碰撞工程职业联盟捐赠 10 万美元，用于购买标准化工具，以吸引学生并加强全国熟练碰撞修复技术人员的储备。

paras.en: “By donating to Collision Engineering, we’re opening doors for the next generation of technicians and helping address a workforce shortage that affects drivers, repair shops and insurers alike,” said Alan Durand, GEICO Philanthropic Foundation board member and head of associate experience at GEICO, in the release. “We’re proud to stand with Collision Engineering, educators and our industry partners to build a stronger workforce for the future.”
paras.zh: GEICO 慈善基金会董事会成员兼 GEICO 员工体验主管艾伦·杜兰德 (Alan Durand) 在新闻稿中表示：“通过向碰撞工程公司捐款，我们为下一代技术人员打开了大门，并帮助解决影响司机、维修店和保险公司等的劳动力短缺问题。” “我们很自豪能够与碰撞工程、教育工作者和我们的行业合作伙伴一起为未来打造更强大的劳动力队伍。”

paras.en: The donation will support an infrastructure for student recruitment including:
paras.zh: 该捐款将用于支持学生招生的基础设施，包括：

paras.en: - “A standardized recruitment framework and training for college recruiters, college staff, and high school counselors;
paras.zh: - “针对大学招聘人员、大学工作人员和高中辅导员的标准化招聘框架和培训；

paras.en: - “Quarterly webinars and ongoing education;
paras.zh: - “季度网络研讨会和持续教育；

paras.en: - “A repeatable approach to student recruitment, employer engagement, and placement.”
paras.zh: - “可重复的学生招聘、雇主参与和安置方法。”

paras.en: “This donation gives Collision Engineering the national backbone every partner college needs to recruit more effectively, engage more employers and grow with confidence,” said Mary Mahoney, Collision Engineering Career Alliance president. “When industry, education and employers come together like this, we can offer more students in more communities hands-on training, paid apprenticeships and meaningful careers.”
paras.zh: 碰撞工程职业联盟主席玛丽·马奥尼 (Mary Mahoney) 表示：“这笔捐款为碰撞工程学院提供了每个合作伙伴学院所需的国家支柱，以更有效地招聘、吸引更多雇主并充满信心地成长。” “当行业、教育和雇主像这样走到一起时，我们可以为更多社区的更多学生提供实践培训、带薪学徒和有意义的职业。”

paras.en: The Collision Engineering program combines a two-year associate degree with paid, hands-on apprenticeships at qualified collision repair facilities. Earlier this year, the U.S. Department of Labor recognized the program as the standard for collision repair technician training and certification.
paras.zh: 碰撞工程项目将为期两年的副学士学位与在合格碰撞维修设施中的带薪实践学徒期相结合。今年早些时候，美国劳工部认可该计划作为碰撞修复技术人员培训和认证的标准。

paras.en: “The collision repair industry talks a lot about the technician shortage, but solving it requires more than recognition,” said Laura Lozano, professor of collision repair technology and chair of the Automotive Department at Contra Costa College. “We need to introduce more young people to these careers and, just as importantly, connect them with employers willing to train and mentor them. GPF’s donation will help build those connections and give schools like ours the resources to reach more students and industry partners.”
paras.zh: 康特拉科斯塔学院碰撞修复技术教授兼汽车系主任劳拉·洛萨诺 (Laura Lozano) 表示：“碰撞修复行业经常谈论技术人员短缺的问题，但解决这一问题需要的不仅仅是认可。” “我们需要向更多的年轻人介绍这些职业，同样重要的是，让他们与愿意培训和指导他们的雇主建立联系。GPF 的捐赠将有助于建立这些联系，并为像我们这样的学校提供​​资源来接触更多的学生和行业合作伙伴。”

paras.en: TechForce’s 2026 “Technician Supply, Demand & Opportunity Report” found the U.S. economy is short roughly 140,000 skilled technicians a year, and the gap is widening, with 73,354 new collision repair entrant technicians needed by 2029.
paras.zh: TechForce 的 2026 年“技术人员供应、需求和机会报告”发现，美国经济每年大约短缺 14 万名熟练技术人员，而且这一缺口正在扩大，到 2029 年需要 73,354 名新的碰撞维修技术人员。

paras.en: It found that the collision repair sector sees the highest turnover of the 10 analyzed at 60.7%.
paras.zh: 调查发现，在分析的 10 个行业中，碰撞维修行业的营业额最高，达到 60.7%。

paras.en: Jennifer Maher, TechForce Foundation CEO, told Repairer Driven News earlier this TechForce continuously polls its 125,000 aspiring working techs to see which industries excite them.
paras.zh: TechForce 基金会首席执行官 Jennifer Maher 早些时候告诉 Repairer Driven News，TechForce 不断对其 125,000 名有抱负的技术人员进行民意调查，看看哪些行业让他们感兴趣。

paras.en: “I am worried about the collision industry because it does not resonate above the fold,” Maher said. “It is way down, way down on the list.”
paras.zh: “我对碰撞行业感到担忧，因为它并没有引起大众的共鸣，”马赫说。 “它在名单上排名靠后，非常靠后。”

paras.en: That is going to be a recruiting challenge for the collision industry, she adds.
paras.zh: 她补充道，这对于碰撞行业来说将是一个招聘挑战。

paras.en: “It is a supply and demand economy,” Maher said. “When you look at wages, it’s not at the top. If it’s the same type of person and they start to learn their options, thanks to AI now, they can just ask. In the past, they didn’t know how to compare, and they weren’t going to do that much research.”
paras.zh: “这是一个供需经济，”马赫说。 “当你看工资时，你会发现它并不是最高的。如果是同一类型的人，他们开始了解自己的选择，感谢现在的人工智能，他们只需询问即可。过去，他们不知道如何比较，也不会做那么多研究。”

paras.en: For every 10 collision techs needed, schools are only producing four, Maher states.
paras.zh: 马赫表示，每需要 10 名碰撞技术人员，学校只能培养 4 名。

paras.en: “That leaves us more than 8,000 techs short every year, and what scares me most is that 6 in 10 leave their job every year,” Maher says.
paras.zh: “这使得我们每年短缺 8,000 多名技术人员，最让我害怕的是每年有十分之六的人离职，”马赫说。

paras.en: The Collision Engineering program is active at seven partner schools:
paras.zh: 碰撞工程项目在七所合作学校开展：

paras.en: - College of Lake County in Grayslake, Illinois
paras.zh: - 伊利诺伊州格雷斯莱克莱克县学院

paras.en: - Contra Costa College in San Pablo, California
paras.zh: - 康特拉科斯塔学院（加利福尼亚州圣巴勃罗）

paras.en: - Parkland College in Champaign, Illinois
paras.zh: - 伊利诺伊州尚佩恩帕克兰学院

paras.en: - Metropolitan Community College in Omaha, Nebraska
paras.zh: - 内布拉斯加州奥马哈大都会社区学院

paras.en: - Sandhills Community College in Pinehurst, North Carolina
paras.zh: - 北卡罗来纳州派恩赫斯特的桑德希尔斯社区学院

paras.en: - North Dakota State College of Science in Wahpeton, North Dakota
paras.zh: - 位于北达科他州瓦佩顿的北达科他州立科学学院

paras.en: - El Camino College in Torrance, California.
paras.zh: - 加利福尼亚州托伦斯的埃尔卡米诺学院。

paras.en: “Through Collision Engineering, I graduated with a degree, real experience, and a clear path forward,” said Karina Badillo, a Collision Engineering graduate from the College of Lake County. “This industry is moving fast, and Collision Engineering prepared me to move with it. Donations like the one made possible by the GEICO Philanthropic Foundation will help more people get that same start.”
paras.zh: “通过碰撞工程，我毕业时获得了学位、真实的经验和清晰的前进道路，”莱克县学院碰撞工程专业的毕业生卡琳娜·巴迪洛 (Karina Badillo) 说。 “这个行业正在快速发展，碰撞工程让我做好了跟上步伐的准备。像 GEICO 慈善基金会这样的捐赠将帮助更多的人获得同样的开始。”

paras.en: For more information about the program, visit here.
paras.zh: 有关该计划的更多信息，请访问此处。

articles.title: Lucid expands service network, increases staffing
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Lucid is expanding its service network with new locations, increased staffing, and additional mobile service capacity, according to a company press release.
paras.zh: 据公司新闻稿称，Lucid 正在通过新地点、增加人员配备和增加移动服务能力来扩展其服务网络。

paras.en: Through Q3, Lucid says it increased technician and service support staffing by more than 40% globally and mobile service capacity by 15% in North America. Q3 also saw overall service wait times down 20% globally compared to the previous quarter.
paras.zh: Lucid 表示，第三季度，其全球技术人员和服务支持人员数量增加了 40% 以上，北美的移动服务能力增加了 15%。第三季度全球整体服务等待时间与上一季度相比也减少了 20%。

paras.en: The automaker recently opened a combined sales studio and service center in Mission Viejo, California. Later this year, Lucid says additional studio and service center operations will open in downtown Los Angeles and Dallas, Texas, followed by one in Highland Park, Illinois, in Q1 2027.
paras.zh: 该汽车制造商最近在加利福尼亚州 Mission Viejo 开设了一家综合销售工作室和服务中心。 Lucid 表示，今年晚些时候，将在洛杉矶市中心和德克萨斯州达拉斯开设更多工作室和服务中心，随后将于 2027 年第一季度在伊利诺伊州高地公园开设工作室和服务中心。

paras.en: “We are building a broader, more accessible service network that supports our guests wherever they are in the ownership journey,” said Billy Hayes, chief customer officer at Lucid, in the release. “We are expanding our network, adding service personnel, and increasing mobile service capacity to reduce wait times and provide more convenient, responsive support. Mission Viejo is just one example of that work in action.”
paras.zh: Lucid 首席客户官比利·海耶斯 (Billy Hayes) 在新闻稿中表示：“我们正在建立一个更广泛、更方便的服务网络，为我们的客人提供支持，无论他们在拥有过程中处于何处。” “我们正在扩展我们的网络、增加服务人员并提高移动服务能力，以减少等待时间并提供更方便、响应更及时的支持。Mission Viejo 只是这项工作的一个例子。”

paras.en: Lucid is expanding capacity at existing service centers by adding vehicle technicians, service advisors, and concierges. Lucid plans to expand technical and service support staffing by another 10% through the end of the year, plus an additional 10% in Q1. It aims to expand mobile service capacity in North America by another 25% through year-end, supported by adding 20 Lucid Gravity mobile service vehicles.
paras.zh: Lucid 正在通过增加车辆技术人员、服务顾问和礼宾人员来扩大现有服务中心的容量。 Lucid 计划在今年年底前将技术和服务支持人员数量再增加 10%，并在第一季度再增加 10%。其目标是通过增加 20 辆 Lucid Gravity 移动服务车，到年底将北美的移动服务容量再扩大 25%。

paras.en: Lucid is also expanding sales and authorized service access in Europe and the Middle East. In October, it announced plans to open its first three retail and service locations in France in Q1 2027. Earlier this month, Lucid shared news that Cloppenburg Automobil SE is a new retail partner in Germany.
paras.zh: Lucid 还在欧洲和中东扩大销售和授权服务范围。 10 月，该公司宣布计划于 2027 年第一季度在法国开设前三个零售和服务网点。本月早些时候，Lucid 分享了 Cloppenburg Automobil SE 成为德国新零售合作伙伴的消息。

paras.en: According to the company’s Q3 earnings results, it saw a 30% sequential reduction in cash consumption and $350 million in revenue, up 4% year over year, while the U.S. battery electric vehicle market was down 41%.
paras.zh: 该公司第三季度财报显示，其现金消耗环比减少30%，营收3.5亿美元，同比增长4%，而美国纯电动汽车市场却下降了41%。

paras.en: Lucid shared the results last week, along with an update on its plans for midsize vehicle production. Testing, final-stage prototyping, and validation continued during Q3, with pilot production entering the final phase. Production remains planned for the second half of 2027. Lucid expects to announce reveal and production dates in Q1 2027.
paras.zh: Lucid 上周公布了业绩，并更新了中型汽车生产计划。第三季度继续进行测试、最终阶段原型设计和验证，试生产进入最后阶段。生产仍计划于 2027 年下半年进行。Lucid 预计将在 2027 年第一季度宣布披露和生产日期。

paras.en: Featured image: Lucid’s new combined sales studio and service center in Mission Viejo, California. (Provided by Lucid)
paras.zh: 特色图片：Lucid 在加利福尼亚州 Mission Viejo 新建的联合销售工作室和服务中心。 （由Lucid提供）

articles.title: ASE Education Foundation Launches $25M Apprenticeship Grant
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: The award comes through the Department’s Pay-for-Performance Incentive Payments Program, and the idea behind it is simple: reward registered apprenticeship sponsors for hiring apprentices and coaching them through the make-or-break first year on the job. Program sponsors — dealer groups, shop associations, franchise operators and similar organizations — can receive $3,500 for every apprentice they bring on and keep, paid in two parts as the new technician reaches 90 and 270 days on the job.
paras.zh: 该奖项来自该部门的绩效工资奖励计划，其背后的想法很简单：奖励注册学徒赞助商雇用学徒并指导他们度过工作成败的第一年。项目赞助商——经销商团体、商店协会、特许经营经营者和类似组织——每招收和留用一名学徒即可获得 3,500 美元的奖励，当新技术人员工作满 90 天和 270 天时，分两部分支付。

paras.en: “This launch of this program lets us do something the industry has needed for a long time: open a clear, paid path into the trade, and give employers a proven way to invest in and grow the people who keep this country moving,” said Mike Coley, President, ASE Education Foundation. “We’re not just filling jobs. We’re building careers that can support a family for a lifetime, strengthening the shops and dealers that serve their communities, and protecting the motoring public who trusts all of us every time they start their car.”
paras.zh: ASE 教育基金会主席迈克·科利 (Mike Coley) 表示：“该计划的推出让我们能够做行业长期以来一直需要的事情：开辟一条清晰的、有偿的进入行业的道路，并为雇主提供一种行之有效的方法来投资和培养推动国家前进的人才。” “我们不仅仅是在填补工作岗位。我们正在建立能够养活一个家庭一生的职业，加强为社区服务的商店和经销商，并保护每次启动汽车时都信任我们的汽车公众。”

paras.en: The Foundation is actively recruiting partners in all 50 states, the five territories and the District of Columbia, and apprenticeships will be created all across the industry; in franchised dealerships, retail chains, fleets, body shops, truck and diesel repair shops, and independent auto repair shops. Current RA Program sponsors who are ready to step up, put apprentices to work, and start receiving incentive payments can apply today at ASEeducationFoundation.org/apprenticeship/sponsor-application.
paras.zh: 基金会正在全美 50 个州、五个地区和哥伦比亚特区积极招募合作伙伴，并将在整个行业内设立学徒岗位；特许经销商、零售连锁店、车队、车身维修店、卡车和柴油维修店以及独立汽车维修店。目前的 RA 计划赞助商如果准备好站出来，让学徒工作并开始接收奖励金，可以立即在 ASEeducationFoundation.org/apprenticeship/sponsor-application 进行申请。

articles.title: New Paint Requires a Different Approach to Detailing
articles.author: Justin Glass

paras.en: A vehicle can leave a collision repair facility looking excellent under shop lighting and still present a completely different set of challenges when it reaches a detailer weeks or months later. From a detailing perspective, one of the most important things to understand is that refinished paint should not automatically be treated the same way as an untouched factory finish.
paras.zh: 一辆车辆在离开碰撞修复设施时，在车间照明下看起来非常出色，但在几周或几个月后到达维修人员手中时，仍然会面临一系列完全不同的挑战。从细节的角度来看，需要理解的最重要的事情之一是修补漆不应自动以与未触及的工厂饰面相同的方式处理。

paras.en: During more than 20 years of professional detailing, and as owner of Fort Lauderdale Precise Mobile Auto Detailing, I’ve worked on vehicles with original paint, repainted panels and combinations of both. Those jobs have taught me that the first step should never be reaching for a polisher. It should be determining what you’re actually working on.
paras.zh: 在 20 多年的专业细节设计生涯中，作为劳德代尔堡精确移动汽车细节公司的所有者，我曾对使用原漆、重新喷漆面板以及两者组合的车辆进行过研究。这些工作告诉我，第一步永远不应该是伸手去拿抛光机。它应该决定你实际上在做什么。

paras.en: Factory paint already varies considerably from manufacturer to manufacturer. Once collision repair and refinishing enter the picture, the variables increase. Film build, curing history, sanding and polishing performed during the repair, previous corrections and the condition of adjacent factory panels can all influence how the finish should be approached.
paras.zh: 不同制造商的工厂油漆差异很大。一旦出现碰撞修复和修补，变量就会增加。成膜、固化历史、修复过程中进行的打磨和抛光、之前的修正以及相邻工厂面板的状况都会影响饰面的处理方式。

paras.en: For a detailer, the goal is not simply to make the paint look as perfect as possible. The goal is to improve the appearance while preserving enough material for the finish to remain healthy over the long term.
paras.zh: 对于细节设计师来说，目标不仅仅是让油漆看起来尽可能完美。目标是改善外观，同时保留足够的材料，使饰面长期保持健康。

paras.en: When I inspect a vehicle that has had body or paint work, I want to know which panels have been refinished before I make decisions about correction. Sometimes the difference is obvious. Other times, a quality refinish blends so well that visual inspection alone does not tell the whole story.
paras.zh: 当我检查一辆进行过车身或喷漆工作的车辆时，我想在做出修正决定之前知道哪些面板已经过整修。有时差异是显而易见的。有时，高质量的修补漆融合得非常好，仅靠目视检查并不能说明全部情况。

paras.en: That is where careful inspection, good lighting and paint-thickness measurements become useful. A paint-thickness gauge cannot tell a detailer everything about a finish, and readings must be interpreted correctly, but comparing panels can reveal significant differences in film build. It can also help identify areas where previous sanding or polishing may have occurred.
paras.zh: 这就是仔细检查、良好照明和油漆厚度测量变得有用的地方。油漆测厚仪无法告诉细节人员有关饰面的所有信息，必须正确解释读数，但比较面板可以揭示漆膜结构的显着差异。它还可以帮助识别之前可能进行过打磨或抛光的区域。

paras.en: The important point is that a detailer should not assume every panel has the same amount of material available to work with. A hood may still have its factory finish while a fender and door have been refinished. Treating all three panels identically simply because they’re on the same vehicle can be a mistake.
paras.zh: 重要的一点是，细节设计师不应假设每个面板都有相同数量的可用材料。引擎盖可能仍具有出厂时的表面处理，而挡泥板和车门已进行了整修。仅仅因为所有三个面板位于同一辆车上而对它们进行相同的处理可能是错误的。

paras.en: Refinished paint does not always respond to polishing the way surrounding factory paint does. Depending on the paint system, application, cure, prior finishing work and environmental conditions, a refinished panel may cut or finish differently from an adjacent original panel.
paras.zh: 修补漆并不总是像周围工厂油漆那样对抛光有反应。根据油漆系统、应用、固化、先前的饰面工作和环境条件，修补后的面板的切割或饰面可能与相邻的原始面板不同。

paras.en: A combination that works beautifully on one panel may be unnecessarily aggressive on another — which is why test spots matter. I would rather begin conservatively and increase correction only when the finish tells me it’s necessary than start aggressively and discover afterward that I removed more material than the job required.
paras.zh: 在一个面板上表现良好的组合可能在另一个面板上表现得过于激进——这就是测试点很重要的原因。我宁愿保守地开始，只有当完成告诉我有必要时才增加修正，而不是积极地开始，然后发现我删除了比工作所需的更多的材料。

paras.en: Detailers also need to respect the refinisher’s recommendations regarding cure time and post-refinish care. Paint systems and repair procedures differ, so a blanket rule about when a newly painted vehicle can be polished, sealed, coated or otherwise treated is not a substitute for information about the specific repair. When there is uncertainty, communication with the collision facility or paint manufacturer is the safer approach.
paras.zh: 细节设计师还需要尊重修补师关于固化时间和修补后护理的建议。喷漆系统和维修程序各不相同，因此关于新喷漆车辆何时可以抛光、密封、涂层或其他处理的一揽子规则并不能替代有关具体维修的信息。当存在不确定性时，与碰撞设施或油漆制造商沟通是更安全的方法。

paras.en: Do Not Correct a Panel Twice Without Thinking
paras.zh: 不要不假思索地两次纠正面板

paras.en: One issue that’s easy to overlook is that a refinished panel may already have undergone substantial finishing before the customer ever sees it. Depending on the repair, the surface may have been denibbed, sanded, compounded and polished to remove texture or defects.
paras.zh: 一个容易忽视的问题是，在客户看到整修好的面板之前，它可能已经经过了实质性的修整。根据修复情况，表面可能经过磨边、打磨、复合和抛光以去除纹理或缺陷。

paras.en: If a detailer later sees a few remaining imperfections and immediately performs another aggressive correction, the panel can effectively be corrected twice. The customer may see a small visual improvement, but additional clearcoat has been removed to achieve it.
paras.zh: 如果细节人员后来发现一些剩余的缺陷并立即执行另一次积极的校正，则面板可以有效地校正两次。客户可能会看到轻微的视觉改善，但为了实现这一目标，额外的清漆已被去除。

paras.en: That trade-off matters. Clearcoat is not an unlimited resource. Every sanding or polishing step that removes measurable material reduces what remains for future correction. A vehicle may need to survive years of washing, environmental exposure and additional cosmetic work. Preserving the finish should therefore be part of the decision, not an afterthought.
paras.zh: 这种权衡很重要。透明涂层不是无限的资源。每一个去除可测量材料的打磨或抛光步骤都会减少剩余的用于未来修正的材料。车辆可能需要经受多年的清洗、环境暴露和额外的装饰工作。因此，保留表面效果应该是决定的一部分，而不是事后的想法。

paras.en: Perfection Is Not Always the Safest Goal
paras.zh: 完美并不总是最安全的目标

paras.en: Customers understandably want repaired areas to look perfect. Detailers want that too. But there are situations where chasing the final isolated defect is not the best decision for the vehicle.
paras.zh: 客户希望修复后的区域看起来完美，这是可以理解的。细节设计师也希望如此。但在某些情况下，追求最终的孤立缺陷并不是车辆的最佳决策。

paras.en: If removing one deeper mark requires disproportionately aggressive sanding or polishing, I explain the trade-off. A defect that’s barely visible under normal conditions may be preferable to unnecessarily reducing the protective clearcoat around it. The same principle applies to factory paint, but it becomes particularly important when the history of a refinished panel isn’t completely known.
paras.zh: 如果去除更深的痕迹需要不成比例的强力打磨或抛光，我会解释其中的权衡。在正常条件下几乎看不见的缺陷可能比不必要地减少其周围的保护性透明涂层更好。同样的原则也适用于工厂油漆，但当修补面板的历史不完全了解时，这一点就变得尤为重要。

paras.en: Professional correction requires judgment. The best result isn’t always the panel with the fewest visible defects under an inspection light. Sometimes the best result is the one that looks dramatically better while retaining as much of the finish as reasonably possible.
paras.zh: 专业纠正需要判断。最好的结果并不总是在检查灯下可见缺陷最少的面板。有时，最好的结果是看起来更好，同时尽可能保留尽可能多的饰面。

paras.en: Edges, Body Lines and Blended Areas Need Respect
paras.zh: 边缘、身体线条和混合区域需要尊重

paras.en: Edges and pronounced body lines deserve additional caution because paint film can be less forgiving in those areas, and polishing pressure and pad contact are harder to control. The same is true around tight contours, adjacent trim and transitions between repaired and original areas.
paras.zh: 边缘和明显的车身线条需要额外小心，因为这些区域的漆膜可能不太宽容，而且抛光压力和抛光垫接触更难控制。紧密的轮廓、相邻的装饰以及修复区域和原始区域之间的过渡也是如此。

paras.en: A detailer also has to recognize that a repaired area may extend beyond the most obvious damaged panel. Blending can involve adjacent panels to achieve a consistent color match. Knowing the repair history helps prevent assumptions about where the refinished area begins and ends.
paras.zh: 细节设计人员还必须认识到修复区域可能会超出最明显的损坏面板。混合可以涉及相邻面板以实现一致的颜色匹配。了解修复历史有助于防止对修补区域的开始和结束位置进行假设。

paras.en: This is another reason communication between collision repairers and detailers can be valuable. A simple explanation of which panels were refinished, blended or heavily finished can give the person caring for the vehicle later information that’s difficult to obtain from appearance alone.
paras.zh: 这是碰撞修复人员和细节人员之间的沟通很有价值的另一个原因。对哪些面板进行了修补、混合或重整的简单说明可以为车辆护理人员提供仅从外观很难获得的后期信息。

paras.en: Finishing Quality Affects the Customer’s Perception
paras.zh: 整理质量影响客户的看法

paras.en: From the customer’s perspective, the paint is often the most visible part of the repair. They may not understand the structural procedures, measuring systems or refinishing process that went into restoring the vehicle, but they’ll notice haze, holograms, sanding marks, compound residue and unfinished edges.
paras.zh: 从客户的角度来看，油漆通常是维修中最明显的部分。他们可能不了解修复车辆的结构程序、测量系统或修补过程，但他们会注意到雾霾、全息图、打磨痕迹、复合残留物和未完成的边缘。

paras.en: Those details can influence how the customer perceives the entire repair. A technically excellent repair deserves an equally thoughtful final presentation.
paras.zh: 这些细节会影响客户对整个维修的看法。技术上出色的修复值得同样深思熟虑的最终展示。

paras.en: Good lighting is critical during the finishing stage. Defects that disappear under one type of shop lighting can become obvious in direct sunlight. Checking the finish under multiple lighting conditions helps identify haze or machine marks before the vehicle is delivered.
paras.zh: 良好的照明在收尾阶段至关重要。在一种商店照明下消失的缺陷在阳光直射下可能会变得明显。在多种照明条件下检查饰面有助于在车辆交付前识别雾霾或机器痕迹。

paras.en: Residue around emblems, trim, panel gaps and edges also matters. These may seem like small details compared with the repair itself, but they’re exactly the details an owner may notice when inspecting the vehicle up close.
paras.zh: 标志、装饰、面板间隙和边缘周围的残留物也很重要。与维修本身相比，这些细节似乎很小，但它们正是车主在近距离检查车辆时可能注意到的细节。

paras.en: When a repaired vehicle comes to me later, my job is not to redo the body shop’s work. It’s to evaluate the finish that exists at that moment and choose the least aggressive process capable of producing the desired improvement.
paras.zh: 当修好的车辆后来找我时，我的工作不是重做车身修理厂的工作。它是评估当时存在的表面处理，并选择能够产生所需改进的最不激进的工艺。

paras.en: That usually begins with proper washing and decontamination, followed by inspection under controlled lighting. If correction is necessary, I perform a test section before deciding on the combination for the rest of the panel. I also compare the behavior of refinished areas with original paint rather than assuming one process will work everywhere.
paras.zh: 通常从适当的清洗和去污开始，然后在受控照明下进行检查。如果需要修正，我会在决定面板其余部分的组合之前执行测试部分。我还将修补区域的行为与原漆进行比较，而不是假设一种工艺在任何地方都适用。

paras.en: If something doesn’t look right, I would rather stop and gather more information than force a result. That can mean asking the customer about the repair, recommending that the collision facility inspect an issue or simply deciding that a particular defect should remain rather than removing excessive material.
paras.zh: 如果事情看起来不对劲，我宁愿停下来收集更多信息，而不是强行得出结果。这可能意味着向客户询问维修情况，建议碰撞设施检查问题，或者简单地决定应保留特定缺陷，而不是去除多余的材料。

paras.en: Collision repairers, detailers and vehicle owners all benefit when the history of a finish is communicated clearly. The more a detailer knows about what was painted, blended, sanded or polished, the better the decisions that can be made later.
paras.zh: 当表面处理的历史得到清晰传达时，碰撞修复人员、细节设计人员和车主都会受益。细节人员对涂漆、混合、打磨或抛光的内容了解得越多，以后就能做出更好的决定。

paras.en: Customers also benefit from realistic aftercare instructions. They should understand that refinished paint needs appropriate care, that not every cosmetic imperfection should automatically be attacked aggressively and that future detailers should be told which areas have been repaired.
paras.zh: 客户还可以从实际的善后护理说明中受益。他们应该明白，修补后的油漆需要适当的护理，并不是所有的装饰缺陷都应该自动受到积极的攻击，并且应该告诉未来的细节人员哪些区域已被修复。

paras.en: For detailers, asking a few questions before correction can prevent expensive mistakes. For collision shops, providing basic information about the refinishing work can help preserve the quality of the repair long after the vehicle leaves the facility.
paras.zh: 对于细节人员来说，在纠正之前问几个问题可以防止出现代价高昂的错误。对于碰撞维修店来说，提供有关修补工作的基本信息有助于在车辆离开工厂后很长时间内保持维修质量。

paras.en: Preservation Should Be Part of the Finish
paras.zh: 保存应该是完成的一部分

paras.en: The collision repair and detailing industries approach vehicles from different perspectives, but they share an important responsibility: protecting the work that has already been done.
paras.zh: 碰撞修复和细节行业从不同的角度处理车辆，但他们都有一个重要的责任：保护已经完成的工作。

paras.en: A refinished panel should not be treated as simply another surface to compound until every visible defect disappears. Its history matters. Its remaining film build matters. The finishing work already performed matters. And the customer’s expectation for how the vehicle will look years from now matters, too.
paras.zh: 在所有可见缺陷消失之前，修补后的面板不应被简单地视为另一个复合表面。它的历史很重要。其剩余的电影制作很重要。收尾工作已经完成了。客户对车辆几年后外观的期望也很重要。

paras.en: After more than two decades of detailing, I’ve learned that restraint can be just as important as correction. Knowing how to polish paint is a skill. Knowing when to stop polishing is another one.
paras.zh: 经过二十多年的详细研究，我了解到克制与纠正同样重要。知道如何抛光油漆是一项技能。知道何时停止抛光是另一回事。

paras.en: When freshly refinished paint is approached with proper evaluation, conservative testing and long-term preservation in mind, the result can look excellent without sacrificing more of the finish than necessary. That’s better for the detailer, better for the repairer and, most importantly, better for the vehicle owner.
paras.zh: 当对新修补的油漆进行适当的评估、保守的测试和长期保存时，结果可以看起来非常出色，而无需牺牲更多的饰面。这对于细节设计人员、维修人员来说都更好，最重要的是，对于车主来说也更好。

articles.title: How to Inspect, Diagnose and Replace Wiper Blades
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: A customer brings a vehicle into the shop because the windshield wipers leave streaks during heavy rain. The customer assumes the blades need replacing, but is that always the right repair?
paras.zh: 一位顾客把车开进店里，因为大雨时挡风玻璃雨刷会留下条纹。客户认为刀片需要更换，但这总是正确的维修吗？

paras.en: For automotive students, this common service concern provides an opportunity to practice inspection, diagnosis and customer communication. Wiper blades may seem like a simple maintenance item, but understanding how to identify performance problems and verify repairs is an important skill for future technicians.
paras.zh: 对于汽车专业的学生来说，这种常见的服务问题提供了练习检查、诊断和客户沟通的机会。雨刷片看似一个简单的维护项目，但了解如何识别性能问题并验证修复是未来技术人员的一项重要技能。

paras.en: Here are some common wiper blade questions and what students should know before entering the service bay.
paras.zh: 以下是一些常见的雨刷片问题以及学生在进入维修区之前应了解的内容。

paras.en: Q: Why Are Windshield Wipers Important to Vehicle Safety?
paras.zh: 问：为什么挡风玻璃雨刷对车辆安全很重要？

paras.en: Windshield wipers help maintain a clear view of the road during rain, snow and other conditions that reduce visibility. A blade that skips, streaks or fails to clear the glass can make it harder for drivers to see traffic, pedestrians and road hazards.
paras.zh: 挡风玻璃刮水器有助于在雨、雪和其他能见度降低的情况下保持清晰的道路视野。刀片出现跳动、划痕或无法清除玻璃的情况，会使驾驶员更难看清交通、行人和道路危险。

paras.en: Technicians should treat wiper blade inspection as part of routine vehicle maintenance. A quick visual inspection and operational test can reveal problems before poor weather makes them more serious.
paras.zh: 技术人员应将雨刮片检查作为日常车辆维护的一部分。快速的目视检查和操作测试可以在恶劣天气使问题变得更加严重之前发现问题。

paras.en: Q: What Are the Signs of Worn or Damaged Wiper Blades?
paras.zh: 问：雨刷片磨损或损坏的迹象是什么？

paras.en: Several conditions can indicate that a wiper blade needs attention:
paras.zh: 有几种情况可能表明雨刷片需要注意：

paras.en: - Streaking: Water or residue remains on the windshield after the blade passes.
paras.zh: - 条纹：刀片通过后挡风玻璃上残留有水或残留物。

paras.en: - Chattering: The blade vibrates or moves unevenly across the glass.
paras.zh: - 颤动：刀片在玻璃上振动或移动不均匀。

paras.en: - Skipping: The blade loses smooth contact with portions of the windshield.
paras.zh: - 跳跃：刀片失去与挡风玻璃部分的平滑接触。

paras.en: - Splitting or cracking: The rubber element shows visible physical damage.
paras.zh: - 破裂或开裂：橡胶元件显示出明显的物理损坏。

paras.en: - Poor wiping coverage: Areas of the windshield remain wet because the blade does not make proper contact.
paras.zh: - 擦拭覆盖范围差：由于刮片没有正确接触，挡风玻璃的区域仍然潮湿。

paras.en: Students should inspect both the condition of the rubber and the blade’s performance before recommending replacement.
paras.zh: 在建议更换之前，学生应检查橡胶的状况和刀片的性能。

paras.en: Q: Do Streaking Wiper Blades Always Need Replacement?
paras.zh: 问：雨刷片出现条纹需要更换吗？

paras.en: Not necessarily. Dirt, road grime, wax and other contaminants can accumulate on the windshield and wiper blade elements, affecting wiping performance.
paras.zh: 未必。污垢、道路污垢、蜡和其他污染物会积聚在挡风玻璃和雨刷片元件上，影响擦拭性能。

paras.en: General Motors’ wiper blade maintenance guidance identifies contaminated glass and blade elements, damaged rubber and uneven blade edges as possible causes of poor performance.
paras.zh: 通用汽车的雨刮片维护指南指出，受污染的玻璃和刮片元件、损坏的橡胶和不均匀的刮片边缘可能是导致性能不佳的原因。

paras.en: Before replacing a blade, inspect it for visible damage and clean the windshield and rubber element using a manufacturer-approved procedure. Then operate the washer and wiper system to determine whether the condition improves.
paras.zh: 更换刀片之前，请检查其是否有明显损坏，并使用制造商批准的程序清洁挡风玻璃和橡胶元件。然后操作清洗器和雨刷器系统以确定情况是否有所改善。

paras.en: If the blade continues to streak or chatter after cleaning, further inspection or replacement may be necessary.
paras.zh: 如果清洁后刀片继续出现条纹或颤动，则可能需要进一步检查或更换。

paras.en: Shop Tip: A good technician verifies the cause of a complaint before recommending parts. This prevents unnecessary repairs and helps build customer confidence.
paras.zh: 商店提示：优秀的技术人员在推荐零件之前会验证投诉的原因。这可以防止不必要的维修并有助于建立客户信心。

paras.en: Q: How Often Should Wiper Blades Be Inspected or Replaced?
paras.zh: 问：雨刷片应该多久检查或更换一次？

paras.en: Wiper blade life varies based on weather, environmental exposure and frequency of use. Heat, sunlight, freezing temperatures, ice and road debris can all affect the rubber element.
paras.zh: 雨刷片的使用寿命因天气、环境暴露和使用频率而异。热量、阳光、冰冻温度、冰和道路碎片都会影响橡胶元件。

paras.en: Inspecting wiper blades at least every six months and during routine maintenance visits is a useful practice. Replacement may be needed every six to 12 months, but technicians should follow the vehicle manufacturer’s guidance and evaluate actual blade condition.
paras.zh: 至少每六个月检查一次雨刷片以及在日常维护期间检查一次是一种有用的做法。可能需要每六到 12 个月更换一次，但技术人员应遵循车辆制造商的指导并评估刀片的实际状况。

paras.en: A blade should not be replaced solely because it has reached a certain age if inspection and performance testing show it remains serviceable.
paras.zh: 如果检查和性能测试表明刀片仍然可用，则不应仅仅因为刀片已达到一定的使用年限而更换刀片。

paras.en: Q: What Types of Wiper Blades Will Students Encounter?
paras.zh: 问：学生会遇到哪些类型的雨刷片？

paras.en: Technicians commonly work with three designs.
paras.zh: 技术人员通常使用三种设计。

paras.en: Conventional blades use a supporting frame and multiple contact points to distribute pressure along the rubber element.
paras.zh: 传统的刀片使用支撑框架和多个接触点来沿着橡胶元件分配压力。

paras.en: Beam blades use a curved, frameless or low-profile design that conforms to the windshield. Their construction can help reduce ice and snow buildup around exposed frame components.
paras.zh: 梁叶片采用与挡风玻璃相符的弯曲、无框或薄型设计。它们的结构有助于减少暴露的框架部件周围的冰雪堆积。

paras.en: Hybrid blades combine features of conventional and beam designs, often including an aerodynamic cover.
paras.zh: 混合叶片结合了传统设计和梁设计的特点，通常包括空气动力学盖。

paras.en: Students should understand that blade design, length and mounting style vary by vehicle. Always verify the correct replacement using vehicle-specific parts information.
paras.zh: 学生应该了解刀片设计、长度和安装方式因车辆而异。始终使用车辆特定零件信息来验证更换是否正确。

paras.en: Q: What Steps Should Technicians Follow When Replacing Wiper Blades?
paras.zh: 问：技术人员更换雨刷片时应遵循哪些步骤？

paras.en: A careful replacement procedure helps prevent windshield damage and ensures proper operation.
paras.zh: 仔细的更换程序有助于防止挡风玻璃损坏并确保正常运行。

paras.en: - Verify the vehicle application. Confirm the required blade lengths and mounting connections.
paras.zh: - 验证车辆申请。确认所需的刀片长度和安装连接。

paras.en: - Check the service procedure. Some vehicles require the wipers to be moved into a service position before the arms can be lifted.
paras.zh: - 检查维修程序。有些车辆需要先将雨刷器移至维修位置，然后才能抬起臂。

paras.en: - Protect the windshield. Raise the wiper arm carefully and prevent the exposed arm from snapping against the glass.
paras.zh: - 保护挡风玻璃。小心地抬起雨刷器臂，防止裸露的雨刷器臂折断玻璃。

paras.en: - Remove the old blade. Release the retaining mechanism according to the vehicle or blade manufacturer’s instructions.
paras.zh: - 拆下旧刀片。根据车辆或刀片制造商的说明释放固定装置。

paras.en: - Install the new blade. Confirm that the connector is fully engaged and the blade is secure.
paras.zh: - 安装新刀片。确认连接器已完全啮合并且刀片已固定。

paras.en: - Inspect and test the system. Return the arms to their normal position and operate the wipers with washer fluid to verify smooth movement and proper wiping coverage.
paras.zh: - 检查和测试系统。将臂恢复到正常位置，并使用清洗液操作雨刷器，以验证平滑的运动和正确的擦拭覆盖范围。

paras.en: Never operate wipers across a dry or frozen windshield during testing. Also check the washer spray pattern and fluid level when diagnosing poor windshield cleaning.
paras.zh: 测试期间切勿在干燥或结冰的挡风玻璃上操作雨刷。在诊断挡风玻璃清洁不良时，还要检查清洗机喷雾模式和液位。

paras.en: Q: What If New Wiper Blades Still Chatter or Streak?
paras.zh: 问：如果新雨刷片仍然发出颤动或条纹怎么办？

paras.en: Installing new blades does not guarantee that the original complaint will disappear.
paras.zh: 安装新刀片并不能保证原来的投诉会消失。

paras.en: If the problem continues, inspect the windshield for contamination or damage. Verify that the correct blades were installed and that the connectors are secure.
paras.zh: 如果问题仍然存在，请检查挡风玻璃是否受到污染或损坏。验证是否安装了正确的刀片以及连接器是否牢固。

paras.en: A damaged or misaligned wiper arm, insufficient arm pressure or another mechanical problem can also affect performance. Use the manufacturer’s service information when checking arm alignment or spring pressure.
paras.zh: 雨刷臂损坏或未对准、雨刷臂压力不足或其他机械问题也会影响性能。检查臂对齐或弹簧压力时，请使用制造商的服务信息。

paras.en: Students should remember that replacing a component is only part of the repair process. The final step is verifying that the customer’s complaint has been corrected.
paras.zh: 学生应该记住，更换部件只是维修过程的一部分。最后一步是验证客户的投诉是否已得到纠正。

paras.en: Q: How Should Students Explain Wiper Blade Problems to Customers?
paras.zh: 问：学生应该如何向客户解释雨刷片问题？

paras.en: Technical skills are important, but technicians also need to communicate inspection results clearly.
paras.zh: 技术技能很重要，但技术人员也需要清楚地传达检查结果。

paras.en: Instead of simply telling a customer that the wipers are bad, explain what was found and why it matters.
paras.zh: 不要简单地告诉顾客雨刷器坏了，而是解释一下发现了什么以及为什么它很重要。

paras.en: “During the inspection, we found that the driver’s side wiper blade has a torn rubber edge. That damage prevents the blade from clearing water evenly. We recommend replacing it to restore proper wiping performance.”
paras.zh: “在检查过程中，我们发现驾驶员侧雨刷片的橡胶边缘撕裂。这种损坏导致雨刷片无法均匀地清除水。我们建议更换它以恢复正常的擦拭性能。”

paras.en: This approach connects the inspection finding to a clear recommendation without unnecessary pressure.
paras.zh: 这种方法将检查结果与明确的建议联系起来，没有不必要的压力。

paras.en: Classroom Connection: Practice a Wiper Blade Inspection
paras.zh: 课堂连接：练习雨刷片检查

paras.en: Instructors can turn wiper blade service into a hands-on learning exercise.
paras.zh: 讲师可以将雨刷片维修变成实践学习练习。

paras.en: Have students work with a training vehicle or approved service components and complete the following tasks:
paras.zh: 让学生使用训练车辆或批准的服务组件并完成以下任务：

paras.en: - Identify the type of wiper blade installed on the vehicle.
paras.zh: - 识别车辆上安装的雨刷片类型。

paras.en: - Inspect the rubber elements for cracks, tears, contamination and uneven wear.
paras.zh: - 检查橡胶元件是否有裂纹、撕裂、污染和不均匀磨损。

paras.en: - Identify the mounting connection and determine the correct replacement blade.
paras.zh: - 确定安装连接并确定正确的更换刀片。

paras.en: - Demonstrate the proper removal and installation procedure.
paras.zh: - 演示正确的拆卸和安装程序。

paras.en: - Test the wiper and washer system and document the results.
paras.zh: - 测试雨刮器和清洗器系统并记录结果。

paras.en: - Explain the inspection findings as if speaking to a customer.
paras.zh: - 像与客户交谈一样解释检查结果。

paras.en: - What conditions can cause a wiper blade to chatter even when the rubber is not damaged?
paras.zh: - 即使橡胶没有损坏，哪些情况也会导致雨刷器刮片颤动？

paras.en: - Why should technicians clean and inspect the windshield before recommending new blades?
paras.zh: - 为什么技术人员在推荐新刀片之前应清洁和检查挡风玻璃？

paras.en: - What could happen if a replacement blade is not secured correctly?
paras.zh: - 如果替换刀片未正确固定，会发生什么情况？

paras.en: - How does verifying the repair improve customer satisfaction?
paras.zh: - 验证维修如何提高客户满意度？

paras.en: This exercise reinforces inspection, diagnosis, service information use and repair verification. It also gives students practice communicating technical findings in a professional shop environment.
paras.zh: 此次演习加强了检查、诊断、服务信息的使用和维修验证。它还让学生练习在专业商店环境中交流技术发现。

paras.en: Wiper blade service is more than a quick parts replacement. It gives future technicians an opportunity to build good diagnostic habits, follow service procedures and understand the connection between routine maintenance and driver safety.
paras.zh: 雨刷片服务不仅仅是快速更换零件。它使未来的技术人员有机会养成良好的诊断习惯、遵循维修程序并了解日常维护与驾驶员安全之间的联系。

paras.en: For students, the goal is to identify the cause of the problem, complete the correct repair and verify the results. For instructors, it is a straightforward way to teach skills students will use throughout their automotive careers.
paras.zh: 对于学生来说，目标是找出问题原因、完成正确修复并验证结果。对于教师来说，这是一种教授学生在整个汽车职业生涯中使用的技能的简单方法。

paras.en: The next time a vehicle enters the shop with streaking or noisy wipers, ask yourself: Is the blade worn out, or is something else affecting its performance?
paras.zh: 下次当车辆进入商店且雨刷器有条纹或噪音时，问问自己：刀片是否磨损，或者是否有其他因素影响其性能？

articles.title: Momentum USA Launches 77 Brake Part Numbers
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Momentum USA announced that it has introduced 77 new part numbers in August. European, Asian and electric vehicles are among those covered by the new part numbers.
paras.zh: Momentum USA 宣布在 8 月份推出了 77 个新零件号。新零件编号涵盖欧洲、亚洲和电动汽车。

paras.en: - 36 new part numbers in the AmeriStar brake pad line, which cover 28.7 million vehicles in operation. Impact applications include high-volume Hyundai/Kia platforms.
paras.zh: - AmeriStar 刹车片系列新增 36 个零件号，覆盖 2870 万辆运营车辆。影响应用包括大批量现代/起亚平台。

paras.en: - 8 new part numbers covering 8.8 million VIO in the AmeriPlatinum Ceramic line. This line now provides late-model coverage for import cars like the Toyota Corolla/Prius, Hyundai Palisade and Kia Telluride.
paras.zh: - 8 个新零件号，涵盖 AmeriPlatinum Ceramic 系列中的 880 万个 VIO。该线路现在为丰田卡罗拉/普锐斯、现代 Palisade 和起亚 Telluride 等进口汽车提供最新型号的覆盖。

paras.en: - 14 new E-Marked R90 Euro Coated Rotor and fully coated rotor additions in the AmeriPro line. This release covers BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Land Rover, Volvo, Genesis and Mini models.
paras.zh: - AmeriPro 系列中增加了 14 个新的 E 标记 R90 Euro 涂层转子和全涂层转子。本次发布涵盖宝马、梅赛德斯-奔驰、路虎、沃尔沃、劳恩斯和Mini车型。

paras.en: - Seven new EPS Friction brake pad SKUs, extending high-performance stopping power to applications like Alfa Romeo, BMW 2/3/4 Series, Maserati, Porsche Cayenne and Jaguar F-Pace.
paras.zh: - 七个新的 EPS 摩擦刹车片 SKU，将高性能制动力扩展到阿尔法罗密欧、宝马 2/3/4 系列、玛莎拉蒂、保时捷卡宴和捷豹 F-Pace 等应用。

paras.en: - New numbers across AmeriPRO and VGX add coverage for electric and late-model crossover models like the Nissan Leaf.
paras.zh: - AmeriPRO 和 VGX 的新数据增加了电动汽车和日产 Leaf 等新型跨界车型的覆盖范围。

articles.title: Replacing an Oil Filter Housing With an Integrated Oil Cooler
articles.author: Andrew Markel

paras.en: A leak at the oil filter housing isn’t limited to a gasket for its explanation. On many late-model import engines, the housing is part of a larger module that manages oil filtration and temperature, and may also contain sensors, thermostats and coolant passages.
paras.zh: 机油滤清器外壳的泄漏不仅仅限于垫圈。在许多新型进口发动机上，外壳是管理油过滤和温度的较大模块的一部分，并且还可能包含传感器、恒温器和冷却剂通道。

paras.en: Look at many late-model European engines and you’ll find an assembly bolted to the side of the block or mounted in the engine’s V. It may hold the oil filter and oil cooler, along with thermostats, valves or sensors. That arrangement helps fit more functions into a crowded engine compartment, but it can turn a straightforward oil leak into a more involved repair.
paras.zh: 看看许多最新型号的欧洲发动机，您会发现一个组件用螺栓固定在缸体侧面或安装在发动机的 V 形中。它可能固定机油滤清器和机油冷却器，以及恒温器、阀门或传感器。这种布置有助于在拥挤的发动机舱中安装更多功能，但也可能会将简单的漏油变成更复杂的维修。

paras.en: The design reflects two pressures on engine development: packaging and temperature control. Modern engines often use oil to operate variable valve timing systems and, in some engines, cylinder deactivation hardware. The oil must reach these components at the required pressure and volume, while staying within the engine’s operating temperature range.
paras.zh: 该设计反映了发动机开发的两个压力：封装和温度控制。现代发动机经常使用油来操作可变气门正时系统，并且在某些发动机中还使用停缸硬件。油必须以所需的压力和体积到达这些部件，同时保持在发动机的工作温度范围内。

paras.en: Oil cooling has changed to meet those needs. Some older imports used an air-to-oil cooler mounted near the radiator, with oil routed through an adapter between the filter and its mounting base. Many later designs moved to a liquid-to-liquid cooler, often sandwiched between the engine and oil filter. Coolant warms the oil more quickly after a cold start and carries away heat once the oil is hot. Integrating the filter, cooler and related controls into a single module saves space and can simplify assembly.
paras.zh: 为了满足这些需求，油冷却已经发生了变化。一些较旧的进口产品使用安装在散热器附近的空气-油冷却器，油通过过滤器与其安装底座之间的适配器输送。许多后来的设计转向液-液冷却器，通常夹在发动机和机油滤清器之间。冷启动后，冷却剂会更快地加热油，并在油热后带走热量。将过滤器、冷却器和相关控制装置集成到单个模块中可以节省空间并简化组装。

paras.en: A liquid-to-liquid cooler transfers heat between engine oil and coolant through plates or passages inside a compact heat exchanger. The fluids remain separate; heat moves through the metal between them. Because coolant can carry heat away efficiently in a relatively small space, the cooler can be packaged close to the engine without the airflow requirements of a front-mounted cooler.
paras.zh: 液-液冷却器通过紧凑型热交换器内的板或通道在发动机油和冷却剂之间传递热量。流体保持分离状态；热量通过它们之间的金属传播。由于冷却液可以在相对较小的空间内有效地带走热量，因此冷却器可以安装在靠近发动机的位置，而无需前置冷却器的气流要求。

paras.en: Many designs use stacked plates to create a large heat-transfer area. That compact construction has a service tradeoff: narrow internal passages can retain debris. If a major engine failure sends metal fragments through the lubrication system, an oil change may not remove everything lodged in the cooler. Manufacturer guidance for some engine repairs calls for replacing the cooler and related components when bearing debris contaminates the oil circuit, because cleaning cannot reliably remove all of it.
paras.zh: 许多设计使用堆叠板来创建较大的传热面积。这种紧凑的结构有一个服务权衡：狭窄的内部通道可以保留碎片。如果发动机发生重大故障，金属碎片会通过润滑系统，更换机油可能无法清除冷却器中残留的所有物质。制造商对某些发动机维修的指导要求在轴承碎屑污染油路时更换冷却器和相关部件，因为清洁无法可靠地将其全部清除。

paras.en: Oil around the housing does not automatically mean that the housing itself has failed. The leak may come from the housing-to-engine seal, the cooler seals, the filter cap or another component above the assembly. Oil can travel down the engine and collect at the lowest point, making the source hard to identify.
paras.zh: 外壳周围有油并不自动意味着外壳本身出现故障。泄漏可能来自外壳至发动机密封件、冷却器密封件、过滤器盖或组件上方的其他部件。油可以沿着发动机流下并聚集在最低点，使得来源难以识别。

paras.en: Clean the area and inspect it closely. If necessary, use an approved leak-detection dye and re-check the engine after running it. Look for coolant residue as well as oil. A leak between the oil and coolant passages can cause contamination in either direction, depending on operating pressures and the failure. If the coolant is oily or the oil appears milky, diagnose the source before deciding what to replace.
paras.zh: 清洁该区域并仔细检查。如有必要，请使用经批准的泄漏检测染料，并在运行后重新检查发动机。寻找冷却剂残留物和油。油道和冷却剂通道之间的泄漏可能会导致任一方向的污染，具体取决于工作压力和故障。如果冷却液呈油状或油呈乳状，请先诊断其来源，然后再决定更换什么。

paras.en: Check the vehicle-specific service information before starting. The procedure may require draining coolant, removing intake or accessory components, or following a particular sequence to release the housing. Some assemblies include separate cooler seals; others are serviced as a unit. Check whether the manufacturer specifies replacement bolts, sealants, tightening sequences or a special coolant bleeding procedure.
paras.zh: 开始前检查车辆特定的服务信息。该过程可能需要排出冷却剂、拆除进气口或附件部件，或者按照特定顺序释放外壳。一些组件包括单独的冷却器密封件；其他的则作为一个单元提供服务。检查制造商是否指定了更换螺栓、密封剂、拧紧顺序或特殊的冷却剂排放程序。

paras.en: Start with a cool engine. Drain the coolant if the service procedure calls for it, then disconnect electrical connectors and coolant hoses without stressing aged plastic fittings. Clean debris from around the assembly before opening the oil and coolant passages. Dirt that falls into an exposed passage can circulate through the engine.
paras.zh: 从一个很酷的引擎开始。如果维修程序需要，请排出冷却液，然后断开电气连接器和冷却液软管，不要对老化的塑料配件施加压力。打开机油和冷却液通道之前，请清除组件周围的碎屑。落入暴露通道的污垢可以在发动机中循环。

paras.en: Clean the engine’s sealing surface carefully. Avoid abrasive discs and aggressive scraping that can gouge or distort the surface. Keep debris out of the oil and coolant passages. If baked-on gasket material is difficult to remove, use a compatible gasket remover and a suitable non-damaging tool. Follow product directions and keep solvent out of the engine.
paras.zh: 仔细清洁发动机的密封面。避免使用研磨盘和强力刮擦，以免造成表面凿伤或变形。让碎屑远离机油和冷却液通道。如果烘烤后的垫圈材料难以去除，请使用兼容的垫圈去除剂和合适的无损工具。遵循产品说明并防止溶剂进入发动机。

paras.en: Install new seals in the correct locations and orientation. Lubricate them only if the service information calls for it. Tighten fasteners in the specified sequence and to the specified torque, using a torque wrench. Remember that uneven or excessive clamping force can distort a housing, damage a cooler or cause a new leak. Avoid adding sealant unless the procedure specifies it; excess sealant can squeeze into passages.
paras.zh: 将新密封件安装在正确的位置和方向。仅当服务信息需要时才润滑它们。使用扭矩扳手按指定顺序和指定扭矩拧紧紧固件。请记住，不均匀或过大的夹紧力可能会导致外壳变形、损坏冷却器或导致新的泄漏。除非程序指定，否则避免添加密封剂；多余的密封剂可能会挤入通道。

paras.en: Address Contamination and Verify the Repair
paras.zh: 解决污染并验证修复情况

paras.en: If oil has entered the cooling system, replacing the failed cooler or housing may not be enough. Oil can remain in the radiator, heater core, hoses and expansion tank. Follow the vehicle manufacturer’s cleaning procedure and use only products approved for that cooling system. A 2025 service bulletin, for example, warns against using unvalidated detergents because they may damage seals or metal components. Replace contaminated parts when the prescribed procedure calls for it.
paras.zh: 如果油已进入冷却系统，仅更换发生故障的冷却器或外壳可能还不够。油可能残留在散热器、加热器芯、软管和膨胀水箱中。遵循车辆制造商的清洁程序，并仅使用经批准用于该冷却系统的产品。例如，2025 年服务公告警告不要使用未经验证的清洁剂，因为它们可能会损坏密封件或金属部件。当规定的程序需要时，更换受污染的部件。

paras.en: If coolant has entered the oil, change the oil and filter after the leak is repaired, and follow the manufacturer’s guidance on whether further oil changes or inspections are needed. If the engine has suffered a mechanical failure that released metal debris, do not assume flushing will make the cooler reusable. The passages can retain contamination that may return to the engine after startup.
paras.zh: 如果冷却液已进入油中，请在修复泄漏后更换油和过滤器，并按照制造商的指导确定是否需要进一步更换油或检查。如果发动机发生机械故障并释放出金属碎片，不要认为冲洗会使冷却器可以重复使用。这些通道可能会滞留污染物，这些污染物可能在启动后返回发动机。

paras.en: Refill the fluids to the correct levels, and bleed the cooling system according to the application; some vehicles require a particular sequence or electronic procedure. Start the engine and check for leaks as it warms up. Confirm that the oil and coolant levels remain stable, then re-check the housing and surrounding area after a road test and cooldown.
paras.zh: 将液体重新加注到正确的液位，并根据应用对冷却系统进行排气；有些车辆需要特定的顺序或电子程序。启动发动机并在预热时检查是否有泄漏。确认机油和冷却液液位保持稳定，然后在路试和冷却后重新检查外壳和周围区域。

articles.title: Top 5 Suspension Problems That Shops and DIYers Commonly Misdiagnose
articles.author: TrakMotive

paras.en: Struts, racks, and alignments get blamed for a lot of problems they didn’t cause. In many cases the real cause is a worn chassis part: a sway bar link, a ball joint, a tie rod end, a control arm bushing, or a strut mount. Here are five common misdiagnoses, and how to find the part that’s actually worn.
paras.zh: 支柱、机架和对准装置因许多并非由它们引起的问题而受到指责。在许多情况下，真正的原因是底盘部件磨损：稳定杆连杆、球窝接头、横拉杆端、控制臂衬套或支柱安装座。以下是五种常见的误诊，以及如何找到实际磨损的部件。

paras.en: - A clunk over bumps blamed on struts or shocks
paras.zh: - 颠簸时发出沉闷的声音，原因是支柱或减震器

paras.en: Worn struts usually make a vehicle bouncy or floaty. They rarely clunk. One of the most common sources is a sway bar end link or sway bar bushing, which is a much cheaper part. Worn strut mounts, ball joints, and control arm bushings are also common culprits. A loose exhaust hanger or heat shield can sound like any of them. To find it, grab each end link and try to twist it with the car on the ground. Then have a helper rock the car while you listen and feel at each component.
paras.zh: 磨损的支柱通常会使车辆有弹性或漂浮。他们很少发出沉闷的声音。最常见的来源之一是稳定杆端连杆或稳定杆衬套，这是一种便宜得多的零件。磨损的支柱安装座、球接头和控制臂衬套也是常见的罪魁祸首。松动的排气吊架或隔热罩可能听起来像其中任何一个。要找到它，请抓住每个末端链接并尝试将汽车放在地面上扭转它。然后让一个帮手摇动汽车，同时您聆听并感觉每个部件。

paras.en: An alignment that checks out but still pulls is a common source of comebacks. Before you re-align, rule out these causes. Two of them are worn chassis parts:
paras.zh: 一个检查但仍然拉动的联盟是卷土重来的常见原因。在重新对齐之前，请排除这些原因。其中两个是磨损的底盘部件：

paras.en: - Radial tire pull: if swapping the front tires left to right reverses the pull, the tire is the cause.
paras.zh: - 子午线轮胎拉力：如果从左向右交换前轮胎使拉力反转，则轮胎是原因。

paras.en: - A sticking brake caliper: after a drive, one wheel will be noticeably hotter than the other.
paras.zh: - 制动卡钳粘滞：行驶后，一个车轮会明显比另一个车轮热。

paras.en: - A worn lower control arm bushing: it lets the wheel shift under braking or acceleration.
paras.zh: - 磨损的下控制臂衬套：它使车轮在制动或加速时发生移动。

paras.en: - A binding strut mount: it causes “memory steer,” where the car pulls in the direction of the last turn.
paras.zh: - 约束支柱安装座：它会导致“记忆转向”，即汽车沿上一转弯的方向拉动。

paras.en: 3. Loose steering or wander blamed on the steering rack
paras.zh: 3. 转向松动或跑偏归咎于转向齿条

paras.en: Play at the wheel often comes from somewhere else: a ball joint, control arm bushings, or a worn wheel bearing. How you check matters. Grab the tire at 9 and 3 o’clock and rock it. Play points to tie rods or the rack. Play when you rock it at 12 and 6 points to ball joints or a wheel bearing. Have a helper watch each joint so you can see where the movement actually is. When checking ball joints, remember that a load-carrying joint has to be unloaded before its play will show. If the coil spring sits on the lower control arm, support the lower arm near the joint. On strut designs, lift by the frame. When the spring sits on the upper arm, lift by the frame and wedge a block between the upper arm and the frame. Lifting at the wrong point can hide the wear. If the joint has a wear indicator, use it.
paras.zh: 车轮间隙通常来自其他地方：球窝接头、控制臂衬套或磨损的车轮轴承。如何检查很重要。抓住 9 点和 3 点钟位置的轮胎并摇晃它。发挥点为横拉杆或机架。当您以 12 点和 6 点摇动球接头或车轮轴承时即可进行演奏。让助手观察每个关节，以便您可以看到实际运动的位置。检查球窝接头时，请记住，必须先卸载承载接头，然后才能显示其间隙。如果螺旋弹簧位于下控制臂上，请在关节附近支撑下臂。在支柱设计中，通过框架提升。当弹簧位于上臂上时，抬起框架并在上臂和框架之间楔入一个块。在错误的位置提起可能会掩盖磨损。如果接头有磨损指示器，请使用它。

paras.en: 4. Tire wear blamed on alignment when the alignment is in spec
paras.zh: 4. 当对准符合规格时，轮胎磨损归咎于对准

paras.en: The printout is all green, but the tires keep wearing on the inside or feathering. Often the cause is a worn chassis part that the alignment rack can’t detect.
paras.zh: 打印输出全是绿色，但轮胎内部不断磨损或羽化。通常，原因是校准架无法检测到磨损的底盘部件。

paras.en: - Bushing deflection: A worn control arm, trailing arm, or subframe bushing can hold correct specs on the alignment rack but still let toe shift under braking, acceleration, or cornering. The rack measures a static car, while the tire wears dynamically. Pry gently on each arm and look for rubber that is cracked, torn, or pushed off center.
paras.zh: - 衬套偏转：磨损的控制臂、拖曳臂或副车架衬套可以在校准架上保持正确的规格，但在制动、加速或转弯时仍然会让前束发生偏移。机架测量静态汽车，而轮胎则动态磨损。轻轻撬动每条臂，寻找橡胶是否破裂、撕裂或偏离中心。

paras.en: - The rear axle gets ignored: Many shops do a front-only alignment on vehicles with adjustable or independent rear suspension. Rear toe or thrust angle that’s off makes the car “dog track,” and the front tires wear while the driver holds a slight steering correction.
paras.zh: - 后轴被忽略：许多商店对带有可调节或独立后悬架的车辆进行仅前部对准。后束角或推力角偏离会使汽车“狗跟踪”，并且当驾驶员进行轻微的转向修正时前轮胎会磨损。

paras.en: - Other factors: Running tires underinflated, carrying heavy loads (which changes camber and toe), skipping rotations, and worn shocks (which cause cupping) all produce wear patterns that look like an alignment problem.
paras.zh: - 其他因素：轮胎充气不足、承载重载（改变外倾角和前束）、跳动旋转和磨损的减震器（导致杯形）都会产生看起来像是对准问题的磨损模式。

paras.en: 5. Heavy steering or poor return-to-center blamed on the power steering pump, rack, or motor
paras.zh: 5. 转向沉重或回中心不良归咎于动力转向泵、齿条或电机

paras.en: When steering feels stiff, notchy, or doesn’t straighten itself after a turn, the pump, rack, or electric assist motor usually gets replaced first. Often the real cause is binding in the steering linkage or front suspension, which the power steering system then has to fight. A tie rod end or ball joint costs a fraction of what a new rack does.
paras.zh: 当转向感觉僵硬、有凹凸感或转弯后无法自行伸直时，通常首先更换泵、齿条或电动辅助电机。通常，真正的原因是转向连杆或前悬架中的束缚，然后动力转向系统必须与之对抗。拉杆端或球形接头的成本只是新机架的一小部分。

paras.en: - Seized or dry tie rod ends and ball joints. A joint can have no play at all, so it passes a play check, and still be stiff. A stiff joint makes the wheel feel heavy and keeps it from returning to center. Inspectors check for looseness but rarely check for binding. To check, disconnect the joint and move the stud by hand. It should move smoothly, with no notches or tight spots.
paras.zh: - 横拉杆端部和球形接头卡住或干燥。关节可能根本没有游隙，因此它通过了游隙检查，但仍然是僵硬的。僵硬的接头会使车轮感觉很重，并使其无法回到中心。检查员检查是否松动，但很少检查是否装订。要进行检查，请断开接头并用手移动螺柱。它应该移动平稳，没有凹口或紧点。

paras.en: - Binding upper strut mount bearings. These cause stiff or notchy steering, often with a creak, pop, or “boing” from the coil spring when turning at low speed. The steering also tends to stay where you leave it after a turn instead of straightening out.
paras.zh: - 绑定上支柱安装轴承。这些会导致转向僵硬或不顺畅，低速转弯时，螺旋弹簧通常会发出吱吱声、爆裂声或“嗡嗡声”。转弯后方向盘也往往会停留在原来的位置，而不是伸直。

paras.en: - Low or uneven caster. Caster is the main thing that makes the wheel return to center. A bent control arm or strut tower, a shifted subframe, or a worn radius rod or control arm bushing can reduce it. Uneven caster side to side also causes a pull toward the side with less caster.
paras.zh: - 主销后倾角低或不均匀。主销后倾角是使车轮回到中心的主要部件。弯曲的控制臂或支柱塔、移位的副车架、磨损的半径杆或控制臂衬套都可以减少这种情况。左右主销后倾角不均匀也会导致向主销后倾角较小的一侧产生拉力。

paras.en: Before you replace the strut, the rack, or the alignment, check the chassis. Most of the culprits on this list are worn control arms, ball joints, tie rod ends, sway bar links, bushings, or strut mounts, and Suspensia engineers every one of them to meet or exceed OE specifications.
paras.zh: 在更换支柱、机架或对齐之前，请检查底盘。此列表中的大多数罪魁祸首是磨损的控制臂、球形接头、横拉杆端部、稳定杆连杆、衬套或支柱安装座，Suspensia 设计的每一项都满足或超过原厂规格。

paras.en: This article was sponsored by Trakmotive Learn more at: https://www.suspensia.com/
paras.zh: 本文由 Trakmotive 赞助 了解更多信息：https://www.suspensia.com/

articles.title: Static vs. Dynamic ADAS Calibrations
articles.author: Christian Hinton

paras.en: Choosing between static and dynamic ADAS calibration depends on the procedure specified by the vehicle manufacturer. Regardless of the method, the vehicle and its surroundings must meet the manufacturer’s requirements.
paras.zh: 静态和动态 ADAS 校准之间的选择取决于车辆制造商指定的程序。无论采用哪种方法，车辆及其周围环境都必须满足制造商的要求。

paras.en: ADAS systems affected by a repair may need to be calibrated, relearned or re-zeroed. Terminology may vary, but the purpose is to establish an accurate reference point for the system.
paras.zh: 受维修影响的 ADAS 系统可能需要校准、重新学习或重新调零。术语可能有所不同，但目的是为系统建立准确的参考点。

paras.en: A static calibration is performed while the vehicle remains stationary. Technicians position targets at exact distances and heights, and the targets must also be square to the vehicle’s centerline.
paras.zh: 静态校准是在车辆保持静止时执行的。技术人员将目标定位在精确的距离和高度，并且目标还必须与车辆中心线成直角。

paras.en: The vehicle must meet specified requirements for weight, ride height, tire pressure, fluid levels, lighting and background conditions.
paras.zh: 车辆必须满足重量、行驶高度、轮胎压力、液位、照明和背景条件的规定要求。

paras.en: Dynamic calibration takes place while driving. The technician places the system into calibration mode and drives the vehicle under specified conditions.
paras.zh: 动态校准在驾驶时进行。技术人员将系统置于校准模式并在指定条件下驾驶车辆。

paras.en: During the drive, the sensors verify that they can identify the roadway, recognize objects and align correctly with the vehicle’s centerline.
paras.zh: 在驾驶过程中，传感器验证它们是否可以识别道路、识别物体并与车辆中心线正确对齐。

paras.en: Extra weight, improper tire pressure, incorrect ride height or environmental interference can cause calibration to fail. These conditions can also establish an inaccurate reference.
paras.zh: 额外的重量、不正确的轮胎压力、不正确的行驶高度或环境干扰都可能导致校准失败。这些条件也可能建立不准确的参考。

paras.en: Whether the procedure is static or dynamic, technicians must follow the manufacturer’s instructions exactly. ADAS calibration depends on precision, and even small inconsistencies can affect system performance.
paras.zh: 无论程序是静态还是动态，技术人员都必须严格遵循制造商的说明。 ADAS 校准取决于精度，即使很小的不一致也会影响系统性能。

articles.title: NTN Volunteer Event Supports Local Food Pantry
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: NTN Bearing Corp. of America held its Community Spirit & Engagement Event at the Elk Grove Township Food Pantry in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, on Tuesday, October 27. A team of twelve NTN employees volunteered to help combat food insecurity and support local families ahead of Thanksgiving.
paras.zh: 美国 NTN 轴承公司于 10 月 27 日星期二在伊利诺伊州埃尔克格罗夫村的埃尔克格罗夫镇食品储藏室举办了社区精神与参与活动。由 12 名 NTN 员工组成的团队自愿在感恩节前帮助应对粮食不安全问题并为当地家庭提供支持。

paras.en: Volunteers spent the morning assembling approximately 400 Thanksgiving food bags that will be distributed to families throughout the community. Designed as a “trick-or-treat” style shopping experience, team members worked together at various food stations, collecting and packing items including cooking oil, canned vegetables, canned pumpkin, mashed potatoes, macaroni and cheese, gravy, brownie mix, and other household necessities.
paras.zh: 志愿者花了一上午的时间组装了大约 400 个感恩节食品袋，这些食品袋将分发给整个社区的家庭。设计为“不给糖就捣蛋”式的购物体验，团队成员在各个食品站一起工作，收集和包装物品，包括食用油、罐装蔬菜、罐装南瓜、土豆泥、通心粉和奶酪、肉汁、布朗尼蛋糕和其他家庭必需品。

paras.en: In the afternoon, NTN employees assisted pantry staff with organizing and storing five pallets of donated food. According to the food pantry manager, the work completed by the NTN team in a few hours would have taken the pantry’s regular staff and volunteers up to a month to accomplish.
paras.zh: 下午，NTN员工协助食品储藏室工作人员整理并存放了五托盘的捐赠食品。据食品储藏室经理称，NTN 团队在几个小时内完成的工作需要储藏室的正式员工和志愿者长达一个月的时间才能完成。

paras.en: NTN’s Community Spirit & Engagement Program, launched in January 2023, includes contributing time and resources to charitable organizations, encouraging employees to take an active role in the local community, and building partnerships with other groups and organizations.
paras.zh: NTN 的社区精神和参与计划于 2023 年 1 月启动，包括向慈善组织贡献时间和资源、鼓励员工在当地社区发挥积极作用，以及与其他团体和组织建立合作伙伴关系。

paras.en: The Elk Grove Township Food Pantry provides food assistance and related support services to residents facing food insecurity, serving approximately 1,100 families each month through a client-choice model that allows households to access nutritious food and household essentials in a dignified and convenient manner. Through partnerships with community organizations, donors, and volunteers, the pantry helps ensure local families have access to the resources they need throughout the year and is expected to distribute the Thanksgiving food bags assembled during the event to nearly 900 families this holiday season.
paras.zh: Elk Grove Township Food Pantry 为面临粮食不安全的居民提供粮食援助和相关支持服务，每月通过客户选择模式为约 1,100 个家庭提供服务，使家庭能够以有尊严和便捷的方式获得营养食品和家庭必需品。通过与社区组织、捐助者和志愿者的合作，食品储藏室帮助确保当地家庭能够获得全年所需的资源，并预计在这个节日期间将活动期间收集的感恩节食品袋分发给近 900 个家庭。

articles.title: LKQ Names Paul Shaw North America President
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: LKQ Corporation announced that John Meyne, senior vice president and president of its North America segment, will retire Dec. 31, 2026. The LKQ board of directors appointed Paul Shaw to succeed Meyne, effective Jan. 1, 2027.
paras.zh: LKQ Corporation 宣布高级副总裁兼北美业务总裁 John Meyne 将于 2026 年 12 月 31 日退休。LKQ 董事会任命 Paul Shaw 接替 Meyne，自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起生效。

paras.en: Shaw currently serves as senior vice president of operations for LKQ’s North America segment.
paras.zh: Shaw 目前担任 LKQ 北美部门运营高级副总裁。

paras.en: “Paul has dedicated more than 25 years to LKQ, and his contributions have been instrumental in driving the growth of our North America segment. This well-deserved promotion reflects the confidence that our Board, senior management, and customers have in him,” said Meyne.
paras.zh: “Paul 为 LKQ 奉献了超过 25 年，他的贡献对于推动我们北美业务的增长发挥了重要作用。这次当之无愧的晋升反映了我们的董事会、高级管理层和客户对他的信心，”Meyne 说道。

paras.en: LKQ President and CEO Sal Abbate commented on Shaw’s appointment.
paras.zh: LKQ 总裁兼首席执行官 Sal Abbate 对 Shaw 的任命发表了评论。

paras.en: “We are pleased to announce Paul’s appointment as Senior Vice President of LKQ and President of North America. Paul has a proven track record of implementing operational discipline, deep industry expertise and a lasting commitment to our teams and customers. The Board is confident that, under Paul’s leadership, North America is well positioned to deliver continued value for our customers and shareholders.”
paras.zh: “我们很高兴地宣布 Paul 被任命为 LKQ 高级副总裁兼北美区总裁。Paul 在执行运营纪律方面拥有良好的记录、深厚的行业专业知识以及对我们团队和客户的持久承诺。董事会相信，在 Paul 的领导下，北美区有能力为我们的客户和股东提供持续价值。”

paras.en: Board Chairman Recognizes Meyne’s Contributions
paras.zh: 董事会主席认可梅恩的贡献

paras.en: John Mendel, chairman of the board, commented on Meyne’s retirement.
paras.zh: 董事会主席约翰·孟德尔 (John Mendel) 对梅恩的退休发表了评论。

paras.en: “Mr. Meyne has been a trusted partner and an integral part of LKQ’s success. On behalf of the Board, I want to thank him for his dedication and the many contributions he has made to the Company. We wish him all the best in his retirement.”
paras.zh: “Meyne 先生一直是值得信赖的合作伙伴，也是 LKQ 成功不可或缺的一部分。我谨代表董事会感谢他的奉献精神以及为公司做出的众多贡献。我们祝愿他退休后一切顺利。”

articles.title: GB Reman Recognizes Top Sales Reps
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: At AAPEX 2026, GB Reman recognized its second annual Sales Representative Agency of the Year and three Top Sales Representative award recipients. The recognition comes as GB Reman celebrates 40 years in the automotive aftermarket.
paras.zh: 在 AAPEX 2026 上，GB Reman 表彰了其第二届年度销售代表机构和三名最佳销售代表奖获得者。此次认可恰逢 GB Reman 庆祝进入汽车售后市场 40 周年之际。

paras.en: 2026 Sales Representative Agency of the Year
paras.zh: 2026 年度最佳销售代表机构

paras.en: Top Sales Representative Award Recipients
paras.zh: 最佳销售代表奖获得者

paras.en: - Dennis Rosinski, Glazier Sales Associates
paras.zh: - Dennis Rosinski，Glazier 销售助理

paras.en: Sales Representatives Support Distribution Customers
paras.zh: 销售代表支持分销客户

paras.en: The company’s outside sales representatives play a key role in supporting its distribution customers nationwide and representing the GB Reman product line. Beyond product knowledge and sales, the company trusts its representatives to uphold its values and commitment to serving customers.
paras.zh: 该公司的外部销售代表在支持全国分销客户和代表 GB Reman 产品线方面发挥着关键作用。除了产品知识和销售之外，公司还相信其代表能够坚持其价值观和为客户服务的承诺。

paras.en: Andrew Kitching, director of sales at GB Reman, reflected on the significance of the awards and the company’s anniversary.
paras.zh: GB Reman 销售总监 Andrew Kitching 反思了该奖项和公司周年纪念的重要性。

paras.en: “Much of our success has been built on the relationships we’ve developed over the years. Our sales representatives are an extension of our team, and they play an important role in how we serve our customers and represent GB Reman in the marketplace. We’re proud to recognize Pro-Reps Sales, along with Blake, Phil and Dennis, for their continued commitment to our customers and to GB Reman. Their hard work and dedication do not go unnoticed, and we are grateful to have them as part of the GB Reman family.”
paras.zh: “我们的成功很大程度上建立在多年来建立的关系之上。我们的销售代表是我们团队的延伸，他们在我们如何服务客户以及在市场上代表 GB Reman 方面发挥着重要作用。我们很自豪能够认可 Pro-Reps Sales 以及 Blake、Phil 和 Dennis 对我们客户和 GB Reman 的持续承诺。他们的辛勤工作和奉献精神不会被忽视，我们很高兴他们成为 GB Reman 大家庭的一员。”

articles.title: AutoZone President and CEO Phil Daniele on ‘Putting Customers First’
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: This episode of DriveTime features Phil Daniele, president and CEO, customer satisfaction, AutoZone.
paras.zh: 本期 DriveTime 的主角是 AutoZone 客户满意度部门总裁兼首席执行官 Phil Daniele。

paras.en: Daniele said the company’s commercial business has evolved significantly as it continues investing in the professional repair market. With commercial sales approaching $6 billion and programs in approximately 95% of its stores, AutoZone is strengthening its product quality, availability and delivery capabilities to better serve repair shops. Daniele emphasized the importance of OE-quality or better products, including its Duralast portfolio, alongside expanded assortments through its hub and mega hub strategy. Investments in technology, inventory optimization and a dedicated professional sales force are helping AutoZone get the right parts to shops faster while building stronger customer relationships.
paras.zh: Daniele 表示，随着公司继续投资专业维修市场，其商业业务已取得显着发展。 AutoZone 的商业销售额接近 60 亿美元，并在其约 95% 的商店中实施了该计划，因此正在加强其产品质量、可用性和交付能力，以更好地为维修店提供服务。 Daniele 强调了原厂品质或更好产品的重要性，包括其 Duralast 产品组合，以及通过其中心和大型中心战略扩大的品种。对技术、库存优化和专业销售队伍的投资正在帮助 AutoZone 更快地将合适的零件送到商店，同时建立更牢固的客户关系。

paras.en: AutoZone’s recent milestone of 8,000 stores globally reflects decades of expansion and continued growth opportunities, Daniele explained. The company also celebrated its 1,000th store in Mexico, expanded distribution capabilities there and broke ground on another facility. Looking ahead, AutoZone plans to continue opening stores across the United States, Mexico and Brazil. Daniele said that expansion creates opportunities not only to serve more customers but also to develop future leaders within the organization. AutoZone’s promote-from-within culture has helped employees build long-term careers, with many executives beginning their careers in stores.
paras.zh: Daniele 解释说，AutoZone 最近在全球拥有 8,000 家门店的里程碑反映了数十年的扩张和持续增长机会。该公司还庆祝其在墨西哥开设第 1,000 家商店，扩大了当地的分销能力，并在另一家工厂破土动工。展望未来，AutoZone 计划继续在美国、墨西哥和巴西开设门店。 Daniele 表示，扩张不仅创造了服务更多客户的机会，而且还为组织内培养未来的领导者创造了机会。 AutoZone 的内部晋升文化帮助员工建立了长期的职业生涯，许多高管都是在商店开始他们的职业生涯的。

paras.en: Delivering “WOW! customer service” remains central to AutoZone’s culture and operating philosophy. Daniele said empowering approximately 130,000 AutoZoners to consistently exceed customer expectations requires strong systems, processes and accountability. For professional repair shops, that means delivering quality parts quickly, ensuring accurate transactions and understanding each customer’s specific needs. Daniele emphasized that every interaction, from sales representatives to delivery drivers, contributes to the customer experience. By combining operational execution with a customer-first mindset, AutoZone aims to strengthen relationships and deliver the level of service that keeps customers coming back.
paras.zh: 提供“哇！客户服务”仍然是 AutoZone 文化和运营理念的核心。 Daniele 表示，要让大约 130,000 名 AutoZoners 持续超越客户期望，需要强大的系统、流程和问责制。对于专业维修店来说，这意味着快速交付优质零件、确保准确的交易并了解每个客户的具体需求。 Daniele 强调，从销售代表到送货司机的每一次互动都有助于提升客户体验。通过将运营执行与客户至上的理念相结合，AutoZone 旨在加强关系并提供高水平的服务，让客户成为回头客。

paras.en: To hear more of Daniele’s insights, be sure to watch the above video.
paras.zh: 要了解 Daniele 的更多见解，请务必观看上面的视频。

articles.title: NTN Employees Volunteer at Local Food Pantry
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: NTN Bearing Corporation of America recently held a Community Spirit & Engagement Event at the Elk Grove Township Food Pantry in Elk Grove Village, Illinois. On Oct. 27, 12 NTN employees volunteered to help combat food insecurity and support local families ahead of Thanksgiving. Volunteers spent the morning assembling approximately 400 Thanksgiving food bags for distribution to families throughout the community. Team members followed a “trick-or-treat”-style shopping process, collecting and packing items at various food stations. Items included cooking oil, canned vegetables, canned pumpkin, mashed potatoes, macaroni and cheese, gravy, brownie mix and other household necessities.
paras.zh: 美国 NTN 轴承公司最近在伊利诺伊州埃尔克格罗夫村的埃尔克格罗夫镇食品储藏室举办了社区精神与参与活动。 10 月 27 日，12 名 NTN 员工自愿在感恩节前帮助应对粮食不安全问题并支持当地家庭。志愿者花了一上午的时间组装了大约 400 个感恩节食品袋，分发给整个社区的家庭。团队成员遵循“不给糖就捣蛋”式的购物流程，在各个食品站收集和包装物品。商品包括食用油、罐装蔬菜、罐装南瓜、土豆泥、通心粉和奶酪、肉汁、布朗尼蛋糕粉和其他家庭必需品。

paras.en: In the afternoon, NTN employees helped pantry staff organize and store five pallets of donated food. According to the food pantry manager, the pantry’s regular staff and volunteers would have needed up to a month. The NTN team completed the same work in just a few hours.
paras.zh: 下午，NTN员工帮助食品储藏室工作人员整理并存放了五托盘的捐赠食品。据食品储藏室经理称，储藏室的正式员工和志愿者最多需要一个月的时间。 NTN团队在短短几个小时内完成了同样的工作。

paras.en: “Helping to address food insecurity is an important part of NTN’s commitment to being a responsible corporate citizen,” said Tom Mohrdieck, president and CEO of NTN Bearing Corporation of America. “This volunteer event directly supports NTN’s global Sustainable Development Goal of Zero Hunger while allowing our employees to make a meaningful difference for families in our community. Knowing that the food bags assembled will help nearly 900 families celebrate Thanksgiving made this an especially impactful event for our team. NTN is grateful for the opportunity to support the Elk Grove Township Food Pantry and the vital services it provides throughout the year.”
paras.zh: 美国 NTN 轴承公司总裁兼首席执行官 Tom Mohrdieck 表示：“帮助解决粮食不安全问题是 NTN 致力于成为负责任的企业公民的重要组成部分。” “这次志愿者活动直接支持 NTN 的全球零饥饿可持续发展目标，同时让我们的员工为社区家庭做出有意义的改变。我们知道组装的食品袋将帮助近 900 个家庭庆祝感恩节，这对我们的团队来说是一次特别有影响力的活动。NTN 非常感谢有机会支持埃尔克格罗夫镇食品储藏室及其全年提供的重要服务。”

paras.en: Community Engagement Program Supports Local Organizations
paras.zh: 社区参与计划支持当地组织

paras.en: NTN launched its Community Spirit & Engagement Program in January 2023. The program reflects the company’s commitment to responsible, ethical operations and supporting communities where it operates.
paras.zh: NTN 于 2023 年 1 月启动了社区精神和参与计划。该计划反映了公司对负责任、道德运营和支持其运营所在社区的承诺。

paras.en: Its goals include contributing time and resources to charitable organizations and encouraging employees to participate in their communities. The program also seeks to build partnerships with other groups and organizations.
paras.zh: 其目标包括为慈善组织贡献时间和资源，并鼓励员工参与社区活动。该计划还寻求与其他团体和组织建立伙伴关系。

paras.en: Food Pantry Serves 1,100 Families Monthly
paras.zh: 食品储藏室每月为 1,100 个家庭提供服务

paras.en: The Elk Grove Township Food Pantry provides food assistance and related support services to residents facing food insecurity. The pantry serves approximately 1,100 families monthly through a client-choice model. This approach allows households to access nutritious food and household essentials in a convenient, dignified manner.
paras.zh: 埃尔克格罗夫镇食品储藏室为面临粮食不安全的居民提供粮食援助和相关支持服务。该食品储藏室每月通过客户选择模式为大约 1,100 个家庭提供服务。这种方法使家庭能够以方便、有尊严的方式获得营养食品和家庭必需品。

paras.en: Through partnerships with community organizations, donors and volunteers, the pantry helps local families access resources throughout the year. The pantry expects to distribute the Thanksgiving food bags from the event to nearly 900 families this holiday season.
paras.zh: 通过与社区组织、捐助者和志愿者的合作，食品储藏室全年帮助当地家庭获取资源。该食品储藏室预计将在这个节日期间向近 900 个家庭分发感恩节食品袋。

articles.title: The 45-Day Rule: How Parts Stores Stop Financing Their Customers
articles.author: Bob Morgan

paras.en: Every parts store has an account like this. The shop buys a lot. The owner is a good guy. He pays — eventually. Meanwhile he’s 50 to 90 days out and asking for another special order “by Thursday.”
paras.zh: 每个配件店都有一个这样的帐户。店里买的很多。店主是个好人。他最终付出了代价。与此同时，他有 50 到 90 天的时间，并要求“在周四之前”再下一份特别订单。

paras.en: Here’s the hard truth I learned after about 15 years running stores on Long Island: volume you don’t collect isn’t volume. It’s a loan you never approved. Most stores aren’t short on sales. They’re short on cash because they’re quietly running a bank for their customers, with the special-order desk as the loan window.
paras.zh: 这是我在长岛经营商店大约 15 年之后学到的残酷事实：你不收集的数量就不是数量。这是一笔您从未批准过的贷款。大多数商店都不缺销售。他们缺乏现金，因为他们悄悄地为客户经营一家银行，以特殊订单柜台作为贷款窗口。

paras.en: The fix isn’t a collections agency or a nasty letter. It’s one rule, written down and used every single time.
paras.zh: 解决办法不是催收机构或令人讨厌的信件。这是一条规则，写下来并每次都使用。

paras.en: If an account is 45 or more days past due and they want a special order, the special waits until the money is in the building.
paras.zh: 如果账户逾期 45 天或以上，并且他们想要特殊订单，则特殊订单会等到钱到达大楼后才进行。

paras.en: That’s it. Shelf stock can still go out for cash. The relationship stays intact. But you stop ordering non-returnable, hard-to-restock parts for an account that hasn’t paid for the last batch.
paras.zh: 就是这样。货架库存仍然可以换取现金。关系保持完好。但您会停止为上一批尚未付款的帐户订购不可退货、难以补货的零件。

paras.en: Why special orders? A stocked part sold on account is a receivable. A special order for a slow-paying account is a receivable plus freight, a restocking fee and a part you may end up owning if the job falls through. That’s where slow accounts do the most damage, so that’s where the line goes.
paras.zh: 为什么要特殊订单？赊销的库存零件是应收账款。慢付款帐户的特殊订单是应收账款加上运费、补货费以及如果工作失败您最终可能拥有的部分。这就是缓慢的帐户造成最大损害的地方，所以这就是线路的所在。

paras.en: Before the rule works, everyone at the counter has to agree on what “45 days” means. I count days past the due date, not days since the invoice. A Net 30 invoice dated June 12 is due July 12. On September 2, it’s 52 days past due — over the line.
paras.zh: 在规则生效之前，柜台上的每个人都必须就“45 天”的含义达成一致。我计算的是到期日之后的天数，而不是发票后的天数。日期为 6 月 12 日的 Net 30 发票应于 7 月 12 日到期。到 9 月 2 日，已逾期 52 天。

paras.en: If you’d rather age from the invoice date, fine. Pick one method, write it on the rule and never switch mid-argument. If your company already has a hold policy, use its number. The discipline matters more than the exact day.
paras.zh: 如果您希望从发票日期算起，没问题。选择一种方法，将其写在规则上，并且永远不要在争论中途改变。如果您的公司已有保留政策，请使用其号码。纪律比具体的日子更重要。

paras.en: The 45-day rule works because nobody gets surprised by it. The steps before it do the heavy lifting:
paras.zh: 45 天的规则之所以有效，是因为没有人对此感到惊讶。完成繁重工作之前的步骤：

paras.en: - Day 30 — a reminder, not a threat. “Invoice 1844 is at 30. Card or check on the next stop?”
paras.zh: - 第 30 天——提醒，而不是威胁。 “发票 1844 是 30。下一站刷卡还是支票？”

paras.en: - Day 35–40 — a human call. Not another statement they’re already ignoring. A person, by name, on the phone.
paras.zh: - 第 35-40 天 — 人工召唤。这不是他们已经忽视的另一个声明。一个人，叫出名字，正在打电话。

paras.en: - Day 45 — credit hold for new specials. Shelf can still be cash. Specials wait.
paras.zh: - 第 45 天 — 新特价商品的积分保留。货架上还是可以现金的。特价等。

paras.en: - Day 60 — hard hold. No “just this once” unless a manager puts the amount and the date in writing.
paras.zh: - 第 60 天 — 坚守。除非经理以书面形式注明金额和日期，否则不能“仅此一次”。

paras.en: Most accounts never reach day 45 once the day-30 and day-35 touches actually happen. The rule is the backstop, not the first move.
paras.zh: 一旦第 30 天和第 35 天的接触实际发生，大多数帐户永远不会到达第 45 天。规则是后盾，而不是第一步。

paras.en: Give your counter people the exact words. Nobody should improvise a credit conversation with a regular at the register. At day 45:
paras.zh: 向柜台人员提供准确的词语。任何人都不应该在收银台与常客即兴进行信用对话。第 45 天：

paras.en: “I can keep selling you what’s here if we’re cash. I can’t put another special in motion until 1844 is clear. I need you current so I can keep saying yes.”
paras.zh: “如果我们有现金，我可以继续向你出售这里的商品。在 1844 年明确之前，我无法推出另一个特价商品。我需要你提供最新信息，这样我才能继续答应。”

paras.en: “I like working with you. I can’t keep shipping on a 60-day balance. Let’s pick an amount for this week and a date for the rest. Until that starts, we’re cash.”
paras.zh: “我喜欢和你一起工作。我无法在 60 天的余额中继续发货。让我们选择本周的金额和其余的日期。在那之前，我们都是现金。”

paras.en: Those lines don’t threaten and don’t apologize. They state the rule and offer a path back. “I need you current so I can keep saying yes” puts you and the customer on the same side.
paras.zh: 这些台词既不构成威胁，也不构成道歉。他们陈述规则并提供返回路径。 “我需要你保持最新状态，这样我才能一直说“是””让你和客户站在同一边。

paras.en: The most common way the rule breaks: “I’m not paying until you fix that core credit.” Freeze the one disputed line and research it. The rest of the balance is still due. Don’t let a $40 question hold up a $4,000 balance.
paras.zh: 最常见的违反规则的方式是：“在你修复核心信用之前，我不会付款。”冻结一条有争议的线路并进行研究。其余余额仍需支付。不要让 40 美元的问题占用 4,000 美元的余额。

paras.en: And if yelling breaks the rule, you’ve just taught every shop in town that yelling works. The rule has to hold for your biggest account, too.
paras.zh: 如果大喊大叫违反了规则，那么你就已经告诉镇上的每一家商店大喊大叫是有效的。该规则也必须适用于您最大的帐户。

paras.en: A rule nobody checks turns into a suggestion. Once a week — I do it in a short Monday meeting — pull your aging and look at three things:
paras.zh: 无人检查的规则变成了建议。每周一次——我在周一的一次简短会议上进行——拉动你的衰老，看看三件事：

paras.en: - Total dollars 45+ and 60+ days past due.
paras.zh: - 逾期 45 天以上和 60 天以上的总金额。

paras.en: - A name and a next-call date next to every one of those accounts.
paras.zh: - 每个帐户旁边都有姓名和下次通话日期。

paras.en: - Any special order that went out to a 45+ account, and who approved it.
paras.zh: - 发送至 45+ 帐户的任何特殊订单以及谁批准的。

paras.en: A simple example (invented numbers): a store has $6,940 at 45+ days past due across two accounts. A fleet account on that list calls for a special. The counter person checks the list and uses the day-45 line. The special gets placed the afternoon the check clears. No fight, no exception, and the store isn’t fronting more parts to a customer who already owes $4,200.
paras.zh: 一个简单的例子（虚构的数字）：一家商店的两个帐户逾期 45 天以上，有 6,940 美元。该名单上的车队帐户需要特殊服务。柜台人员检查清单并使用第 45 天的线路。特价商品将在支票兑现的下午进行。没有打架，没有例外，商店也不会向已经欠下 4,200 美元的顾客提供更多零件。

paras.en: - Export or write down your current aging.
paras.zh: - 导出或写下您当前的年龄。

paras.en: - Highlight everything 45+ and 60+ days past due.
paras.zh: - 突出显示逾期 45 天以上和 60 天以上的所有内容。

paras.en: - Put a name and a next-call date on every one.
paras.zh: - 在每个人身上写上姓名和下次通话日期。

paras.en: - Write the special-order rule on a sticky note at the counter where everyone can see it.
paras.zh: - 将特殊订单规则写在柜台的便利贴上，让每个人都能看到。

paras.en: You can like the shop. You can need the volume. You still collect. The 45-day rule is how a parts store stops financing its customers and gets back to selling them parts.
paras.zh: 你可以喜欢这家商店。您可能需要音量。你还是收藏吧。 45 天规则规定了零部件商店如何停止向客户提供融资并重新向他们销售零部件。
